    <script>
        const ADMIN_EMAILS = ['juhsim@live.com', 'zinidnosreme@gmail.com', 'admin@taskflow.com', 'admin@empresa.com'];

        // Data Local Correta (Fuso do Brasil)
        function getLocalTodayString() {
            const d = new Date();
            const year = d.getFullYear();
            const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
            const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
            return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // GERADOR UNIVERSAL DE GRÁFICOS DE PIZZA (SVG PURO 100% OFFLINE)
        // =====================================================================
        window.createSvgPieChart = function(data, options = {}) {
            const size = options.size || 220;
            const cx = size / 2;
            const cy = size / 2;
            const r = options.radius || (size / 2 - 16);
            const innerRadius = options.donut ? (r * 0.55) : 0;
            
            const validData = (data || []).filter(item => item && Number(item.value) > 0);
            const total = validData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.value), 0);

            if (total === 0) {
                return `
                <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-gray-500 bg-gray-950/50 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 text-xs text-center space-y-1">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-pie text-2xl text-gray-600 mb-1"></i>
                    <span class="font-medium">Nenhum dado registrado neste período.</span>
                </div>`;
            }

            let cumulativeAngle = -Math.PI / 2; // Inicia às 12 horas
            const slicesSvg = [];
            const legendItems = [];

            validData.forEach((slice) => {
                const fraction = Number(slice.value) / total;
                const sliceAngle = fraction * 2 * Math.PI;
                const percent = Math.round(fraction * 100);

                const startAngle = cumulativeAngle;
                const endAngle = cumulativeAngle + sliceAngle;
                cumulativeAngle = endAngle;

                const x1 = cx + r * Math.cos(startAngle);
                const y1 = cy + r * Math.sin(startAngle);
                const x2 = cx + r * Math.cos(endAngle);
                const y2 = cy + r * Math.sin(endAngle);

                const largeArc = sliceAngle > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;

                let pathD = '';
                if (fraction >= 0.999) {
                    if (innerRadius > 0) {
                        pathD = `M ${cx} ${cy - r} A ${r} ${r} 0 1 1 ${cx} ${cy + r} A ${r} ${r} 0 1 1 ${cx} ${cy - r} M ${cx} ${cy - innerRadius} A ${innerRadius} ${innerRadius} 0 1 0 ${cx} ${cy + innerRadius} A ${innerRadius} ${innerRadius} 0 1 0 ${cx} ${cy - innerRadius} Z`;
                    } else {
                        pathD = `M ${cx} ${cy - r} A ${r} ${r} 0 1 1 ${cx} ${cy + r} A ${r} ${r} 0 1 1 ${cx} ${cy - r} Z`;
                    }
                } else if (innerRadius > 0) {
                    const ix1 = cx + innerRadius * Math.cos(endAngle);
                    const iy1 = cy + innerRadius * Math.sin(endAngle);
                    const ix2 = cx + innerRadius * Math.cos(startAngle);
                    const iy2 = cy + innerRadius * Math.sin(startAngle);
                    pathD = `M ${x1} ${y1} A ${r} ${r} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${x2} ${y2} L ${ix1} ${iy1} A ${innerRadius} ${innerRadius} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${ix2} ${iy2} Z`;
                } else {
                    pathD = `M ${cx} ${cy} L ${x1} ${y1} A ${r} ${r} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${x2} ${y2} Z`;
                }

                slicesSvg.push(`
                    <path d="${pathD}" fill="${slice.color}" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" class="transition-opacity duration-200 hover:opacity-80">
                        <title>${slice.label}: ${slice.value} (${percent}%)</title>
                    </path>
                `);

                legendItems.push(`
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800/40 transition text-xs">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                            <span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full shrink-0 shadow-sm" style="background-color: ${slice.color};"></span>
                            <span class="text-gray-200 truncate font-medium">${slice.label}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px]">
                            <span class="text-white font-bold">${slice.value}</span>
                            <span class="text-gray-400 font-semibold">(${percent}%)</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `);
            });

            return `
            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4 p-3 bg-gray-950/70 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl shadow-lg">
                <div class="relative shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 ${size} ${size}" class="drop-shadow-md">
                        ${slicesSvg.join('')}
                    </svg>
                    ${options.donut ? `
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center pointer-events-none text-center">
                            <span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-extrabold text-gray-400 tracking-wider">${options.centerLabel || 'Total'}</span>
                            <span class="text-lg font-black text-white">${total}</span>
                        </div>
                    ` : ''}
                </div>
                <div class="flex-1 w-full space-y-1 custom-scrollbar max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                    <div class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-wider pb-1 border-b border-gray-800/80 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span>Fatias & Legenda</span>
                        <span class="text-indigo-400 font-mono">${total} total</span>
                    </div>
                    ${legendItems.join('')}
                </div>
            </div>`;
        };

        // Auto-detecção de APK Android Offline com Internet ativa -> Redireciona para versão online mais recente
        if (window.location.protocol === 'file:' && !window.location.href.includes('local=1') && navigator.onLine) {
            console.log("APK em modo local com conexão ativa. Redirecionando para nuvem...");
            window.location.href = "https://thelorddada.github.io/taskflow/?v=" + Date.now();
        }

        // PWA Service Worker com detecção automática e auto-reload
        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            let swRefreshing = false;
            navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('controllerchange', () => {
                if (!swRefreshing) {
                    swRefreshing = true;
                    window.location.reload();
                }
            });
            window.addEventListener('load', () => {
                navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js?v=1793316684038').then(reg => {
                    if (reg) reg.update();
                }).catch(() => {});
            });
        }

        // Função global de recarregamento forçado (limpa ServiceWorker, Caches e recarrega)
        window.forceAppReload = async function(interactive = true) {
            if (interactive && window.syncManager) {
                syncManager.showToast("Buscando atualizações e limpando cache...");
            }
            try {
                if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
                    const registrations = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations();
                    for (let reg of registrations) {
                        await reg.unregister();
                    }
                }
                if ('caches' in window) {
                    const keys = await caches.keys();
                    for (let k of keys) {
                        await caches.delete(k);
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {
                console.warn("Erro ao limpar caches:", e);
            }
            if (window.AndroidApp && typeof window.AndroidApp.reloadOnline === 'function') {
                window.AndroidApp.reloadOnline();
            } else {
                const targetUrl = (window.location.origin && window.location.origin !== 'null' && window.location.protocol !== 'file:')
                    ? window.location.origin + window.location.pathname
                    : 'https://thelorddada.github.io/taskflow/';
                window.location.href = targetUrl + '?v=' + Date.now();
            }
        };

        // 1. GERENCIADOR DE TAREFAS
        class TaskApp {
            constructor() {
                this.tasks = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_work_tasks')) || [];
                this.currentFilter = 'all';
                this.absenceFilter = 'all';

                this.tempImage = null;
                this.mediaStream = null;
                this.pomoInterval = null;
                this.pomoTime = 25 * 60;
                this.pomoRunning = false;
            }

            init() {
                const initialLen = this.tasks.length;
                this.tasks = this.tasks.filter(t => t.id !== 'test_123' && t.id !== 'test_task_456' && t.id !== 'cors_test_1');
                if (this.tasks.length !== initialLen) {
                    this.saveLocally();
                }
                this.render();
            }

            saveLocally() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_work_tasks', JSON.stringify(this.tasks));
                } catch(e) {
                    console.warn("Storage quota limit reached, maintaining in active session memory:", e);
                }
                this.render();
                if (window.admin && typeof admin.renderAdminTasks === 'function') { try { admin.renderAdminTasks(); } catch(e) {} }
            }

            playNotificationSound() {
                if (!window.auth || !auth.currentUser) return;
                try {
                    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
                    if (!AudioCtx) return;
                    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
                    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
                    const playTone = (freq, start, duration) => {
                        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                        const gain = ctx.createGain();
                        osc.type = 'sine';
                        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + start);
                        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime + start);
                        gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.28, ctx.currentTime + start + 0.02);
                        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + start + duration);
                        osc.connect(gain);
                        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                        osc.start(ctx.currentTime + start);
                        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + start + duration);
                    };
                    playTone(1046.50, 0.00, 0.22); // C6
                    playTone(1567.98, 0.12, 0.38); // G6
                } catch(e) {}
            }

            playAnnouncementAlertSound() {
                if (!window.auth || !auth.currentUser) return;
                try {
                    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
                    if (!AudioCtx) return;
                    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
                    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
                    const playTone = (freq, start, duration) => {
                        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                        const gain = ctx.createGain();
                        osc.type = 'sine';
                        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + start);
                        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime + start);
                        gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.35, ctx.currentTime + start + 0.02);
                        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + start + duration);
                        osc.connect(gain);
                        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                        osc.start(ctx.currentTime + start);
                        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + start + duration);
                    };
                    playTone(523.25, 0.00, 0.18); // C5
                    playTone(659.25, 0.14, 0.18); // E5
                    playTone(783.99, 0.28, 0.20); // G5
                    playTone(1046.50, 0.44, 0.42); // C6
                } catch(e) {}
            }

            playTaskCompleteSound() {
                if (!window.auth || !auth.currentUser) return;
                try {
                    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
                    if (!AudioCtx) return;
                    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
                    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
                    const playTone = (freq, start, duration) => {
                        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                        const gain = ctx.createGain();
                        osc.type = 'triangle';
                        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + start);
                        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime + start);
                        gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime + start + 0.02);
                        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + start + duration);
                        osc.connect(gain);
                        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                        osc.start(ctx.currentTime + start);
                        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + start + duration);
                    };
                    playTone(523.25, 0.00, 0.15);
                    playTone(659.25, 0.10, 0.15);
                    playTone(783.99, 0.20, 0.35);
                } catch(e) {}
            }

            dispatchNotification(title, message) {
                if (!window.auth || !auth.currentUser) return;
                if (window.AndroidApp && typeof window.AndroidApp.showNotification === 'function') {
                    try {
                        window.AndroidApp.showNotification(title, message);
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
                if ('Notification' in window) {
                    if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
                        try {
                            new Notification(title, { body: message, icon: 'apple-touch-icon.png' });
                        } catch(e) {}
                    } else if (Notification.permission === 'default') {
                        Notification.requestPermission().then(perm => {
                            if (perm === 'granted') {
                                new Notification(title, { body: message });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            testNotificationSound() {

            }

            setFilter(filter) {
                this.currentFilter = filter;
                if (window.currentMainView !== 'tasks' && typeof window.switchMainView === 'function') {
                    window.switchMainView('tasks');
                }
                
                ['all', 'mine', 'today', 'upcoming'].forEach(f => {

                ['all', 'mine', 'today', 'upcoming'].forEach(f => {

                        if (f === filter) {
                            topBtn.className = "shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap py-1.5 px-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md";

                        }

                ['all', 'mine', 'today', 'upcoming'].forEach(f => {

            // ==========================================
            // MÉTODOS DE TAREFAS RECORRENTES / CHECKPOINTS
            // ==========================================
            toggleRecurrenceFields(checked) {
                const fields = document.getElementById('task-recurrent-fields');
                if (fields) {
                    fields.classList.toggle('hidden', !checked);
                }
                if (checked) {
                    this.updateRecurrenceSummary();
                }
            }

            calculateRecurrenceCheckpoints(mode, startTime, endTime) {
                const list = [];
                if (!startTime || !endTime) return list;

                const [sH, sM] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
                const [eH, eM] = endTime.split(':').map(Number);

                const startMinutes = sH * 60 + sM;
                const endMinutes = eH * 60 + eM;

                if (endMinutes <= startMinutes) {
                    list.push(startTime);
                    list.push(endTime);
                    return list;
                }

                if (mode.startsWith('interval_')) {
                    let step = 60;
                    if (mode === 'interval_30m') step = 30;
                    else if (mode === 'interval_1h') step = 60;
                    else if (mode === 'interval_2h') step = 120;
                    else if (mode === 'interval_3h') step = 180;
                    else if (mode === 'interval_4h') step = 240;

                    for (let m = startMinutes; m <= endMinutes; m += step) {
                        const hh = String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
                        const mm = String(m % 60).padStart(2, '0');
                        list.push(hh + ':' + mm);
                    }
                } else if (mode.startsWith('times_')) {
                    const times = parseInt(mode.replace('times_', ''), 10) || 3;
                    if (times <= 1) {
                        list.push(startTime);
                    } else {
                        const totalSpan = endMinutes - startMinutes;
                        const step = totalSpan / (times - 1);
                        for (let i = 0; i < times; i++) {
                            const curM = Math.round(startMinutes + (i * step));
                            const hh = String(Math.floor(curM / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
                            const mm = String(curM % 60).padStart(2, '0');
                            list.push(hh + ':' + mm);
                        }
                    }
                }

                return list;
            }

            updateRecurrenceSummary() {
                const mode = document.getElementById('task-recurrence-mode')?.value || 'interval_2h';
                const start = document.getElementById('task-recurrence-start')?.value || '07:00';
                const end = document.getElementById('task-recurrence-end')?.value || '19:00';
                const preview = document.getElementById('task-recurrence-checkpoints-preview');

                const points = this.calculateRecurrenceCheckpoints(mode, start, end);
                if (preview) {
                    if (points.length === 0) {
                        preview.innerHTML = '<span class="text-rose-400">Nenhum horário válido.</span>';
                    } else {
                        preview.innerHTML = points.map(p => `
                            <span class="bg-indigo-900/60 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-700/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono font-bold">
                                ${p}
                            </span>
                        `).join('');
                    }
                }
            }

            toggleRecurrenceCheckpoint(taskId, checkpointTime) {
                const task = this.tasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
                if (!task || !task.recurrence) return;

                const user = (window.auth && auth.currentUser) ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Equipe';
                
                if (!Array.isArray(task.recurrence.checkpoints)) {
                    task.recurrence.checkpoints = [];
                }

                const cp = task.recurrence.checkpoints.find(c => c.time === checkpointTime);
                if (cp) {
                    cp.completed = !cp.completed;
                    cp.completedBy = cp.completed ? user : null;
                    cp.completedAt = cp.completed ? Date.now() : null;
                } else {
                    task.recurrence.checkpoints.push({
                        time: checkpointTime,
                        completed: true,
                        completedBy: user,
                        completedAt: Date.now()
                    });
                }

                // Se todos os checkpoints forem concluídos, marca a tarefa geral como concluída
                const allDone = task.recurrence.checkpoints.length > 0 && task.recurrence.checkpoints.every(c => c.completed);
                task.completed = allDone;
                task.completedBy = allDone ? user : null;
                task.updatedAt = Date.now();

                this.saveLocally();
                this.render();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.showToast(cp && cp.completed ? `✓ Validação das ${checkpointTime} concluída por ${user}!` : `Validação das ${checkpointTime} reaberta.`);
                }

                // Dispara sincronização em nuvem
                try {
                    if (window.syncManager && typeof syncManager.broadcastChange === 'function') {
                        syncManager.broadcastChange('TASK_UPDATE', task);
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }

            openModal(taskOrId = null) {
                // Checa se o modo somente leitura para colaboradores está ativo
                if (window.admin && admin.config && admin.config.adminOnlyCreate && (!auth.currentUser || !auth.currentUser.isAdmin)) {
                    alert("Aviso: Apenas os Administradores podem criar novas tarefas no momento.\nSe você é o Administrador, faça login com sua conta.");
                    return;
                }

                let task = null;
                if (taskOrId && typeof taskOrId === 'object') {
                    task = taskOrId;
                } else if (taskOrId) {
                    task = this.tasks.find(t => t.id == taskOrId) || null;
                }

                this.closeCamera();
                this.cameraSessionPhotos = [];

                const m = document.getElementById('task-modal');
                if (m) {
                    m.classList.remove('hidden');
                    m.style.display = 'flex';
                    m.style.zIndex = '99999';
                }

                this.populateInconsistencySectors();

                const openChatContainer = document.getElementById('task-open-chat-container');
                const openChatLabel = document.getElementById('task-open-chat-label');

                if(task) {
                    document.getElementById('modal-title').innerText = 'Editar Tarefa';
                    document.getElementById('task-id').value = task.id;
                    document.getElementById('task-title').value = task.title || '';
                    document.getElementById('task-assignee').value = task.assignee || '';
                    document.getElementById('task-date').value = task.date || '';
                    document.getElementById('task-priority').value = task.priority || 'media';

                    // Fotos múltiplas com suporte a legado (task.images ou task.image)
                    if (task.images && Array.isArray(task.images)) {
                        this.currentTaskPhotos = [...task.images];
                    } else if (task.image) {
                        this.currentTaskPhotos = [task.image];
                    } else {
                        this.currentTaskPhotos = [];
                    }

                    // Inconsistência Operacional
                    const incToggle = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-toggle');
                    if (task.inconsistency && task.inconsistency.hasInconsistency) {
                        if (incToggle) incToggle.checked = true;
                        this.toggleInconsistencyFields(true);
                        const rSelect = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-reason');
                        const sSelect = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-sector');
                        const nText = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-notes');
                        if (rSelect) rSelect.value = task.inconsistency.reason || '';
                        if (sSelect) sSelect.value = task.inconsistency.sector || '';
                        if (nText) nText.value = task.inconsistency.notes || '';
                    } else {
                        if (incToggle) incToggle.checked = false;
                        this.toggleInconsistencyFields(false);
                    }

                    this.currentChatTaskId = task.id;

                    // Mostra botão para abrir chat dedicado desta tarefa
                    if (openChatContainer) openChatContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (openChatLabel) {
                        const count = (task.comments && Array.isArray(task.comments)) ? task.comments.length : 0;
                        openChatLabel.innerText = `Abrir Chat da Tarefa (${count} msg${count !== 1 ? 's' : ''})`;
                    }
                } else {
                    document.getElementById('modal-title').innerText = 'Nova Tarefa';
                    document.getElementById('task-form').reset();
                    document.getElementById('task-id').value = '';
                    document.getElementById('task-date').value = getLocalTodayString();
                    document.getElementById('task-assignee').value = auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : '';
                    this.currentTaskPhotos = [];
                    this.currentChatTaskId = null;

                    const incToggle = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-toggle');
                    if (incToggle) incToggle.checked = false;
                    this.toggleInconsistencyFields(false);

                    // Oculta botão de chat ao criar nova tarefa
                    if (openChatContainer) openChatContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                }

                this.renderTaskPhotosPreview();
            }

            closeModal() {
                this.closeCamera();
                const m = document.getElementById('task-modal');
                if (m) {
                    m.classList.add('hidden');
                    m.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            openTaskChat(taskId) {

            }

            closeTaskChat() {

            }

            openTaskChatFromModal() {

                    this.openViewTask(this.currentChatTaskId, 'chat');
                }
            }

            toggleInconsistencyFields(checked) {
                const fields = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-fields');
                if (fields) {
                    if (checked) fields.classList.remove('hidden');
                    else fields.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

            populateInconsistencySectors() {
                const select = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-sector');
                if (!select) return;

                const sectors = [
                    'Mercearia / Alimentos', 'Bebidas / Adega', 'Frente de Caixa', 
                    'Açougue / Carnes', 'Padaria / Confeitaria', 'Frios & Laticínios', 
                    'FLV / Hortifrúti', 'Depósito & Estoque', 'Prevenção de Perdas / Fiscal', 'Geral / Loja'
                ];

                // Acrescenta departamentos cadastrados pela administração
                const customDepts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_custom_departments') || '[]');
                customDepts.forEach(d => {
                    const name = typeof d === 'string' ? d : d.name;
                    if (name && !sectors.includes(name)) sectors.push(name);
                });

                select.innerHTML = sectors.map(s => `<option value="${s}">${s}</option>`).join('');
            }

            saveInconsistency(inc) {
                let list = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_inconsistencies') || '[]');
                // Se já existir para esta mesma tarefa/posto, substitui
                list = list.filter(item => item.id !== inc.id);
                list.unshift(inc);
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_inconsistencies', JSON.stringify(list));

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'INCONSISTENCY_ADD',
                        inconsistency: inc
                    });
                }
            }

            renderTaskPhotosPreview() {
                const gallery = document.getElementById('task-photos-gallery');
                const countBadge = document.getElementById('task-photos-count');

                const totalPhotos = this.currentTaskPhotos ? this.currentTaskPhotos.length : 0;
                if (countBadge) countBadge.innerText = totalPhotos;
                if (!gallery) return;

                if (!this.currentTaskPhotos || this.currentTaskPhotos.length === 0) {
                    gallery.innerHTML = '<span class="text-[11px] text-gray-500 italic py-1">Nenhuma foto anexada a esta tarefa.</span>';
                    return;
                }

                let html = this.currentTaskPhotos.map((src, idx) => `
                    <div class="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-gray-700 shrink-0 group shadow-md bg-gray-950">
                        <img src="${src}" onclick="app.openTaskPhotosGallery(${idx})" title="Clique para ampliar na galeria" class="w-full h-full object-cover cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition">
                        <button type="button" onclick="app.removePhoto(${idx})" title="Remover esta foto" class="absolute top-1 right-1 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] shadow-lg transition active:scale-90">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                `).join('');

                // Botão de atalho para adicionar mais fotos direto na galeria
                html += `
                    <button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('task-image-input').click()" title="Adicionar mais fotos da galeria" class="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-gray-700 hover:border-indigo-500 bg-gray-900/60 hover:bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-indigo-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 transition shrink-0 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-xs"></i>
                        <span class="text-[9px] font-bold">+ Foto</span>
                    </button>
                `;

                gallery.innerHTML = html;
            }

            removePhoto(idx) {
                if (this.currentTaskPhotos && this.currentTaskPhotos[idx] !== undefined) {
                    this.currentTaskPhotos.splice(idx, 1);
                    this.renderTaskPhotosPreview();
                }
            }

            compressImage(fileOrDataUrl, maxWidth = 800, quality = 0.7) {
                return new Promise((resolve) => {
                    const img = new Image();
                    let blobUrl = null;

                    img.onload = () => {
                        if (blobUrl) {
                            try { URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl); } catch(e) {}
                        }
                        let w = img.width;
                        let h = img.height;
                        if (w > maxWidth || h > maxWidth) {
                            if (w > h) {
                                h = Math.round((h * maxWidth) / w);
                                w = maxWidth;
                            } else {
                                w = Math.round((w * maxWidth) / h);
                                h = maxWidth;
                            }
                        }
                        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                        canvas.width = w;
                        canvas.height = h;
                        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
                        const compressed = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
                        resolve(compressed);
                    };

                    img.onerror = () => {
                        if (blobUrl) {
                            try { URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl); } catch(e) {}
                        }
                        resolve(null);
                    };

                    if (typeof fileOrDataUrl === 'string') {
                        img.src = fileOrDataUrl;
                    } else if (window.URL && typeof window.URL.createObjectURL === 'function') {
                        try {
                            blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(fileOrDataUrl);
                            img.src = blobUrl;
                        } catch(e) {
                            const reader = new FileReader();
                            reader.onload = (e) => { img.src = e.target.result; };
                            reader.onerror = () => resolve(null);
                            reader.readAsDataURL(fileOrDataUrl);
                        }
                    } else {
                        const reader = new FileReader();
                        reader.onload = (e) => { img.src = e.target.result; };
                        reader.onerror = () => resolve(null);
                        reader.readAsDataURL(fileOrDataUrl);
                    }
                });
            }

            async handleImageUpload(e) {
                const files = e.target.files;
                if (!files || files.length === 0) return;

                const count = files.length;
                if (window.syncManager) window.syncManager.showToast(`Processando ${count} foto(s)...`);

                for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
                    const file = files[i];
                    try {
                        const compressed = await this.compressImage(file, 800, 0.7);
                        if (compressed) {
                            if (!this.currentTaskPhotos) this.currentTaskPhotos = [];
                            this.currentTaskPhotos.push(compressed);
                        }
                    } catch(err) {
                        console.warn("Erro ao comprimir imagem:", err);
                    }
                }

                this.renderTaskPhotosPreview();
                if (window.syncManager) window.syncManager.showToast(`✓ ${count} foto(s) anexada(s)!`);
                e.target.value = ''; // Permite selecionar mais fotos em seguida
            }

            async openCamera() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('camera-modal');
                const video = document.getElementById('camera-stream');

                // Garante que o modal esteja visível com o maior z-index
                if (modal) {
                    modal.style.zIndex = '100000';
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                }

                this.cameraSessionPhotos = [];
                this.updateCameraSessionUI();

                if (navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
                    try {
                        this.mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
                            video: { 
                                facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' },
                                width: { ideal: 1280 },
                                height: { ideal: 720 }
                            },
                            audio: false
                        });
                        if (video) {
                            video.srcObject = this.mediaStream;
                            video.play().catch(() => {});
                        }
                        return;
                    } catch(err) {
                        console.warn("getUserMedia falhou ou foi bloqueado:", err);
                    }
                }

                // Fallback automático para a câmera nativa do celular se não puder rodar stream de vídeo
                this.closeCamera();
                const fallbackInput = document.getElementById('camera-fallback-input');
                if (fallbackInput) {
                    if (window.syncManager) window.syncManager.showToast("Abrindo câmera do aparelho...");
                    fallbackInput.click();
                }
            }

            triggerNativeCamera() {
                this.closeCamera();
                const fallbackInput = document.getElementById('camera-fallback-input');
                if (fallbackInput) {
                    fallbackInput.click();
                }
            }

            closeCamera() {
                if (this.mediaStream) {
                    try {
                        this.mediaStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
                    } catch(e) {}
                    this.mediaStream = null;
                }
                const video = document.getElementById('camera-stream');
                if (video) video.srcObject = null;

                const modal = document.getElementById('camera-modal');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            async capturePhoto() {
                const video = document.getElementById('camera-stream');
                if (!video || !video.videoWidth) {
                    if (window.syncManager) window.syncManager.showToast("Iniciando câmera... Aguarde 1 segundo.");
                    return;
                }

                // Efeito visual de Flash no visor
                const flash = document.getElementById('camera-shutter-flash');
                if (flash) {
                    flash.style.opacity = '0.85';
                    setTimeout(() => { flash.style.opacity = '0'; }, 150);
                }

                let w = video.videoWidth || 800;
                let h = video.videoHeight || 600;
                const maxDim = 800;
                if (w > maxDim || h > maxDim) {
                    if (w > h) {
                        h = Math.round((h * maxDim) / w);
                        w = maxDim;
                    } else {
                        w = Math.round((w * maxDim) / h);
                        h = maxDim;
                    }
                }

                const canvas = document.getElementById('capture-canvas') || document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = w;
                canvas.height = h;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, w, h);
                const captured = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7);

                if (!this.currentTaskPhotos) this.currentTaskPhotos = [];
                this.currentTaskPhotos.push(captured);

                if (!this.cameraSessionPhotos) this.cameraSessionPhotos = [];
                this.cameraSessionPhotos.push(captured);

                this.updateCameraSessionUI();
                this.renderTaskPhotosPreview();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.showToast(`✓ Foto ${this.cameraSessionPhotos.length} capturada! Pode tirar mais.`);
                }
            }

            updateCameraSessionUI() {
                const countBadge = document.getElementById('camera-session-count');
                const strip = document.getElementById('camera-session-strip');
                const btnFinish = document.getElementById('camera-btn-finish');

                const totalSession = (this.cameraSessionPhotos && this.cameraSessionPhotos.length) || 0;
                const totalAll = (this.currentTaskPhotos && this.currentTaskPhotos.length) || 0;

                if (countBadge) {
                    countBadge.innerText = `${totalAll} fotos`;
                }

                if (btnFinish) {
                    btnFinish.innerHTML = `<span>Anexar (${totalAll})</span> <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>`;
                }

                if (strip) {
                    if (!this.cameraSessionPhotos || this.cameraSessionPhotos.length === 0) {
                        strip.innerHTML = '<span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 italic px-2">Toque no círculo branco abaixo para tirar fotos.</span>';
                    } else {
                        strip.innerHTML = this.cameraSessionPhotos.map((src, sIdx) => `
                            <div class="relative w-11 h-11 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-gray-700 shrink-0 bg-black">
                                <img src="${src}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                                <span class="absolute bottom-0 right-0 bg-indigo-600 text-[8px] font-bold px-1 text-white">${sIdx + 1}</span>
                            </div>
                        `).join('');
                        strip.scrollLeft = strip.scrollWidth;
                    }
                }
            }

            finishCameraSession() {
                this.closeCamera();
                this.renderTaskPhotosPreview();
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    const total = (this.currentTaskPhotos && this.currentTaskPhotos.length) || 0;
                    window.syncManager.showToast(`✓ ${total} foto(s) anexada(s) à tarefa!`);
                }
            }

            // ==========================================
            // MODAL UNIFICADO: VISUALIZAR TAREFA
            // (FOTOS + CHAT & DISCUSSÃO EQUIPE)
            // ==========================================
            openViewTask(taskIdOrTarget, initialTab = 'auto', initialIndex = 0) {
                let task = null;
                let images = [];
                let title = 'Visualizar Tarefa';

                if (taskIdOrTarget && typeof taskIdOrTarget === 'object' && !Array.isArray(taskIdOrTarget)) {
                    task = taskIdOrTarget;
                } else if (typeof taskIdOrTarget === 'string' || typeof taskIdOrTarget === 'number') {
                    task = this.tasks.find(t => t.id == taskIdOrTarget);
                    if (!task && (String(taskIdOrTarget).startsWith('data:') || String(taskIdOrTarget).startsWith('http') || String(taskIdOrTarget).startsWith('blob:') || String(taskIdOrTarget).startsWith('/'))) {
                        images = [taskIdOrTarget];
                    }
                } else if (Array.isArray(taskIdOrTarget)) {
                    images = [...taskIdOrTarget];
                }

                if (task) {
                    this.currentViewTaskId = task.id;
                    this.currentChatTaskId = task.id;
                    title = task.title || 'Visualizar Tarefa';
                    if (task.images && Array.isArray(task.images) && task.images.length > 0) {
                        images = [...task.images];
                    } else if (task.image) {
                        images = [task.image];
                    }
                } else {
                    this.currentViewTaskId = null;
                    if (!this.currentChatTaskId) this.currentChatTaskId = null;
                }

                this.activeGalleryImages = images;
                this.activeGalleryIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(initialIndex, Math.max(0, images.length - 1)));
                this.activeGalleryTitle = title;

                // 1. Atualiza cabeçalho do modal
                const titleEl = document.getElementById('view-task-title');
                if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = title;

                const prioEl = document.getElementById('view-task-priority-badge');
                if (prioEl) {
                    if (task && task.priority) {
                        prioEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                        const p = (task.priority || '').toLowerCase();
                        prioEl.innerText = p.toUpperCase();
                        if (p === 'alta' || p === 'urgente') {
                            prioEl.className = 'text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded uppercase font-bold shrink-0 bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30';
                        } else if (p === 'baixa') {
                            prioEl.className = 'text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded uppercase font-bold shrink-0 bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30';
                        } else {
                            prioEl.className = 'text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded uppercase font-bold shrink-0 bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30';
                        }
                    } else {
                        prioEl.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }

                const assigneeEl = document.getElementById('view-task-assignee');
                if (assigneeEl) {
                    assigneeEl.innerText = `Responsável: ${task && task.assignee ? task.assignee : 'Equipe'}`;
                }

                const dateEl = document.getElementById('view-task-date');
                if (dateEl) {
                    dateEl.innerText = task && task.date ? task.date : 'Hoje';
                }

                const incBadge = document.getElementById('view-task-inc-badge');
                if (incBadge) {
                    if (task && (task.inconsistency || task.inconsistencyType || (task.inconsistencyData && task.inconsistencyData.reason))) {
                        const reason = (task.inconsistencyData && task.inconsistencyData.reason) || task.inconsistencyType || (task.inconsistency && task.inconsistency.reason) || 'Ruptura';
                        incBadge.innerText = reason;
                        incBadge.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        incBadge.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }

                // 2. Seção de fotos
                const photosContainer = document.getElementById('view-task-photos-container');
                const noPhotosState = document.getElementById('view-task-no-photos');
                const tabPhotosBadge = document.getElementById('tab-badge-photos-count');

                if (tabPhotosBadge) tabPhotosBadge.innerText = `Fotos (${images.length})`;

                if (images.length > 0) {
                    if (photosContainer) photosContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (noPhotosState) noPhotosState.classList.add('hidden');
                    this.updateGalleryUI();
                } else {
                    if (photosContainer) photosContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (noPhotosState) noPhotosState.classList.remove('hidden');
                }

                // 3. Seção de chat
                this.renderTaskChat();

                // 4. Determina aba mobile ativa
                let selectedTab = initialTab;
                if (selectedTab === 'auto') {
                    selectedTab = (images.length > 0) ? 'photos' : 'chat';
                }
                this.switchViewTaskTab(selectedTab);

                // Fecha modal de edição se estivesse aberto
                this.closeModal();

                // Abre o modal unificado
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-view-task');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                    modal.style.zIndex = '100001';
                    try { history.pushState({ modal: 'view_task' }, ''); } catch(e) {}
                }

                if (selectedTab === 'chat') {
                    const input = document.getElementById('task-chat-input');
                    if (input) setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 150);
                }
            }

            switchViewTaskTab(tab) {
                const photosCol = document.getElementById('view-task-photos-col');
                const chatCol = document.getElementById('view-task-chat-col');
                const btnPhotos = document.getElementById('tab-btn-view-photos');
                const btnChat = document.getElementById('tab-btn-view-chat');

                if (tab === 'photos') {
                    if (photosCol) {
                        photosCol.className = 'flex flex-col flex-1 min-w-0 bg-black/60 relative overflow-hidden md:flex';
                    }
                    if (chatCol) {
                        chatCol.className = 'hidden md:flex flex-col flex-1 min-w-0 bg-gray-950/80 overflow-hidden';
                    }
                    if (btnPhotos) {
                        btnPhotos.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm';
                    }
                    if (btnChat) {
                        btnChat.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 bg-transparent';
                    }
                } else {
                    // Chat tab
                    if (photosCol) {
                        photosCol.className = 'hidden md:flex flex-col flex-1 min-w-0 bg-black/60 relative overflow-hidden';
                    }
                    if (chatCol) {
                        chatCol.className = 'flex flex-col flex-1 min-w-0 bg-gray-950/80 overflow-hidden md:flex';
                    }
                    if (btnPhotos) {
                        btnPhotos.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 bg-transparent';
                    }
                    if (btnChat) {
                        btnChat.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm';
                    }
                    const input = document.getElementById('task-chat-input');
                    if (input) setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 150);
                }
            }

            closeViewTaskModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-view-task');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                const drop = document.getElementById('task-mention-dropdown');
                if (drop) drop.classList.add('hidden');
                this.cancelChatImageUpload();
                this.activeGalleryImages = [];
                this.currentViewTaskId = null;
            }

            editCurrentViewedTask() {
                const tid = this.currentViewTaskId;
                this.closeViewTaskModal();
                if (tid) {
                    this.openModal(tid);
                }
            }

            viewFullImage(target) {
                this.openViewTask(target, 'photos', 0);
            }

            openGallery(target, initialIndex = 0) {
                this.openViewTask(target, 'photos', initialIndex);
            }

            openTaskPhotosGallery(initialIndex = 0) {
                if (this.currentTaskPhotos && this.currentTaskPhotos.length > 0) {
                    this.openViewTask(this.currentTaskPhotos, 'photos', initialIndex);
                }
            }

            updateGalleryUI() {
                if (!this.activeGalleryImages || this.activeGalleryImages.length === 0) return;
                const total = this.activeGalleryImages.length;
                const idx = this.activeGalleryIndex;
                const currentSrc = this.activeGalleryImages[idx];

                const img = document.getElementById('view-image-full');
                if (img) img.src = currentSrc;

                const titleEl = document.getElementById('view-task-title') || document.getElementById('gallery-task-title');
                if (titleEl && this.activeGalleryTitle) titleEl.innerText = this.activeGalleryTitle;

                const badgeEl = document.getElementById('gallery-counter-badge');
                if (badgeEl) badgeEl.innerText = `${idx + 1} de ${total}`;

                const btnPrev = document.getElementById('gallery-btn-prev');
                const btnNext = document.getElementById('gallery-btn-next');
                if (btnPrev) btnPrev.style.display = (total > 1) ? 'flex' : 'none';
                if (btnNext) btnNext.style.display = (total > 1) ? 'flex' : 'none';

                const strip = document.getElementById('gallery-thumbnails-strip');
                if (strip) {
                    if (total <= 1) {
                        strip.innerHTML = '';
                    } else {
                        strip.innerHTML = this.activeGalleryImages.map((src, i) => `
                            <button type="button" onclick="app.goToGalleryImage(${i})" class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border-2 shrink-0 transition ${i === idx ? 'border-indigo-500 scale-105 shadow-lg' : 'border-gray-700 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100'}">
                                <img src="${src}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                            </button>
                        `).join('');
                    }
                }
            }

            nextGalleryImage() {
                if (!this.activeGalleryImages || this.activeGalleryImages.length <= 1) return;
                this.activeGalleryIndex = (this.activeGalleryIndex + 1) % this.activeGalleryImages.length;
                this.updateGalleryUI();
            }

            prevGalleryImage() {
                if (!this.activeGalleryImages || this.activeGalleryImages.length <= 1) return;
                this.activeGalleryIndex = (this.activeGalleryIndex - 1 + this.activeGalleryImages.length) % this.activeGalleryImages.length;
                this.updateGalleryUI();
            }

            goToGalleryImage(index) {
                if (!this.activeGalleryImages || index < 0 || index >= this.activeGalleryImages.length) return;
                this.activeGalleryIndex = index;
                this.updateGalleryUI();
            }

            closeFullImage() {
                this.closeViewTaskModal();
            }

            // ==========================================
            // CHAT INTERNO DA TAREFA & @ MENÇÕES
            // ==========================================
            renderTaskChat() {
                const container = document.getElementById('task-chat-messages');
                const badge = document.getElementById('task-chat-badge');
                if (!container) return;

                if (!this.currentChatTaskId) {
                    container.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="text-center py-12 px-4 text-gray-500 space-y-2">
                            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 text-indigo-400 border border-gray-800 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-base">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-comments"></i>
                            </div>
                            <p class="font-bold text-gray-300 text-xs">Chat Disponível após Salvar</p>
                            <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-500 max-w-xs mx-auto">Salve esta tarefa primeiro para iniciar o chat em tempo real e marcar colaboradores com @.</p>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    if (badge) badge.innerText = '0 msg';
                    const tabBadgeChat = document.getElementById('tab-badge-chat-count');
                    if (tabBadgeChat) tabBadgeChat.innerText = 'Chat (0)';
                    return;
                }

                const task = this.tasks.find(t => t.id == this.currentChatTaskId);
                if (!task) return;

                const comments = task.comments || [];
                if (badge) badge.innerText = `${comments.length} msg${comments.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
                const tabBadgeChat = document.getElementById('tab-badge-chat-count');
                if (tabBadgeChat) tabBadgeChat.innerText = `Chat (${comments.length})`;

                if (comments.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="text-center py-10 px-3 text-gray-500 space-y-1.5">
                            <i class="fa-regular fa-comment-dots text-2xl text-indigo-500/50 block mb-1"></i>
                            <p class="font-bold text-gray-300 text-xs">Nenhuma mensagem ainda</p>
                            <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-500">Escreva uma mensagem abaixo e use <strong class="text-indigo-400">@nome</strong> para notificar um colaborador.</p>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    return;
                }

                const myEmail = (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.email : '').toLowerCase();

                let html = '';
                comments.forEach(c => {
                    const isMe = (c.authorEmail && c.authorEmail.toLowerCase() === myEmail);
                    const dateFormatted = new Date(c.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

                    // Formata texto destacando @Menções
                    let formattedText = (c.text || '')
                        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
                        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                        .replace(/@([a-zA-Z0-9À-ÿ\s]{2,25})/g, (match) => {
                            return `<span class="bg-indigo-900/60 text-indigo-300 font-extrabold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-indigo-700/60">${match}</span>`;
                        });

                    const bubbleBg = isMe 
                        ? 'bg-indigo-950/70 border border-indigo-800/80 text-gray-100 ml-auto' 
                        : 'bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 text-gray-200 mr-auto';

                    let imgHtml = '';
                    if (c.image) {
                        const safeAuthor = (c.authorName || 'Colaborador').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
                        imgHtml = `
                            <div class="my-1 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-indigo-500/40 bg-black/50 cursor-pointer shadow-md group relative max-w-full" onclick="app.openChatImageLightbox('${c.image}', '${safeAuthor}')">
                                <img src="${c.image}" alt="Comprovação de Tarefa" class="max-h-56 w-auto max-w-full rounded-xl object-contain mx-auto transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-[1.02]">
                                <div class="absolute bottom-1.5 right-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/80 text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1 backdrop-blur-sm border border-emerald-500/30 pointer-events-none">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-[10px]"></i>
                                    <span>Comprovante</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    }

                    html += `
                        <div class="flex flex-col ${isMe ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'} max-w-[90%] ${isMe ? 'ml-auto' : ''}">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-gray-400 mb-1 px-1">
                                <strong class="${isMe ? 'text-indigo-300' : 'text-gray-300'}">${c.authorName || 'Colaborador'}</strong>
                                ${c.authorRole ? `<span class="text-[9px] px-1 rounded bg-gray-800 text-gray-400">${c.authorRole}</span>` : ''}
                                <span>• ${dateFormatted}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl ${bubbleBg} text-xs leading-relaxed break-words shadow-sm">
                                ${imgHtml}
                                ${formattedText ? `<div class="${c.image ? 'mt-1 pt-1 border-t border-gray-800/60' : ''}">${formattedText}</div>` : ''}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });

                container.innerHTML = html;
                container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
            }

            toggleMentionDropdown(forceOpen = null) {
                const drop = document.getElementById('task-mention-dropdown');
                if (!drop) return;

                const isHidden = drop.classList.contains('hidden');
                const shouldOpen = (forceOpen !== null) ? forceOpen : isHidden;

                if (!shouldOpen) {
                    drop.classList.add('hidden');
                    return;
                }

                // Coleta exclusivamente os usuários e colaboradores cadastrados no App
                const appUsers = [];
                const seen = new Set();

                // 1. Contas cadastradas no App (TaskFlow Accounts)
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                accounts.forEach(a => {
                    const name = (a.displayName || a.name || '').trim();
                    if (!name || seen.has(name.toUpperCase())) return;
                    if (a.status === 'blocked' || a.status === 'rejected') return;
                    seen.add(name.toUpperCase());
                    appUsers.push({
                        name: name,
                        role: a.role || (a.isAdmin ? 'Administrador' : 'Colaborador'),
                        email: a.email || ''
                    });
                });

                // 2. Usuários cadastrados localmente
                const users = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_users') || '[]');
                users.forEach(u => {
                    const name = (u.name || u.displayName || '').trim();
                    if (!name || seen.has(name.toUpperCase())) return;
                    seen.add(name.toUpperCase());
                    appUsers.push({
                        name: name,
                        role: u.role || 'Colaborador',
                        email: u.email || ''
                    });
                });

                // 3. Usuário atualmente logado
                if (window.auth && auth.currentUser) {
                    const myName = (auth.currentUser.displayName || auth.currentUser.name || '').trim();
                    if (myName && !seen.has(myName.toUpperCase())) {
                        seen.add(myName.toUpperCase());
                        appUsers.push({
                            name: myName,
                            role: auth.currentUser.role || (auth.currentUser.isAdmin ? 'Administrador' : 'Colaborador'),
                            email: auth.currentUser.email || ''
                        });
                    }
                }

                // 4. Se a lista estiver vazia (primeiro acesso), inclui os líderes/administradores do app
                if (appUsers.length === 0) {
                    const defaults = [
                        { name: "Emerson Diniz", role: "Administrador" },
                        { name: "João Guilherme", role: "Líder" },
                        { name: "Admin Juhsim", role: "Administrador" }
                    ];
                    defaults.forEach(d => {
                        if (!seen.has(d.name.toUpperCase())) {
                            seen.add(d.name.toUpperCase());
                            appUsers.push(d);
                        }
                    });
                }

                let html = '<div class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-1">Mencionar Usuário do App:</div>';
                appUsers.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).forEach(user => {
                    const safeName = user.name.replace(/'/g, "\\'");
                    html += `
                        <button type="button" onclick="app.insertMention('${safeName}')" class="w-full text-left px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 text-xs text-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between transition group">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                                <span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-md bg-indigo-600/30 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/40 font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">@</span>
                                <span class="font-semibold text-gray-100 truncate">${user.name}</span>
                            </div>
                            ${user.role ? `<span class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 group-hover:bg-indigo-950/80 group-hover:text-indigo-300 shrink-0 border border-gray-700/60">${user.role}</span>` : ''}
                        </button>
                    `;
                });

                drop.innerHTML = html;
                drop.classList.remove('hidden');
            }

            insertMention(name) {
                const input = document.getElementById('task-chat-input');
                const drop = document.getElementById('task-mention-dropdown');
                if (input) {
                    const currentText = input.value;
                    // Se o último caractere for '@', remove antes de inserir o nome completo com @
                    if (currentText.endsWith('@')) {
                        input.value = currentText.slice(0, -1) + `@${name} `;
                    } else {
                        input.value = currentText + (currentText.length > 0 && !currentText.endsWith(' ') ? ' ' : '') + `@${name} `;
                    }
                    input.focus();
                }
                if (drop) drop.classList.add('hidden');
            }

            handleChatKeyDown(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.sendTaskComment();
                } else if (e.key === '@') {
                    setTimeout(() => this.toggleMentionDropdown(true), 50);
                }
            }

            sendTaskComment() {
                const input = document.getElementById('task-chat-input');
                if (!input) return;
                const text = input.value.trim();
                const imageToSend = this.pendingChatImage || null;

                // Permite envio se houver texto OU imagem
                if (!text && !imageToSend) return;

                if (!this.currentChatTaskId) {
                    alert("Por favor, clique em 'Salvar Tarefa' primeiro para gerar o identificador do chat.");
                    return;
                }

                const task = this.tasks.find(t => t.id == this.currentChatTaskId);
                if (!task) return;

                // Extrai menções com @
                const mentionMatches = text.match(/@([a-zA-Z0-9À-ÿ\s]{2,25})/g) || [];
                const mentionsClean = mentionMatches.map(m => m.replace('@', '').trim());

                const authorName = (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Colaborador');
                const authorEmail = (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.email : '');
                const authorRole = (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.role : 'Colaborador');

                const comment = {
                    id: 'cmt_' + Date.now(),
                    authorName: authorName,
                    authorEmail: authorEmail,
                    authorRole: authorRole,
                    text: text,
                    image: imageToSend,
                    isProof: !!imageToSend,
                    mentions: mentionsClean,
                    createdAt: Date.now()
                };

                if (!task.comments) task.comments = [];
                task.comments.push(comment);

                // Integra automaticamente a foto de comprovação na galeria da tarefa
                if (imageToSend) {
                    if (!task.images) task.images = [];
                    if (!task.images.includes(imageToSend)) {
                        task.images.push(imageToSend);
                    }
                    const tabBadgePhotos = document.getElementById('tab-badge-photos-count');
                    if (tabBadgePhotos) tabBadgePhotos.innerText = `Fotos (${task.images.length})`;
                }

                task.updatedAt = Date.now();
                this.saveLocally();

                // Publica em nuvem imediatamente
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'TASK_COMMENT_ADD',
                        taskId: task.id,
                        taskTitle: task.title,
                        taskAssignee: task.assignee,
                        taskAuthorEmail: task.authorEmail,
                        comment: comment
                    });
                }

                // Som de notificação local e feedback
                try { this.playNotificationSound(); } catch(e) {}
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.showToast(imageToSend ? "✓ Foto de comprovação enviada no chat!" : "✓ Mensagem enviada para o chat da tarefa!");
                }

                // Dispara notificação no envio (com menção ou geral)
                let notifTitle = 'TaskFlow - Chat da Tarefa';
                let notifBody = '';
                if (imageToSend) {
                    notifTitle = 'TaskFlow - Comprovante de Tarefa';
                    notifBody = `📸 ${authorName} enviou uma foto de comprovação na tarefa: "${task.title}"`;
                } else if (mentionsClean.length > 0) {
                    notifTitle = 'TaskFlow - @Menção em Tarefa';
                    notifBody = `${authorName} mencionou ${mentionsClean.join(', ')} na tarefa: "${task.title}"`;
                } else {
                    notifBody = `${authorName}: "${text}" na tarefa "${task.title}"`;
                }
                try { this.dispatchNotification(notifTitle, notifBody); } catch(e) {}

                input.value = '';
                this.cancelChatImageUpload();

                const drop = document.getElementById('task-mention-dropdown');
                if (drop) drop.classList.add('hidden');

                this.renderTaskChat();
                this.render(); // Atualiza contador do card na lista de tarefas imediatamente!
            }

            // ==========================================
            // COMPROVAÇÃO DE TAREFA POR FOTO NO CHAT
            // ==========================================
            triggerChatImageUpload() {
                const fileInput = document.getElementById('task-chat-image-input');
                if (fileInput) {
                    fileInput.value = '';
                    fileInput.click();
                }
            }

            async handleChatImageSelected(e) {
                const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
                if (!file) return;

                try {
                    if (window.syncManager) syncManager.showToast("Processando imagem de comprovação...");
                    const compressed = await this.compressImage(file, 960, 0.75);
                    if (!compressed) {
                        alert("Não foi possível processar a foto. Tente novamente.");
                        return;
                    }
                    this.pendingChatImage = compressed;

                    const previewBar = document.getElementById('task-chat-image-preview-bar');
                    const thumb = document.getElementById('task-chat-image-preview-thumb');
                    if (thumb) thumb.src = compressed;
                    if (previewBar) previewBar.classList.remove('hidden');

                    const input = document.getElementById('task-chat-input');
                    if (input) {
                        input.placeholder = "Adicione uma legenda ou envie a foto diretamente...";
                        input.focus();
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    console.error("Erro ao processar foto do chat:", err);
                    alert("Erro ao anexar imagem.");
                }
            }

            cancelChatImageUpload() {
                this.pendingChatImage = null;
                const previewBar = document.getElementById('task-chat-image-preview-bar');
                if (previewBar) previewBar.classList.add('hidden');
                const fileInput = document.getElementById('task-chat-image-input');
                if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';
                const input = document.getElementById('task-chat-input');
                if (input) input.placeholder = "Escreva uma mensagem... (@ para marcar)";
            }

            openChatImageLightbox(src, author = '') {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-chat-image-lightbox');
                const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img-full');
                const dl = document.getElementById('lightbox-download-btn');
                const cap = document.getElementById('lightbox-caption');
                if (!modal || !img) return;

                img.src = src;
                if (dl) dl.href = src;
                if (cap) cap.innerText = author ? `Comprovação de tarefa enviada por ${author}` : 'Foto de comprovação da tarefa';

                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                modal.style.display = 'flex';
            }

            closeChatImageLightbox() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-chat-image-lightbox');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            async saveTask(e) {
                if (e) e.preventDefault();
                try {
                    const id = (document.getElementById('task-id').value || '').trim();
                    const title = (document.getElementById('task-title').value || '').trim();
                    if (!title) {
                        alert("Por favor, informe o título da tarefa.");
                        return;
                    }
                    const assignee = (document.getElementById('task-assignee').value || '').trim() || 'Equipe';

                    // Validação de Hierarquia Organizacional & Autoridade
                    if (window.admin && typeof admin.canAssignTask === 'function') {
                        const authorRole = auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.role : 'Colaborador';
                        const authorIsAdmin = auth.currentUser ? !!auth.currentUser.isAdmin : false;

                        let targetRole = null;
                        const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                        const targetUser = accounts.find(a => 
                            a.displayName && (
                                a.displayName.toLowerCase() === assignee.toLowerCase() ||
                                assignee.toLowerCase().includes(a.displayName.toLowerCase())
                            )
                        );
                        if (targetUser) {
                            targetRole = targetUser.role;
                        } else {
                            const matchRole = assignee.match(/\(([^)]+)\)/);
                            if (matchRole) targetRole = matchRole[1];
                        }

                        if (targetRole && !authorIsAdmin) {
                            const check = admin.canAssignTask(authorRole, targetRole, authorIsAdmin);
                            if (!check.allowed) {
                                alert("⚠️ Ação Bloqueada pela Hierarquia Organizacional:\n\n" + check.reason);
                                return;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    const date = document.getElementById('task-date').value || getLocalTodayString();
                    const priority = document.getElementById('task-priority').value || 'media';

                    const authorName = auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Equipe';
                    const authorRole = auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.role : 'Colaborador';

                    // Fotos múltiplas
                    let finalImages = this.currentTaskPhotos || [];
                    let firstImage = finalImages.length > 0 ? finalImages[0] : null;

                    // Seção de Inconsistência Operacional
                    const incToggle = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-toggle');
                    let inconsistencyData = null;
                    if (incToggle && incToggle.checked) {
                        const reason = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-reason') ? document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-reason').value : 'Ruptura Operacional';
                        const sector = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-sector') ? document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-sector').value : 'Geral';
                        const notes = document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-notes') ? document.getElementById('task-inconsistency-notes').value.trim() : '';

                        inconsistencyData = {
                            hasInconsistency: true,
                            reason: reason,
                            sector: sector,
                            notes: notes,
                            createdAt: Date.now()
                        };

                        // Seção de Programação de Validações Recorrentes
                    const recToggle = document.getElementById('task-recurrent-toggle');
                    let recurrenceData = null;
                    if (recToggle && recToggle.checked) {
                        const recMode = document.getElementById('task-recurrence-mode')?.value || 'interval_2h';
                        const recStart = document.getElementById('task-recurrence-start')?.value || '07:00';
                        const recEnd = document.getElementById('task-recurrence-end')?.value || '19:00';
                        const recTol = parseInt(document.getElementById('task-recurrence-tolerance')?.value || '15', 10);

                        const points = this.calculateRecurrenceCheckpoints(recMode, recStart, recEnd);

                        // Preserva checkpoints já marcados se for edição
                        let existingCheckpoints = [];
                        if (id) {
                            const oldTask = this.tasks.find(t => t.id == id);
