                            if (oldTask && oldTask.recurrence && Array.isArray(oldTask.recurrence.checkpoints)) {
                                existingCheckpoints = oldTask.recurrence.checkpoints;
                            }
                        }

                        const builtCheckpoints = points.map(p => {
                            const found = existingCheckpoints.find(c => c.time === p);
                            return found ? found : {
                                time: p,
                                completed: false,
                                completedBy: null,
                                completedAt: null
                            };
                        });

                        recurrenceData = {
                            enabled: true,
                            mode: recMode,
                            startTime: recStart,
                            endTime: recEnd,
                            toleranceMinutes: recTol,
                            checkpoints: builtCheckpoints,
                            updatedAt: Date.now()
                        };
                    }

                    // Registra no banco global de inconsistências para o Relatório do Administrador
                        const incRecord = {
                            id: 'inc_task_' + (id || ('task_' + Date.now())),
                            source: 'tarefa',
                            type: 'Inconsistência em Tarefa / Ruptura',
                            taskId: (id || ('task_' + Date.now())),
                            taskTitle: title,
                            departamento: sector,
                            reason: reason,
                            notes: notes || title,
                            date: date,
                            author: authorName,
                            createdAt: Date.now()
                        };
                        this.saveInconsistency(incRecord);
                    }

                    let taskToBroadcast = null;

                    if (id) {
                        const task = this.tasks.find(t => t.id == id);
                        if (task) {
                            task.title = title;
                            task.assignee = assignee;
                            task.date = date;
                            task.priority = priority;
                            task.image = firstImage;
                            task.images = finalImages;
                            task.inconsistency = inconsistencyData;
                            task.recurrence = recurrenceData;
                            task.updatedAt = Date.now();
                            taskToBroadcast = task;
                        }
                    } else {
                        const newTaskId = 'task_' + Date.now();
                        taskToBroadcast = {
                            id: newTaskId,
                            title,
                            assignee,
                            date,
                            priority,
                            image: firstImage,
                            images: finalImages,
                            inconsistency: inconsistencyData,
                            recurrence: recurrenceData,
                            comments: [],
                            authorName,
                            authorEmail: (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.email : ''),
                            authorRole,
                            completed: false,
                            completedBy: null,
                            createdAt: Date.now(),
                            updatedAt: Date.now()
                        };
                        this.tasks.unshift(taskToBroadcast);
                    }

                    this.closeModal();

                    // Se criou uma nova tarefa e o filtro ativo não for 'all', muda para 'all' para que a tarefa apareça imediatamente!
                    if (!id && this.currentFilter !== 'all') {
                        this.currentFilter = 'all';
                        ['all', 'mine', 'today', 'upcoming'].forEach(f => {
                            const btn = document.getElementById('filter-' + f);
                            if (btn) {
                                if (f === 'all') {
                                    btn.className = "w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-sm transition text-left";
                                } else {
                                    btn.className = "w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-800/60 transition text-left";
                                }
                            }
                        });
                        const viewTitle = document.getElementById('current-view-title');
                        if (viewTitle) viewTitle.innerText = 'Todas as Tarefas';
                    }

                    this.saveLocally();

                    // Feedback visual instantâneo garantido
                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        syncManager.showToast(id ? "✓ Tarefa atualizada com sucesso!" : "✓ Tarefa criada com sucesso!");
                    }

                    // Som e Notificação (com proteção contra bloqueio de áudio/notif)
                    try { this.playNotificationSound(); } catch(e) {}
                    try {
                        const notifTitle = id ? "TaskFlow - Tarefa Atualizada" : "TaskFlow - Nova Tarefa Criada";
                        const notifBody = `"${title}" (Responsável: ${assignee})`;
                        this.dispatchNotification(notifTitle, notifBody);
                    } catch(e) {}

                    // Publica em nuvem imediatamente
                    if (window.syncManager && taskToBroadcast) {
                        window.syncManager.publish({
                            type: 'TASK_UPSERT',
                            task: taskToBroadcast
                        });
                    }
                } catch(err) {
                    console.error("Erro ao salvar tarefa:", err);
                    alert("Ocorreu um erro ao salvar a tarefa: " + err.message);
                }
            }

            toggleTask(id) {
                const task = this.tasks.find(t => t.id == id);
                if (task) {
                    task.completed = !task.completed;
                    task.completedBy = task.completed ? (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Colaborador') : null;
                    task.updatedAt = Date.now();
                    this.saveLocally();

                    if (task.completed) {
                        this.playTaskCompleteSound();
                        const notifBody = `${task.completedBy || 'Colaborador'} concluiu "${task.title}"`;
                        this.dispatchNotification("TaskFlow - Tarefa Concluída", notifBody);
                    }

                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        window.syncManager.publish({
                            type: 'TASK_UPSERT',
                            task: task
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            dismissTaskForMe(id) {
                const user = (window.auth && auth.currentUser) ? auth.currentUser : null;
                if (!user) {
                    alert("Por favor, faça login para excluir a tarefa da sua lista pessoal.");
                    return;
                }
                const userKey = (user.email || user.displayName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                const task = this.tasks.find(t => t.id == id);
                if (!task) return;

                if (!confirm(`Deseja excluir esta tarefa apenas para você?\n\n• Ela sumirá da sua lista.\n• Continuará visível para os outros colaboradores vinculados e para os administradores no painel.`)) {
                    return;
                }

                task.hiddenFor = task.hiddenFor || [];
                if (!task.hiddenFor.includes(userKey)) {
                    task.hiddenFor.push(userKey);
                }
                if (user.email && !task.hiddenFor.includes(user.email.toLowerCase().trim())) {
                    task.hiddenFor.push(user.email.toLowerCase().trim());
                }
                if (user.displayName && !task.hiddenFor.includes(user.displayName.toLowerCase().trim())) {
                    task.hiddenFor.push(user.displayName.toLowerCase().trim());
                }

                task.updatedAt = Date.now();
                this.saveLocally();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'TASK_UPSERT',
                        task: task
                    });
                }

                this.render();
                if (window.toast) toast.info("Tarefa excluída da sua lista pessoal.");
            }

            deleteTask(id) {
                if (!confirm("Deseja realmente excluir esta tarefa?")) return;
                this.tasks = this.tasks.filter(t => t.id != id);
                this.saveLocally();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'TASK_DELETE',
                        taskId: id
                    });
                }
            }

            applyRemoteTask(remoteTask) {
                if (!remoteTask || !remoteTask.id) return;
                const index = this.tasks.findIndex(t => t.id == remoteTask.id);
                if (index >= 0) {
                    if (!this.tasks[index].updatedAt || (remoteTask.updatedAt && remoteTask.updatedAt >= this.tasks[index].updatedAt)) {
                        this.tasks[index] = remoteTask;
                    }
                } else {
                    this.tasks.unshift(remoteTask);
                }
                this.saveLocally();
                this.render();
            }

            applyRemoteDelete(taskId) {
                this.tasks = this.tasks.filter(t => t.id != taskId);
                this.saveLocally();
                this.render();
            }

            openPomodoro() { 
                const m = document.getElementById('pomodoro-modal');
                if (m) { m.classList.remove('hidden'); m.style.display = 'flex'; }
            }
            closePomodoro() { 
                const m = document.getElementById('pomodoro-modal');
                if (m) { m.classList.add('hidden'); m.style.display = 'none'; }
            }

            playBeep() {
                try {
                    const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(800, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
                } catch(e) {}
            }

            startPomodoro() {
                if(this.pomoRunning) {
                    clearInterval(this.pomoInterval);
                    this.pomoRunning = false;
                    document.getElementById('pomo-start-btn').innerText = 'Iniciar';
                } else {
                    this.pomoRunning = true;
                    document.getElementById('pomo-start-btn').innerText = 'Pausar';
                    this.pomoInterval = setInterval(() => {
                        if(this.pomoTime > 0) {
                            this.pomoTime--;
                            let m = Math.floor(this.pomoTime / 60);
                            let s = this.pomoTime % 60;
                            document.getElementById('pomo-display').innerText = `${m.toString().padStart(2,'0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;
                        } else {
                            clearInterval(this.pomoInterval);
                            this.playBeep();
                            alert('Pomodoro finalizado! Parabéns pelo foco na tarefa.');
                            this.resetPomodoro();
                        }
                    }, 1000);
                }
            }

            resetPomodoro() {
                clearInterval(this.pomoInterval);
                this.pomoRunning = false;
                this.pomoTime = 25 * 60;
                document.getElementById('pomo-display').innerText = '25:00';
                document.getElementById('pomo-start-btn').innerText = 'Iniciar';
            }

            getVisibleTasks() {
                const user = (window.auth && auth.currentUser) ? auth.currentUser : null;
                if (!user) return this.tasks;

                const myName = (user.displayName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                const myEmail = (user.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                const userKey = myEmail || myName;

                // Administrador vê TODAS as tarefas (exceto se ele mesmo escolheu ocultar para si)
                const isAdm = !!(
                    user.isAdmin || 
                    (user.email && (ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(user.email.toLowerCase().trim()) || user.email.toLowerCase().includes('admin'))) ||
                    user.role === 'Administrador' ||
                    (user.role && user.role.toLowerCase().includes('admin')) ||
                    (user.displayName && user.displayName.toUpperCase().includes('ADMIN'))
                );

                return this.tasks.filter(t => {
                    // Requisito 3: Se o usuário excluiu a tarefa "para mim", oculta da visualização dele
                    if (t.hiddenFor && Array.isArray(t.hiddenFor) && userKey) {
                        if (t.hiddenFor.includes(userKey) || (myEmail && t.hiddenFor.includes(myEmail)) || (myName && t.hiddenFor.includes(myName))) {
                            return false;
                        }
                    }

                    if (isAdm) return true;
                    const assignee = (t.assignee || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    const authorName = (t.authorName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    const authorEmail = (t.authorEmail || '').toLowerCase().trim();

                    // 1. Sem definir pessoa a executar (livre para qualquer um / tarefas gerais)
                    const isUnassigned = !assignee || assignee === '' || assignee === 'todos' || assignee === 'todos da equipe' || assignee === 'livre' || assignee === 'geral' || assignee === 'equipe';
                    if (isUnassigned) return true;

                    // 2. Definida para ele
                    const isAssignedToMe = (myName && assignee.includes(myName)) || (myEmail && assignee.includes(myEmail));
                    if (isAssignedToMe) return true;

                    // 3. Criada por ele
                    const isCreatedByMe = (myName && authorName.includes(myName)) || (myEmail && authorEmail === myEmail);
                    if (isCreatedByMe) return true;

                    return false;
                });
            }

            render() {
                const container = document.getElementById('tasks-container');
                const todayStr = getLocalTodayString();
                const user = (window.auth && auth.currentUser) ? auth.currentUser : null;
                const myName = user ? (user.displayName || '').toLowerCase().trim() : '';
                const myEmail = user ? (user.email || '').toLowerCase().trim() : '';

                // Lista de tarefas visíveis para o perfil atual (já excluindo as que o usuário dispensou para si)
                const visibleTasks = this.getVisibleTasks();

                const pendingTasks = visibleTasks.filter(t => !t.completed);
                const completedTasks = visibleTasks.filter(t => !!t.completed);

                // Requisito 3: Aba Concluídas separada para despoluir a visualização das tarefas ativas!
                let filtered = [];
                if (this.currentFilter === 'completed') {
                    filtered = completedTasks;
                } else {
                    filtered = pendingTasks.filter(t => {
                        if (this.currentFilter === 'today') return t.date === todayStr;
                        if (this.currentFilter === 'upcoming') return t.date > todayStr;
                        if (this.currentFilter === 'mine') {
                            const assignee = (t.assignee || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                            return (myName && assignee.includes(myName)) || (myEmail && assignee.includes(myEmail));
                        }
                        return true;
                    });
                }

                const countMine = pendingTasks.filter(t => {
                    const assignee = (t.assignee || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    return (myName && assignee.includes(myName)) || (myEmail && assignee.includes(myEmail));
                }).length;

                const countAllEl = document.getElementById('count-all');
                const countMineEl = document.getElementById('count-mine');
                const countTodayEl = document.getElementById('count-today');
                const countUpcomingEl = document.getElementById('count-upcoming');
                const countCompletedEl = document.getElementById('count-completed');
                const countCompletedTopEl = document.getElementById('count-completed-top');

                if (countAllEl) countAllEl.innerText = pendingTasks.length;
                if (countMineEl) countMineEl.innerText = countMine;
                if (countTodayEl) countTodayEl.innerText = pendingTasks.filter(t => t.date === todayStr).length;
                if (countUpcomingEl) countUpcomingEl.innerText = pendingTasks.filter(t => t.date > todayStr).length;
                if (countCompletedEl) countCompletedEl.innerText = completedTasks.length;
                if (countCompletedTopEl) countCompletedTopEl.innerText = completedTasks.length;
                const sidebarCount = document.getElementById('sidebar-tasks-count');
                if (sidebarCount) sidebarCount.innerText = pendingTasks.length;

                if(filtered.length === 0) {
                    if (this.currentFilter === 'completed') {
                        container.innerHTML = `
                            <div class="text-center py-14 px-4 bg-gray-900/60 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl space-y-3">
                                <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-800/60 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-xl shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/50">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i>
                                </div>
                                <h3 class="text-base font-bold text-gray-200">Nenhuma tarefa concluída arquivada</h3>
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 max-w-sm mx-auto">Assim que você ou sua equipe concluírem uma tarefa, ela será movida automaticamente para esta aba para despoluir a visualização principal.</p>
                            </div>`;
                        return;
                    }
                    container.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="text-center py-14 px-4 bg-gray-900/60 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl space-y-3">
                            <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-900/50 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-xl shadow-lg">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-check"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <p class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-200">Nenhuma tarefa pendente encontrada</p>
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">Você está com tudo em dia ou não há tarefas pendentes neste filtro.</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-2">
                                <button onclick="app.openModal()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-semibold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-sm transition active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-xs"></i>
                                    <span>Criar Tarefa</span>
                                </button>
                                <button onclick="window.switchMainView('occurrences')" class="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-amber-300 font-semibold text-xs rounded-xl border border-gray-700 transition active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-user text-xs text-amber-400"></i>
                                    <span>Ver Ocorrências & Processos</span>
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                    return;
                }

                container.innerHTML = filtered.map(t => {
                    const isCompleted = !!t.completed;
                    const priorityBadge = t.priority === 'alta' 
                        ? 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20' 
                        : t.priority === 'media' 
                        ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20' 
                        : 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20';

                    const safeTaskJson = JSON.stringify(t).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

                    const commentsCount = (t.comments && Array.isArray(t.comments)) ? t.comments.length : 0;
                    const photos = (t.images && Array.isArray(t.images) && t.images.length > 0) ? t.images : (t.image ? [t.image] : []);

                    return `
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 bg-gray-900/70 border border-gray-800/80 rounded-xl hover:border-gray-700 transition gap-3">
                        <div class="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <input type="checkbox" ${isCompleted ? 'checked' : ''} onclick="app.toggleTask('${t.id}')" class="w-5 h-5 rounded-md accent-indigo-600 cursor-pointer shrink-0 mt-0.5 sm:mt-0">
                            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-1">
                                <p class="text-sm font-semibold ${isCompleted ? 'line-through text-gray-500' : 'text-gray-100'} break-words leading-snug">${t.title}</p>
                                
                                ${t.recurrence && t.recurrence.enabled && Array.isArray(t.recurrence.checkpoints) && t.recurrence.checkpoints.length > 0 ? (() => {
                                    const now = new Date();
                                    const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
                                    const tol = t.recurrence.toleranceMinutes || 15;
                                    const totalCount = t.recurrence.checkpoints.length;
                                    const doneCount = t.recurrence.checkpoints.filter(c => c.completed).length;

                                    let hasDelayed = false;

                                    const checkpointsHtml = t.recurrence.checkpoints.map(cp => {
                                        const [h, m] = cp.time.split(':').map(Number);
                                        const cpMinutes = h * 60 + m;
                                        const isDelayed = !cp.completed && (currentMinutes > (cpMinutes + tol));
                                        if (isDelayed) hasDelayed = true;

                                        let btnClass = "";
                                        let iconClass = "";
                                        let statusBadge = "";

                                        if (cp.completed) {
                                            btnClass = "bg-emerald-950/70 border-emerald-700/80 text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-900/80";
                                            iconClass = "fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400";
                                            statusBadge = cp.completedBy ? `<span class="text-[9px] opacity-75 truncate max-w-[80px]">(${cp.completedBy.split(' ')[0]})</span>` : '';
                                        } else if (isDelayed) {
                                            btnClass = "bg-rose-950/80 border-rose-600 text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-900 animate-pulse";
                                            iconClass = "fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-rose-400";
                                            statusBadge = '<span class="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-rose-400">ATRASADO</span>';
                                        } else {
                                            btnClass = "bg-gray-900 border-gray-700 text-gray-300 hover:border-indigo-500 hover:text-white";
                                            iconClass = "fa-regular fa-clock text-indigo-400";
                                            statusBadge = '<span class="text-[9px] text-gray-400">Pendente</span>';
                                        }

                                        return `
                                            <button type="button" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); app.toggleRecurrenceCheckpoint('${t.id}', '${cp.time}')" title="Clique para validar horário (${cp.time})" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 shadow-sm ${btnClass}">
                                                <i class="${iconClass} text-[10px]"></i>
                                                <span class="font-mono">${cp.time}</span>
                                                ${statusBadge}
                                            </button>
                                        `;
                                    }).join('');

                                    return `
                                        <div class="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gray-950/70 border ${hasDelayed ? 'border-rose-900/60 bg-rose-950/20' : 'border-indigo-900/40'} space-y-1.5">
                                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold">
                                                <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-indigo-300">
                                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-clock-rotate-left text-xs ${hasDelayed ? 'text-rose-400 animate-spin' : 'text-indigo-400'}"></i>
                                                    <span>Ronda / Validações Programadas</span>
                                                </span>
                                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black ${doneCount === totalCount ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40' : (hasDelayed ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40 animate-pulse' : 'bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/40')}">
                                                    ${doneCount}/${totalCount} Concluídas ${hasDelayed ? '• Atrasos detectados' : ''}
                                                </span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-0.5">
                                                ${checkpointsHtml}
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    `;
                                })() : ''}
                                <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-gray-400">
                                    ${t.assignee ? `<span class="bg-gray-800 text-indigo-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-user text-[9px]"></i><span>${t.assignee}</span></span>` : ''}
                                    ${t.date ? `<span class="bg-gray-800/60 text-gray-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] inline-flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-regular fa-calendar text-[9px]"></i><span>${t.date}</span></span>` : ''}
                                    <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase ${priorityBadge}">${t.priority || 'média'}</span>
                                    ${t.inconsistency && t.inconsistency.hasInconsistency ? `
                                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-300 border border-amber-800/80 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-[9px] text-amber-400"></i>
                                            <span>${t.inconsistency.reason || 'Ruptura'}</span>
                                        </span>
                                    ` : ''}
                                    ${commentsCount > 0 ? `
                                        <button type="button" onclick="app.openViewTask('${t.id}', 'chat')" title="Ver fotos e mensagens da tarefa" class="bg-indigo-950/70 hover:bg-indigo-900 border border-indigo-800/80 text-indigo-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1 transition">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-comments text-[9px]"></i>
                                            <span>${commentsCount}</span>
                                        </button>
                                    ` : ''}
                                    ${t.authorName ? `<span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500">por ${t.authorName}</span>` : ''}
                                    ${isCompleted && t.completedBy ? `<span class="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-semibold bg-emerald-950/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-900/50">✓ Feito por ${t.completedBy}</span>` : ''}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 self-center">
                            ${photos.length > 0 ? `
                                <div class="relative inline-block cursor-pointer" onclick="app.openViewTask('${t.id}', 'photos', 0)" title="Ver ${photos.length > 1 ? `todas as ${photos.length} fotos` : 'foto'}">
                                    <img src="${photos[0]}" class="w-9 h-9 object-cover rounded-xl border border-gray-700 shrink-0 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition shadow-sm">
                                    ${photos.length > 1 ? `<span class="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[9px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow border border-indigo-400 leading-tight flex items-center gap-0.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-images text-[8px]"></i>+${photos.length - 1}</span>` : ''}
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                            <button onclick="app.openViewTask('${t.id}', 'chat')" title="Visualizar Tarefa e Mensagens" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-indigo-300 hover:bg-gray-800 transition active:scale-95">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-comments text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                            <button onclick='app.openModal(${safeTaskJson})' title="Editar Tarefa" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-800 transition active:scale-95">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-pen text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                            <button onclick="app.dismissTaskForMe('${t.id}')" title="Excluir apenas para mim (mantém a tarefa para os outros membros e no painel)" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-amber-400 hover:bg-gray-800 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-eye-slash text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                            <button onclick="app.deleteTask('${t.id}')" title="Excluir Tarefa Geral" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-gray-800 transition active:scale-95">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `}).join('');
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // 1.5. SERVIÇO DE ENVIO REAL DE E-MAILS (TRANSACTIONAL)
        // ==========================================
        class EmailService {
            constructor() {
                this.config = this.loadConfig();
            }

            loadConfig() {
                try {
                    const saved = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_email_config');
                    if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
                } catch(e) {}
                return {
                    provider: 'resend',
                    resendApiKey: '',
                    resendFromEmail: 'TaskFlow <onboarding@resend.dev>',
                    brevoApiKey: '',
                    brevoSenderEmail: 'admin@taskflow.app',
                    emailjsServiceId: '',
                    emailjsTemplateId: '',
                    emailjsPublicKey: '',
                    webhookUrl: ''
                };
            }

            saveConfig(cfg) {
                this.config = Object.assign(this.config, cfg);
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_email_config', JSON.stringify(this.config));
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'APP_CONFIG_UPDATE',
                        config: window.admin ? window.admin.config : {},
                        emailConfig: this.config
                    });
                }
            }

            generateEmailHtml(userName, code) {
                return `
                <div style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background-color: #030712; padding: 35px 15px; color: #f3f4f6;">
                    <div style="max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto; background-color: #111827; border-radius: 20px; padding: 30px; border: 1px solid #1f2937; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
                        <div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 25px;">
                            <div style="display: inline-block; background-color: #4f46e5; color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.5px;">
                                TaskFlow
                            </div>
                            <h2 style="color: #ffffff; margin-top: 14px; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700;">Verificação de E-mail</h2>
                            <p style="color: #818cf8; font-size: 13px; margin: 0; font-weight: 500;">Gestão Integrada de Trabalho</p>
                        </div>
                        
                        <p style="font-size: 14px; color: #e5e7eb; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 10px;">
                            Olá, <strong>${userName || 'Colaborador'}</strong>!
                        </p>
                        <p style="font-size: 13px; color: #9ca3af; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 22px;">
                            Para confirmar seu cadastro no aplicativo TaskFlow, use o código de segurança de 6 dígitos abaixo:
                        </p>
                        
                        <div style="background-color: #030712; border: 2px dashed #4f46e5; border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 22px;">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9ca3af; display: block; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 6px;">Código de Verificação</span>
                            <span style="font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 8px; color: #818cf8; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; display: block;">${code}</span>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div style="background-color: #1e1b4b; border-left: 4px solid #6366f1; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px;">
                            <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: #c7d2fe; line-height: 1.5;">
                                ⏱️ <strong>Atenção:</strong> Este código expira em <strong>10 minutos</strong>. Nunca compartilhe este código.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        
                        <p style="font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; text-align: center; margin-top: 25px; line-height: 1.5; border-top: 1px solid #1f2937; padding-top: 18px;">
                            Se você não realizou esta solicitação, desconsidere esta mensagem.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            }

            async sendVerificationEmail(toEmail, userName, code) {
                const subject = `Seu Código de Verificação TaskFlow: ${code}`;
                const html = this.generateEmailHtml(userName, code);

                // 1. Provedor Resend
                if (this.config.provider === 'resend' && this.config.resendApiKey && this.config.resendApiKey.trim()) {
                    try {
                        const from = this.config.resendFromEmail || 'TaskFlow <onboarding@resend.dev>';
                        const res = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: {
                                'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.config.resendApiKey.trim()}`,
                                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                            },
                            body: JSON.stringify({
                                from: from,
                                to: [toEmail],
                                subject: subject,
                                html: html
                            })
                        });
                        const data = await res.json();
                        if (res.ok && data.id) {
                            return { success: true, provider: 'Resend', id: data.id };
                        } else {
                            return { success: false, error: data.message || JSON.stringify(data) };
                        }
                    } catch(err) {
                        return { success: false, error: err.message };
                    }
                }

                // 2. Provedor Brevo (Sendinblue)
                if (this.config.provider === 'brevo' && this.config.brevoApiKey && this.config.brevoApiKey.trim()) {
                    try {
                        const res = await fetch('https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: {
                                'api-key': this.config.brevoApiKey.trim(),
                                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                                'Accept': 'application/json'
                            },
                            body: JSON.stringify({
                                sender: { name: 'TaskFlow', email: this.config.brevoSenderEmail || 'admin@taskflow.app' },
                                to: [{ email: toEmail, name: userName }],
                                subject: subject,
                                htmlContent: html
                            })
                        });
                        const data = await res.json();
                        if (res.ok && data.messageId) {
                            return { success: true, provider: 'Brevo', id: data.messageId };
                        } else {
                            return { success: false, error: data.message || JSON.stringify(data) };
                        }
                    } catch(err) {
                        return { success: false, error: err.message };
                    }
                }

                // 3. Provedor EmailJS
                if (this.config.provider === 'emailjs' && this.config.emailjsPublicKey && this.config.emailjsServiceId) {
                    try {
                        const res = await fetch('https://api.emailjs.com/api/v1.0/email/send', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                            body: JSON.stringify({
                                service_id: this.config.emailjsServiceId.trim(),
                                template_id: this.config.emailjsTemplateId.trim(),
                                user_id: this.config.emailjsPublicKey.trim(),
                                template_params: {
                                    to_email: toEmail,
                                    user_name: userName,
                                    passcode: code,
                                    code: code,
                                    subject: subject
                                }
                            })
                        });
                        if (res.ok) {
                            return { success: true, provider: 'EmailJS' };
                        } else {
                            const txt = await res.text();
                            return { success: false, error: txt };
                        }
                    } catch(err) {
                        return { success: false, error: err.message };
                    }
                }

                // 4. Provedor Webhook / Google Apps Script
                if (this.config.provider === 'webhook' && this.config.webhookUrl) {
                    try {
                        const res = await fetch(this.config.webhookUrl.trim(), {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                            body: JSON.stringify({
                                email: toEmail,
                                name: userName,
                                code: code,
                                subject: subject,
                                html: html
                            })
                        });
                        return { success: res.ok, provider: 'Webhook' };
                    } catch(err) {
                        return { success: false, error: err.message };
                    }
                }

                return {
                    success: false,
                    needsConfig: true,
                    message: 'Nenhum provedor de e-mail (Resend/Brevo/EmailJS) configurado pelo Administrador.'
                };
            }
        }

        class OccurrenceApp {
            constructor() {
                this.occurrences = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_work_occurrences') || '[]');
                this.currentFilter = 'all';
            }

            init() {
                this.updateBadges();
                this.render();
            }

            saveLocally() {
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_work_occurrences', JSON.stringify(this.occurrences));
                this.updateBadges();
                this.render();
                if (window.admin) admin.renderAdminOccurrences();
            }

            setFilter(filter) {
                this.currentFilter = filter;
                if (window.currentMainView !== 'tasks' && typeof window.switchMainView === 'function') {
                    window.switchMainView('tasks');
                }
                ['all', 'pending', 'answered', 'resolved'].forEach(f => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById(`occ-filter-${f}`);
                    if (btn) {
                        if (f === filter) {
                            btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-amber-600 text-black transition shadow-sm";
                        } else {
                            btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition";
                        }
                    }
                });
                this.render();
            }

            updateBadges() {
                const pendingCount = this.occurrences.filter(o => o.status === 'pending_admin' || !o.status).length;
                const badgeDesk = document.getElementById('occurrences-badge');
                const badgeTopbar = document.getElementById('topbar-occurrences-badge');
                const badgeMob = document.getElementById('mob-occurrences-badge');
                const badgeAdminTab = document.getElementById('admin-tab-occurrences-badge');

                if (pendingCount > 0) {
                    if (badgeDesk) { badgeDesk.innerText = pendingCount; badgeDesk.classList.remove('hidden'); }
                    if (badgeTopbar) { badgeTopbar.innerText = pendingCount; badgeTopbar.classList.remove('hidden'); }
                    if (badgeMob) { badgeMob.classList.remove('hidden'); }
                    if (badgeAdminTab) { badgeAdminTab.innerText = pendingCount; badgeAdminTab.classList.remove('hidden'); }
                } else {
                    if (badgeDesk) badgeDesk.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (badgeTopbar) badgeTopbar.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (badgeMob) badgeMob.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (badgeAdminTab) badgeAdminTab.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

            getSpreadsheetCollaborators(filterLeaders = false) {
                const list = [];
                const seen = new Set();

                // 1. Planilha ativa em memória ou cache local
                let sheetColabs = [];
                if (window.scheduleApp && scheduleApp.data && Array.isArray(scheduleApp.data.colaboradores)) {
                    sheetColabs = scheduleApp.data.colaboradores;
                } else {
                    try {
                        const cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_data') || '{}');
                        if (cached && Array.isArray(cached.colaboradores)) {
                            sheetColabs = cached.colaboradores;
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }

                sheetColabs.forEach(c => {
                    const nome = (c.nome || '').trim();
                    if (!nome || nome.toUpperCase() === 'X' || /^\(?em\s*branco\)?$/i.test(nome)) return;

                    let rawDept = (c.departamento || '').trim();
                    const isLideranca = /lideran[çc]a|em\s*branco\s*ou\s*lideran[çc]a/i.test(rawDept) ||
                                        /^(Emerson Diniz|João Guilherme|Bruno Mattara|Bruno)$/i.test(nome);

                    // Se solicitado, remove da lista os colaboradores que forem liderança / "em branco ou liderança"
                    if (filterLeaders && isLideranca) {
                        return;
                    }

                    // Limpa qualquer texto remanescente de 'em branco ou liderança' ou 'liderança'
                    let deptLimpo = rawDept
                        .replace(/\(?em\s*branco(\s*ou\s*lideran[çc]a)?\)?/gi, '')
                        .replace(/\(?lideran[çc]a\)?/gi, '')
                        .trim();

                    if (!seen.has(nome.toUpperCase())) {
                        seen.add(nome.toUpperCase());
                        list.push({
                            nome: nome,
                            departamento: deptLimpo,
                            rawDepartamento: rawDept,
                            escala: c.escala || '',
                            folga: c.folga || ''
                        });
                    }
                });

                // 2. Contas cadastradas no TaskFlow (se não estiverem na lista)
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                accounts.forEach(a => {
                    const nome = (a.displayName || a.name || '').trim();
                    if (!nome || /^\(?em\s*branco\)?$/i.test(nome)) return;

                    const role = (a.role || '').toLowerCase();
                    const isAdmOrLeader = (role === 'admin' || role === 'lider' || role === 'gerente') ||
                                          /^(Emerson Diniz|João Guilherme|Bruno Mattara|Bruno)$/i.test(nome);

                    if (filterLeaders && isAdmOrLeader) {
                        return;
                    }

                    let rawDept = (a.dept || a.department || '').trim();
                    let deptLimpo = rawDept
                        .replace(/\(?em\s*branco(\s*ou\s*lideran[çc]a)?\)?/gi, '')
                        .replace(/\(?lideran[çc]a\)?/gi, '')
                        .trim();

                    if (!seen.has(nome.toUpperCase())) {
                        seen.add(nome.toUpperCase());
                        list.push({
                            nome: nome,
                            departamento: deptLimpo,
                            rawDepartamento: rawDept,
                            escala: '',
                            folga: ''
                        });
                    }
                });

                // Ordena alfabeticamente
                list.sort((a, b) => a.nome.localeCompare(b.nome));
                return list;
            }

            openNewModal() {
                if (window.admin) admin.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-occurrence');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                }
                const input = document.getElementById('occ-collaborator');
                if (input) {
                    input.value = '';
                    input.classList.add('hidden');
                }
                // Preenche os colaboradores da planilha e os líderes responsáveis
                this.populateCollaboratorsDatalist();
                this.populateLeaderSelect();
            }

            closeNewModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-occurrence');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            populateCollaboratorsDatalist() {
                const colabs = this.getSpreadsheetCollaborators(true);

                // 1. Dropdown rápido de seleção da planilha (único campo visível)
                const select = document.getElementById('occ-collab-select');
                if (select) {
                    let html = '<option value="">-- Escolher Colaborador da Planilha --</option>';
                    colabs.forEach(c => {
                        const depto = c.departamento ? ` [${c.departamento}]` : '';
                        html += `<option value="${c.nome}" data-dept="${c.departamento || ''}">${c.nome}${depto}</option>`;
                    });
                    html += '<option value="__OUTRO__">+ Outro Colaborador (Digitar Manualmente)...</option>';
                    select.innerHTML = html;
                    select.value = '';
                }

                // 2. Datalist para autocomplete se necessário
                const datalist = document.getElementById('team-collaborators-datalist');
                if (datalist) {
                    datalist.innerHTML = colabs.map(c => `<option value="${c.nome}">${c.nome} ${c.departamento ? '(' + c.departamento + ')' : ''}</option>`).join('');
                }
            }

            populateLeaderSelect(selectedLeader = '') {
                const select = document.getElementById('occ-leader');
                if (!select) return;

                const primaryLeaders = ["Emerson Diniz", "João Guilherme"];
                const options = new Set(primaryLeaders);

                if (selectedLeader && selectedLeader.trim()) {
                    options.add(selectedLeader.trim());
                }

                if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.displayName) {
                    options.add(auth.currentUser.displayName.trim());
                }

                let html = '';
                options.forEach(lead => {
                    const isAdm = (lead === "Emerson Diniz" || lead === "João Guilherme");
                    html += `<option value="${lead}">${lead}${isAdm ? ' (Administrador)' : ''}</option>`;
                });
                select.innerHTML = html;

                if (selectedLeader) {
                    select.value = selectedLeader;
                } else if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.displayName && Array.from(options).includes(auth.currentUser.displayName)) {
                    select.value = auth.currentUser.displayName;
                } else {
                    select.value = "Emerson Diniz";
                }
            }

            onCollabSelectChange(val) {
                const input = document.getElementById('occ-collaborator');
                if (val === '__OUTRO__') {
                    if (input) {
                        input.classList.remove('hidden');
                        input.value = '';
                        input.focus();
                    }
                    return;
                }

                if (input) {
                    input.classList.add('hidden');
                    input.value = val || '';
                }
                if (!val) return;

                // Tenta auto-selecionar o departamento do colaborador
                const colabs = this.getSpreadsheetCollaborators(false);
                const found = colabs.find(c => c.nome.toUpperCase() === val.toUpperCase());
                if (found && found.departamento) {
                    const deptSelect = document.getElementById('occ-dept');
                    if (deptSelect) {
                        const deptVal = found.departamento.trim();
                        for (let i = 0; i < deptSelect.options.length; i++) {
                            const optText = deptSelect.options[i].text.toLowerCase();
                            const optVal = deptSelect.options[i].value.toLowerCase();
                            if (optVal === deptVal.toLowerCase() || optText.includes(deptVal.toLowerCase()) || deptVal.toLowerCase().includes(optVal)) {
                                deptSelect.selectedIndex = i;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            handleCreateOccurrence(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const title = document.getElementById('occ-title').value.trim();
                const dept = document.getElementById('occ-dept').value;
                const selectVal = document.getElementById('occ-collab-select') ? document.getElementById('occ-collab-select').value : '';
                const inputVal = document.getElementById('occ-collaborator') ? document.getElementById('occ-collaborator').value.trim() : '';
                const collaborator = (selectVal && selectVal !== '__OUTRO__') ? selectVal : inputVal;

                const what = document.getElementById('occ-what').value.trim();
                const resolution = document.getElementById('occ-resolution').value.trim();
                const actionTaken = document.getElementById('occ-action-taken').value;
                const severity = document.getElementById('occ-severity').value;

                const leaderSelect = document.getElementById('occ-leader');
                const selectedLeader = leaderSelect ? leaderSelect.value : (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Emerson Diniz');

                if (!title || !collaborator || !what || !resolution) {
                    alert("Preencha todos os campos obrigatórios da ocorrência (incluindo o colaborador envolvido).");
                    return;
                }

                const currentUser = auth.currentUser || { displayName: selectedLeader, email: 'admin@taskflow.app', role: 'Administrador' };

                const newOcc = {
                    id: 'occ_' + Date.now(),
                    title,
                    department: dept,
                    collaborator,
                    whatHappened: what,
                    currentResolution: resolution,
                    actionTaken,
                    severity,
                    authorName: selectedLeader,
                    authorEmail: currentUser.email,
                    authorRole: 'Líder / Administrador',
                    createdAt: Date.now(),
                    status: 'pending_admin',
                    adminFeedback: null
                };

                this.occurrences.unshift(newOcc);
                this.saveLocally();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'OCCURRENCE_UPSERT',
                        occurrence: newOcc
                    });
                }

                this.closeNewModal();
                e.target.reset();

                if (window.app) app.playNotificationSound();
                syncManager.showToast("✓ Ocorrência enviada ao Administrador para orientação!");
            }

            openAdminReplyModal(occId) {
                const occ = this.occurrences.find(o => o.id === occId);
                if (!occ) return;

                document.getElementById('admin-reply-occ-id').value = occ.id;
                const summaryBox = document.getElementById('admin-reply-case-summary');
                if (summaryBox) {
                    const dateFormatted = new Date(occ.createdAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                    summaryBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-800 pb-2">
                            <div>
                                <span class="font-bold text-amber-300 text-sm">${occ.title}</span>
                                <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Setor: <strong class="text-gray-200">${occ.department}</strong> • Colaborador: <strong class="text-amber-300">${occ.collaborator}</strong></p>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono">${dateFormatted}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="space-y-1 pt-1 text-gray-300">
                            <p><strong class="text-gray-400">Relatado por:</strong> ${occ.authorName} (${occ.authorRole || 'Líder'})</p>
                            <p><strong class="text-gray-400">O que ocorreu:</strong> ${occ.whatHappened}</p>
                            <p><strong class="text-gray-400">Resolução do Líder:</strong> ${occ.currentResolution}</p>
                            <p><strong class="text-gray-400">Medida tomada pelo Líder:</strong> <span class="text-indigo-300">${occ.actionTaken}</span></p>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                if (occ.adminFeedback) {
                    document.getElementById('admin-reply-text').value = occ.adminFeedback.guidance || '';
                    document.getElementById('admin-reply-decision').value = occ.adminFeedback.recommendedDecision || '';
                    document.getElementById('admin-reply-status').value = occ.status || 'answered';
                } else {
                    document.getElementById('admin-reply-text').value = '';
                    document.getElementById('admin-reply-status').value = 'answered';
                }

                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-reply');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                }
            }

            closeAdminReplyModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-reply');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            handleAdminReplySubmit(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const occId = document.getElementById('admin-reply-occ-id').value;
                const occ = this.occurrences.find(o => o.id === occId);
                if (!occ) return;

                const guidance = document.getElementById('admin-reply-text').value.trim();
                const recommendedDecision = document.getElementById('admin-reply-decision').value;
                const newStatus = document.getElementById('admin-reply-status').value;

                if (!guidance) {
                    alert("Digite a orientação e diretriz para o líder.");
                    return;
                }

                const currentAdmin = auth.currentUser || { displayName: 'Administrador', email: 'adm@empresa.com' };

                occ.status = newStatus;
                occ.adminFeedback = {
                    adminName: currentAdmin.displayName,
                    adminEmail: currentAdmin.email,
                    answeredAt: Date.now(),
                    guidance: guidance,
                    recommendedDecision: recommendedDecision
                };

                this.saveLocally();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'OCCURRENCE_REPLY',
                        occurrence: occ
                    });
                }

                this.closeAdminReplyModal();
                if (window.app) app.playNotificationSound();
                syncManager.showToast("✓ Parecer e orientação do Administrador enviados com sucesso!");
            }

            markAsResolved(occId) {
                const occ = this.occurrences.find(o => o.id === occId);
                if (!occ) return;
                occ.status = 'resolved';
                if (!occ.adminFeedback) {
                    occ.adminFeedback = {
                        adminName: (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Administrador'),
                        answeredAt: Date.now(),
                        guidance: 'Processo concluído e arquivado com sucesso.',
                        recommendedDecision: 'Caso resolvido'
                    };
                }
                this.saveLocally();
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'OCCURRENCE_UPSERT',
                        occurrence: occ
                    });
                }
                syncManager.showToast("✓ Ocorrência concluída!");
            }

            deleteOccurrence(occId) {
                if (!confirm("Deseja realmente excluir este registro de ocorrência?")) return;
                this.occurrences = this.occurrences.filter(o => o.id !== occId);
                this.saveLocally();
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'OCCURRENCE_DELETE',
                        occurrenceId: occId
                    });
                }
                syncManager.showToast("Ocorrência excluída.");
            }

            applyRemoteOccurrence(remoteOcc) {
                if (!remoteOcc || !remoteOcc.id) return;
                const idx = this.occurrences.findIndex(o => o.id === remoteOcc.id);
                if (idx !== -1) {
                    this.occurrences[idx] = Object.assign(this.occurrences[idx], remoteOcc);
                } else {
                    this.occurrences.unshift(remoteOcc);
                }
                this.saveLocally();
            }

            applyRemoteDelete(occId) {
                this.occurrences = this.occurrences.filter(o => o.id !== occId);
                this.saveLocally();
            }

            exportOccurrencesToCSV() {
                if (this.occurrences.length === 0) {
                    alert("Nenhuma ocorrência registrada para exportar.");
                    return;
                }

                let csv = "ID,Data,Titulo,Setor,Colaborador_Envolvido,O_Que_Ocorreu,Resolucao_Imediata_Lider,Medida_Tomada,Gravidade,Status,Lider_Relator,Orientacao_ADM,Decisao_ADM\n";
                this.occurrences.forEach(o => {
                    const dateFormatted = new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                    const row = [
                        `"${o.id}"`,
                        `"${dateFormatted}"`,
                        `"${(o.title || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.department || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.collaborator || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.whatHappened || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.currentResolution || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.actionTaken || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${o.severity || 'Normal'}"`,
                        `"${o.status || 'pending_admin'}"`,
                        `"${(o.authorName || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.adminFeedback ? o.adminFeedback.guidance || '' : '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.adminFeedback ? o.adminFeedback.recommendedDecision || '' : '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
                    ];
                    csv += row.join(',') + "\n";
                });

                const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
                const link = document.createElement("a");
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                link.setAttribute("href", url);
                link.setAttribute("download", `TaskFlow_Ocorrencias_Processos_${getLocalTodayString()}.csv`);
                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);
                syncManager.showToast("✓ Relatório de Ocorrências exportado em CSV!");
            }

            render() {
                const container = document.getElementById('occurrences-list');
                if (!container) return;

                let list = [...this.occurrences];
                if (this.currentFilter === 'pending') {
                    list = list.filter(o => o.status === 'pending_admin' || !o.status);
                } else if (this.currentFilter === 'answered') {
                    list = list.filter(o => o.status === 'answered');
                } else if (this.currentFilter === 'resolved') {
                    list = list.filter(o => o.status === 'resolved');
                }

                if (list.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="text-center py-16 text-gray-500 bg-gray-950/40 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-check text-4xl mb-3 text-amber-500/40"></i>
                            <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-300">Nenhuma ocorrência neste filtro</p>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Líderes setoriais podem registrar situações operacionais e acompanhamentos pelo botão "+ Nova Ocorrência".</p>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    return;
                }

                const isAdm = auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.isAdmin;

                container.innerHTML = list.map(occ => {
                    const isPending = occ.status === 'pending_admin' || !occ.status;
                    const isAnswered = occ.status === 'answered';
                    const isResolved = occ.status === 'resolved';

                    const dateFormatted = new Date(occ.createdAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR');

                    const statusBadge = isPending 
                        ? `<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/40 animate-pulse flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400"></span>Aguardando Orientação do ADM</span>`
                        : isAnswered
                        ? `<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/40 flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-400"></span>Orientado pelo ADM</span>`
                        : `<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span>Concluído / Resolvido</span>`;

                    const severityBadge = occ.severity === 'Urgente'
                        ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-extrabold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-950 text-red-400 border border-red-800">URGENTE</span>`
                        : occ.severity === 'Média'
                        ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-950 text-amber-400 border border-amber-800">ATENÇÃO</span>`
                        : `<span class="text-[10px] font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-gray-800 text-gray-400">NORMAL</span>`;

                    return `
                    <div class="bg-gray-900 border ${isPending ? 'border-amber-500/40' : 'border-gray-800'} rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xl space-y-3.5 transition hover:border-gray-700">
                        <!-- Topo do Card -->
                        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5 border-b border-gray-800/80 pb-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                ${statusBadge}
                                ${severityBadge}
                                <span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">Setor: <strong class="text-indigo-300">${occ.department}</strong></span>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono self-end sm:self-auto">${dateFormatted}</span>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Título & Colaborador Envolvido -->
                        <div>
                            <h4 class="text-base font-bold text-gray-100 leading-snug">${occ.title}</h4>
                            <p class="text-xs text-amber-300/90 font-medium mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-user-tag text-xs text-amber-400"></i>
                                <span>Colaborador Envolvido: <strong>${occ.collaborator}</strong></span>
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Fatos & Resoluções do Líder -->
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs bg-gray-950/70 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/70">
                            <div class="space-y-1">
                                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">O que ocorreu (Fatos):</span>
                                <p class="text-gray-200 leading-relaxed break-words whitespace-pre-line">${occ.whatHappened}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="space-y-1">
                                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Resolução no Momento pelo Líder:</span>
                                <p class="text-gray-200 leading-relaxed break-words whitespace-pre-line">${occ.currentResolution}</p>
                                <div class="pt-1.5">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Medida Tomada: </span>
                                    <span class="text-indigo-300 font-semibold">${occ.actionTaken}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Seção de Parecer & Orientação do Administrador -->
                        ${occ.adminFeedback ? `
                            <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-950/30 via-indigo-950/40 to-gray-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/50 space-y-2 shadow-inner">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-black flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-gavel text-[10px]"></i>
                                        </div>
                                        <span class="text-xs font-bold text-amber-300">Parecer & Orientação da Administração</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">${occ.adminFeedback.adminName}</span>
                                </div>
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-100 font-medium leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line pl-8">${occ.adminFeedback.guidance}</p>
                                <div class="pl-8 pt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                                    <span class="text-gray-400">Decisão Recomendada:</span>
                                    <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 font-bold">${occ.adminFeedback.recommendedDecision || 'Aprovado'}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ` : `
                            <div class="bg-amber-950/15 border border-amber-900/30 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-amber-300/80 flex items-center gap-2">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-clock-rotate-left text-amber-400 animate-spin"></i>
                                <span>Aguardando resposta do Administrador para respaldar e guiar a decisão final do líder.</span>
                            </div>
                        `}

                        <!-- Rodapé com Autor e Ações -->
                        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between pt-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                            <span class="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Registrado por: <strong class="text-gray-300">${occ.authorName}</strong> (${occ.authorRole || 'Líder'})</span>
                            <div class="w-full sm:w-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1.5 pt-2 sm:pt-0">
                                ${isAdm ? `
                                    <button onclick="admin.openEditOccurrenceModal('${occ.id}')" title="Editar Registro Completo" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-indigo-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 border border-gray-700">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square text-xs"></i>
                                        <span>Editar</span>
                                    </button>
                                    <button onclick="occApp.openAdminReplyModal('${occ.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-black font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 shadow-md">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-gavel text-xs"></i>
                                        <span>${occ.adminFeedback ? 'Editar Parecer' : 'Dar Resposta'}</span>
                                    </button>
                                    ${!isResolved ? `
                                        <button onclick="occApp.markAsResolved('${occ.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-gray-300 hover:text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition active:scale-95">
                                            Concluir
                                        </button>
                                    ` : ''}
                                    <button onclick="occApp.deleteOccurrence('${occ.id}')" title="Excluir Registro" class="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 rounded-xl transition active:scale-95">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
                                    </button>
                                ` : ''}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');
            }
        }

        // 2. GERENCIADOR DE AUTENTICAÇÃO, VERIFICAÇÃO E APROVAÇÃO
        
        // =========================================================================
        // 1.5 GERENCIADOR DE FEEDBACK DE COLABORADORES & AVALIAÇÃO 1-ON-1
        // =========================================================================
        class FeedbackApp {
            constructor() {
                this.templates = this.loadTemplates();
                this.feedbacks = this.loadFeedbacks();
                this.currentTab = 'history'; // 'history' | 'apply' | 'guidelines'
                this.currentFilter = 'all'; // 'all' | 'pending' | 'Excelente' | 'Bom' | 'Regular' | 'Precisa Melhorar'
                this.searchQuery = '';
                this.deptFilter = '';
                this.lastCreatedFeedbackId = null;
                this.currentDetailFeedbackId = null;
                this.activeCategoryRatings = {};
                this.modalCategoryRatings = {};
                this.modalCollabType = 'app'; // 'app' | 'external'
                this.formCollabType = 'app'; // 'app' | 'external'
                this.modalMode = 'now'; // 'now' | 'assign'
                this.formMode = 'now'; // 'now' | 'assign'
                this.modalCustomTopics = [];
                this.formCustomTopics = [];
                this.editingPendingFeedbackId = null;
            }

            getDefaultTemplates() {

                    {

                        category: 'Organização & Qualidade do Trabalho',
                        description: 'Manutenção do ambiente limpo, zelo por ferramentas e cumprimento das normas operacionais.',
