            loadTemplates() {
                const saved = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_feedback_templates');
                if (saved) {
                    try { return JSON.parse(saved); } catch(e) {}
                }
                return this.getDefaultTemplates();
            }

            loadFeedbacks() {
                const saved = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_feedbacks');
                if (saved) {
                    try { return JSON.parse(saved); } catch(e) {}
                }
                return [];
            }

            saveTemplates(publish = true) {
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_feedback_templates', JSON.stringify(this.templates));
                this.renderGuidelines();
                this.renderApplyForm();
                this.renderAdminPanelGuidelines();
                if (publish && window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'FEEDBACK_TEMPLATES_UPDATE',
                        templates: this.templates
                    });
                }
            }

            saveFeedbacks(publish = true) {
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_feedbacks', JSON.stringify(this.feedbacks));
                this.updateBadges();
                this.renderHistory();
                if (publish && window.syncManager) {
                    // Publicação do estado dos feedbacks
                }
            }

            init() {
                this.updateBadges();
                this.populateCollaboratorsSelect();
                this.populateLeadersSelect('fb-form-leader-select');
                this.populateDeptsSelect('fb-form-collab-dept-ext');
                this.populateDeptFilter();
                this.switchTab('history');
                this.renderAdminPanelGuidelines();

                const dateInput = document.getElementById('fb-form-date');
                if (dateInput && !dateInput.value) {
                    dateInput.value = typeof getLocalTodayString === 'function' ? getLocalTodayString() : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
                }
            }

            getVisibleFeedbacks() {
                const user = (window.auth && auth.currentUser) ? auth.currentUser : null;
                if (!user) return this.feedbacks;

                // Administrador vê TODOS os feedbacks do sistema
                const isAdm = !!(
                    user.isAdmin || 
                    (user.email && (ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(user.email.toLowerCase().trim()) || user.email.toLowerCase().includes('admin'))) ||
                    user.role === 'Administrador' ||
                    (user.role && user.role.toLowerCase().includes('admin')) ||
                    (user.displayName && user.displayName.toUpperCase().includes('ADMIN'))
                );
                if (isAdm) return this.feedbacks;

                const myName = (user.displayName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                const myEmail = (user.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();

                return this.feedbacks.filter(fb => {
                    // Garantia absoluta: se foi criado nesta sessão pelo usuário, exibe sempre
                    if (this.lastCreatedFeedbackId && fb.id === this.lastCreatedFeedbackId) return true;

                    const leaderEmail = (fb.leaderEmail || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    const leaderName = (fb.leaderName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    const collabEmail = (fb.collaboratorEmail || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    const collabName = (fb.collaboratorName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    const createdByEmail = (fb.createdByEmail || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    const createdByName = (fb.createdByName || '').toLowerCase().trim();

                    // 1. Usuário é o Líder responsável atribuído para conduzir o 1-on-1
                    const isMyLeadership = (myEmail && leaderEmail && (leaderEmail === myEmail || leaderEmail.includes(myEmail) || myEmail.includes(leaderEmail))) ||
                                           (myName && leaderName && (leaderName.includes(myName) || myName.includes(leaderName)));
                    if (isMyLeadership) return true;

                    // 2. Usuário é o Colaborador avaliado
                    const isMyEvaluation = (myEmail && collabEmail && (collabEmail === myEmail || collabEmail.includes(myEmail) || myEmail.includes(collabEmail))) ||
                                           (myName && collabName && (collabName.includes(myName) || myName.includes(collabName)));
                    if (isMyEvaluation) return true;

                    // 3. Usuário foi o autor/criador da avaliação
                    const isCreatedByMe = (myEmail && createdByEmail && (createdByEmail === myEmail || createdByEmail.includes(myEmail) || myEmail.includes(createdByEmail))) ||
                                          (myName && createdByName && (createdByName.includes(myName) || myName.includes(createdByName)));
                    if (isCreatedByMe) return true;

                    return false;
                });
            }

            updateBadges() {
                const visible = this.getVisibleFeedbacks();
                const count = visible.length;
                const pendingCount = visible.filter(f => f.status === 'pending').length;

                const b1 = document.getElementById('fb-history-badge');
                const b2 = document.getElementById('feedback-badge');
                const b3 = document.getElementById('topbar-feedback-badge');
                const b4 = document.getElementById('mob-feedback-badge');

                if (b1) {
                    b1.innerText = pendingCount > 0 ? `${count} (${pendingCount} ⏳)` : count;
                }
                if (b2) {
                    b2.innerText = count;
                    if (count > 0) b2.classList.remove('hidden'); else b2.classList.add('hidden');
                }
                if (b3) {
                    b3.innerText = count;
                    if (count > 0) b3.classList.remove('hidden'); else b3.classList.add('hidden');
                }
                if (b4) {
                    if (count > 0) b4.classList.remove('hidden'); else b4.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

            switchTab(tab) {
                this.currentTab = tab;
                const vApply = document.getElementById('fb-view-apply');
                const vHistory = document.getElementById('fb-view-history');
                const vGuidelines = document.getElementById('fb-view-guidelines');

                const btnApply = document.getElementById('fb-tab-apply-btn');
                const btnHistory = document.getElementById('fb-tab-history-btn');
                const btnGuidelines = document.getElementById('fb-tab-guidelines-btn');

                if (vApply) vApply.classList.add('hidden');
                if (vHistory) vHistory.classList.add('hidden');
                if (vGuidelines) vGuidelines.classList.add('hidden');

                const defaultBtnClass = "shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap py-2 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-800/40 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
                const activeBtnClass = "shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap py-2 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-purple-600 text-white transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30";

                if (btnApply) btnApply.className = defaultBtnClass;
                if (btnHistory) btnHistory.className = defaultBtnClass;
                if (btnGuidelines) btnGuidelines.className = defaultBtnClass;

                if (tab === 'apply') {
                    if (vApply) vApply.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (btnApply) btnApply.className = activeBtnClass;
                    this.populateCollaboratorsSelect('fb-form-collaborator');
                    this.populateLeadersSelect('fb-form-leader-select');
                    this.populateDeptsSelect('fb-form-collab-dept-ext');
                    this.renderApplyForm();
                } else if (tab === 'history') {
                    if (vHistory) vHistory.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (btnHistory) btnHistory.className = activeBtnClass;
                    this.renderHistory();
                } else if (tab === 'guidelines') {
                    if (vGuidelines) vGuidelines.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (btnGuidelines) btnGuidelines.className = activeBtnClass;
                    this.renderGuidelines();
                }
            }

            // =====================================================================
            // HELPERS DE COLABORADOR, LÍDER E SETOR
            // =====================================================================
            setModalCollabType(type) {
                this.modalCollabType = type;
                const tabApp = document.getElementById('fb-modal-tab-collab-app');
                const tabExt = document.getElementById('fb-modal-tab-collab-ext');
                const boxApp = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-app-container');
                const boxExt = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-ext-container');

                if (type === 'app') {
                    if (tabApp) tabApp.className = "px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg bg-purple-600 text-white transition shadow-sm";
                    if (tabExt) tabExt.className = "px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition";
                    if (boxApp) boxApp.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (boxExt) boxExt.classList.add('hidden');
                } else {
                    if (tabExt) tabExt.className = "px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg bg-purple-600 text-white transition shadow-sm";
                    if (tabApp) tabApp.className = "px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition";
                    if (boxExt) boxExt.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (boxApp) boxApp.classList.add('hidden');
                    this.populateDeptsSelect('fb-modal-collab-dept-ext');
                }
            }

            setFormCollabType(type) {
                this.formCollabType = type;
                const tabApp = document.getElementById('fb-form-tab-collab-app');
                const tabExt = document.getElementById('fb-form-tab-collab-ext');
                const boxApp = document.getElementById('fb-form-collab-app-container');
                const boxExt = document.getElementById('fb-form-collab-ext-container');

                if (type === 'app') {
                    if (tabApp) tabApp.className = "px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg bg-purple-600 text-white transition shadow-sm";
                    if (tabExt) tabExt.className = "px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition";
                    if (boxApp) boxApp.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (boxExt) boxExt.classList.add('hidden');
                } else {
                    if (tabExt) tabExt.className = "px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg bg-purple-600 text-white transition shadow-sm";
                    if (tabApp) tabApp.className = "px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition";
                    if (boxExt) boxExt.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (boxApp) boxApp.classList.add('hidden');
                    this.populateDeptsSelect('fb-form-collab-dept-ext');
                }
            }

            populateLeadersSelect(targetSelectId = 'fb-modal-leader-select') {
                const select = document.getElementById(targetSelectId);
                if (!select) return;

                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                let leaders = accounts.filter(a => a.status === 'approved' && (a.isAdmin || a.role === 'Administrador' || a.role === 'Líder' || a.role === 'Gerente' || a.role === 'Supervisor'));
                
                // Fallback para todas as contas aprovadas caso não haja roles cadastrados
                if (leaders.length === 0) {
                    leaders = accounts.filter(a => a.status === 'approved');
                }

                const currentVal = select.value;
                const currentUser = window.auth ? auth.currentUser : null;

                let optionsHtml = '';
                leaders.forEach(a => {
                    const label = `${a.displayName} (${a.role || (a.isAdmin ? 'Administrador' : 'Líder')}) - ${a.dept || 'Geral'}`;
                    optionsHtml += `<option value="${a.email}">${label}</option>`;
                });

                select.innerHTML = optionsHtml;

                if (currentVal) {
                    select.value = currentVal;
                } else if (currentUser && currentUser.email) {
                    // Pré-seleciona o usuário conectado
                    const exists = leaders.some(l => l.email.toLowerCase() === currentUser.email.toLowerCase());
                    if (exists) select.value = currentUser.email;
                    else if (select.options.length > 0) select.selectedIndex = 0;
                }
            }

            populateDeptsSelect(targetSelectId = 'fb-modal-collab-dept-ext') {
                const select = document.getElementById(targetSelectId);
                if (!select) return;

                const defaultDepts = ['ARROZ/OLEO', 'BAZAR', 'BEBIDA', 'CAFE/SALG', 'FARINACEO', 'LEITE', 'LEITE COND', 'LIMP', 'MAC/MOL', 'MATINAIS/BISC', 'PERFUMARIA', 'RAÇÃO/PAPEL/VIN', 'SUPORTE', 'Liderança', 'Geral'];
                const depts = window.admin ? admin.getDepartments() : defaultDepts;
                const currentVal = select.value;
                select.innerHTML = depts.map(d => `<option value="${d}">${d}</option>`).join('');
                if (currentVal) select.value = currentVal;
            }

            populateCollaboratorsSelect(targetSelectId = null) {
                const select = document.getElementById(targetSelectId || 'fb-form-collaborator');
                if (!select) return;

                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const approved = accounts.filter(a => a.status === 'approved' || a.isAdmin);

                const currentVal = select.value;
                select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Selecione o colaborador...</option>' + 
                    approved.map(a => `<option value="${a.email}">${a.displayName} - ${a.dept || 'Geral'} (${a.role || 'Colaborador'})` + (a.isAdmin ? ' [ADM]' : '') + `</option>`).join('');

                if (currentVal) select.value = currentVal;
            }

            populateDeptFilter() {
                const select = document.getElementById('fb-history-filter-dept');
                if (!select) return;

                const defaultDepts = ['ARROZ/OLEO', 'BAZAR', 'BEBIDA', 'CAFE/SALG', 'FARINACEO', 'LEITE', 'LEITE COND', 'LIMP', 'MAC/MOL', 'MATINAIS/BISC', 'PERFUMARIA', 'RAÇÃO/PAPEL/VIN', 'SUPORTE', 'Liderança', 'Geral'];
                const depts = window.admin ? admin.getDepartments() : defaultDepts;
                select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Todos os Setores</option>' + 
                    depts.map(d => `<option value="${d}">${d}</option>`).join('');
            }

            onModalModeChange(mode) {
                this.modalMode = mode;
                const box = document.getElementById('fb-modal-assign-instructions-container');
                const btn = document.getElementById('fb-modal-submit-btn');
                const planInput = document.getElementById('fb-modal-action-plan');
                const planLabel = document.getElementById('fb-modal-action-plan-label');

                if (mode === 'assign') {
                    if (box) box.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (btn) btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane mr-1.5"></i> <span>Atribuir Avaliação para o Líder Aplicar</span>`;
                    if (planInput) planInput.removeAttribute('required');
                    if (planLabel) planLabel.innerText = "Plano de Ação Sugerido pelo Admin (Opcional - Líder finalizará na reunião):";
                } else {
                    if (box) box.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (btn) btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-floppy-disk mr-1.5"></i> <span>Salvar Feedback & Registrar 1-on-1</span>`;
                    if (planInput) planInput.setAttribute('required', 'true');
                    if (planLabel) planLabel.innerText = "Plano de Ação & Metas para o Próximo Ciclo *";
                }
            }

            onFormModeChange(mode) {
                this.formMode = mode;
                const box = document.getElementById('fb-form-assign-instructions-container');
                const btn = document.getElementById('fb-form-submit-btn');
                const planInput = document.getElementById('fb-form-action-plan');

                if (mode === 'assign') {
                    if (box) box.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (btn) btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane text-sm"></i> <span>Atribuir Avaliação para o Líder Conduzir</span>`;
                    if (planInput) planInput.removeAttribute('required');
                } else {
                    if (box) box.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (btn) btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-floppy-disk text-sm"></i> <span>Salvar Feedback & Registrar no Histórico</span>`;
                    if (planInput) planInput.setAttribute('required', 'true');
                }
            }

            // =====================================================================
            // CRIAÇÃO DINÂMICA DE TÓPICOS / PERGUNTAS NO FORMULÁRIO / MODAL
            // =====================================================================
            toggleAddModalTopicForm() {
                const box = document.getElementById('fb-modal-add-topic-box');
                if (!box) return;
                box.classList.toggle('hidden');
                if (!box.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                    const input = document.getElementById('fb-modal-custom-topic-name');
                    if (input) input.focus();
                }
            }

            addCustomModalTopic() {
                const nameInput = document.getElementById('fb-modal-custom-topic-name');
                const qInput = document.getElementById('fb-modal-custom-topic-question');
                const saveGlobalCheck = document.getElementById('fb-modal-custom-topic-save-global');

                const name = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
                const question = qInput ? qInput.value.trim() : '';

                if (!name) {
                    alert("Por favor, digite o título da competência / tópico.");
                    return;
                }

                const newTopic = {
                    id: 'custom_' + Date.now(),
                    category: name,
                    description: 'Tópico personalizado formulado para esta avaliação.',
                    questions: question ? [question] : ['Atende ao padrão de qualidade exigido pelo setor?'],
                    isCustom: true
                };

                this.modalCustomTopics.push(newTopic);

                if (saveGlobalCheck && saveGlobalCheck.checked) {
                    this.templates.push(newTopic);
                    this.saveTemplates(true);
                }

                if (nameInput) nameInput.value = '';
                if (qInput) qInput.value = '';
                if (saveGlobalCheck) saveGlobalCheck.checked = false;

                this.toggleAddModalTopicForm();
                this.renderModalApplyTopics();
            }

            removeCustomModalTopic(topicId) {
                this.modalCustomTopics = this.modalCustomTopics.filter(t => t.id !== topicId);
                this.renderModalApplyTopics();
            }

            toggleAddFormTopicForm() {
                const box = document.getElementById('fb-form-add-topic-box');
                if (!box) return;
                box.classList.toggle('hidden');
                if (!box.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                    const input = document.getElementById('fb-form-custom-topic-name');
                    if (input) input.focus();
                }
            }

            addCustomFormTopic() {
                const nameInput = document.getElementById('fb-form-custom-topic-name');
                const qInput = document.getElementById('fb-form-custom-topic-question');
                const saveGlobalCheck = document.getElementById('fb-form-custom-topic-save-global');

                const name = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
                const question = qInput ? qInput.value.trim() : '';

                if (!name) {
                    alert("Por favor, digite o título da competência / tópico.");
                    return;
                }

                const newTopic = {
                    id: 'custom_' + Date.now(),
                    category: name,
                    description: 'Tópico formulado para esta avaliação.',
                    questions: question ? [question] : ['Atende ao padrão de qualidade exigido pelo setor?'],
                    isCustom: true
                };

                this.formCustomTopics.push(newTopic);

                if (saveGlobalCheck && saveGlobalCheck.checked) {
                    this.templates.push(newTopic);
                    this.saveTemplates(true);
                }

                if (nameInput) nameInput.value = '';
                if (qInput) qInput.value = '';
                if (saveGlobalCheck) saveGlobalCheck.checked = false;

                this.toggleAddFormTopicForm();
                this.renderApplyForm();
            }

            removeCustomFormTopic(topicId) {
                this.formCustomTopics = this.formCustomTopics.filter(t => t.id !== topicId);
                this.renderApplyForm();
            }

            // =====================================================================
            // MODAL NOVO FEEDBACK / CONDUZIR PENDENTE
            // =====================================================================
            openNewFeedbackModal(prefilledData = null) {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-apply');
                if (!modal) return;

                this.editingPendingFeedbackId = prefilledData ? prefilledData.id : null;
                this.modalCustomTopics = [];
                this.modalCategoryRatings = {};

                this.populateCollaboratorsSelect('fb-modal-collaborator');
                this.populateLeadersSelect('fb-modal-leader-select');
                this.populateDeptsSelect('fb-modal-collab-dept-ext');

                const titleEl = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-title');
                const subtitleEl = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-subtitle');
                const dateInput = document.getElementById('fb-modal-date');
                if (dateInput) dateInput.value = typeof getLocalTodayString === 'function' ? getLocalTodayString() : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

                if (prefilledData) {
                    // Modo de Condução de Feedback Pré-agendado / Pendente
                    if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = prefilledData.status === 'pending' ? "Conduzir Avaliação 1-on-1 (Atribuída pelo ADM)" : "Editar Avaliação 1-on-1";
                    if (subtitleEl) subtitleEl.innerText = `Avaliação de ${prefilledData.collaboratorName} • Líder Responsável: ${prefilledData.leaderName}`;

                    if (prefilledData.isExternalOrNonAccount) {
                        this.setModalCollabType('external');
                        const nEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-name-ext');
                        const dEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-dept-ext');
                        const rEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-role-ext');
                        if (nEl) nEl.value = prefilledData.collaboratorName || '';
                        if (dEl) dEl.value = prefilledData.collaboratorDept || 'Geral';
                        if (rEl) rEl.value = prefilledData.collaboratorRole || 'Colaborador';
                    } else {
                        this.setModalCollabType('app');
                        const colSelect = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collaborator');
                        if (colSelect) colSelect.value = prefilledData.collaboratorEmail || '';
                        this.onModalCollaboratorChange(prefilledData.collaboratorEmail);
                    }

                    const cycleSelect = document.getElementById('fb-modal-cycle');
                    if (cycleSelect && prefilledData.cycle) cycleSelect.value = prefilledData.cycle;

                    const leaderSelect = document.getElementById('fb-modal-leader-select');
                    if (leaderSelect && prefilledData.leaderEmail) leaderSelect.value = prefilledData.leaderEmail;

                    // Tópicos salvos
                    if (prefilledData.topics && prefilledData.topics.length > 0) {
                        prefilledData.topics.forEach(t => {
                            this.modalCategoryRatings[t.categoryId] = t.rating || 'Bom';
                            const existsInTemplates = this.templates.some(c => c.id === t.categoryId);
                            if (!existsInTemplates) {
                                this.modalCustomTopics.push({
                                    id: t.categoryId,
                                    category: t.categoryName,
                                    description: 'Critério formulado pelo Administrador para esta sessão.',
                                    questions: t.questions || ['Critério avaliado na sessão.'],
                                    isCustom: true
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }

                    const overallEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-overall');
                    if (overallEl && prefilledData.overallRating && prefilledData.overallRating !== 'Aguardando Avaliação') {
                        overallEl.value = prefilledData.overallRating;
                    }

                    const posEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-positives');
                    if (posEl) posEl.value = prefilledData.positiveHighlights || '';

                    const actEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-action-plan');
                    if (actEl) actEl.value = prefilledData.actionPlan || '';

                    const folEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-follow-up');
                    if (folEl && prefilledData.followUpDate) folEl.value = prefilledData.followUpDate;

                    const notesEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-assign-notes');
                    if (notesEl && prefilledData.adminNotes) notesEl.value = prefilledData.adminNotes;

                    // Sempre abre em modo "Realizar e Concluir Agora" quando conduzindo
                    const radioNow = document.querySelector('input[name="fb-modal-mode"][value="now"]');
                    if (radioNow) radioNow.checked = true;
                    this.onModalModeChange('now');
                } else {
                    // Novo do Zero
                    if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = "Nova Avaliação 1-on-1 & Feedback";
                    if (subtitleEl) subtitleEl.innerText = "Aplicação de diretrizes corporativas e alinhamento de desempenho";
                    this.setModalCollabType('app');

                    const form = document.querySelector('#modal-feedback-apply form');
                    if (form) form.reset();

                    if (dateInput) dateInput.value = typeof getLocalTodayString === 'function' ? getLocalTodayString() : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    this.populateLeadersSelect('fb-modal-leader-select');

                    const radioNow = document.querySelector('input[name="fb-modal-mode"][value="now"]');
                    if (radioNow) radioNow.checked = true;
                    this.onModalModeChange('now');
                }

                this.renderModalApplyTopics();

                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                modal.style.display = 'flex';
                modal.style.zIndex = '99999';
            }

            conductPendingFeedback(id) {
                const fb = this.feedbacks.find(f => f.id === id);
                if (!fb) return;
                this.openNewFeedbackModal(fb);
            }

            closeNewFeedbackModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-apply');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                this.editingPendingFeedbackId = null;
            }

            onModalCollaboratorChange(email) {
                const infoEl = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-info');
                if (!email) {
                    if (infoEl) infoEl.classList.add('hidden');
                    return;
                }
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (acc && infoEl) {
                    infoEl.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400 mr-1.5"></i> Setor: <strong>${acc.dept || 'Geral'}</strong> • Cargo: <strong>${acc.role || 'Colaborador'}</strong> • E-mail: ${acc.email}`;
                    infoEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            }

            onCollaboratorChange(email) {
                const infoEl = document.getElementById('fb-form-collab-info');
                if (!email) {
                    if (infoEl) infoEl.classList.add('hidden');
                    return;
                }
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (acc && infoEl) {
                    infoEl.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400 mr-1.5"></i> Setor: <strong>${acc.dept || 'Geral'}</strong> • Cargo: <strong>${acc.role || 'Colaborador'}</strong> • E-mail: ${acc.email}`;
                    infoEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            }

            setModalTopicRating(catId, rating) {
                if (!this.modalCategoryRatings) this.modalCategoryRatings = {};
                this.modalCategoryRatings[catId] = rating;

                const options = ['Excelente', 'Bom', 'Regular', 'Precisa Melhorar'];
                options.forEach(opt => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById(`fb-modal-rate-${catId}-${opt.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}`);
                    if (btn) {
                        if (opt === rating) {
                            if (opt === 'Excelente') {
                                btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500 text-black border border-emerald-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95";
                            } else if (opt === 'Bom') {
                                btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-600 text-white border border-indigo-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95";
                            } else if (opt === 'Regular') {
                                btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500 text-black border border-amber-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95";
                            } else {
                                btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-red-600 text-white border border-red-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95";
                            }
                        } else {
                            btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition active:scale-95";
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            setTopicRating(catId, rating) {
                this.activeCategoryRatings[catId] = rating;
                const options = ['Excelente', 'Bom', 'Regular', 'Precisa Melhorar'];
                options.forEach(opt => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById(`fb-rate-${catId}-${opt.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}`);
                    if (btn) {
                        if (opt === rating) {
                            if (opt === 'Excelente') {
                                btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500 text-black border border-emerald-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95";
                            } else if (opt === 'Bom') {
                                btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-600 text-white border border-indigo-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95";
                            } else if (opt === 'Regular') {
                                btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500 text-black border border-amber-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95";
                            } else {
                                btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-red-600 text-white border border-red-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95";
                            }
                        } else {
                            btn.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition active:scale-95";
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            renderModalApplyTopics() {
                const container = document.getElementById('fb-modal-topics-container');
                if (!container) return;

                if (!this.modalCategoryRatings) this.modalCategoryRatings = {};

                const allTopics = [...this.templates, ...this.modalCustomTopics];

                if (allTopics.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div class="p-4 text-center text-xs text-gray-400 bg-gray-900 rounded-xl">Nenhum tópico cadastrado no momento.</div>`;
                    return;
                }

                container.innerHTML = allTopics.map((cat, idx) => {
                    const currentRating = this.modalCategoryRatings[cat.id] || 'Bom';
                    this.modalCategoryRatings[cat.id] = currentRating;

                    return `
                    <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-3">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-800/60 pb-2">
                            <div>
                                <h5 class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-gray-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-md bg-purple-600/30 text-purple-300 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold">${idx + 1}</span>
                                    <span>${cat.category}</span>
                                    ${cat.isCustom ? '<span class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-950 text-purple-300 border border-purple-800 font-semibold">Tópico Desta Sessão</span>' : ''}
                                </h5>
                                <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">${cat.description}</p>
                            </div>
                            ${cat.isCustom ? `<button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.removeCustomModalTopic('${cat.id}')" class="text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 text-xs p-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i></button>` : ''}
                        </div>

                        <div class="space-y-1 bg-gray-950/70 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/60 text-xs">
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-300 uppercase tracking-wider block">Critérios / Perguntas para o Líder abordar:</span>
                            <ul class="space-y-1 text-gray-300">
                                ${(cat.questions || []).map(q => `
                                    <li class="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-angle-right text-purple-400 text-[10px] mt-1 shrink-0"></i>
                                        <span>${q}</span>
                                    </li>
                                `).join('')}
                            </ul>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">Classificação do Tópico:</label>
                            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                                ${['Excelente', 'Bom', 'Regular', 'Precisa Melhorar'].map(opt => {
                                    const isSel = opt === currentRating;
                                    const selClass = isSel
                                        ? (opt === 'Excelente' ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-black border-emerald-400 shadow-md font-bold'
                                          : opt === 'Bom' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-400 shadow-md font-bold'
                                          : opt === 'Regular' ? 'bg-amber-500 text-black border-amber-400 shadow-md font-bold'
                                          : 'bg-red-600 text-white border-red-400 shadow-md font-bold')
                                        : 'bg-gray-950 border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200';
                                    return `<button type="button" id="fb-modal-rate-${cat.id}-${opt.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}" onclick="feedbackApp.setModalTopicRating('${cat.id}', '${opt}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition border ${selClass}">${opt === 'Excelente' ? '🟢' : opt === 'Bom' ? '🔵' : opt === 'Regular' ? '🟡' : '🔴'} ${opt}</button>`;
                                }).join('')}
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <input type="text" id="fb-modal-obs-${cat.id}" placeholder="Observações e exemplos reais do dia a dia sobre ${cat.category}..." class="w-full bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500 transition">
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');
            }

            renderApplyForm() {

                        </div>

                        <!-- Seletor de Avaliação da Competência -->

                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-300">Avaliação do Líder para este Tópico:</span>
                            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">

'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500 text-black border border-emerald-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95' : 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition active:scale-95'}"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 inline-block mr-1"></span>Excelente</button>

'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-600 text-white border border-indigo-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95' : 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition active:scale-95'}"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-400 inline-block mr-1"></span>Bom</button>
                                <button type="button" id="fb-rate-${cat.id}-Regular" onclick="feedbackApp.setTopicRating('${cat.id}', 'Regular')" class="${currentRating === 'Regular' ? 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500 text-black border border-amber-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95' : 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition active:scale-95'}"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 inline-block mr-1"></span>Regular</button>
                                <button type="button" id="fb-rate-${cat.id}-Precisa_Melhorar" onclick="feedbackApp.setTopicRating('${cat.id}', 'Precisa Melhorar')" class="${currentRating === 'Precisa Melhorar' ? 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-red-600 text-white border border-red-400 shadow-md transition active:scale-95' : 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition active:scale-95'}"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-400 inline-block mr-1"></span>Precisa Melhorar</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Campo de Observações do Tópico -->
                        <div>
                            <input type="text" id="fb-notes-${cat.id}" placeholder="Observações e exemplos reais do dia a dia sobre esta competência..." class="w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500 transition">
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
