            // =====================================================================
            // SALVAMENTO DE FEEDBACK (MODAL & FORMULÁRIO)
            // =====================================================================
            handleSaveModalFeedback(event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                try {
                    let collabName = '', collabEmail = '', collabDept = 'Geral', collabRole = 'Colaborador', isExternal = false;

                    if (this.modalCollabType === 'app') {
                        collabEmail = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collaborator').value;
                        if (!collabEmail) {
                            alert("Por favor, selecione o colaborador avaliado com conta.");
                            return;
                        }
                        const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                        const collabAcc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === collabEmail.toLowerCase());
                        collabName = collabAcc ? collabAcc.displayName : collabEmail;
                        collabDept = collabAcc ? (collabAcc.dept || 'Geral') : 'Geral';
                        collabRole = collabAcc ? (collabAcc.role || 'Colaborador') : 'Colaborador';
                    } else {
                        // Funcionário Geral sem conta
                        const nameInput = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-name-ext');
                        const deptInput = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-dept-ext');
                        const roleInput = document.getElementById('fb-modal-collab-role-ext');

                        collabName = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
                        if (!collabName) {
                            alert("Por favor, digite o nome completo do funcionário.");
                            return;
                        }
                        collabDept = deptInput ? deptInput.value : 'Geral';
                        collabRole = roleInput && roleInput.value.trim() ? roleInput.value.trim() : 'Funcionário Operacional';
                        collabEmail = 'geral_' + collabName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_') + '@empresa.local';
                        isExternal = true;
                    }

                    // Líder Responsável Selecionado
                    const leaderSelect = document.getElementById('fb-modal-leader-select');
                    const leaderEmail = leaderSelect ? leaderSelect.value : (window.auth && auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.email : '');
                    const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                    const leaderAcc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === leaderEmail.toLowerCase());
                    const leaderName = leaderAcc ? leaderAcc.displayName : (window.auth && auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Líder Responsável');
                    const leaderRole = leaderAcc ? (leaderAcc.role || 'Líder') : 'Líder';

                    const cycle = document.getElementById('fb-modal-cycle').value;
                    const date = document.getElementById('fb-modal-date').value || (typeof getLocalTodayString === 'function' ? getLocalTodayString() : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);

                    // Coleta de tópicos (padrão + customizados)
                    const allTopics = [...this.templates, ...this.modalCustomTopics];
                    const topicsData = allTopics.map(cat => {
                        const obsInput = document.getElementById(`fb-modal-obs-${cat.id}`);
                        return {
                            categoryId: cat.id,
                            categoryName: cat.category,
                            rating: (this.modalCategoryRatings && this.modalCategoryRatings[cat.id]) || 'Bom',
                            notes: obsInput ? obsInput.value.trim() : '',
                            questions: cat.questions || []
                        };
                    });

                    const mode = this.modalMode; // 'now' | 'assign'
                    const isAssign = mode === 'assign';

                    const overallRating = isAssign ? 'Aguardando Avaliação' : document.getElementById('fb-modal-overall').value;
                    const positiveHighlights = document.getElementById('fb-modal-positives').value.trim();
                    const actionPlan = document.getElementById('fb-modal-action-plan').value.trim();
                    const followUpDate = document.getElementById('fb-modal-follow-up').value;
                    const adminNotes = isAssign ? (document.getElementById('fb-modal-assign-notes') ? document.getElementById('fb-modal-assign-notes').value.trim() : '') : '';

                    const currentUser = window.auth ? auth.currentUser : null;
                    const feedbackObj = {
                        id: this.editingPendingFeedbackId || ('fb_' + Date.now()),
                        createdAt: Date.now(),
                        date: date,
                        cycle: cycle,
                        collaboratorName: collabName,
                        collaboratorEmail: collabEmail,
                        collaboratorDept: collabDept,
                        collaboratorRole: collabRole,
                        isExternalOrNonAccount: isExternal,
                        leaderName: leaderName,
                        leaderEmail: leaderEmail,
                        leaderRole: leaderRole,
                        createdByEmail: currentUser ? currentUser.email : '',
                        createdByName: currentUser ? currentUser.displayName : 'Administrador',
                        createdByRole: currentUser ? (currentUser.role || (currentUser.isAdmin ? 'Administrador' : 'Líder')) : 'Administrador',
                        createdByAdmin: currentUser ? !!(currentUser.isAdmin || currentUser.role === 'Administrador') : true,
                        assignedByAdmin: isAssign || !!this.editingPendingFeedbackId,
                        status: isAssign ? 'pending' : 'completed',
                        adminNotes: adminNotes,
                        topics: topicsData,
                        positiveHighlights: positiveHighlights,
                        actionPlan: actionPlan || (isAssign ? 'Será alinhado pelo Líder durante o 1-on-1.' : ''),
                        overallRating: overallRating,
                        followUpDate: followUpDate,
                        agreement: true
                    };

                    if (this.editingPendingFeedbackId) {
                        const idx = this.feedbacks.findIndex(f => f.id === this.editingPendingFeedbackId);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.feedbacks[idx] = feedbackObj;
                        } else {
                            this.feedbacks.unshift(feedbackObj);
                        }
                    } else {
                        this.feedbacks.unshift(feedbackObj);
                    }

                    this.saveFeedbacks(true);

                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        syncManager.publish({
                            type: 'FEEDBACK_UPSERT',
                            feedback: feedbackObj
                        });
                        const msg = isAssign
                            ? `✓ Avaliação atribuída para o Líder ${leaderName} conduzir com ${collabName}!`
                            : `✓ Feedback de ${collabName} registrado com sucesso!`;
                        syncManager.showToast(msg);
                    }

                    this.lastCreatedFeedbackId = feedbackObj.id;
                    this.currentFilter = 'all';
                    this.searchQuery = '';
                    this.deptFilter = '';
                    const searchInput = document.getElementById('fb-history-search');
                    if (searchInput) searchInput.value = '';
                    const deptSelect = document.getElementById('fb-history-filter-dept');
                    if (deptSelect) deptSelect.value = '';
                    this.setRatingFilter('all');

                    this.closeNewFeedbackModal();
                    window.switchMainView('feedback');
                    this.switchTab('history');
                    this.renderHistory();
                } catch(err) {
                    console.error("Erro ao salvar feedback:", err);
                    alert("Ocorreu um erro ao salvar o feedback: " + err.message);
                }
            }

            handleSaveFeedback(event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                try {
                    let collabName = '', collabEmail = '', collabDept = 'Geral', collabRole = 'Colaborador', isExternal = false;

                    if (this.formCollabType === 'app') {
                        collabEmail = document.getElementById('fb-form-collaborator').value;
                        if (!collabEmail) {
                            alert("Por favor, selecione o colaborador avaliado com conta.");
                            return;
                        }
                        const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                        const collabAcc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === collabEmail.toLowerCase());
                        collabName = collabAcc ? collabAcc.displayName : collabEmail;
                        collabDept = collabAcc ? (collabAcc.dept || 'Geral') : 'Geral';
                        collabRole = collabAcc ? (collabAcc.role || 'Colaborador') : 'Colaborador';
                    } else {
                        const nameInput = document.getElementById('fb-form-collab-name-ext');
                        const deptInput = document.getElementById('fb-form-collab-dept-ext');
                        const roleInput = document.getElementById('fb-form-collab-role-ext');

                        collabName = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
                        if (!collabName) {
                            alert("Por favor, digite o nome completo do funcionário.");
                            return;
                        }
                        collabDept = deptInput ? deptInput.value : 'Geral';
                        collabRole = roleInput && roleInput.value.trim() ? roleInput.value.trim() : 'Funcionário Operacional';
                        collabEmail = 'geral_' + collabName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_') + '@empresa.local';
                        isExternal = true;
                    }

                    // Líder Responsável Selecionado
                    const leaderSelect = document.getElementById('fb-form-leader-select');
                    const leaderEmail = leaderSelect ? leaderSelect.value : (window.auth && auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.email : '');
                    const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                    const leaderAcc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === leaderEmail.toLowerCase());
                    const leaderName = leaderAcc ? leaderAcc.displayName : (window.auth && auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Líder Responsável');
                    const leaderRole = leaderAcc ? (leaderAcc.role || 'Líder') : 'Líder';

                    const cycle = document.getElementById('fb-form-cycle').value;
                    const date = document.getElementById('fb-form-date').value || (typeof getLocalTodayString === 'function' ? getLocalTodayString() : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);

                    const allTopics = [...this.templates, ...this.formCustomTopics];
                    const topicsData = allTopics.map(cat => {
                        const rating = this.activeCategoryRatings[cat.id] || 'Bom';
                        const notesEl = document.getElementById(`fb-notes-${cat.id}`);
                        const notes = notesEl ? notesEl.value.trim() : '';
                        return {
                            categoryId: cat.id,
                            categoryName: cat.category,
                            rating: rating,
                            notes: notes,
                            questions: cat.questions || []
                        };
                    });

                    const isAssign = this.formMode === 'assign';
                    const overallRating = isAssign ? 'Aguardando Avaliação' : document.getElementById('fb-form-overall-rating').value;
                    const positiveHighlights = document.getElementById('fb-form-positive').value.trim();
                    const actionPlan = document.getElementById('fb-form-action-plan').value.trim();
                    const followUpDate = document.getElementById('fb-form-followup-date').value;
                    const agreement = document.getElementById('fb-form-agreement').checked;
                    const adminNotes = isAssign ? (document.getElementById('fb-form-assign-notes') ? document.getElementById('fb-form-assign-notes').value.trim() : '') : '';

                    const currentUserForm = window.auth ? auth.currentUser : null;
                    const newFeedback = {
                        id: 'fb_' + Date.now(),
                        createdAt: Date.now(),
                        date: date,
                        cycle: cycle,
                        collaboratorName: collabName,
                        collaboratorEmail: collabEmail,
                        collaboratorDept: collabDept,
                        collaboratorRole: collabRole,
                        isExternalOrNonAccount: isExternal,
                        leaderName: leaderName,
                        leaderEmail: leaderEmail,
                        leaderRole: leaderRole,
                        createdByEmail: currentUserForm ? currentUserForm.email : '',
                        createdByName: currentUserForm ? currentUserForm.displayName : 'Administrador',
                        createdByRole: currentUserForm ? (currentUserForm.role || (currentUserForm.isAdmin ? 'Administrador' : 'Líder')) : 'Administrador',
                        createdByAdmin: currentUserForm ? !!(currentUserForm.isAdmin || currentUserForm.role === 'Administrador') : true,
                        assignedByAdmin: isAssign,
                        status: isAssign ? 'pending' : 'completed',
                        adminNotes: adminNotes,
                        topics: topicsData,
                        positiveHighlights: positiveHighlights,
                        actionPlan: actionPlan || (isAssign ? 'Será alinhado pelo Líder durante o 1-on-1.' : ''),
                        overallRating: overallRating,
                        followUpDate: followUpDate,
                        agreement: agreement
                    };

                    this.feedbacks.unshift(newFeedback);
                    this.saveFeedbacks(true);

                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        syncManager.publish({
                            type: 'FEEDBACK_UPSERT',
                            feedback: newFeedback
                        });
                        const msg = isAssign
                            ? `✓ Avaliação atribuída para o Líder ${leaderName} conduzir com ${collabName}!`
                            : `✓ Feedback de ${collabName} registrado com sucesso!`;
                        syncManager.showToast(msg);
                    }

                    this.lastCreatedFeedbackId = newFeedback.id;
                    this.currentFilter = 'all';
                    this.searchQuery = '';
                    this.deptFilter = '';
                    const searchInput = document.getElementById('fb-history-search');
                    if (searchInput) searchInput.value = '';
                    const deptSelect = document.getElementById('fb-history-filter-dept');
                    if (deptSelect) deptSelect.value = '';
                    this.setRatingFilter('all');

                    this.resetForm();
                    this.switchTab('history');
                    this.renderHistory();
                } catch(err) {
                    console.error("Erro ao salvar feedback:", err);
                    alert("Ocorreu um erro ao salvar o feedback: " + err.message);
                }
            }

            resetForm() {
                const form = document.querySelector('#fb-view-apply form');
                if (form) form.reset();

                const infoEl = document.getElementById('fb-form-collab-info');
                if (infoEl) infoEl.classList.add('hidden');

                const dateInput = document.getElementById('fb-form-date');
                if (dateInput) dateInput.value = typeof getLocalTodayString === 'function' ? getLocalTodayString() : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

                this.setFormCollabType('app');
                this.onFormModeChange('now');
                this.formCustomTopics = [];
                this.activeCategoryRatings = {};
                this.populateLeadersSelect('fb-form-leader-select');
                this.renderApplyForm();
            }

            // =====================================================================
            // HISTÓRICO CONSULTÁVEL & FILTROS
            // =====================================================================
            onSearchInput(val) {
                this.searchQuery = val.trim().toLowerCase();
                this.renderHistory();
            }

            onDeptFilterChange(val) {
                this.deptFilter = val;
                this.renderHistory();
            }

            setRatingFilter(filter) {
                this.currentFilter = filter;
                ['all', 'pending', 'excelente', 'bom', 'regular', 'melhorar'].forEach(f => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById(`fb-filter-${f}`);
                    if (btn) {
                        const targetKey = f === 'all' ? 'all' : f === 'pending' ? 'pending' : f === 'melhorar' ? 'Precisa Melhorar' : f.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + f.slice(1);
                        if (targetKey.toLowerCase() === filter.toLowerCase()) {
                            btn.className = "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-purple-600 text-white transition shadow-sm";
                        } else {
                            btn.className = "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition";
                        }
                    }
                });
                this.renderHistory();
            }

            renderHistory() {
                try {
                    const container = document.getElementById('fb-history-list');
                    if (!container) return;

                    const visibleFeedbacks = this.getVisibleFeedbacks();

                    // Renderiza o Gráfico de Pizza no topo do histórico
                    const chartContainer = document.getElementById('fb-history-pie-chart-container');
                    const badgeTotal = document.getElementById('fb-history-pie-total-badge');
                    if (badgeTotal) badgeTotal.innerText = `${visibleFeedbacks.length} avaliações`;

                    if (chartContainer && typeof window.createSvgPieChart === 'function') {
                        try {
                            const fbCounts = { 'Excelente': 0, 'Bom': 0, 'Regular': 0, 'Precisa Melhorar': 0, 'Pendente': 0 };
                            visibleFeedbacks.forEach(f => {
                                if (f.status === 'pending') {
                                    fbCounts['Pendente']++;
                                } else if (fbCounts[f.overallRating] !== undefined) {
                                    fbCounts[f.overallRating]++;
                                } else {
                                    fbCounts['Bom']++;
                                }
                            });

                            const pieSlices = [
                                { label: 'Excelente (Supera)', value: fbCounts['Excelente'], color: '#10b981' },
                                { label: 'Bom (Atende)', value: fbCounts['Bom'], color: '#6366f1' },
                                { label: 'Regular (Atenção)', value: fbCounts['Regular'], color: '#f59e0b' },
                                { label: 'Precisa Melhorar', value: fbCounts['Precisa Melhorar'], color: '#ef4444' },
                                { label: 'Pendente (Aguardando Líder)', value: fbCounts['Pendente'], color: '#a855f7' }
                            ];

                            chartContainer.innerHTML = window.createSvgPieChart(pieSlices, { donut: true, centerLabel: 'Feedbacks' });
                        } catch(chartErr) {
                            console.error("Erro ao gerar gráfico de pizza dos feedbacks:", chartErr);
                        }
                    }

                    let list = [...visibleFeedbacks];

                    // Filtro por Classificação Geral ou Pendente
                    if (this.currentFilter === 'pending') {
                        list = list.filter(fb => fb.status === 'pending');
                    } else if (this.currentFilter && this.currentFilter !== 'all') {
                        list = list.filter(fb => fb.status !== 'pending' && fb.overallRating === this.currentFilter);
                    }

                    // Filtro por Setor
                    if (this.deptFilter) {
                        list = list.filter(fb => (fb.collaboratorDept || '').toLowerCase() === this.deptFilter.toLowerCase());
                    }

                    // Busca por texto
                    if (this.searchQuery) {
                        list = list.filter(fb => 
                            (fb.collaboratorName || '').toLowerCase().includes(this.searchQuery) ||
                            (fb.leaderName || '').toLowerCase().includes(this.searchQuery) ||
                            (fb.collaboratorDept || '').toLowerCase().includes(this.searchQuery) ||
                            (fb.actionPlan || '').toLowerCase().includes(this.searchQuery) ||
                            (fb.adminNotes || '').toLowerCase().includes(this.searchQuery)
                        );
                    }

                    if (list.length === 0) {
                        container.innerHTML = `
                            <div class="text-center py-12 px-4 bg-gray-950/60 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl space-y-3">
                                <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-400 border border-purple-900/50 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-xl shadow-lg">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-comments"></i>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <p class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-200">Nenhum feedback registrado neste filtro</p>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">Líderes e administradores podem aplicar feedbacks ou atribuir aos líderes pelo botão "+ Feedback".</p>
                                </div>
                                <div class="pt-1">
                                    <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.openNewFeedbackModal()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-purple-600/30 transition active:scale-95">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus mr-1"></i> Nova Avaliação 1-on-1
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        `;
                        return;
                    }

                    const currentUser = window.auth ? auth.currentUser : null;
                    const isAdm = currentUser && (
                        currentUser.isAdmin || 
                        (currentUser.email && (ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(currentUser.email.toLowerCase().trim()) || currentUser.email.toLowerCase().includes('admin'))) || 
                        currentUser.role === 'Administrador' ||
                        (currentUser.displayName && currentUser.displayName.toUpperCase().includes('ADMIN'))
                    );

                    container.innerHTML = list.map(fb => {
                        const isPending = fb.status === 'pending';

                        const ratingColor = isPending
                            ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/50 animate-pulse'
                            : fb.overallRating === 'Excelente'
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40'
                            : fb.overallRating === 'Bom'
                            ? 'bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border-indigo-500/40'
                            : fb.overallRating === 'Regular'
                            ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40'
                            : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border-red-500/40';

                        let dateFormatted = 'Data não informada';
                        try {
                            if (fb.date) {
                                const d = new Date(fb.date.includes('T') ? fb.date : (fb.date + 'T12:00:00'));
                                dateFormatted = !isNaN(d.getTime()) ? d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR') : fb.date;
                            }
                        } catch(e) {
                            dateFormatted = fb.date || '';
                        }

                        return `
                        <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border ${isPending ? 'border-amber-500/40 shadow-amber-950/20' : 'border-gray-800'} rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xl space-y-3 transition hover:border-purple-500/40">
                            <!-- Topo do Card -->
                            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-800/80 pb-3">
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                                    <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl ${isPending ? 'bg-amber-600/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40' : 'bg-purple-600/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30'} flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shrink-0">
                                        ${fb.collaboratorName ? fb.collaboratorName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase() : 'CO'}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="min-w-0">
                                        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                                            <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-100 truncate">${fb.collaboratorName}</h4>
                                            ${fb.isExternalOrNonAccount ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold bg-gray-800 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30"><i class="fa-solid fa-users-viewfinder mr-1"></i> Sem Login</span>' : ''}
                                            <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border ${ratingColor}">
                                                ${isPending ? '⏳ Pendente para o Líder' : fb.overallRating}
                                            </span>
                                        </div>
                                        <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Setor: <strong class="text-indigo-300">${fb.collaboratorDept || 'Geral'}</strong> • Cargo: ${fb.collaboratorRole || 'Colaborador'}</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="flex flex-col items-end shrink-0 text-right">
                                    <span class="text-xs font-mono text-gray-400">${dateFormatted}</span>
                                    <span class="text-[10px] text-purple-300 font-semibold">${fb.cycle}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            ${isPending ? `
                                <!-- Card de Alerta Pendente -->
                                <div class="bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-500/30 p-3 rounded-xl space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-hourglass-half"></i>
                                            <span>Aguardando Aplicação / Condução pelo Líder:</span>
                                        </span>
                                        <strong class="text-white text-xs">${fb.leaderName}</strong>
                                    </div>
                                    ${fb.adminNotes ? `<p class="text-amber-100/90 text-[11px] bg-amber-950/60 p-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-800/40"><strong>Orientações do Administrador:</strong> ${fb.adminNotes}</p>` : ''}
                                    <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-400">O Administrador pré-configurou esta avaliação e atribuiu ao Líder responsável para sentar com o colaborador e alinhar as diretrizes.</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : `
                                <!-- Resumo das Notas por Tópico -->
                                <div class="bg-gray-950/70 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/70 space-y-2">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Resumo das Competências Avaliadas:</span>
                                    <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                                        ${(fb.topics || []).map(t => {
                                            const dotColor = t.rating === 'Excelente' ? 'bg-emerald-400' : t.rating === 'Bom' ? 'bg-indigo-400' : t.rating === 'Regular' ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-red-400';
                                            return `
                                                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 text-[11px] text-gray-300" title="${t.categoryName}: ${t.rating}">
                                                    <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${dotColor}"></span>
                                                    <span class="font-medium truncate max-w-[150px]">${t.categoryName}:</span>
                                                    <strong class="text-white">${t.rating}</strong>
                                                </span>
                                            `;
                                        }).join('')}
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <!-- Plano de Ação & Combinados -->
                                <div class="text-xs bg-gray-950/50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/60 space-y-1">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Plano de Ação Acordado:</span>
                                    <p class="text-gray-200 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">${fb.actionPlan || 'Nenhum plano de ação registrado.'}</p>
                                </div>
                            `}

                            <!-- Rodapé: Líder Conduzindo + Botões de Ação -->
                            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-gray-800/60 gap-2 text-xs">
                                <span class="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Líder Avaliador: <strong class="text-gray-200">${fb.leaderName}</strong> (${fb.leaderRole || 'Líder'})</span>
                                
                                <div class="w-full sm:w-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1.5 pt-1 sm:pt-0">
                                    ${isPending ? `
                                        <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.conductPendingFeedback('${fb.id}')" class="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-play text-xs"></i>
                                            <span>Conduzir e Concluir 1-on-1</span>
                                        </button>
                                    ` : `
                                        <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.openDetailModal('${fb.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-purple-600/20 hover:bg-purple-600 text-purple-300 hover:text-white border border-purple-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 shadow-sm">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines text-xs"></i>
                                            <span>Ver Ficha / Imprimir</span>
                                        </button>
                                    `}
                                    ${isAdm ? `
                                        <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.deleteFeedback('${fb.id}')" title="Excluir Avaliação (Apenas ADM)" class="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-950/30 rounded-xl transition active:scale-95">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
                                        </button>
                                    ` : ''}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                    }).join('');
                } catch(err) {
                    console.error("Erro fatal ao renderizar histórico de feedbacks:", err);
                }
            }

            openDetailModal(id) {
                const fb = this.feedbacks.find(f => f.id === id);
                if (!fb) return;

                this.currentDetailFeedbackId = id;
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-detail');
                const content = document.getElementById('feedback-detail-sheet-content');
                if (!modal || !content) return;

                const isPending = fb.status === 'pending';
                const dateFormatted = new Date(fb.date + 'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
                const followUpFormatted = fb.followUpDate ? new Date(fb.followUpDate + 'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR') : 'A definir';

                content.innerHTML = `
                <div id="feedback-printable-sheet" class="space-y-5 bg-gray-950 p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 text-gray-200">
                    <!-- Topo Executivo da Folha -->
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b-2 border-purple-500/40 pb-4">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xl font-bold shadow-lg">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-check-double"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <h2 class="text-base sm:text-lg font-extrabold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">Ficha de Avaliação 1-on-1 & Feedback</h2>
                                <p class="text-xs text-purple-300 font-medium">TaskFlow • Gestão de Desempenho e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-right">
                            <span class="text-xs font-mono text-gray-400 block">Data: ${dateFormatted}</span>
                            <span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-extrabold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/40">${fb.cycle}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Dados Cadastrais -->
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 bg-gray-900/80 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 text-xs">
                        <div>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 uppercase font-bold block">Colaborador Avaliado:</span>
                            <strong class="text-white text-sm">${fb.collaboratorName}</strong>
                            ${fb.isExternalOrNonAccount ? '<span class="text-[9px] text-purple-400 block">(Funcionário Sem Login)</span>' : ''}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 uppercase font-bold block">Setor / Departamento:</span>
                            <span class="text-indigo-300 font-semibold">${fb.collaboratorDept || 'Geral'}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 uppercase font-bold block">Cargo:</span>
                            <span class="text-gray-300 font-medium">${fb.collaboratorRole || 'Colaborador'}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 uppercase font-bold block">Líder Responsável:</span>
                            <span class="text-purple-300 font-bold">${fb.leaderName}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    ${isPending ? `
                        <div class="bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-500/50 p-4 rounded-xl text-center space-y-2">
                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-amber-300 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-hourglass-half mr-1.5"></i> STATUS: AGENDADA / PENDENTE DE CONDUÇÃO PELO LÍDER
                            </span>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-300">Esta sessão foi pré-configurada pela Administração com os tópicos abaixo e aguarda a reunião do Líder ${fb.leaderName} com o colaborador.</p>
                            ${fb.adminNotes ? `<p class="text-xs text-amber-200 bg-amber-900/40 p-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-700/50"><strong>Orientações:</strong> ${fb.adminNotes}</p>` : ''}
                        </div>
                    ` : `
                        <!-- Classificação Geral em Destaque -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-950/40 via-indigo-950/40 to-gray-900 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-purple-500/40 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-award text-amber-400 text-lg"></i>
                                <span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-200">Resultado Geral da Avaliação:</span>
                            </div>
                            <span class="px-3.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-extrabold uppercase shadow-sm ${fb.overallRating === 'Excelente' ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-black' : fb.overallRating === 'Bom' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : fb.overallRating === 'Regular' ? 'bg-amber-500 text-black' : 'bg-red-600 text-white'}">
                                ${fb.overallRating}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    `}

                    <!-- Tabela de Competências Avaliadas -->
                    <div class="space-y-2">
                        <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check text-purple-400"></i>
                            <span>Tópicos & Competências Abordadas:</span>
                        </h4>
                        <div class="space-y-2.5">
                            ${(fb.topics || []).map((t, idx) => `
                                <div class="bg-gray-900/60 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                            <span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-md bg-purple-600/30 text-purple-300 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold">${idx + 1}</span>
                                            <strong class="text-gray-100">${t.categoryName}</strong>
                                        </div>
                                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold ${t.rating === 'Excelente' ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30' : t.rating === 'Bom' ? 'bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30' : t.rating === 'Regular' ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30' : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border border-red-500/30'}">
                                            ${isPending ? 'A Avaliar' : t.rating}

                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Pontos Fortes & Reconhecimento -->
                    ${fb.positiveHighlights ? `
                        <div class="bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-900/40 p-3.5 rounded-xl space-y-1 text-xs">
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider block flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-thumbs-up"></i>
                                <span>Pontos Fortes & Reconhecimentos:</span>
                            </span>
                            <p class="text-emerald-100/90 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">${fb.positiveHighlights}</p>
                        </div>
                    ` : ''}

                    <!-- Plano de Ação & Compromissos -->
                    <div class="bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-900/40 p-3.5 rounded-xl space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">

            closeDetailModal() {

            deleteFeedback(id) {
                if (!confirm("Tem certeza que deseja excluir este registro de feedback? Esta ação não pode ser desfeita.")) return;

                this.feedbacks = this.feedbacks.filter(f => f.id !== id);
                this.saveFeedbacks(true);

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'FEEDBACK_DELETE',
                        feedbackId: id
                    });
                    syncManager.showToast("✓ Registro de feedback excluído.");
                }

                this.renderHistory();
            }

            exportFeedbacksCSV() {
                if (this.feedbacks.length === 0) {
                    alert("Nenhum feedback registrado para exportar.");
                    return;
                }

                let csv = "ID,Data,Colaborador,Setor,Cargo,Lider,Ciclo,Classificacao_Geral,Status,Plano_de_Acao,Proxima_Revisao\n";
                this.feedbacks.forEach(f => {
                    const row = [
                        f.id,
                        f.date,
                        `"${(f.collaboratorName || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(f.collaboratorDept || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(f.collaboratorRole || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(f.leaderName || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(f.cycle || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        f.overallRating || '',
                        f.status || 'completed',
                        `"${(f.actionPlan || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        f.followUpDate || ''
                    ];
                    csv += row.join(",") + "\n";
                });

                const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `feedbacks_taskflow_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
            }

            // =====================================================================

            renderGuidelines() {
                const container = document.getElementById('fb-guidelines-categories-list');
                const nonAdminAlert = document.getElementById('fb-guidelines-non-admin-alert');
                if (!container) return;

                const isAdm = window.auth && auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.isAdmin;
                if (nonAdminAlert) {
                    if (isAdm) nonAdminAlert.classList.add('hidden');
                    else nonAdminAlert.classList.remove('hidden');
                }

                if (this.templates.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="text-center py-10 bg-gray-950/60 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 text-gray-500">
                            <p class="text-xs">Nenhuma diretriz ou tópico cadastrado.</p>
                            <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.resetDefaultTemplates()" class="mt-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs">Restaurar Padrão Corporativo</button>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    return;
                }

                container.innerHTML = this.templates.map((cat, idx) => `
                    <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xl space-y-3.5 transition hover:border-purple-500/30">
                        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-800/80 pb-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">

                                </span>

                                </div>
                            </div>

                                <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-auto">

                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-pen text-[10px]"></i> <span>Editar</span>
                                    </button>
                                    <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.deleteCategory('${cat.id}')" class="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 rounded-xl transition active:scale-95" title="Excluir Tópico">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>

                        <!-- Lista de Perguntas / Critérios -->
                        <div class="space-y-2 bg-gray-950/70 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/70">
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-300 uppercase tracking-wider">Perguntas & Critérios Obrigatórios para o Líder:</span>
                                ${isAdm ? `
                                    <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.promptAddQuestion('${cat.id}')" class="text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300 transition flex items-center gap-1">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-[10px]"></i> <span>+ Pergunta</span>
                                    </button>
                                ` : ''}
                            </div>
                            <ul class="space-y-1.5">
                                ${(cat.questions || []).map((q, qIdx) => `
                                    <li class="flex items-center justify-between p-2 bg-gray-900/60 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/60 text-xs text-gray-200 gap-2">
                                        <span class="flex items-start gap-2">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-question text-purple-400 text-[10px] mt-1 shrink-0"></i>
                                            <span>${q}</span>
                                        </span>
                                        ${isAdm ? `
                                            <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.deleteQuestion('${cat.id}', ${qIdx})" class="text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 p-1 shrink-0 transition" title="Remover Pergunta">
                                                <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-xs"></i>
                                            </button>
                                        ` : ''}
                                    </li>
                                `).join('')}

                `).join('');

            renderAdminPanelGuidelines() {
                const container = document.getElementById('admin-feedback-guidelines-container');
                if (!container) return;

                if (this.templates.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-gray-500">Nenhum tópico cadastrado.</div>`;
                    return;
                }

                container.innerHTML = this.templates.map((cat, idx) => `
                    <div class="p-3 bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl text-xs space-y-2">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-[10px]">${idx + 1}</span>
                                <strong class="text-gray-100 text-sm">${cat.category}</strong>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                                <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.openAddCategoryModal('${cat.id}')" class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-purple-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold">Editar</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.deleteCategory('${cat.id}')" class="p-1 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 rounded-lg"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-gray-400 text-[11px]">${cat.description}</p>
                        <div class="text-[11px] text-gray-300 bg-gray-900/80 p-2 rounded-xl">
                            <strong>${(cat.questions || []).length} pergunta(s) obrigatória(s)</strong>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }

            openAddCategoryModal(catId = null) {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-edit-category');
                const titleEl = document.getElementById('modal-fb-cat-title');
                const idInput = document.getElementById('fb-edit-cat-id');
                const nameInput = document.getElementById('fb-edit-cat-name');
                const descInput = document.getElementById('fb-edit-cat-desc');
                const questionsInput = document.getElementById('fb-edit-cat-questions');
                if (!modal) return;

                if (catId) {
                    const cat = this.templates.find(c => c.id === catId);
                    if (cat) {
                        if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = "Editar Tópico de Feedback";
                        if (idInput) idInput.value = cat.id;
                        if (nameInput) nameInput.value = cat.category;
                        if (descInput) descInput.value = cat.description;
                        if (questionsInput) questionsInput.value = (cat.questions || []).join('\n');
                    }
                } else {
                    if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = "Novo Tópico de Feedback";
                    if (idInput) idInput.value = '';
                    if (nameInput) nameInput.value = '';
                    if (descInput) descInput.value = '';
                    if (questionsInput) questionsInput.value = '';
                }

                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                modal.style.display = 'flex';
                modal.style.zIndex = '99999';
            }

            closeCategoryModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-edit-category');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            handleSaveCategory(event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                const id = document.getElementById('fb-edit-cat-id').value;
                const name = document.getElementById('fb-edit-cat-name').value.trim();
                const desc = document.getElementById('fb-edit-cat-desc').value.trim();
                const questionsRaw = document.getElementById('fb-edit-cat-questions').value.trim();

                if (!name) {
                    alert("O título do tópico é obrigatório.");
                    return;
                }

                const questions = questionsRaw ? questionsRaw.split('\n').map(q => q.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];

                if (id) {
                    const cat = this.templates.find(c => c.id === id);
                    if (cat) {
                        cat.category = name;
                        cat.description = desc;
                        cat.questions = questions;
                    }
                } else {
                    this.templates.push({
                        id: 'cat_' + Date.now(),
                        category: name,
                        description: desc,
                        questions: questions
                    });
                }

                this.saveTemplates(true);
                this.closeCategoryModal();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.showToast(`✓ Tópico "${name}" salvo com sucesso!`);
                }
            }

            deleteCategory(catId) {
                if (!confirm("Tem certeza que deseja excluir este tópico de diretrizes?")) return;

                this.templates = this.templates.filter(c => c.id !== catId);
                this.saveTemplates(true);

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.showToast("✓ Tópico de diretrizes removido.");
                }
            }

            promptAddQuestion(catId) {
                const cat = this.templates.find(c => c.id === catId);
                if (!cat) return;

                const q = prompt(`Adicionar nova pergunta obrigatória para "${cat.category}":`);
                if (!q || !q.trim()) return;

                if (!cat.questions) cat.questions = [];
                cat.questions.push(q.trim());
                this.saveTemplates(true);

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.showToast("✓ Nova pergunta adicionada.");
                }
            }

            deleteQuestion(catId, qIdx) {
                const cat = this.templates.find(c => c.id === catId);
                if (!cat || !cat.questions) return;

                cat.questions.splice(qIdx, 1);
                this.saveTemplates(true);
            }

            resetDefaultTemplates() {
                if (!confirm("Deseja restaurar as diretrizes e tópicos para o padrão corporativo recomendado?")) return;

                this.templates = this.getDefaultTemplates();
                this.saveTemplates(true);

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.showToast("✓ Diretrizes padrão restauradas.");
                }
            }

            // Sync hooks
            handleIncomingFeedback(fb) {
                const idx = this.feedbacks.findIndex(f => f.id === fb.id);
                if (idx !== -1) {
                    this.feedbacks[idx] = fb;
                } else {
                    this.feedbacks.unshift(fb);
                }
                this.saveFeedbacks(false);
            }

            handleIncomingFeedbackDelete(fbId) {
                this.feedbacks = this.feedbacks.filter(f => f.id !== fbId);
                this.saveFeedbacks(false);
            }

            handleIncomingTemplates(templates) {
                this.templates = templates;
                this.saveTemplates(false);
            }
        }
