            isEmailAdmin(email) {
                return ADMIN_EMAILS.includes((email || '').toLowerCase().trim());
            }

            switchTab(tab) {
                const btnLogin = document.getElementById('tab-login');
                const btnReg = document.getElementById('tab-register');
                const formLogin = document.getElementById('form-login');
                const formReg = document.getElementById('form-register');

                if (tab === 'login') {
                    if (btnLogin) btnLogin.className = "flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white transition shadow-sm";
                    if (btnReg) btnReg.className = "flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition";
                    if (formLogin) formLogin.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (formReg) formReg.classList.add('hidden');
                } else {
                    if (btnReg) btnReg.className = "flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white transition shadow-sm";
                    if (btnLogin) btnLogin.className = "flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 transition";
                    if (formReg) formReg.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (formLogin) formLogin.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

            async handleLogin(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const emailInput = document.getElementById('login-email');
                const passInput = document.getElementById('login-password');
                const btnSubmit = document.getElementById('btn-login-submit');
                const errBox = document.getElementById('login-error');
                const successBox = document.getElementById('login-success-msg');

                const email = (emailInput ? emailInput.value : '').trim();
                const password = passInput ? passInput.value : '';

                if (errBox) errBox.classList.add('hidden');
                if (successBox) successBox.classList.add('hidden');

                // 1. Caso seja um dos administradores mestres
                if (this.isEmailAdmin(email)) {
                    let accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                    let acc = accounts.find(a => a.email && a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());

                    // Se a conta não existe localmente ainda (ex: limpou cache/dados) OU se foi digitada a senha
                    if (!acc) {
                        acc = {
                            uid: 'adm_' + (email === 'zinidnosreme@gmail.com' ? 'emerson' : 'juhsim'),
                            email: email,
                            displayName: (email === 'zinidnosreme@gmail.com' ? 'Admin Emerson' : 'Admin Juhsim'),
                            role: 'Administrador',
                            dept: 'Administração Geral',
                            isAdmin: true,
                            status: 'approved',
                            emailVerified: true,
                            password: password || 'admin123'
                        };
                        accounts.push(acc);
                        localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                    } else if (password && acc.password && acc.password !== password) {
                        // Se digitou uma senha diferente mas a senha anterior ficou dessincronizada após limpeza de cache,
                        // atualiza para a nova senha informada pelo Administrador Mestre
                        acc.password = password;
                        acc.isAdmin = true;
                        acc.status = 'approved';
                        localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                    }

                    this.currentUser = {
                        uid: acc.uid,
                        email: email,
                        displayName: acc.displayName || (email === 'zinidnosreme@gmail.com' ? 'Admin Emerson' : 'Admin Juhsim'),
                        role: 'Administrador',
                        dept: 'Administração Geral',
                        isAdmin: true,
                        status: 'approved',
                        emailVerified: true
                    };
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(this.currentUser));
                    this.onLoginSuccess();
                    return;
                }

                // 2. Busca inicial local
                let accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                let acc = accounts.find(a => a.email && a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());

                // 3. Se não encontrou localmente OU se a senha não bate,
                // consulta a base de contas na nuvem (Google Sheets) antes de dar erro
                if (!acc || acc.password !== password) {
                    let originalBtnText = btnSubmit ? btnSubmit.innerHTML : '';
                    if (btnSubmit) {
                        btnSubmit.disabled = true;
                        btnSubmit.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin text-sm"></i><span>Verificando base de contas...</span>`;
                    }

                    try {
                        await this.syncRemoteAccounts(true);
                    } catch (syncErr) {
                        console.warn('Erro ao consultar contas remotas:', syncErr);
                    }

                    if (btnSubmit) {
                        btnSubmit.disabled = false;
                        btnSubmit.innerHTML = originalBtnText;
                    }

                    // Reavalia após consulta na nuvem
                    accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                    acc = accounts.find(a => a.email && a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                }

                // Para colaboradores comuns:
                if (!acc) {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerHTML = `
                            <div class="flex items-start gap-2">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-red-400 mt-0.5"></i>
                                <div>
                                    <strong class="text-red-300">Conta não encontrada!</strong><br>
                                    Verifique o e-mail digitado ou solicite ao Administrador a ativação do seu cadastro.
                                </div>
                            </div>`;
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                if (acc.password !== password) {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerText = "Senha incorreta para esta conta.";
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // Verifica aprovação pelo administrador
                if (acc.status === 'pending') {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerHTML = `
                            <div class="flex items-start gap-2">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-clock text-amber-400 mt-0.5"></i>
                                <div>
                                    <strong class="text-amber-300">Conta Aguardando Aprovação!</strong><br>
                                    Seu cadastro foi recebido, mas o acesso precisa ser liberado pelo administrador 
                                    (<em>juhsim@live.com</em> ou <em>zinidnosreme@gmail.com</em>) no Painel de Controle.
                                </div>
                            </div>`;
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                if (acc.status === 'rejected' || acc.status === 'blocked') {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerText = "Esta conta foi suspensa ou rejeitada pelo Administrador.";
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                this.currentUser = acc;
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(this.currentUser));
                this.onLoginSuccess();
            }

            async handleRegister(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const name = document.getElementById('reg-name').value.trim();
                const dept = document.getElementById('reg-dept').value.trim() || 'Geral';
                const email = document.getElementById('reg-email').value.trim();
                const password = document.getElementById('reg-password').value;
                const errBox = document.getElementById('register-error');

                errBox.classList.add('hidden');

                // Validação de Nome Completo Correto: mínimo nome e sobrenome
                const nameParts = name.split(/\s+/).filter(p => p.length >= 2);
                if (nameParts.length < 2) {
                    errBox.innerText = "Por favor, informe seu NOME COMPLETO correto (Nome e Sobrenome).";
                    errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    return;
                }

                // O cargo não é selecionado pelo usuário. Fica pendente para o ADM atribuir.
                const role = "Pendente de Atribuição";

                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');

                if (accounts.some(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase())) {
                    errBox.innerText = "Este e-mail já foi cadastrado na empresa.";
                    errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    return;
                }

                // Se for um dos Administradores Mestres criando a conta:
                if (this.isEmailAdmin(email)) {
                    const newAdmin = {
                        uid: 'adm_' + Date.now(),
                        displayName: name,
                        role: 'Administrador',
                        dept: dept,
                        email: email,
                        password: password,
                        isAdmin: true,
                        status: 'approved',
                        emailVerified: true,
                        createdAt: Date.now()
                    };
                    accounts.push(newAdmin);
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                    this.currentUser = newAdmin;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(this.currentUser));
                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        window.syncManager.publish({ type: 'ACCOUNT_REGISTER', account: newAdmin });
                    }
                    this.updateCollaboratorsList();
                    this.onLoginSuccess();
                    return;
                }

                // Para colaboradores: inicia o fluxo de verificação de e-mail REAL (6 dígitos)
                const code = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
                this.pendingVerification = {
                    name, role, dept, email, password, code, createdAt: Date.now()
                };

                // Registra nos códigos pendentes para controle da administração
                const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                pendingCodes[email.toLowerCase()] = { name, role, dept, email, code, requestedAt: Date.now() };
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_pending_codes', JSON.stringify(pendingCodes));

                // Abre o modal de verificação (SEM EXIBIR O CÓDIGO NA TELA!)
                document.getElementById('verify-modal-email').innerText = email;
                document.getElementById('input-verification-code').value = '';
                document.getElementById('verify-error').classList.add('hidden');
                
                const statusBox = document.getElementById('verify-send-status');
                statusBox.className = "my-3.5 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-950 border border-indigo-500/30 text-xs text-indigo-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
                statusBox.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Disparando e-mail com o código de 6 dígitos...`;
                
                const vm = document.getElementById('email-verification-modal');
                if (vm) {
                    vm.classList.remove('hidden');
                    vm.style.display = 'flex';
                }
                this.startResendCooldown();

                // Notifica a administração via nuvem para que o Admin receba o aviso
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'PENDING_REGISTRATION_CODE',
                        pending: { email, name, role, dept, code, requestedAt: Date.now() }
                    });
                }

                // Disparo real via EmailService
                const res = await emailService.sendVerificationEmail(email, name, code);
                if (res.success) {
                    statusBox.className = "my-3.5 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs text-emerald-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
                    statusBox.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400"></i> Código enviado! Verifique seu e-mail (${email}).`;
                } else if (res.needsConfig) {
                    statusBox.className = "my-3.5 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-500/40 text-[11px] text-amber-300 flex items-start gap-2 text-left";
                    statusBox.innerHTML = `
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-amber-400 mt-0.5 shrink-0"></i>
                        <div>
                            <strong>Envio Real: Chave Pendente no Painel ADM</strong><br>
                            O administrador pode cadastrar a chave no Painel ADM para envio automático, ou você pode solicitar a aprovação direta com a administração.
                        </div>`;
                } else {
                    statusBox.className = "my-3.5 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-500/40 text-[11px] text-amber-300 flex items-start gap-2 text-left";
                    statusBox.innerHTML = `
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation text-amber-400 mt-0.5 shrink-0"></i>
                        <div>
                            Não foi possível entregar o e-mail: ${res.error || 'Erro no envio'}.<br>
                            Você pode solicitar aprovação direta com o Administrador.
                        </div>`;
                }
            }

            async resendCode() {
                if (!this.pendingVerification) return;
                const btn = document.getElementById('btn-resend-code');
                if (btn && btn.disabled) return;

                const code = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
                this.pendingVerification.code = code;

                const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                pendingCodes[this.pendingVerification.email.toLowerCase()] = {
                    name: this.pendingVerification.name,
                    role: this.pendingVerification.role,
                    dept: this.pendingVerification.dept,
                    email: this.pendingVerification.email,
                    code,
                    requestedAt: Date.now()
                };
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_pending_codes', JSON.stringify(pendingCodes));

                const statusBox = document.getElementById('verify-send-status');
                statusBox.className = "my-3.5 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-950 border border-indigo-500/30 text-xs text-indigo-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
                statusBox.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Reenviando novo código de 6 dígitos...`;
                
                this.startResendCooldown();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'PENDING_REGISTRATION_CODE',
                        pending: { 
                            email: this.pendingVerification.email, 
                            name: this.pendingVerification.name, 
                            role: this.pendingVerification.role, 
                            dept: this.pendingVerification.dept, 
                            code, 
                            requestedAt: Date.now() 
                        }
                    });
                }

                const res = await emailService.sendVerificationEmail(this.pendingVerification.email, this.pendingVerification.name, code);
                if (res.success) {
                    statusBox.className = "my-3.5 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs text-emerald-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
                    statusBox.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400"></i> Novo código enviado para ${this.pendingVerification.email}!`;
                }
            }

            startResendCooldown() {
                const btn = document.getElementById('btn-resend-code');
                const text = document.getElementById('resend-countdown-text');
                if (!btn) return;
                let count = 60;
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.classList.add('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');

                if (this.resendTimer) clearInterval(this.resendTimer);
                this.resendTimer = setInterval(() => {
                    count--;
                    if (count <= 0) {
                        clearInterval(this.resendTimer);
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        btn.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                        if (text) text.innerText = "Não recebeu?";
                        btn.innerText = "Reenviar Código";
                    } else {
                        if (text) text.innerText = `Aguarde ${count}s para reenviar`;
                        btn.innerText = `Reenviar (${count}s)`;
                    }
                }, 1000);
            }

            confirmVerificationCode() {
                const inputCode = document.getElementById('input-verification-code').value.trim();
                const errBox = document.getElementById('verify-error');

                if (!this.pendingVerification) return;

                if (inputCode !== this.pendingVerification.code) {
                    errBox.innerText = "Código incorreto. Digite os 6 dígitos recebidos no seu e-mail.";
                    errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    return;
                }

                // Código correto: cria a conta com status "pending" (Aguardando Aprovação do Administrador)
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const newAccount = {
                    uid: 'usr_' + Date.now(),
                    displayName: this.pendingVerification.name,
                    role: this.pendingVerification.role,
                    dept: this.pendingVerification.dept,
                    email: this.pendingVerification.email,
                    password: this.pendingVerification.password,
                    isAdmin: false,
                    status: 'pending',
                    emailVerified: true,
                    requestedAt: Date.now()
                };

                accounts.push(newAccount);
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));

                // Remove dos códigos pendentes
                const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                delete pendingCodes[newAccount.email.toLowerCase()];
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_pending_codes', JSON.stringify(pendingCodes));

                // Publica em nuvem para que o Administrador receba a notificação de aprovação
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_REGISTER',
                        account: newAccount
                    });
                }

                const vm = document.getElementById('email-verification-modal');
                if (vm) {
                    vm.classList.add('hidden');
                    vm.style.display = 'none';
                }
                this.pendingVerification = null;

                // Muda para aba de login com mensagem de aprovação pendente
                this.switchTab('login');
                const successMsg = document.getElementById('login-success-msg');
                successMsg.innerHTML = `
                    <strong>✅ E-mail verificado com sucesso!</strong><br>
                    Sua conta foi enviada ao Administrador e aguarda aprovação de <em>juhsim@live.com</em> ou <em>zinidnosreme@gmail.com</em>.
                `;
                successMsg.classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('login-email').value = newAccount.email;
            }

            cancelVerification() {
                this.pendingVerification = null;
                if (this.resendTimer) clearInterval(this.resendTimer);
                const vm = document.getElementById('email-verification-modal');
                if (vm) {
                    vm.classList.add('hidden');
                    vm.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            applyRemoteAccount(account) {
                if (!account || !account.email) return;
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const idx = accounts.findIndex(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === account.email.toLowerCase());
                if (idx >= 0) {
                    accounts[idx] = Object.assign(accounts[idx], account);
                } else {
                    accounts.push(account);
                }
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                this.updateCollaboratorsList();

                // Se o usuário logado for admin, atualiza o contador de pendências
                if (this.currentUser && this.currentUser.isAdmin && window.admin) {
                    admin.updatePendingBadge();
                    admin.renderAdminUsers();
                }
            }

            updateCollaboratorsList() {
                const datalist = document.getElementById('collaborators-datalist');
                const occDatalist = document.getElementById('team-collaborators-datalist');
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const approved = accounts.filter(a => a.status === 'approved' || a.isAdmin);
                if (datalist) {
                    datalist.innerHTML = approved.map(a => `<option value="${a.displayName} (${a.role})"></option>`).join('');
                }
                if (occDatalist) {
                    occDatalist.innerHTML = approved.map(a => `<option value="${a.displayName}">${a.displayName} (${a.role || 'Colaborador'})</option>`).join('');
                }
                if (window.feedbackApp) feedbackApp.populateCollaboratorsSelect();
            }

            handleForgotPassword() {
                const email = prompt("Digite seu e-mail cadastrado:");
                if (email) {
                    const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                    const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                    if (acc) {
                        alert(`A senha cadastrada para ${acc.email} é: ${acc.password}`);
                    } else {
                        alert("E-mail não encontrado na base de dados da empresa.");
                    }
                }
            }

            enterDemoMode() {
                this.currentUser = {
                    uid: 'guest_' + Date.now(),
                    email: 'colaborador@empresa.com',
                    displayName: 'Colaborador Teste',
                    role: 'Colaborador',
                    dept: 'Operações',
                    isAdmin: false,
                    status: 'approved'
                };
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(this.currentUser));
                this.onLoginSuccess();
            }

            applyPermissionsUI() {
                if (!this.currentUser) return;

                // Administradores sempre têm acesso total
                const isAdm = !!this.currentUser.isAdmin;
                const canOccurrences = isAdm || !!this.currentUser.canAccessOccurrences;

                const switchOcc = document.getElementById('main-switch-occurrences');
                const topbarOcc = document.getElementById('topbar-switch-occurrences');
                const mobOcc = document.getElementById('mob-nav-occurrences');
                const btnNewOcc = document.getElementById('topbar-new-occurrence-btn');

                if (canOccurrences) {
                    if (switchOcc) switchOcc.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (topbarOcc) topbarOcc.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (mobOcc) mobOcc.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    if (switchOcc) switchOcc.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (topbarOcc) topbarOcc.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (mobOcc) mobOcc.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (btnNewOcc) { btnNewOcc.classList.add('hidden'); btnNewOcc.style.display = 'none'; }

                    if (window.currentMainView === 'occurrences') {
                        window.switchMainView('tasks');
                    }
                }

                // Permissões do Módulo de Feedback (Admins e Líderes/Supervisores)
                const userRole = (this.currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase();
                const isLeader = isAdm || userRole.includes('líder') || userRole.includes('lider') || userRole.includes('supervisor') || userRole.includes('gerente') || userRole.includes('coordenador') || userRole.includes('encarregado');
                const canFeedback = isAdm || isLeader || (this.currentUser.canAccessFeedback !== false);

                const switchFb = document.getElementById('main-switch-feedback');
                const topbarFb = document.getElementById('topbar-switch-feedback');
                const mobFb = document.getElementById('mob-nav-feedback');
                const btnNewFb = document.getElementById('topbar-new-feedback-btn');

                if (canFeedback) {
                    if (switchFb) switchFb.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (topbarFb) topbarFb.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (mobFb) mobFb.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    if (switchFb) switchFb.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (topbarFb) topbarFb.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (mobFb) mobFb.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (btnNewFb) { btnNewFb.classList.add('hidden'); btnNewFb.style.display = 'none'; }

                    if (window.currentMainView === 'feedback') {
                        window.switchMainView('tasks');
                    }
                }
            }

            onLoginSuccess() {
                document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.add('hidden');
                
                const name = this.currentUser.displayName || 'Colaborador';
                const role = this.currentUser.role || 'Colaborador';
                const initials = name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').substring(0, 2).toUpperCase() || 'TF';

                document.getElementById('user-avatar').innerText = initials;
                document.getElementById('user-display-name').innerText = name;
                document.getElementById('user-display-role').innerText = role;
                const mobSub = document.getElementById('mob-user-subtitle');
                if (mobSub) mobSub.innerText = `${name} (${role})`;

                // Se for Administrador, exibe botões exclusivos do Painel (Sidebar e Topbar)
                const adminContainer = document.getElementById('admin-panel-btn-container');
                const adminTopbarBtn = document.getElementById('admin-topbar-btn');
                if (this.currentUser.isAdmin) {
                    if (adminContainer) adminContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (adminTopbarBtn) {
                        adminTopbarBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                        adminTopbarBtn.style.display = 'flex';
                    }
                    if (window.admin) {
                        admin.updatePendingBadge();
                    }
                } else {
                    if (adminContainer) adminContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (adminTopbarBtn) {
                        adminTopbarBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                        adminTopbarBtn.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }

                if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'default') {
                    Notification.requestPermission();
                }

                if (window.admin) {
                    admin.applyFeatureConfigUI();
                }

                this.applyPermissionsUI();

                if (window.app) {
                    app.render();
                }

                if (window.feedbackApp) {
                    feedbackApp.updateBadges();
                    feedbackApp.renderHistory();
                }
            }

            openAccountSettingsModal() {
                if (!this.currentUser) return;
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-account-settings');
                if (modal) {
                    document.getElementById('settings-user-name').innerText = this.currentUser.displayName || 'Colaborador';
                    document.getElementById('settings-user-email').innerText = this.currentUser.email || '';
                    document.getElementById('settings-user-role-dept').innerText = `${this.currentUser.role || 'Colaborador'} • ${this.currentUser.dept || 'Geral'}`;
                    
                    document.getElementById('input-curr-password').value = '';
                    document.getElementById('input-new-password').value = '';
                    document.getElementById('input-confirm-new-password').value = '';
                    
                    const errBox = document.getElementById('settings-password-error');
                    const succBox = document.getElementById('settings-password-success');
                    if (errBox) errBox.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (succBox) succBox.classList.add('hidden');

                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                }
            }

            closeAccountSettingsModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-account-settings');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            handleChangePasswordSubmit(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const currPass = document.getElementById('input-curr-password').value;
                const newPass = document.getElementById('input-new-password').value;
                const confirmPass = document.getElementById('input-confirm-new-password').value;
                const errBox = document.getElementById('settings-password-error');
                const succBox = document.getElementById('settings-password-success');

                if (errBox) errBox.classList.add('hidden');
                if (succBox) succBox.classList.add('hidden');

                // Verifica se a senha atual está correta
                if (this.currentUser.password && this.currentUser.password !== currPass) {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerText = "A senha atual digitada está incorreta.";
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                if (newPass.length < 4) {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerText = "A nova senha deve ter no mínimo 4 caracteres.";
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                if (newPass !== confirmPass) {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerText = "A confirmação da nova senha não confere.";
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // Atualiza a senha no usuário atual
                this.currentUser.password = newPass;
                this.currentUser.lastPasswordChangedAt = Date.now();
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(this.currentUser));

                // Atualiza na base de contas da empresa
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === this.currentUser.email.toLowerCase());
                if (acc) {
                    acc.password = newPass;
                    acc.lastPasswordChangedAt = Date.now();
                    if (!acc.passwordHistory) acc.passwordHistory = [];
                    acc.passwordHistory.unshift({
                        password: newPass,
                        changedAt: Date.now(),
                        changedBy: this.currentUser.displayName
                    });
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                }

                // Notifica a Nuvem e os Administradores com a nova senha
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'PASSWORD_CHANGED',
                        email: this.currentUser.email,
                        displayName: this.currentUser.displayName,
                        newPassword: newPass,
                        timestamp: Date.now()
                    });
                }

                if (succBox) {
                    succBox.innerText = "✓ Senha alterada com sucesso!";
                    succBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                }

                setTimeout(() => {
                    this.closeAccountSettingsModal();
                    syncManager.showToast("✓ Sua nova senha foi salva e sincronizada!");
                }, 1200);
            }

            quickLogin(email, name, isAdmin, role = 'Colaborador') {
                this.currentUser = {
                    uid: 'usr_' + Date.now(),
                    email: email,
                    displayName: name,
                    role: isAdmin ? 'Administrador' : role,
                    dept: isAdmin ? 'Administração Geral' : 'Reposição & Loja',
                    isAdmin: !!isAdmin,
                    status: 'approved',
                    emailVerified: true
                };
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(this.currentUser));
                this.onLoginSuccess();
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.showToast(`✓ Conectado como ${name} (${this.currentUser.role})`);
                }
            }

            logout() {
                if (confirm("Deseja realmente sair da sua conta?")) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('taskflow_current_user');
                    this.currentUser = null;
                    this.showAuthScreen();
                }
            }

            
            /**
             * Busca todas as contas cadastradas no PropertiesService interno do Google Script (100% invisível na planilha)
             */
            async syncRemoteAccounts(force = false) {
                try {
                    const webAppUrl = (window.scheduleApp && window.scheduleApp.webAppUrl) ||
                        localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_webapp_url') ||
                        'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzlmXyjnVs5uH41a_9bddnNfIn-M2KMU4arwHreAlRkB0DFw3ziMLeR5MOVRarQy_4r/exec';

                    const code = `(function() {
                        var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
                        var raw = props.getProperty("TASKFLOW_USERS_DB");
                        if (!raw) return [];
                        try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) { return []; }
                    })()`;

                    const resp = await fetch(webAppUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            action: 'execute_command',
                            code: code
                        })
                    });

                    if (!resp.ok) return false;
                    const data = await resp.json();
                    if (data && data.success && Array.isArray(data.result)) {
                        const remoteUsers = data.result;
                        let accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                        let changed = false;

                        remoteUsers.forEach(rem => {
                            if (!rem || !rem.email) return;
                            const remEmail = rem.email.toLowerCase().trim();
                            const idx = accounts.findIndex(a => a.email && a.email.toLowerCase().trim() === remEmail);
                            if (idx === -1) {
                                accounts.push(rem);
                                changed = true;
                            } else {
                                const cur = accounts[idx];
                                let updated = false;
                                ['displayName', 'password', 'role', 'dept', 'status', 'canAccessOccurrences', 'canEditSchedule', 'isAdmin'].forEach(prop => {
                                    if (rem[prop] !== undefined && rem[prop] !== cur[prop]) {
                                        cur[prop] = rem[prop];
                                        updated = true;
                                    }
                                });
                                if (updated) changed = true;
                            }
                        });

                        if (changed) {
                            localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                            this.updateCollaboratorsList();
                            if (window.admin && admin.renderAdminUsers) admin.renderAdminUsers();
                        }
                        return true;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('Aviso: Consulta de contas remotas ignorada:', e);
                }
                return false;
            }

            /**
             * Salva ou atualiza uma conta no PropertiesService interno do Google Script (100% invisível na planilha)
             */
            async syncUserToCloud(user) {
                if (!user || !user.email) return;
                try {
                    const webAppUrl = (window.scheduleApp && window.scheduleApp.webAppUrl) ||
                        localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_webapp_url') ||
                        'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzlmXyjnVs5uH41a_9bddnNfIn-M2KMU4arwHreAlRkB0DFw3ziMLeR5MOVRarQy_4r/exec';

                    const userPayload = JSON.stringify(user);
                    const code = `(function() {
                        var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
                        var raw = props.getProperty("TASKFLOW_USERS_DB");
                        var users = [];
                        if (raw) {
                            try { users = JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) { users = []; }
                        }
                        var target = ${userPayload};
                        var targetEmail = (target.email || "").toString().toLowerCase().trim();
                        var idx = -1;
                        for (var i = 0; i < users.length; i++) {
                            if ((users[i].email || "").toString().toLowerCase().trim() === targetEmail) {
                                idx = i;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            users[idx] = Object.assign(users[idx], target);
                        } else {
                            users.push(target);
                        }
                        props.setProperty("TASKFLOW_USERS_DB", JSON.stringify(users));
                        return { success: true, count: users.length };
                    })()`;

                    fetch(webAppUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            action: 'execute_command',
                            code: code
                        })
                    }).catch(err => console.warn('Erro ao salvar usuario no Google Script:', err));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('syncUserToCloud exception:', e);
                }
            }

            /**
             * Remove uma conta do PropertiesService interno do Google Script
             */
            async deleteUserFromCloud(email) {
                if (!email) return;
                try {
                    const webAppUrl = (window.scheduleApp && window.scheduleApp.webAppUrl) ||
                        localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_webapp_url') ||
                        'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzlmXyjnVs5uH41a_9bddnNfIn-M2KMU4arwHreAlRkB0DFw3ziMLeR5MOVRarQy_4r/exec';

                    const code = `(function() {
                        var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
                        var raw = props.getProperty("TASKFLOW_USERS_DB");
                        if (!raw) return { success: true };
                        var users = [];
                        try { users = JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) { return { success: true }; }
                        var targetEmail = "${email.toLowerCase().trim()}";
                        var filtered = users.filter(function(u) {
                            return (u.email || "").toString().toLowerCase().trim() !== targetEmail;
                        });
                        props.setProperty("TASKFLOW_USERS_DB", JSON.stringify(filtered));
                        return { success: true, count: filtered.length };
                    })()`;

                    fetch(webAppUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            action: 'execute_command',
                            code: code
                        })
                    }).catch(err => console.warn('Erro ao excluir usuario do Google Script:', err));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('deleteUserFromCloud exception:', e);
                }
            }

            showAuthScreen() {
                document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }

        // 3. GERENCIADOR DO PAINEL DO ADMINISTRADOR (ROOT)
        class AdminManager {
            constructor() {
                this.currentTab = 'users';
                this.config = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_app_config') || '{}');
                if (this.config.allowCamera === undefined) this.config.allowCamera = true;
                if (this.config.enablePomodoro === undefined) this.config.enablePomodoro = true;
                if (this.config.adminOnlyCreate === undefined) this.config.adminOnlyCreate = false;
                if (this.config.announcement === undefined) this.config.announcement = '';
            }

            openPanel() {
                if (!auth.currentUser || !auth.currentUser.isAdmin) {
                    alert("Acesso restrito apenas aos Administradores.");
                    return;
                }
                const m = document.getElementById('admin-modal');
                if (m) {
                    m.classList.remove('hidden');
                    m.style.display = 'flex';
                }
                this.updatePendingBadge();
                this.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                this.renderRolesAndDepts();
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                this.populateAuditUserSelect();
                this.initReportMonths();
                this.renderAdminOccurrences();
                this.renderAdminTasks();
                this.syncSettingsUI();
                this.syncEmailUI();
            }

            closePanel() {
                const m = document.getElementById('admin-modal');
                if (m) {
                    m.classList.add('hidden');
                    m.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            switchTab(tab) {
                this.currentTab = tab;
                ['users', 'roles', 'hierarchy', 'audit', 'occurrences', 'tasks', 'reports', 'settings', 'email', 'feedback_guidelines'].forEach(t => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById(`admin-tab-${t}`);
                    const content = document.getElementById(`admin-content-${t}`);
                    if (btn && content) {
                        if (t === tab) {
                            btn.className = "shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap py-2 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-md shadow-sm";
                            content.classList.remove('hidden');
                        } else {
                            btn.className = "shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap py-2 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-800/40 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2";
                            content.classList.add('hidden');
                        }
                    }
                });
                if (tab === 'roles') {
                    this.renderRolesAndDepts();
                } else if (tab === 'feedback_guidelines' && window.feedbackApp) {
                    feedbackApp.renderAdminPanelGuidelines();
                }
            }

            updatePendingBadge() {
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                const unconfirmedCount = Object.keys(pendingCodes).filter(em => !accounts.some(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === em.toLowerCase())).length;
                const pendingCount = accounts.filter(a => a.status === 'pending').length + unconfirmedCount;

                const badgeSidebar = document.getElementById('pending-users-badge');
                const badgeTab = document.getElementById('admin-tab-pending-badge');
                const badgeTopbar = document.getElementById('admin-topbar-badge');

                if (pendingCount > 0) {
                    if (badgeSidebar) {
                        badgeSidebar.innerText = pendingCount;
                        badgeSidebar.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    if (badgeTab) {
                        badgeTab.innerText = pendingCount;
                        badgeTab.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    if (badgeTopbar) {
                        badgeTopbar.innerText = pendingCount;
                        badgeTopbar.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                } else {
                    if (badgeSidebar) badgeSidebar.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (badgeTab) badgeTab.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (badgeTopbar) badgeTopbar.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

            renderAdminUsers() {
                const container = document.getElementById('admin-users-list');
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');

                const unconfirmedEmails = Object.keys(pendingCodes).filter(em => !accounts.some(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === em.toLowerCase()));
                const unconfirmedUsers = unconfirmedEmails.map(em => {
                    const item = pendingCodes[em];
                    return {
                        uid: 'pre_' + item.requestedAt,
                        displayName: item.name,
                        role: item.role,
                        dept: item.dept,
                        email: item.email,
                        status: 'awaiting_email',
                        code: item.code,
                        requestedAt: item.requestedAt
                    };
                });

                const allItems = [...unconfirmedUsers, ...accounts];
                const totalCountEl = document.getElementById('admin-total-users-count');
                if (totalCountEl) totalCountEl.innerText = allItems.length;

                if (allItems.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-gray-500">Nenhum colaborador registrado ainda.</div>`;
                    return;
                }

                const sorted = [...allItems].sort((a, b) => {
                    if ((a.status === 'pending' || a.status === 'awaiting_email') && (b.status !== 'pending' && b.status !== 'awaiting_email')) return -1;
                    if ((b.status === 'pending' || b.status === 'awaiting_email') && (a.status !== 'pending' && a.status !== 'awaiting_email')) return 1;
                    return (b.requestedAt || 0) - (a.requestedAt || 0);
                });

                container.innerHTML = sorted.map(acc => {
                    const isAdm = ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(acc.email.toLowerCase()) || acc.isAdmin;
                    const isPending = acc.status === 'pending';
                    const isAwaitingEmail = acc.status === 'awaiting_email';
                    const isBlocked = acc.status === 'rejected' || acc.status === 'blocked';

                    let statusBadge = isAwaitingEmail
                        ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30 animate-pulse">Código E-mail</span>`
                        : isPending 
                        ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 animate-pulse">Aguardando Aprovação</span>`
                        : isBlocked
                        ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30">Bloqueado</span>`
                        : `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">Aprovado</span>`;

                    return `
                    <div class="flex flex-col p-3 sm:p-3.5 bg-gray-950/90 border ${isPending || isAwaitingEmail ? 'border-amber-500/50' : 'border-gray-800'} rounded-xl gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 transition hover:border-gray-700">
                        <!-- Topo do Card: Avatar, Nome, E-mail e Status -->
                        <div class="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl ${isAdm ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30' : 'bg-indigo-600/20 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30'} flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shrink-0 mt-0.5 sm:mt-0">
                                ${acc.displayName ? acc.displayName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase() : 'CO'}
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
                                <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-100 truncate">${acc.displayName}</span>
                                    <button type="button" onclick="admin.quickEditUserName('${acc.email}')" title="Renomear colaborador" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-indigo-300 p-0.5 transition">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-pen text-[10px]"></i>
                                    </button>
                                    ${isAdm ? '<span class="text-[9px] font-extrabold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500 text-black">ADMIN</span>' : ''}
                                    ${statusBadge}
                                </div>
                                <p class="text-gray-400 font-mono text-[11px] break-all leading-tight">${acc.email}</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Linha de Edição Rápida: Cargo, Setor e Senha -->
                        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-1 text-xs">
                            <button type="button" onclick="admin.toggleScheduleEditor('${acc.email}')" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 ${(acc.canEditSchedule || isAdm) ? 'bg-teal-950 border-teal-500/80 text-teal-200 shadow-sm shadow-teal-900/50' : 'bg-gray-900 border-gray-700 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 hover:border-gray-600'} border rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer" title="Clique para alternar permissão: Permitir ou bloquear edição da Escala Diária">
                                <i class="fa-solid ${(acc.canEditSchedule || isAdm) ? 'fa-calendar-check text-teal-400' : 'fa-calendar-xmark text-gray-500'} text-xs"></i>
                                <span>Escala: <strong class="${(acc.canEditSchedule || isAdm) ? 'text-teal-300' : 'text-gray-400'}">${isAdm ? 'Admin (Livre)' : (acc.canEditSchedule ? 'Pode Editar ✓' : 'Apenas Ver')}</strong></span>
                            </button>

                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase shrink-0">Cargo:</span>

                                    ${admin.getDepartments().map(d => `<option value="${d}" class="bg-gray-900 text-gray-200" ${(acc.dept || 'Geral') === d ? 'selected' : ''}>${d}</option>`).join('')}
                                </select>
                            </div>

                            <button type="button" onclick="admin.quickEditUserPassword('${acc.email}')" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-amber-300 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono transition active:scale-95" title="Clique para ver ou trocar a senha">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-key text-[10px] text-amber-400 shrink-0"></i>
                                <span>Senha: <strong>${acc.password ? '••••' : 'Definir'}</strong></span>
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Barra de Ações: Responsiva, organizada em linha própria sem sobreposição -->
                        <div class="w-full flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-gray-800/80">
                            ${isAwaitingEmail ? `
                                <button onclick="admin.approveDirectlyFromPendingCode('${acc.email}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1 shadow-md active:scale-95">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> <span>Aprovar Direto</span>
                                </button>
                                <button onclick="admin.viewPendingCode('${acc.email}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-indigo-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition active:scale-95" title="Ver código OTP de segurança">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-key text-[10px]"></i> <span>Ver Código</span>
                                </button>
                                <button onclick="admin.cancelPendingCode('${acc.email}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-red-600 text-gray-400 hover:text-white rounded-xl text-xs transition active:scale-95">
                                    Cancelar
                                </button>
                            ` : isPending ? `
                                <button onclick="admin.approveUser('${acc.email}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1 shadow-md active:scale-95">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> <span>Aprovar</span>
                                </button>
                                <button onclick="admin.viewPendingCode('${acc.email}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-indigo-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition active:scale-95" title="Ver código OTP de segurança">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-key text-[10px]"></i> <span>Ver Código</span>
                                </button>
                                <button onclick="admin.blockUser('${acc.email}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-red-600 text-gray-400 hover:text-white rounded-xl text-xs transition active:scale-95">
                                    Rejeitar
                                </button>

                                    <button onclick="admin.approveUser('${acc.email}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold active:scale-95">
                                        Desbloquear
                                    </button>

                                        Bloquear
                                    </button>
                                `}
                                
                                <button type="button" onclick="admin.openEditUserModal('${acc.email}')" title="Modo Editor Completo: alterar todos os dados deste colaborador" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-sm">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square text-xs"></i>
                                    <span>Editar Tudo</span>
                                </button>

                                <button type="button" onclick="admin.toggleOccurrencesAccess('${acc.email}')" title="Autorizar ou Ocultar o Painel de Ocorrências para este colaborador" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 ${acc.canAccessOccurrences ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-500/30' : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 border border-gray-700 hover:text-gray-200'}">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-user ${acc.canAccessOccurrences ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-gray-500'} text-xs"></i>
                                    <span>${acc.canAccessOccurrences ? 'Ocorrências ON' : 'Ocorrências OFF'}</span>
