                                <button type="button" onclick="admin.openUserAudit('${acc.email}')" title="Ver Dossiê e Tudo que Este Usuário Fez" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-indigo-900/60 text-indigo-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-gray-700">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-id-card text-xs"></i>
                                    <span>Dossiê</span>
                                </button>

                                <button onclick="admin.deleteUser('${acc.email}')" class="p-2 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-950/40 rounded-xl transition active:scale-95" title="Excluir Usuário">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
                                </button>
                            ` : `
                                <button type="button" onclick="admin.openEditUserModal('${acc.email}')" title="Editar dados da conta de administrador" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-sm">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square text-xs"></i>
                                    <span>Editar Tudo</span>
                                </button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="admin.openUserAudit('${acc.email}')" title="Ver Dossiê Administrativo" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-indigo-900/60 text-indigo-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-gray-700">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-id-card text-xs"></i>
                                    <span>Dossiê</span>
                                </button>
                            `}
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');
            }

            approveUser(email) {
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (acc) {
                    acc.status = 'approved';
                    acc.approvedAt = Date.now();
                    acc.approvedBy = auth.currentUser.email;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));

                    // Notifica nuvem
                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        window.syncManager.publish({
                            type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                            email: acc.email,
                            status: 'approved',
                            account: acc
                        });
                    }

                    if (window.auth && auth.syncUserToCloud) auth.syncUserToCloud(acc);
                    this.updatePendingBadge();
                    this.renderAdminUsers();
                    auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                    syncManager.showToast(`✓ Usuário ${acc.displayName} APROVADO!`);
                }
            }

            blockUser(email) {
                if (!confirm(`Deseja bloquear/rejeitar o acesso de ${email}?`)) return;
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (acc) {
                    acc.status = 'blocked';
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));

                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        window.syncManager.publish({
                            type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                            email: acc.email,
                            status: 'blocked',
                            account: acc
                        });
                    }

                    if (window.auth && auth.syncUserToCloud) auth.syncUserToCloud(acc);
                    this.updatePendingBadge();
                    this.renderAdminUsers();
                    syncManager.showToast(`Usuário ${acc.displayName} bloqueado.`);
                }
            }

            deleteUser(email) {
                if (!confirm(`Deseja excluir permanentemente o cadastro de ${email}?`)) return;
                let accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                accounts = accounts.filter(a => a.email.toLowerCase() !== email.toLowerCase());
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_DELETE',
                        email: email
                    });
                }

                if (window.auth && auth.deleteUserFromCloud) auth.deleteUserFromCloud(email);
                    this.updatePendingBadge();
                    this.renderAdminUsers();
                    auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                    syncManager.showToast("Cadastro excluído.");
            }

            changeUserRole(email, newRole) {
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (acc) {
                    acc.role = newRole;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        window.syncManager.publish({
                            type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                            email: acc.email,
                            status: acc.status,
                            account: acc
                        });
                    }
                    auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                    this.renderAdminUsers();
                    syncManager.showToast(`✓ Cargo de ${acc.displayName} atualizado para "${newRole}"`);
                }
            }

            changeUserDept(email, newDept) {
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (acc) {
                    acc.dept = newDept;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        window.syncManager.publish({
                            type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                            email: acc.email,
                            status: acc.status,
                            account: acc
                        });
                    }
                    this.renderAdminUsers();
                    auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                    syncManager.showToast(`✓ Setor de ${acc.displayName} atualizado para "${newDept}"`);
                }
            }

            quickEditUserName(email) {
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (!acc) return;
                const newName = prompt(`Editar nome completo de ${acc.displayName}:`, acc.displayName);
                if (!newName || !newName.trim() || newName.trim() === acc.displayName) return;
                acc.displayName = newName.trim();
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) {
                    auth.currentUser.displayName = acc.displayName;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(auth.currentUser));
                    auth.updateUserUI();
                }
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                        email: acc.email,
                        status: acc.status,
                        account: acc
                    });
                }
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Nome atualizado para "${acc.displayName}"`);
            }

            quickEditUserPassword(email) {
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (!acc) return;
                const newPass = prompt(`Senha atual de ${acc.displayName}: "${acc.password || '123456'}"\n\nDigite a nova senha para este colaborador:`, acc.password || '');
                if (newPass === null || !newPass.trim()) return;
                acc.password = newPass.trim();
                if (!acc.passwordHistory) acc.passwordHistory = [];
                acc.passwordHistory.unshift({
                    password: acc.password,
                    changedAt: Date.now(),
                    changedBy: auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Administrador'
                });
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) {
                    auth.currentUser.password = acc.password;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(auth.currentUser));
                }
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                        email: acc.email,
                        status: acc.status,
                        account: acc
                    });
                }
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Nova senha de ${acc.displayName} definida com sucesso!`);
            }


            initReportMonths() {
                const select = document.getElementById('report-month-filter');
                if (!select) return;

                const monthsNames = [
                    'Janeiro', 'Fevereiro', 'Março', 'Abril', 'Maio', 'Junho',
                    'Julho', 'Agosto', 'Setembro', 'Outubro', 'Novembro', 'Dezembro'
                ];

                const now = new Date();
                let options = '';

                // Opção Mês Atual
                const currMonthYear = `${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${now.getFullYear()}`;
                options += `<option value="${currMonthYear}" selected>Mês Atual (${monthsNames[now.getMonth()]}/${now.getFullYear()})</option>`;

                // Últimos 11 meses anteriores
                for (let i = 1; i <= 11; i++) {
                    const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1);
                    const val = `${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${d.getFullYear()}`;
                    options += `<option value="${val}">${monthsNames[d.getMonth()]}/${d.getFullYear()}</option>`;
                }
                options += `<option value="all">Todos os Períodos (Geral)</option>`;

                select.innerHTML = options;
                this.generateMonthlyReport();
            }

            generateMonthlyReport() {
                const container = document.getElementById('monthly-report-printable');
                if (!container) return;

                const monthFilter = document.getElementById('report-month-filter') ? document.getElementById('report-month-filter').value : 'all';
                const sectorFilter = document.getElementById('report-sector-filter') ? document.getElementById('report-sector-filter').value : 'all';

                // Todas as ocorrências (ativas + arquivadas)
                const allOccs = window.occApp ? window.occApp.occurrences : [];
                const allTasks = window.app ? window.app.tasks : [];

                // Filtro por mês
                const filterByMonth = (item) => {
                    if (monthFilter === 'all') return true;
                    const date = item.createdAt ? new Date(item.createdAt) : (item.date ? new Date(item.date) : new Date());
                    const itemMonthYear = `${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${date.getFullYear()}`;
                    return itemMonthYear === monthFilter;
                };

                let filteredOccs = allOccs.filter(filterByMonth);
                let filteredTasks = allTasks.filter(filterByMonth);

                if (sectorFilter !== 'all') {
                    filteredOccs = filteredOccs.filter(o => o.department === sectorFilter);
                }

                // Cálculo de Gargalos: Contagem por Setor
                const sectorCounts = {};
                filteredOccs.forEach(o => {
                    const sec = o.department || 'Outro Setor';
                    sectorCounts[sec] = (sectorCounts[sec] || 0) + 1;
                });

                // Setor com maior incidência (Maior Gargalo)
                let topGargaloSector = 'Nenhum gargalo registrado';
                let topGargaloCount = 0;
                Object.keys(sectorCounts).forEach(sec => {
                    if (sectorCounts[sec] > topGargaloCount) {
                        topGargaloCount = sectorCounts[sec];
                        topGargaloSector = sec;
                    }
                });

                // Taxa de resolução de ocorrências
                const resolvedCount = filteredOccs.filter(o => o.status === 'resolved' || o.status === 'answered').length;
                const resolutionRate = filteredOccs.length > 0 ? Math.round((resolvedCount / filteredOccs.length) * 100) : 100;

                // Tarefas concluídas
                const completedTasksCount = filteredTasks.filter(t => t.completed).length;
                const taskRate = filteredTasks.length > 0 ? Math.round((completedTasksCount / filteredTasks.length) * 100) : 100;

                const nowFormatted = new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                const adminName = (auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Administrador');

                // Agrupamento de ocorrências por setor
                const occsBySector = {};
                filteredOccs.forEach(o => {
                    const sec = o.department || 'Outro Setor';
                    if (!occsBySector[sec]) occsBySector[sec] = [];
                    occsBySector[sec].push(o);
                });

                // PREPARAÇÃO DOS DADOS PARA OS GRÁFICOS DE PIZZA (SVG)
                const sectorColors = {
                    'Reposição': '#ef4444',
                    'Frente de Caixa': '#f59e0b',
                    'Açougue': '#ec4899',
                    'Padaria / Frios': '#8b5cf6',
                    'Padaria': '#8b5cf6',
                    'Hortifrúti': '#10b981',
                    'Depósito / Estoque': '#3b82f6',
                    'Depósito': '#3b82f6',
                    'Fiscal de Loja': '#06b6d4',
                    'Loja': '#6366f1',
                    'Geral': '#64748b',
                    'Outro Setor': '#94a3b8'
                };

                // Gráfico 1: Gargalos por Setor
                const occPieData = Object.keys(occsBySector).map(sec => ({
                    label: sec,
                    value: occsBySector[sec].length,
                    color: sectorColors[sec] || '#a855f7'
                }));
                const occPieChartHtml = (typeof window.createSvgPieChart === 'function') 
                    ? window.createSvgPieChart(occPieData, { donut: true, centerLabel: 'Gargalos' })
                    : '';

                // Gráfico 2: Produtividade de Tarefas
                const pendingTasksCount = filteredTasks.length - completedTasksCount;
                const taskPieData = [
                    { label: 'Tarefas Concluídas', value: completedTasksCount, color: '#10b981' },
                    { label: 'Tarefas Pendentes', value: pendingTasksCount, color: '#6366f1' }
                ];
                const taskPieChartHtml = (typeof window.createSvgPieChart === 'function') 
                    ? window.createSvgPieChart(taskPieData, { donut: true, centerLabel: 'Tarefas' })
                    : '';

                // Gráfico 3: Taxa de Resolução de Ocorrências
                const pendingOccsCount = filteredOccs.length - resolvedCount;
                const resPieData = [
                    { label: 'Casos Resolvidos / Com Parecer', value: resolvedCount, color: '#10b981' },
                    { label: 'Aguardando Decisão do Admin', value: pendingOccsCount, color: '#f59e0b' }
                ];
                const resPieChartHtml = (typeof window.createSvgPieChart === 'function') 
                    ? window.createSvgPieChart(resPieData, { donut: true, centerLabel: 'Casos' })
                    : '';

                // Gráfico 4: Avaliações de Feedback
                const allFeedbacks = window.feedbackApp ? window.feedbackApp.feedbacks : [];
                const filteredFeedbacks = allFeedbacks.filter(filterByMonth);
                const fbCountsReport = { 'Excelente': 0, 'Bom': 0, 'Regular': 0, 'Precisa Melhorar': 0, 'Pendente': 0 };
                filteredFeedbacks.forEach(f => {
                    if (f.status === 'pending') fbCountsReport['Pendente']++;
                    else if (fbCountsReport[f.overallRating] !== undefined) fbCountsReport[f.overallRating]++;
                    else fbCountsReport['Bom']++;
                });
                const fbPieData = [
                    { label: 'Excelente (Supera)', value: fbCountsReport['Excelente'], color: '#10b981' },
                    { label: 'Bom (Atende)', value: fbCountsReport['Bom'], color: '#6366f1' },
                    { label: 'Regular (Atenção)', value: fbCountsReport['Regular'], color: '#f59e0b' },
                    { label: 'Precisa Melhorar', value: fbCountsReport['Precisa Melhorar'], color: '#ef4444' },
                    { label: 'Pendente (Aguardando)', value: fbCountsReport['Pendente'], color: '#a855f7' }
                ];
                const fbPieChartHtml = (typeof window.createSvgPieChart === 'function') 
                    ? window.createSvgPieChart(fbPieData, { donut: true, centerLabel: 'Feedbacks' })
                    : '';

                // INCONSISTÊNCIAS OPERACIONAIS & DESFALQUES DE ESCALA
                const allInconsistencies = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_inconsistencies') || '[]');
                // Garante que inconsistências de tarefas ativas também entrem se não estiverem no array global
                allTasks.forEach(t => {
                    if (t.inconsistency && t.inconsistency.hasInconsistency) {
                        const exists = allInconsistencies.some(inc => inc.taskId === t.id || inc.id === 'inc_task_' + t.id);
                        if (!exists) {
                            allInconsistencies.push({
                                id: 'inc_task_' + t.id,
                                source: 'tarefa',
                                type: 'Inconsistência em Tarefa / Ruptura',
                                taskId: t.id,
                                taskTitle: t.title,
                                departamento: t.inconsistency.sector || 'Geral',
                                reason: t.inconsistency.reason || 'Ruptura Operacional',
                                notes: t.inconsistency.notes || t.title,
                                date: t.date || getLocalTodayString(),
                                author: t.authorName || 'Colaborador',
                                createdAt: t.createdAt || Date.now()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                });

                let filteredInconsistencies = allInconsistencies.filter(inc => {
                    if (monthFilter === 'all') return true;
                    const date = inc.createdAt ? new Date(inc.createdAt) : (inc.date ? new Date(inc.date) : new Date());
                    const itemMonthYear = `${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${date.getFullYear()}`;
                    return itemMonthYear === monthFilter;
                });

                if (sectorFilter !== 'all') {
                    filteredInconsistencies = filteredInconsistencies.filter(inc => (inc.departamento || '').toUpperCase().includes(sectorFilter.toUpperCase()));
                }

                // Agrupamento de inconsistências por motivo
                const incReasonsCount = {};
                filteredInconsistencies.forEach(inc => {
                    const r = inc.reason || 'Outra Inconsistência';
                    incReasonsCount[r] = (incReasonsCount[r] || 0) + 1;
                });

                const incColors = ['#ef4444', '#f59e0b', '#ec4899', '#8b5cf6', '#10b981', '#3b82f6', '#06b6d4'];
                const incPieData = Object.keys(incReasonsCount).map((r, i) => ({
                    label: r,
                    value: incReasonsCount[r],
                    color: incColors[i % incColors.length]
                }));
                const incPieChartHtml = (typeof window.createSvgPieChart === 'function' && incPieData.length > 0)
                    ? window.createSvgPieChart(incPieData, { donut: true, centerLabel: 'Rupturas' })
                    : '<div class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-gray-500 italic">Nenhuma inconsistência operacional registrada no período.</div>';

                container.innerHTML = `
                    <!-- CABEÇALHO OFICIAL DO RELATÓRIO EXECUTIVO -->
                    <div class="border-b-2 border-indigo-500/80 pb-4 page-break-avoid">
                        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg text-xl font-bold">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-line"></i>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-extrabold tracking-widest text-indigo-400 block">TASKFLOW • GESTÃO E AUDITORIA OPERACIONAL</span>
                                    <h2 class="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-gray-100 uppercase tracking-tight">RELATÓRIO MENSAL DE PROCESSOS & GARGALOS OPERACIONAIS</h2>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-left sm:text-right text-xs text-gray-400 space-y-0.5">
                                <p>Período de Referência: <strong class="text-amber-300 font-bold">${monthFilter === 'all' ? 'Histórico Completo' : monthFilter}</strong></p>
                                <p>Data de Emissão: <strong class="text-gray-200 font-mono">${nowFormatted}</strong></p>
                                <p>Emitido por: <strong class="text-indigo-300">${adminName}</strong></p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- RISCO SEPARADOR PRINCIPAL GRADIENTE -->
                    <div class="report-divider-heavy"></div>

                    <!-- QUADRO EXECUTIVO: DIAGNÓSTICO DOS GARGALOS (KPIs) -->
                    <div class="page-break-avoid">
                        <span class="text-[11px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-gray-400 block mb-2">Quadro Sintético de Indicadores & Gargalos:</span>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
                            <!-- Card Gargalo Crítico -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-amber-500/50 p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-1">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-amber-400">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider">Maior Gargalo</span>
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>
                                </div>
                                <h3 class="text-sm font-black text-amber-300 truncate">${topGargaloSector}</h3>
                                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">${topGargaloCount > 0 ? `${topGargaloCount} ocorrências` : 'Sem gargalos'}</p>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Card Total de Ocorrências -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-1">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-indigo-400">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider">Ocorrências</span>
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-user"></i>
                                </div>
                                <h3 class="text-xl font-black text-gray-100">${filteredOccs.length}</h3>
                                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Casos relatados</p>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Card Inconsistências & Rupturas -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-rose-600/50 p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-1">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-rose-400">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider">Inconsistências</span>
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation"></i>
                                </div>
                                <h3 class="text-xl font-black text-rose-400">${filteredInconsistencies.length}</h3>
                                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Rupturas & Vagas Escala</p>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Card Taxa de Resolução -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-1">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-emerald-400">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider">Resolução ADM</span>
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-check-double"></i>
                                </div>
                                <h3 class="text-xl font-black text-emerald-400">${resolutionRate}%</h3>
                                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">${resolvedCount} casos concluídos</p>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Card Tarefas Operacionais -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg space-y-1">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-purple-400">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider">Tarefas Mês</span>
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check"></i>
                                </div>
                                <h3 class="text-xl font-black text-purple-300">${completedTasksCount} / ${filteredTasks.length}</h3>
                                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">${taskRate}% de conclusão</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- RISCO SEPARADOR SÓLIDO -->
                    <div class="report-divider-solid"></div>

                    <!-- DIAGNÓSTICO EM GRÁFICOS DE PIZZA (PRODUTIVIDADE & GARGALOS) -->
                    <div class="space-y-3.5 page-break-avoid">
                        <div class="report-section-title">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-pie text-indigo-400"></i>
                            <span>Diagnóstico Visual em Gráficos de Pizza</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                            <!-- Gráfico 1: Ocorrências e Gargalos por Setor -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
                                <h5 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400"></span>
                                    <span>Gargalos & Ocorrências por Setor</span>
                                </h5>
                                ${occPieChartHtml}
                            </div>

                            <!-- Gráfico 2: Inconsistências Operacionais & Rupturas -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
                                <h5 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500"></span>
                                    <span>Inconsistências & Rupturas</span>
                                </h5>
                                ${incPieChartHtml}
                            </div>

                            <!-- Gráfico 3: Produtividade de Tarefas Operacionais -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
                                <h5 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-400"></span>
                                    <span>Produtividade de Tarefas</span>
                                </h5>
                                ${taskPieChartHtml}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                            <!-- Gráfico 3: Taxa de Resolução de Ocorrências -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
                                <h5 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span>
                                    <span>Índice de Resolução das Ocorrências</span>
                                </h5>
                                ${resPieChartHtml}
                            </div>

                            <!-- Gráfico 4: Avaliações de Desempenho 1-on-1 -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
                                <h5 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-purple-400"></span>
                                    <span>Panorama de Feedbacks & Desempenho</span>
                                </h5>
                                ${fbPieChartHtml}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- RISCO SEPARADOR SÓLIDO -->
                    <div class="report-divider-solid"></div>

                    <!-- SEÇÃO 1: DETALHAMENTO DE GARGALOS POR SETOR (COM RISCOS DE ESPAÇAMENTO) -->
                    <div class="space-y-4">
                        <div class="report-section-title">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group text-amber-400"></i>
                            <span>1. Mapeamento de Ocorrências & Gargalos por Setor</span>
                        </div>

                        ${Object.keys(occsBySector).length === 0 ? `
                            <div class="p-6 bg-gray-900/40 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 text-center text-xs text-gray-400">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-2xl text-emerald-500/60 mb-2 block"></i>
                                <span>Nenhuma ocorrência ou falha operacional registrada neste período e setor selecionado.</span>
                            </div>
                        ` : Object.keys(occsBySector).map(sector => {
                            const sectorOccs = occsBySector[sector];
                            return `
                            <!-- BLOCO DO SETOR COM RISCO SUPERIOR E INFERIOR -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/80 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3.5 shadow-md page-break-avoid">
                                <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b-2 border-indigo-600/50 pb-2.5">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-400"></span>
                                        <h4 class="text-sm font-black text-gray-100 uppercase tracking-wider">SETOR: ${sector}</h4>
                                    </div>
                                    <span class="text-xs font-bold text-amber-400 bg-amber-950/40 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-800/40">
                                        Total de Ocorrências no Setor: ${sectorOccs.length}
                                    </span>
                                </div>

                                <!-- Casos do Setor com Riscos Divisórios Tracejados Entre Cada Um -->
                                <div class="space-y-3">
                                    ${sectorOccs.map((occ, idx) => {
                                        const occDate = new Date(occ.createdAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                                        return `
                                        <div class="${idx > 0 ? 'pt-3 border-t border-dashed border-gray-800' : ''} space-y-2 text-xs">
                                            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-1.5 bg-gray-950/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/60">
                                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                                    <strong class="text-gray-100 font-bold">${occ.title}</strong>
                                                    <span class="text-gray-500">•</span>
                                                    <span class="text-amber-300 font-medium">Colaborador: <strong>${occ.collaborator}</strong></span>
                                                    <span class="text-gray-500">•</span>
                                                    <span class="text-indigo-400">Relator: ${occ.authorName} (${occ.authorRole || 'Líder'})</span>
                                                </div>
                                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono">${occDate}</span>
                                            </div>

                                            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 pt-1 pl-1">
                                                <div class="bg-gray-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/60">

                                                </div>
                                            `}
                                        </div>
                                        `;
                                    }).join('')}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            `;
                        }).join('')}
                    </div>

                    <div class="report-divider-solid"></div>

                                ${filteredTasks.length > 25 ? `<p class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-1 italic">* Exibindo as 25 primeiras tarefas do mês. Utilize o botão "Planilha CSV" para extrair todas as ${filteredTasks.length} tarefas.</p>` : ''}
                            </div>

            exportMonthlyReportCSV() {
                const monthFilter = document.getElementById('report-month-filter') ? document.getElementById('report-month-filter').value : 'all';
                const sectorFilter = document.getElementById('report-sector-filter') ? document.getElementById('report-sector-filter').value : 'all';

                const allOccs = window.occApp ? window.occApp.occurrences : [];
                const filterByMonth = (item) => {
                    if (monthFilter === 'all') return true;
                    const date = item.createdAt ? new Date(item.createdAt) : new Date();
                    const itemMonthYear = `${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/${date.getFullYear()}`;
                    return itemMonthYear === monthFilter;
                };

                let filteredOccs = allOccs.filter(filterByMonth);
                if (sectorFilter !== 'all') {
                    filteredOccs = filteredOccs.filter(o => o.department === sectorFilter);
                }

                if (filteredOccs.length === 0) {
                    alert("Nenhum dado encontrado para exportar com os filtros atuais.");
                    return;
                }

                let csv = "ID,Data,Periodo,Setor,Colaborador_Envolvido,Titulo,O_Que_Ocorreu,Resolucao_Lider,Medida_Tomada,Gravidade,Status,Lider_Relator,Orientacao_ADM,Decisao_ADM\n";
                filteredOccs.forEach(o => {
                    const dateFormatted = new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                    const row = [
                        `"${o.id}"`,
                        `"${dateFormatted}"`,
                        `"${monthFilter}"`,
                        `"${(o.department || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.collaborator || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.title || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.whatHappened || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.currentResolution || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.actionTaken || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${o.severity || 'Normal'}"`,
                        `"${o.status || 'pending'}"`,
                        `"${(o.authorName || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.adminFeedback ? o.adminFeedback.guidance || '' : '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(o.adminFeedback ? o.adminFeedback.recommendedDecision || '' : '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
                    ];
                    csv += row.join(',') + "\n";
                });

                const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
                const link = document.createElement("a");
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                link.setAttribute("href", url);
                link.setAttribute("download", `TaskFlow_Relatorio_Gargalos_${monthFilter.replace('/', '_')}.csv`);
                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);
                syncManager.showToast("✓ Planilha de Relatório Mensal baixada!");
            }

            populateAuditUserSelect(selectedEmail = null) {
                const select = document.getElementById('audit-user-select');
                if (!select) return;
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                select.innerHTML = accounts.map(a => `<option value="${a.email}">${a.displayName} (${a.role || 'Colaborador'})</option>`).join('');
                if (selectedEmail) {
                    select.value = selectedEmail;
                } else if (accounts.length > 0 && !select.value) {
                    select.value = accounts[0].email;
                }
            }

            openUserAudit(email) {
                this.switchTab('audit');
                this.populateAuditUserSelect(email);
                this.renderUserAudit(email);
            }

            renderUserAudit(email) {
                const container = document.getElementById('audit-user-details-container');
                if (!container) return;

                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const targetEmail = (email || (document.getElementById('audit-user-select') ? document.getElementById('audit-user-select').value : '') || '').toLowerCase();
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === targetEmail);

                if (!acc) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div class="p-8 text-center text-xs text-gray-500 bg-gray-950 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">Selecione um colaborador no menu acima para consultar seu dossiê completo.</div>`;
                    return;
                }

                // Tarefas criadas pelo colaborador
                const allTasks = window.app ? window.app.tasks : [];
                const tasksCreatedBy = allTasks.filter(t => (t.authorName && t.authorName.toLowerCase() === acc.displayName.toLowerCase()) || (t.authorEmail && t.authorEmail.toLowerCase() === acc.email.toLowerCase()));
                
                // Tarefas concluídas pelo colaborador
                const tasksCompletedBy = allTasks.filter(t => t.completed && ((t.completedBy && t.completedBy.toLowerCase() === acc.displayName.toLowerCase()) || (t.assignee && t.assignee.toLowerCase() === acc.displayName.toLowerCase())));

                // Ocorrências relatadas pelo colaborador
                const allOccs = window.occApp ? window.occApp.occurrences : [];
                const occsCreatedBy = allOccs.filter(o => (o.authorEmail && o.authorEmail.toLowerCase() === acc.email.toLowerCase()) || (o.authorName && o.authorName.toLowerCase() === acc.displayName.toLowerCase()));

                // Ocorrências em que o colaborador esteve envolvido
                const occsInvolvedIn = allOccs.filter(o => o.collaborator && o.collaborator.toLowerCase().includes(acc.displayName.toLowerCase()));

                // Feedbacks recebidos pelo colaborador
                const allFeedbacks = window.feedbackApp ? window.feedbackApp.feedbacks : [];
                const userFeedbacks = allFeedbacks.filter(f => (f.collaboratorEmail && f.collaboratorEmail.toLowerCase() === acc.email.toLowerCase()) || (f.collaboratorName && f.collaboratorName.toLowerCase() === acc.displayName.toLowerCase()));

                const dateRegistered = acc.createdAt ? new Date(acc.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR') : 'Data não registrada';
                const lastPassChange = acc.lastPasswordChangedAt ? new Date(acc.lastPasswordChangedAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR') : 'Nunca alterada';

                container.innerHTML = `
                    <!-- Card de Perfil & Dados de Acesso -->
                    <div class="bg-gray-950 p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 shadow-xl space-y-4">
                        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-gray-800 pb-4">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600/20 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shrink-0">
                                    ${acc.displayName ? acc.displayName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase() : 'CO'}
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <h3 class="text-base font-bold text-gray-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <span>${acc.displayName}</span>
                                        ${acc.isAdmin ? '<span class="text-[10px] font-extrabold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500 text-black">ADMINISTRADOR</span>' : ''}
                                    </h3>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-indigo-400 font-medium font-mono mt-0.5">${acc.email}</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
                                <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold ${acc.status === 'approved' ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30' : 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30'}">
                                    Status: ${acc.status === 'approved' ? 'Aprovado' : 'Pendente'}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- DESTAQUE DE SEGURANÇA: SENHA ATUAL & HISTÓRICO -->
                        <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-indigo-950/30 border border-indigo-500/40 space-y-2.5">
                            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-indigo-300 block">SENHA ATUAL DO COLABORADOR:</span>
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1">
                                        <span class="font-mono text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-amber-300 bg-gray-900 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 select-all">${acc.password || '(Não definida)'}</span>
                                        <button onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText('${acc.password || ''}'); syncManager.showToast('Senha copiada!');" class="p-2 text-indigo-300 hover:text-white bg-indigo-900/60 hover:bg-indigo-800 rounded-xl transition text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5" title="Copiar Senha">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-copy"></i>
                                            <span class="hidden sm:inline">Copiar</span>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-left sm:text-right text-xs text-gray-400">
                                    <p>Última Alteração: <strong class="text-gray-200">${lastPassChange}</strong></p>
                                    <p>Cadastrado em: <span class="text-gray-300">${dateRegistered}</span></p>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            ${acc.passwordHistory && acc.passwordHistory.length > 0 ? `
                                <div class="pt-2 border-t border-indigo-900/50">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-indigo-400 block mb-1">Histórico de Alterações de Senha:</span>
                                    <div class="space-y-1">
                                        ${acc.passwordHistory.slice(0, 4).map(h => `
                                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-gray-300 bg-gray-900/70 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">
                                                <span>Senha definida: <strong class="text-amber-300 font-mono">${h.password}</strong></span>
                                                <span class="text-gray-500 font-mono">${new Date(h.changedAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</span>
                                            </div>
                                        `).join('')}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>

                        <!-- Grid de Métricas de Atividade -->
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2.5 text-center">
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                                <span class="text-lg font-black text-indigo-400">${tasksCreatedBy.length}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-semibold block mt-0.5">Tarefas Criadas</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                                <span class="text-lg font-black text-emerald-400">${tasksCompletedBy.length}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-semibold block mt-0.5">Tarefas Concluídas</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                                <span class="text-lg font-black text-amber-400">${occsCreatedBy.length}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-semibold block mt-0.5">Ocorrências Relatadas</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                                <span class="text-lg font-black text-red-400">${occsInvolvedIn.length}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-semibold block mt-0.5">Ocorrências Envolvido</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                                <span class="text-lg font-black text-purple-400">${userFeedbacks.length}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-semibold block mt-0.5">Feedbacks 1-on-1</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Histórico 1: Tarefas do Colaborador -->
                        <div class="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-gray-800">
                            <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check text-indigo-400"></i>
                                <span>Tarefas Criadas ou Vinculadas (${tasksCreatedBy.length})</span>
                            </h4>
                            ${tasksCreatedBy.length === 0 ? `
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 italic bg-gray-900/50 p-2.5 rounded-xl">Nenhuma tarefa criada por este colaborador.</p>
                            ` : `
                                <div class="space-y-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                                    ${tasksCreatedBy.map(t => `
                                        <div class="p-2.5 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center justify-between">
                                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                                                <i class="fa-solid ${t.completed ? 'fa-check text-emerald-400' : 'fa-clock text-amber-400'}"></i>
                                                <span class="${t.completed ? 'line-through text-gray-500' : 'text-gray-200 font-medium'} truncate">${t.title}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 shrink-0 font-mono">${t.priority} • ${t.date || 'S/D'}</span>
                                        </div>
                                    `).join('')}
                                </div>
                            `}
                        </div>

                        <!-- Histórico 2: Ocorrências em que Esteve Envolvido -->
                        
                        <!-- Histórico 3: Feedbacks & Avaliações 1-on-1 Recebidas -->
                        <div class="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-gray-800">
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-purple-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-comments text-purple-400"></i>
                                    <span>Feedbacks & Avaliações 1-on-1 Realizadas (${userFeedbacks.length})</span>
                                </h4>
                                <button type="button" onclick="admin.closePanel(); window.switchMainView('feedback'); feedbackApp.switchTab('apply');" class="text-[11px] font-bold text-purple-300 hover:text-white transition flex items-center gap-1">

                                </button>

                            ${userFeedbacks.length === 0 ? `
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 italic bg-gray-900/50 p-2.5 rounded-xl">Nenhum feedback 1-on-1 registrado para este colaborador até o momento.</p>
                            ` : `
                                <div class="space-y-2 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                                    ${userFeedbacks.map(f => `
                                        <div class="p-3 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl text-xs space-y-1.5">
                                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                                    <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${f.overallRating === 'Excelente' ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30' : f.overallRating === 'Bom' ? 'bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30' : f.overallRating === 'Regular' ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30' : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border border-red-500/30'}">
                                                        ${f.overallRating}
                                                    </span>
                                                    <span class="text-gray-300 font-semibold">${f.cycle}</span>
                                                </div>
                                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono">${new Date(f.date + 'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <p class="text-gray-400 text-[11px]"><strong class="text-gray-300">Avaliador:</strong> ${f.leaderName} (${f.leaderRole})</p>
                                            <p class="text-amber-200/90 text-[11px] bg-amber-950/20 p-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-900/40"><strong class="text-amber-400">Plano de Ação:</strong> ${f.actionPlan}</p>
                                            <div class="pt-1 flex justify-end">
                                                <button type="button" onclick="feedbackApp.openDetailModal('${f.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-purple-600/20 hover:bg-purple-600 text-purple-300 hover:text-white rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition">
                                                    Ver Ficha Completa
                                                </button>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    `).join('')}
                                </div>
                            `}
                        </div>

                        <div class="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-gray-800">
                            <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-user text-amber-400"></i>
                                <span>Ocorrências em que Foi Envolvido (${occsInvolvedIn.length})</span>
                            </h4>
                            ${occsInvolvedIn.length === 0 ? `
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 italic bg-gray-900/50 p-2.5 rounded-xl">Nenhuma ocorrência registrada envolvendo este colaborador.</p>
                            ` : `
                                <div class="space-y-2 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">

                                            </div>

                                            ` : ''}

                                </div>
                            `}
                        </div>

                `;
