            renderAdminOccurrences() {
                const container = document.getElementById('admin-occurrences-list');
                if (!container || !window.occApp) return;

                const occs = window.occApp.occurrences;
                if (occs.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-gray-500 bg-gray-950 rounded-xl border border-gray-800">Nenhuma ocorrência registrada por líderes no momento.</div>`;
                    return;
                }

                container.innerHTML = occs.map(occ => {
                    const isPending = occ.status === 'pending_admin' || !occ.status;
                    const dateFormatted = new Date(occ.createdAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR');

                    return `
                    <div class="p-3.5 bg-gray-950 border ${isPending ? 'border-amber-500/50' : 'border-gray-800'} rounded-xl space-y-2 text-xs">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span class="font-bold text-gray-200 text-sm">${occ.title}</span>
                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${isPending ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 animate-pulse' : 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300'}">${isPending ? 'Aguardando Parecer' : 'Respondido'}</span>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono">${dateFormatted}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-gray-400 space-y-0.5">
                            <p>Setor: <strong class="text-gray-200">${occ.department}</strong> • Colaborador: <strong class="text-amber-300">${occ.collaborator}</strong> • Relator: <strong class="text-indigo-300">${occ.authorName}</strong></p>
                            <p class="text-gray-300 bg-gray-900/60 p-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/80 mt-1"><strong class="text-gray-400">O que ocorreu:</strong> ${occ.whatHappened}</p>
                            <p class="text-gray-300 bg-gray-900/60 p-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/80"><strong class="text-gray-400">Resolução do Líder:</strong> ${occ.currentResolution}</p>
                        </div>
                        ${occ.adminFeedback ? `
                            <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-900/40 text-amber-200">
                                <strong class="text-amber-400">Orientação do ADM:</strong> ${occ.adminFeedback.guidance}
                                <div class="text-[10px] text-amber-400/80 mt-1">Decisão: ${occ.adminFeedback.recommendedDecision}</div>
                            </div>
                        ` : ''}
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-gray-800/60">
                            <button onclick="occApp.openAdminReplyModal('${occ.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-black font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 shadow-md">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-gavel text-xs"></i>
                                <span>${occ.adminFeedback ? 'Editar Parecer' : 'Dar Resposta & Orientar'}</span>
                            </button>
                            <button onclick="occApp.deleteOccurrence('${occ.id}')" title="Excluir Ocorrência" class="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 transition">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');
            }

            openNewUserModal() {
                this.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-create-user');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                }
                const errBox = document.getElementById('admin-create-error');
                if (errBox) errBox.classList.add('hidden');
            }

            closeNewUserModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-create-user');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            handleCreateUserSubmit(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const name = document.getElementById('admin-create-name').value.trim();
                const email = document.getElementById('admin-create-email').value.trim();
                const password = document.getElementById('admin-create-password').value;
                const role = document.getElementById('admin-create-role').value;
                const dept = document.getElementById('admin-create-dept').value.trim() || 'Geral';
                const canOccurrences = document.getElementById('admin-create-can-occurrences').checked;
                const errBox = document.getElementById('admin-create-error');

                if (errBox) errBox.classList.add('hidden');

                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                if (accounts.some(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase())) {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerText = "Já existe uma conta cadastrada com este e-mail.";
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                const newAccount = {
                    uid: 'usr_' + Date.now(),
                    displayName: name,
                    email: email,
                    password: password,
                    role: role,
                    dept: dept,
                    isAdmin: false,
                    canAccessOccurrences: canOccurrences,
                    status: 'approved',
                    emailVerified: true,
                    createdAt: Date.now(),
                    createdBy: auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.email : 'Admin'
                };

                accounts.push(newAccount);
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_REGISTER',
                        account: newAccount
                    });
                }

                auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                this.closeNewUserModal();
                e.target.reset();

                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Conta de ${name} criada com sucesso!`);
            }

            toggleOccurrencesAccess(email) {
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (!acc) return;

                acc.canAccessOccurrences = !acc.canAccessOccurrences;
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                if (window.auth && auth.syncUserToCloud) auth.syncUserToCloud(acc);

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                        email: acc.email,
                        status: acc.status,
                        account: acc
                    });
                }

                // Se o usuário logado for este colaborador, aplica permissão na hora
                if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email.toLowerCase() === acc.email.toLowerCase()) {
                    auth.currentUser.canAccessOccurrences = acc.canAccessOccurrences;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(auth.currentUser));
                    auth.applyPermissionsUI();
                }

                this.renderAdminUsers();
                syncManager.showToast(`Ocorrências de ${acc.displayName}: ${acc.canAccessOccurrences ? 'LIBERADO' : 'OCULTO'}`);
            }

            toggleScheduleEditor(email) {
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (!acc) return;

                acc.canEditSchedule = !acc.canEditSchedule;
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                        email: acc.email,
                        status: acc.status,
                        account: acc
                    });
                }

                // Se o usuário logado for este colaborador, aplica permissão na hora
                if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email.toLowerCase() === acc.email.toLowerCase()) {
                    auth.currentUser.canEditSchedule = acc.canEditSchedule;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(auth.currentUser));
                }

                if (window.scheduleApp) {
                    scheduleApp.render();
                }

                this.renderAdminUsers();
                if (window.syncManager && syncManager.showToast) {
                    syncManager.showToast(`Escala Diária de ${acc.displayName}: ${acc.canEditSchedule ? 'EDIÇÃO LIBERADA ✓' : 'APENAS VISUALIZAR'}`);
                }
            }

            renderAdminTasks() {
                const container = document.getElementById('admin-tasks-list');
                if (!container) return;
                const tasks = window.app ? window.app.tasks : [];

                if (tasks.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-gray-500">Nenhuma tarefa na base de dados.</div>`;
                    return;
                }

                container.innerHTML = tasks.map(t => {
                    const isCompleted = !!t.completed;
                    return `
                    <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl text-xs gap-2.5">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <input type="checkbox" ${isCompleted ? 'checked' : ''} onclick="app.toggleTask('${t.id}')" class="w-4 h-4 rounded accent-indigo-600 cursor-pointer shrink-0">
                            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
                                <p class="${isCompleted ? 'line-through text-gray-500' : 'text-gray-200'} font-semibold break-words leading-tight">${t.title}</p>
                                <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                                    <span>Resp: <strong class="text-indigo-300 font-medium">${t.assignee || 'Todos'}</strong></span>
                                    <span>•</span>
                                    <span>Venc: <strong class="text-gray-300">${t.date || 'S/D'}</strong></span>
                                    <span>•</span>
                                    <span class="uppercase font-semibold text-gray-400">${t.priority}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-auto">
                            ${t.image ? `<img src="${t.image}" onclick="app.viewFullImage(this.src)" title="Ver Foto Ampliada" class="w-7 h-7 object-cover rounded-lg border border-gray-700 cursor-pointer hover:border-indigo-400">` : ''}
                            <button onclick="admin.editTask('${t.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen-to-square text-[10px]"></i>Editar</button>
                            <button onclick="admin.reassignTaskPrompt('${t.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition active:scale-95">Reatribuir</button>
                            <button onclick="app.deleteTask('${t.id}')" title="Excluir" class="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 rounded-lg transition active:scale-95"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash text-xs"></i></button>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');
            }

            reassignTaskPrompt(id) {
                const task = app.tasks.find(t => t.id == id);
                if (!task) return;
                const newAssignee = prompt("Novo responsável pela tarefa:", task.assignee || '');
                if (newAssignee !== null) {
                    task.assignee = newAssignee.trim();
                    task.updatedAt = Date.now();
                    app.saveLocally();
                    if (window.syncManager) {
                        window.syncManager.publish({ type: 'TASK_UPSERT', task: task });
                    }
                    this.renderAdminTasks();
                    syncManager.showToast(`Tarefa reatribuída para ${task.assignee}`);
                }
            }

            clearCompletedTasks() {
                if (!confirm("Deseja remover todas as tarefas já concluídas?")) return;
                const uncompleted = app.tasks.filter(t => !t.completed);
                const removedCount = app.tasks.length - uncompleted.length;
                app.tasks = uncompleted;
                app.saveLocally();
                this.renderAdminTasks();
                syncManager.showToast(`${removedCount} tarefas concluídas foram removidas.`);
            }

            exportTasksToCSV() {
                const tasks = window.app ? window.app.tasks : [];
                if (tasks.length === 0) {
                    alert("Nenhuma tarefa para exportar.");
                    return;
                }

                let csv = "ID,Titulo,Responsavel,Vencimento,Prioridade,Status,CriadoPor,ConcluidoPor\n";
                tasks.forEach(t => {
                    const row = [
                        `"${t.id}"`,
                        `"${(t.title || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${(t.assignee || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                        `"${t.date || ''}"`,
                        `"${t.priority || ''}"`,
                        `"${t.completed ? 'Concluida' : 'Pendente'}"`,
                        `"${t.authorName || ''}"`,
                        `"${t.completedBy || ''}"`
                    ];
                    csv += row.join(',') + "\n";
                });

                const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
                const link = document.createElement("a");
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                link.setAttribute("href", url);
                link.setAttribute("download", `TaskFlow_Tarefas_${getLocalTodayString()}.csv`);
                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);
                syncManager.showToast("✓ Planilha CSV exportada com sucesso!");
            }

            // ==========================================
            
            // ==========================================
            // QUADRO ORGANIZACIONAL & HIERARQUIA CORPORATIVA
            // ==========================================
            getDefaultHierarchyLevels() {
                return {
                    "Administrador": 10,
                    "Diretoria / Geral": 10,
                    "Gerente": 8,
                    "Supervisor": 6,
                    "Líder": 4,
                    "Líder Setorial": 4,
                    "Líder de Reposição": 4,
                    "Encarregado": 4,
                    "Fiscal de Loja": 3,
                    "Monitor": 3,
                    "Açougue": 2,
                    "Padaria": 2,
                    "Operador de Caixa": 2,
                    "Depósito / Estoque": 2,
                    "Repositor": 1,
                    "Colaborador": 1
                };
            }

            getRoleHierarchyLevels() {
                const stored = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_hierarchy_levels');
                if (stored) {
                    try { return Object.assign({}, this.getDefaultHierarchyLevels(), JSON.parse(stored)); } catch(e) {}
                }
                return this.getDefaultHierarchyLevels();
            }

            saveRoleHierarchyLevels(levels) {
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_hierarchy_levels', JSON.stringify(levels));
                this.renderHierarchyTab();
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'APP_CONFIG_UPDATE',
                        config: { hierarchyLevels: levels }
                    });
                }
            }

            isHierarchyEnforcementEnabled() {
                const stored = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_enforce_hierarchy');
                return stored === null ? true : (stored === 'true');
            }

            setHierarchyEnforcement(enabled) {
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_enforce_hierarchy', enabled ? 'true' : 'false');
                this.renderHierarchyTab();
                if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(enabled ? '✓ Bloqueio hierárquico ativado' : '⚠️ Bloqueio hierárquico desativado', 'info');
            }

            getRoleLevel(roleName) {
                if (!roleName) return 1;
                const levels = this.getRoleHierarchyLevels();
                const trimmed = roleName.trim();
                if (levels[trimmed] !== undefined) return levels[trimmed];

                const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
                if (lower.includes('admin') || lower.includes('diretor') || lower.includes('proprietário')) return 10;
                if (lower.includes('gerente')) return 8;
                if (lower.includes('supervisor') || lower.includes('subgerente')) return 6;
                if (lower.includes('líder') || lower.includes('lider') || lower.includes('encarregado')) return 4;
                if (lower.includes('fiscal') || lower.includes('monitor') || lower.includes('auditor')) return 3;
                if (lower.includes('caixa') || lower.includes('açougue') || lower.includes('acougue') || lower.includes('padaria') || lower.includes('estoque')) return 2;
                return 1;
            }

            canAssignTask(authorRole, targetRole, authorIsAdmin = false) {
                if (authorIsAdmin) return { allowed: true };
                if (!this.isHierarchyEnforcementEnabled()) return { allowed: true };

                const authorLvl = this.getRoleLevel(authorRole);
                const targetLvl = this.getRoleLevel(targetRole);

                if (authorLvl < targetLvl) {
                    return {
                        allowed: false,
                        reason: `Seu cargo atual (${authorRole || 'Colaborador'} - Nível ${authorLvl}) não possui permissão para delegar tarefas para ${targetRole || 'Cargo Superior'} (Nível ${targetLvl}). Na hierarquia da empresa, atribuições são restritas à sua própria equipe ou mesmo nível hierárquico.`
                    };
                }
                return { allowed: true };
            }

            changeRoleHierarchyLevel(role, newLevel) {
                const levels = this.getRoleHierarchyLevels();
                levels[role] = parseInt(newLevel, 10) || 1;
                this.saveRoleHierarchyLevels(levels);
                if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`✓ Nível de "${role}" atualizado para Nível ${newLevel}`, 'success');
            }

            renderHierarchyTab() {
                const container = document.getElementById('admin-hierarchy-levels-container');
                const toggle = document.getElementById('admin-toggle-hierarchy-enforcement');
                if (toggle) toggle.checked = this.isHierarchyEnforcementEnabled();
                if (!container) return;

                const levels = this.getRoleHierarchyLevels();
                const roles = this.getRoles();
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');

                const levelCategories = [
                    { min: 10, label: "Diretoria & Administração", badge: "Nível 10 - Estratégico Máximo", color: "from-rose-950/60 to-red-950/40 border-rose-500/40 text-rose-300" },
                    { min: 8, label: "Gerência Geral & Operacional", badge: "Nível 8 - Tático / Gerencial", color: "from-amber-950/60 to-orange-950/40 border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300" },
                    { min: 6, label: "Supervisão de Turno & Setor", badge: "Nível 6 - Supervisão", color: "from-purple-950/60 to-indigo-950/40 border-purple-500/40 text-purple-300" },
                    { min: 4, label: "Liderança de Equipe & Encarregados", badge: "Nível 4 - Liderança de Campo", color: "from-blue-950/60 to-cyan-950/40 border-blue-500/40 text-blue-300" },
                    { min: 3, label: "Monitores & Fiscais de Loja", badge: "Nível 3 - Monitoria & Fiscalização", color: "from-teal-950/60 to-emerald-950/40 border-teal-500/40 text-teal-300" },
                    { min: 2, label: "Operadores Especializados", badge: "Nível 2 - Especialistas / Seções", color: "from-emerald-950/60 to-green-950/40 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300" },
                    { min: 1, label: "Operacional & Repositores", badge: "Nível 1 - Execução Operacional", color: "from-gray-900 to-gray-950 border-gray-800 text-gray-300" }
                ];

                let html = '';
                levelCategories.forEach(cat => {
                    const matchedRoles = roles.filter(r => {
                        const lvl = levels[r] !== undefined ? levels[r] : this.getRoleLevel(r);
                        if (cat.min === 10) return lvl >= 10;
                        if (cat.min === 8) return lvl === 8 || lvl === 9;
                        if (cat.min === 6) return lvl === 6 || lvl === 7;
                        if (cat.min === 4) return lvl === 4 || lvl === 5;
                        if (cat.min === 3) return lvl === 3;
                        if (cat.min === 2) return lvl === 2;
                        return lvl <= 1;
                    });

                    html += `
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r ${cat.color} p-3.5 rounded-xl border shadow-md space-y-2.5">
                            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-black/40 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black">${cat.min}</span>
                                    <h6 class="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white">${cat.label}</h6>
                                </div>
                                <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold bg-black/40 border border-white/10 uppercase tracking-wide">${cat.badge}</span>
                            </div>

                            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                                ${matchedRoles.length === 0 ? `<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 italic p-1">Nenhum cargo neste nível.</p>` : matchedRoles.map(r => {
                                    const currentLvl = levels[r] !== undefined ? levels[r] : this.getRoleLevel(r);
                                    const userCount = accounts.filter(a => a.role === r).length;
                                    return `
                                        <div class="bg-gray-950/80 border border-gray-800/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                            <div class="min-w-0">
                                                <p class="font-bold text-xs text-gray-100 truncate">${r}</p>
                                                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">${userCount} colaborador(es)</p>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                                                <span class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase">Nível:</span>
                                                <select onchange="admin.changeRoleHierarchyLevel('${r}', this.value)" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 text-indigo-300 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg px-1.5 py-0.5 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer">
                                                    ${[10,8,6,4,3,2,1].map(n => `<option value="${n}" ${currentLvl === n ? 'selected' : ''}>Nível ${n}</option>`).join('')}
                                                </select>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    `;
                                }).join('')}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });

                container.innerHTML = html;
            }

            // MODO EDITOR: GESTÃO DINÂMICA DE CARGOS & SETORES
            // ==========================================
            getRoles() {
                const custom = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_custom_roles');
                if (custom) {
                    try { return JSON.parse(custom); } catch(e) {}
                }
                return [
                    "Administrador",
                    "Gerente",
                    "Supervisor",
                    "Líder Setorial",
                    "Líder de Reposição",
                    "Repositor",
                    "Operador de Caixa",
                    "Fiscal de Loja",
                    "Açougue",
                    "Padaria",
                    "Depósito / Estoque",
                    "Colaborador"
                ];
            }

            saveRoles(roles) {
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_custom_roles', JSON.stringify(roles));
                this.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                this.renderRolesAndDepts();
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'APP_CONFIG_UPDATE',
                        config: { customRoles: roles }
                    });
                }
            }

            promptAddRole() {
                const name = prompt("Digite o título do novo Cargo a cadastrar:");
                if (!name || !name.trim()) return;
                const clean = name.trim();
                const roles = this.getRoles();
                if (roles.some(r => r.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase())) {
                    alert("Este cargo já existe no sistema.");
                    return;
                }
                roles.push(clean);
                this.saveRoles(roles);
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Cargo "${clean}" criado com sucesso!`);
            }

            editRole(oldName) {
                const newName = prompt(`Novo nome para o cargo "${oldName}":`, oldName);
                if (!newName || !newName.trim() || newName.trim() === oldName) return;
                const clean = newName.trim();
                let roles = this.getRoles();
                const idx = roles.indexOf(oldName);
                if (idx !== -1) roles[idx] = clean;
                
                // Atualiza colaboradores que tinham este cargo
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                accounts.forEach(a => {
                    if (a.role === oldName) a.role = clean;
                });
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                
                if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.role === oldName) {
                    auth.currentUser.role = clean;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(auth.currentUser));
                    auth.updateUserUI();
                }
                
                auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                this.saveRoles(roles);
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Cargo renomeado para "${clean}"!`);
            }

            deleteRole(roleName) {
                if (roleName === 'Administrador' || roleName === 'Colaborador') {
                    alert("Os cargos base 'Administrador' e 'Colaborador' não podem ser excluídos.");
                    return;
                }
                if (!confirm(`Deseja realmente excluir o cargo "${roleName}"? Os colaboradores com este cargo continuarão no sistema, mas o cargo será removido da lista.`)) return;
                let roles = this.getRoles().filter(r => r !== roleName);
                this.saveRoles(roles);
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                syncManager.showToast(`Cargo "${roleName}" excluído.`);
            }

            getDepartments() {
                const sheetDepts = [
                    "ARROZ/OLEO",
                    "BAZAR",
                    "BEBIDA",
                    "CAFE/SALG",
                    "FARINACEO",
                    "LEITE",
                    "LEITE COND",
                    "LIMP",
                    "MAC/MOL",
                    "MATINAIS/BISC",
                    "PERFUMARIA",
                    "RAÇÃO/PAPEL/VIN",
                    "SUPORTE",
                    "Liderança",
                    "Geral"
                ];
                const custom = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_custom_departments');
                if (custom) {
                    try {
                        const parsed = JSON.parse(custom);
                        // Se for a lista antiga de exemplo (com Açougue ou Frente de Caixa), migra para os setores reais da planilha
                        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0 && !parsed.includes("Açougue") && !parsed.includes("Frente de Caixa")) {
                            return parsed;
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
                return sheetDepts;
            }

            saveDepartments(depts) {
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_custom_departments', JSON.stringify(depts));
                this.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                this.renderRolesAndDepts();
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'APP_CONFIG_UPDATE',
                        config: { customDepartments: depts }
                    });
                }
            }

            promptAddDepartment() {
                const name = prompt("Digite o nome do novo Setor / Departamento:");
                if (!name || !name.trim()) return;
                const clean = name.trim();
                const depts = this.getDepartments();
                if (depts.some(d => d.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase())) {
                    alert("Este setor já existe no sistema.");
                    return;
                }
                depts.push(clean);
                this.saveDepartments(depts);
                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Setor "${clean}" criado com sucesso!`);
            }

            editDepartment(oldName) {
                const newName = prompt(`Novo nome para o setor "${oldName}":`, oldName);
                if (!newName || !newName.trim() || newName.trim() === oldName) return;
                const clean = newName.trim();
                let depts = this.getDepartments();
                const idx = depts.indexOf(oldName);
                if (idx !== -1) depts[idx] = clean;

                // Atualiza colaboradores
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                accounts.forEach(a => {
                    if (a.dept === oldName) a.dept = clean;
                });
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));

                // Atualiza ocorrências
                if (window.occApp) {
                    occApp.occurrences.forEach(o => {
                        if (o.department === oldName) o.department = clean;
                    });
                    occApp.saveLocally();
                }

                this.saveDepartments(depts);
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Setor renomeado para "${clean}"!`);
            }

            deleteDepartment(deptName) {
                if (deptName === 'Geral') {
                    alert("O setor 'Geral' não pode ser excluído.");
                    return;
                }
                if (!confirm(`Deseja realmente excluir o setor "${deptName}"?`)) return;
                let depts = this.getDepartments().filter(d => d !== deptName);
                this.saveDepartments(depts);
                syncManager.showToast(`Setor "${deptName}" excluído.`);
            }

            populateRoleAndDeptSelects() {
                const roles = this.getRoles();
                const depts = this.getDepartments();

                // 0. admin-create-dept
                const createDeptEl = document.getElementById('admin-create-dept');
                if (createDeptEl) {
                    const currentVal = createDeptEl.value;
                    createDeptEl.innerHTML = depts.map(d => `<option value="${d}">${d}</option>`).join('');
                    if (currentVal && depts.includes(currentVal)) createDeptEl.value = currentVal;
                }

                // 1. admin-create-role
                const createRoleEl = document.getElementById('admin-create-role');
                if (createRoleEl) {
                    const currentVal = createRoleEl.value;
                    createRoleEl.innerHTML = roles.map(r => `<option value="${r}">${r}</option>`).join('');
                    if (currentVal && roles.includes(currentVal)) createRoleEl.value = currentVal;
                }

                // 2. admin-edit-user-role
                const editRoleEl = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-role');
                if (editRoleEl) {
                    const currentVal = editRoleEl.value;
                    editRoleEl.innerHTML = roles.map(r => `<option value="${r}">${r}</option>`).join('');
                    if (currentVal && roles.includes(currentVal)) editRoleEl.value = currentVal;
                }

                // 3. admin-edit-user-dept
                const editDeptEl = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-dept');
                if (editDeptEl) {
                    const currentVal = editDeptEl.value;
                    editDeptEl.innerHTML = depts.map(d => `<option value="${d}">${d}</option>`).join('');
                    if (currentVal && depts.includes(currentVal)) editDeptEl.value = currentVal;
                }

                // 4. occ-dept (Modal Nova Ocorrência)
                const occDeptEl = document.getElementById('occ-dept');
                if (occDeptEl) {
                    const currentVal = occDeptEl.value;
                    occDeptEl.innerHTML = depts.map(d => `<option value="${d}">${d}</option>`).join('');
                    if (currentVal && depts.includes(currentVal)) occDeptEl.value = currentVal;
                }

                // 5. admin-edit-occ-dept (Modal Editar Ocorrência)
                const editOccDeptEl = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-dept');
                if (editOccDeptEl) {
                    const currentVal = editOccDeptEl.value;
                    editOccDeptEl.innerHTML = depts.map(d => `<option value="${d}">${d}</option>`).join('');
                    if (currentVal && depts.includes(currentVal)) editOccDeptEl.value = currentVal;
                }
            }

            renderRolesAndDepts() {
                const rolesContainer = document.getElementById('admin-roles-list');
                const deptsContainer = document.getElementById('admin-departments-list');
                if (!rolesContainer || !deptsContainer) return;

                const roles = this.getRoles();
                const depts = this.getDepartments();
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const occurrences = window.occApp ? occApp.occurrences : [];

                // Render Cargos
                rolesContainer.innerHTML = roles.map(role => {
                    const userCount = accounts.filter(a => (a.role || 'Colaborador') === role).length;
                    const isProtected = (role === 'Administrador' || role === 'Colaborador');
                    return `
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl text-xs hover:border-purple-500/40 transition">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                            <span class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-[11px] shrink-0">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i>
                            </span>
                            <div class="min-w-0">
                                <span class="font-bold text-gray-200 block truncate">${role}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500">${userCount} colaborador(es)</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                            <button type="button" onclick="admin.editRole('${role}')" class="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-purple-300 hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg transition" title="Editar Cargo">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-pen text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                            ${!isProtected ? `
                            <button type="button" onclick="admin.deleteRole('${role}')" class="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg transition" title="Excluir Cargo">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                            ` : '<span class="text-[10px] text-gray-600 px-1 font-mono">Padrão</span>'}
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');

                // Render Setores
                deptsContainer.innerHTML = depts.map(dept => {
                    const occCount = occurrences.filter(o => o.department === dept).length;
                    const isProtected = (dept === 'Geral');
                    return `
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl text-xs hover:border-indigo-500/40 transition">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                            <span class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-indigo-500/15 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-[11px] shrink-0">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i>
                            </span>
                            <div class="min-w-0">
                                <span class="font-bold text-gray-200 block truncate">${dept}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500">${occCount} ocorrência(s)</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                            <button type="button" onclick="admin.editDepartment('${dept}')" class="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-indigo-300 hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg transition" title="Editar Setor">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-pen text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                            ${!isProtected ? `
                            <button type="button" onclick="admin.deleteDepartment('${dept}')" class="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg transition" title="Excluir Setor">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                            ` : '<span class="text-[10px] text-gray-600 px-1 font-mono">Padrão</span>'}
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');
            }

            // ==========================================
            // MODO EDITOR: EDIÇÃO COMPLETA DE COLABORADOR
            // ==========================================
            openEditUserModal(email) {
                this.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                let acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());

                if (!acc) {
                    const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                    const pending = pendingCodes[email.toLowerCase()];
                    if (pending) {
                        acc = {
                            displayName: pending.name,
                            email: pending.email,
                            password: pending.password || '123456',
                            role: pending.role || 'Colaborador',
                            dept: pending.dept || 'Geral',
                            isAdmin: false,
                            status: 'pending',
                            canAccessOccurrences: true
                        };
                    }
                }

                if (!acc) {
                    alert("Colaborador não encontrado.");
                    return;
                }

                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-original-email').value = acc.email;
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-name').value = acc.displayName || '';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-email').value = acc.email;
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-password').value = acc.password || '';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-role').value = acc.role || 'Colaborador';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-dept').value = acc.dept || 'Geral';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-is-admin').value = acc.isAdmin ? 'true' : 'false';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-status').value = acc.status || 'approved';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-can-occurrences').checked = !!acc.canAccessOccurrences;
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-can-schedule').checked = !!acc.canEditSchedule;

                const errBox = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-error');
                if (errBox) errBox.classList.add('hidden');

                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-edit-user');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                    modal.style.zIndex = '99999';
                }
            }

            closeEditUserModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-edit-user');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            toggleEditPasswordVisibility() {
                const passInput = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-password');
                const icon = document.getElementById('admin-edit-pass-icon');
                if (!passInput || !icon) return;
                if (passInput.type === 'password') {
                    passInput.type = 'text';
                    icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-eye-slash';
                } else {
                    passInput.type = 'password';
                    icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-eye';
                }
            }

            handleSaveEditUser(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const originalEmail = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-original-email').value;
                const newName = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-name').value.trim();
                const newEmail = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-email').value.trim();
                const newPassword = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-password').value;
                const newRole = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-role').value;
                const newDept = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-dept').value;
                const newIsAdmin = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-is-admin').value === 'true';
                const newStatus = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-status').value;
                const newCanOccurrences = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-can-occurrences').checked;
                const newCanSchedule = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-can-schedule').checked;
                const errBox = document.getElementById('admin-edit-user-error');

                if (!newName || !newEmail || !newPassword) {
                    if (errBox) {
                        errBox.innerText = "Preencha todos os campos obrigatórios.";
                        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                let accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                
                // Se o e-mail foi alterado, checa duplicidade
                if (newEmail.toLowerCase() !== originalEmail.toLowerCase()) {
                    if (accounts.some(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === newEmail.toLowerCase())) {
                        if (errBox) {
                            errBox.innerText = "Já existe outra conta com este novo e-mail.";
                            errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                }

                let accIdx = accounts.findIndex(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === originalEmail.toLowerCase());
                if (accIdx === -1) {
                    const newAcc = {
                        uid: 'usr_' + Date.now(),
                        displayName: newName,
                        email: newEmail,
                        password: newPassword,
                        role: newRole,
                        dept: newDept,
                        isAdmin: newIsAdmin,
                        status: newStatus,
                        canAccessOccurrences: newCanOccurrences,
                        canEditSchedule: newCanSchedule,
                        createdAt: Date.now(),
                        updatedAt: Date.now()
                    };
                    accounts.push(newAcc);
                    accIdx = accounts.length - 1;
                    const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                    delete pendingCodes[originalEmail.toLowerCase()];
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_pending_codes', JSON.stringify(pendingCodes));
                }

                const oldPassword = accounts[accIdx].password;
                accounts[accIdx].displayName = newName;
                accounts[accIdx].email = newEmail;
                accounts[accIdx].password = newPassword;
                accounts[accIdx].role = newRole;
                accounts[accIdx].dept = newDept;
                accounts[accIdx].isAdmin = newIsAdmin;
                accounts[accIdx].status = newStatus;
                accounts[accIdx].canAccessOccurrences = newCanOccurrences;
                accounts[accIdx].canEditSchedule = newCanSchedule;
                accounts[accIdx].updatedAt = Date.now();

                if (newPassword !== oldPassword) {
                    if (!accounts[accIdx].passwordHistory) accounts[accIdx].passwordHistory = [];
                    accounts[accIdx].passwordHistory.unshift({
                        password: newPassword,
                        changedAt: Date.now(),
                        changedBy: auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Administrador'
                    });
                }

                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                if (window.auth && auth.syncUserToCloud) auth.syncUserToCloud(accounts[accIdx]);

                // Se estiver editando a si próprio
                if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email.toLowerCase() === originalEmail.toLowerCase()) {
                    auth.currentUser = Object.assign(auth.currentUser, accounts[accIdx]);
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(auth.currentUser));
                    auth.updateUserUI();
                    auth.applyPermissionsUI();
                }

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    // Se mudou e-mail, remove o anterior e publica o novo
                    if (newEmail.toLowerCase() !== originalEmail.toLowerCase()) {
                        syncManager.publish({ type: 'ACCOUNT_DELETE', email: originalEmail });
                    }
                    syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                        email: newEmail,
                        status: newStatus,
                        account: accounts[accIdx]
                    });
                }

                auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                this.closeEditUserModal();
                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Dados de ${newName} salvos e atualizados!`);
            }

            // ==========================================
            // MODO EDITOR: EDIÇÃO COMPLETA DE OCORRÊNCIA
            // ==========================================
            populateOccCollabSelect(selectedCollab = '') {
                const colabs = window.occApp ? occApp.getSpreadsheetCollaborators(true) : [];
                const select = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-collab-select');
                const input = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-collab');
                if (select) {
                    let html = '<option value="">-- Escolher Colaborador da Planilha --</option>';
                    let matched = false;
                    colabs.forEach(c => {
                        const depto = c.departamento ? ` [${c.departamento}]` : '';
                        const isSel = (c.nome.toUpperCase() === String(selectedCollab).trim().toUpperCase());
                        if (isSel) matched = true;
                        html += `<option value="${c.nome}" data-dept="${c.departamento || ''}" ${isSel ? 'selected' : ''}>${c.nome}${depto}</option>`;
                    });
                    html += `<option value="__OUTRO__" ${(!matched && selectedCollab) ? 'selected' : ''}>+ Outro Colaborador (Digitar Manualmente)...</option>`;
                    select.innerHTML = html;

                    if (input) {
                        if (!matched && selectedCollab) {
                            input.classList.remove('hidden');
                            input.value = selectedCollab;
                        } else {
                            input.classList.add('hidden');
                            input.value = selectedCollab || '';
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            populateLeaderSelect(targetSelectId, selectedLeader = '') {
                const select = document.getElementById(targetSelectId);
                if (!select) return;

                const primaryLeaders = ["Emerson Diniz", "João Guilherme"];
                const options = new Set(primaryLeaders);

                if (selectedLeader && selectedLeader.trim()) {
                    options.add(selectedLeader.trim());
                }

                let html = '';
                options.forEach(lead => {
                    const isAdm = (lead === "Emerson Diniz" || lead === "João Guilherme");
                    const isSel = (lead.toUpperCase() === String(selectedLeader).toUpperCase());
                    html += `<option value="${lead}" ${isSel ? 'selected' : ''}>${lead}${isAdm ? ' (Administrador)' : ''}</option>`;
                });
                select.innerHTML = html;

                if (selectedLeader) {
                    select.value = selectedLeader;
                }
            }

            onSelectOccCollabChange(val) {
                const input = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-collab');
                if (val === '__OUTRO__') {
                    if (input) {
                        input.classList.remove('hidden');
                        input.value = '';
                        input.focus();
                    }
                    return;
                }

                if (input) {
                    input.classList.add('hidden');
                    input.value = val || '';
                }
                if (!val) return;

                // Tenta auto-selecionar o departamento no modal de edição
                const colabs = window.occApp ? occApp.getSpreadsheetCollaborators(false) : [];
                const found = colabs.find(c => c.nome.toUpperCase() === val.toUpperCase());
                if (found && found.departamento) {
                    const deptSelect = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-dept');
                    if (deptSelect) {
                        const deptVal = found.departamento.trim();
                        for (let i = 0; i < deptSelect.options.length; i++) {
                            const optText = deptSelect.options[i].text.toLowerCase();
                            const optVal = deptSelect.options[i].value.toLowerCase();
                            if (optVal === deptVal.toLowerCase() || optText.includes(deptVal.toLowerCase()) || deptVal.toLowerCase().includes(optVal)) {
                                deptSelect.selectedIndex = i;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            openEditOccurrenceModal(occId) {
                this.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                if (!window.occApp) return;
                const occ = occApp.occurrences.find(o => o.id === occId);
                if (!occ) {
                    alert("Ocorrência não encontrada.");
                    return;
                }

                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-id').value = occ.id;
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-title').value = occ.title || '';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-dept').value = occ.department || 'Geral';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-collab').value = occ.collaborator || '';
                
                // Popula seleção da planilha e líderes responsáveis
                this.populateOccCollabSelect(occ.collaborator || '');
                this.populateLeaderSelect('admin-edit-occ-author', occ.authorName || 'Emerson Diniz');

                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-severity').value = occ.severity || 'Normal';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-what').value = occ.whatHappened || '';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-resolution').value = occ.currentResolution || '';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-action').value = occ.actionTaken || '';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-status').value = occ.status || 'pending_admin';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-guidance').value = occ.adminFeedback ? occ.adminFeedback.guidance || '' : '';
                document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-decision').value = occ.adminFeedback ? occ.adminFeedback.recommendedDecision || '' : '';

                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-edit-occurrence');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                    modal.style.zIndex = '99999';
                }
            }

            closeEditOccurrenceModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-edit-occurrence');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            handleSaveEditOccurrence(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!window.occApp) return;
                const occId = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-id').value;
                const occ = occApp.occurrences.find(o => o.id === occId);
                if (!occ) return;

                const title = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-title').value.trim();
                const dept = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-dept').value;
                const selectVal = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-collab-select') ? document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-collab-select').value : '';
                const inputVal = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-collab') ? document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-collab').value.trim() : '';
                const collab = (selectVal && selectVal !== '__OUTRO__') ? selectVal : inputVal;

                if (!collab) {
                    alert("Por favor, selecione ou informe o colaborador envolvido.");
                    return;
                }
                const author = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-author').value.trim();
                const severity = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-severity').value;
                const what = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-what').value.trim();
                const resolution = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-resolution').value.trim();
                const actionTaken = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-action').value.trim();
                const status = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-status').value;
                const guidance = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-guidance').value.trim();
                const decision = document.getElementById('admin-edit-occ-decision').value.trim();

                occ.title = title;
                occ.department = dept;
                occ.collaborator = collab;
                occ.authorName = author;
                occ.severity = severity;
                occ.whatHappened = what;
                occ.currentResolution = resolution;
                occ.actionTaken = actionTaken;
                occ.status = status;
                occ.updatedAt = Date.now();

                if (guidance || decision) {
                    occ.adminFeedback = {
                        adminName: auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.displayName : 'Administrador',
                        adminEmail: auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.email : 'admin@empresa.com',
                        answeredAt: Date.now(),
                        guidance: guidance,
                        recommendedDecision: decision
                    };
                }

                occApp.saveLocally();
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'OCCURRENCE_UPSERT',
                        occurrence: occ
                    });
                }

                this.renderAdminOccurrences();
                this.closeEditOccurrenceModal();
                syncManager.showToast("✓ Ocorrência atualizada com sucesso!");
            }

            editTask(id) {

                this.closePanel();
                app.openModal(task);
            }

                document.getElementById('feature-admin-only-create').checked = !!this.config.adminOnlyCreate;

            }

                this.config.allowCamera = document.getElementById('feature-allow-camera').checked;
                this.config.enablePomodoro = document.getElementById('feature-enable-pomodoro').checked;

                    window.syncManager.publish({

                    });
                }
                syncManager.showToast("✓ Configurações salvas e propagadas!");
            }

            applyFeatureConfigUI() {
                // Aplica visibilidade de Câmera
                const camSec = document.getElementById('task-image-section');
                if (camSec) {
                    if (this.config.allowCamera || (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.isAdmin)) {
                        camSec.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        camSec.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }

                // Aplica visibilidade do Pomodoro
                const pomoBtn = document.getElementById('topbar-pomo-btn');
                if (pomoBtn) {
                    if (this.config.enablePomodoro) {
                        pomoBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        pomoBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }

                // Aplica Modo Somente Leitura
                const newBtn = document.getElementById('topbar-new-task-btn');
                if (newBtn) {
                    if (this.config.adminOnlyCreate && (!auth.currentUser || !auth.currentUser.isAdmin)) {
                        newBtn.classList.add('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                    } else {
                        newBtn.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                    }
                }

                // Aplica Mural de Avisos (Fixo e com notificação)
                const banner = document.getElementById('company-announcement-banner');
                const annText = document.getElementById('announcement-text');
                const removeBtn = document.getElementById('admin-banner-remove-btn');

                if (banner && annText) {
                    if (this.config.announcement && this.config.announcement.trim()) {
                        annText.innerText = this.config.announcement;
                        banner.classList.remove('hidden');
                        if (removeBtn) {
                            if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.isAdmin) {
                                removeBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                            } else {
                                removeBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        banner.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }
            }

            viewPendingCode(email) {
                const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                const item = pendingCodes[email.toLowerCase()];
                if (item && item.code) {
                    alert(`🔑 CÓDIGO DE SEGURANÇA OTP:\n\nColaborador: ${item.name || item.displayName || email}\nE-mail: ${email}\nCódigo de 6 dígitos: ${item.code}\n\nEste código foi enviado por e-mail para o colaborador.`);
                } else {
                    alert(`Nenhum código pendente ativo registrado no momento para ${email}.\nSe necessário, clique diretamente no botão "Aprovar" para liberar o acesso.`);
                }
            }

            approveDirectlyFromPendingCode(email) {
                const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                const item = pendingCodes[email.toLowerCase()];
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');

                const newAccount = {
                    uid: 'usr_' + Date.now(),
                    displayName: item ? item.name : email.split('@')[0],
                    role: item ? item.role : 'Colaborador',
                    dept: item ? item.dept : 'Geral',
                    email: email,
                    password: item ? item.password : '123456',
                    isAdmin: false,
                    status: 'approved',
                    emailVerified: true,
                    approvedAt: Date.now(),
                    approvedBy: auth.currentUser.email
                };

                const existingIdx = accounts.findIndex(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
                if (existingIdx >= 0) {
                    accounts[existingIdx] = Object.assign(accounts[existingIdx], newAccount);
                } else {
                    accounts.push(newAccount);
                }
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));

                delete pendingCodes[email.toLowerCase()];
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_pending_codes', JSON.stringify(pendingCodes));

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE',
                        email: email,
                        status: 'approved',
                        account: newAccount
                    });
                }

                this.updatePendingBadge();
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                syncManager.showToast(`✓ Acesso de ${newAccount.displayName} APROVADO diretamente!`);
            }

            cancelPendingCode(email) {
                if (!confirm(`Deseja cancelar o pedido de cadastro de ${email}?`)) return;
                const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                delete pendingCodes[email.toLowerCase()];
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_pending_codes', JSON.stringify(pendingCodes));
                this.updatePendingBadge();
                this.renderAdminUsers();
                syncManager.showToast("Solicitação de cadastro cancelada.");
            }

            onEmailProviderChange() {
                const provSelect = document.getElementById('admin-email-provider');
                if (!provSelect) return;
                const provider = provSelect.value;
                ['resend', 'brevo', 'emailjs', 'webhook'].forEach(p => {
                    const el = document.getElementById(`email-fields-${p}`);
                    if (el) {
                        if (p === provider) el.classList.remove('hidden');
                        else el.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                });
            }

            syncEmailUI() {
                if (!window.emailService) return;
                const cfg = emailService.config;
                const provSelect = document.getElementById('admin-email-provider');
                if (provSelect) provSelect.value = cfg.provider || 'resend';

                const rKey = document.getElementById('admin-resend-key');
                if (rKey) rKey.value = cfg.resendApiKey || '';
                const rFrom = document.getElementById('admin-resend-from');
                if (rFrom) rFrom.value = cfg.resendFromEmail || 'TaskFlow <onboarding@resend.dev>';

                const bKey = document.getElementById('admin-brevo-key');
                if (bKey) bKey.value = cfg.brevoApiKey || '';
                const bSender = document.getElementById('admin-brevo-sender');
                if (bSender) bSender.value = cfg.brevoSenderEmail || '';

                const ejPub = document.getElementById('admin-emailjs-public');
                if (ejPub) ejPub.value = cfg.emailjsPublicKey || '';
                const ejSrv = document.getElementById('admin-emailjs-service');
                if (ejSrv) ejSrv.value = cfg.emailjsServiceId || '';
                const ejTpl = document.getElementById('admin-emailjs-template');
                if (ejTpl) ejTpl.value = cfg.emailjsTemplateId || '';

                const whUrl = document.getElementById('admin-webhook-url');
                if (whUrl) whUrl.value = cfg.webhookUrl || '';

                const testTarget = document.getElementById('admin-email-test-target');
                if (testTarget && auth.currentUser) {
                    testTarget.value = auth.currentUser.email;
                }

                this.onEmailProviderChange();
            }

            async testEmailSend() {
                const targetInput = document.getElementById('admin-email-test-target');
