                const resultBox = document.getElementById('admin-email-test-result');

                if (!targetEmail) {
                    alert("Digite um e-mail de destino para o teste.");
                    return;
                }

                this.saveEmailConfig();

                resultBox.className = "p-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-950 border border-indigo-500/40 text-xs text-indigo-300 flex items-center gap-2";
                resultBox.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Disparando e-mail de teste real para <strong>${targetEmail}</strong>...`;
                resultBox.classList.remove('hidden');

                const testCode = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
                const res = await emailService.sendVerificationEmail(targetEmail, "Administrador", testCode);

                if (res.success) {
                    resultBox.className = "p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/50 text-xs text-emerald-300";
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400 mt-0.5 text-base"></i>
                            <div>
                                <strong class="text-emerald-200">✅ E-mail Real Entregue com Sucesso!</strong><br>
                                Foi enviado um e-mail com o código de teste <span class="font-mono font-bold text-white">${testCode}</span> para <strong>${targetEmail}</strong> via <em>${res.provider}</em>.<br>
                                <span class="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Verifique a Caixa de Entrada ou Lixo Eletrônico do destinatário.</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                } else {
                    resultBox.className = "p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-red-950/40 border border-red-500/50 text-xs text-red-300";
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-xmark text-red-400 mt-0.5 text-base"></i>
                            <div>
                                <strong class="text-red-200">❌ Falha no Disparo do E-mail:</strong><br>
                                ${res.error || res.message || 'Verifique se a chave de API e o e-mail remetente estão corretos.'}
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. GERENCIADOR DE SINCRONIZAÇÃO EM NUVEM ROBUSTO
        class CloudSyncManager {
            constructor() {
                this.defaultChannel = 'taskflow_empresa_rondon_2026';
                this.channel = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_cloud_channel') || this.defaultChannel;
                this.eventSource = null;
                this.sessionId = 'ses_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9);
                this.pollingTimer = null;
                this.appStartTime = Date.now();
                
                // Carrega IDs já processados para impedir que mensagens históricas disparem som e notificação
                try {
                    const saved = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_processed_msg_ids');
                    this.processedMessageIds = saved ? new Set(JSON.parse(saved)) : new Set();
                } catch(e) {
                    this.processedMessageIds = new Set();
                }
            }

            saveProcessedId(id) {
                if (!id) return;
                this.processedMessageIds.add(id);
                try {
                    const arr = Array.from(this.processedMessageIds).slice(-400);
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_processed_msg_ids', JSON.stringify(arr));
                } catch(e) {}
            }

            init() {
                this.updateChannelUI();
                this.startRealtimeAndPolling();
                this.setupVisibilityListeners();
            }

            getPublishUrl() {
                return `https://ntfy.sh/${this.channel}`;
            }

            getStreamUrl() {
                return `https://ntfy.sh/${this.channel}/sse`;
            }

            getPollUrl() {
                return `https://ntfy.sh/${this.channel}/json?poll=1&since=all`;
            }

            startRealtimeAndPolling() {
                // 1. Busca inicial completa de tudo que está na nuvem (silenciosa)
                this.fetchFullCloudState(true);

                // 2. Conecta ao stream SSE em tempo real
                this.connectSSE();

                // 3. Polling em segundo plano a cada 3.5 segundos
                if (this.pollingTimer) clearInterval(this.pollingTimer);
                this.pollingTimer = setInterval(() => {
                    this.fetchFullCloudState(false);
                }, 3500);
            }

            connectSSE() {
                if (this.eventSource) {
                    try { this.eventSource.close(); } catch(e) {}
                }

                try {
                    this.eventSource = new EventSource(this.getStreamUrl());

                    this.eventSource.onopen = () => {
                        this.updateStatusUI(true);
                    };

                    this.eventSource.onmessage = async (event) => {
                        try {
                            const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                            if (data.event === 'message' && data.id) {
                                if (this.processedMessageIds.has(data.id)) return;
                                this.saveProcessedId(data.id);
                                const payload = await this.extractPayload(data);
                                if (payload) {
                                    // Apenas notifica se for evento recente (< 45s) e se o app já tiver iniciado
                                    const isRecent = payload.timestamp ? (Date.now() - payload.timestamp < 45000) : false;
                                    const isAfterStartup = (Date.now() - this.appStartTime > 3500);
                                    const shouldNotify = isRecent && isAfterStartup;
                                    this.handleIncomingAction(payload, shouldNotify);
                                }
                            }
                        } catch(err) {}
                    };

                    this.eventSource.onerror = () => {
                        this.updateStatusUI(false);
                    };
                } catch(e) {
                    this.updateStatusUI(false);
                }
            }

            async extractPayload(data) {
                if (!data) return null;
                // Se a mensagem ultrapassa 4KB (ex: tarefas com foto), o ntfy armazena o JSON em anexo
                if (data.attachment && data.attachment.url) {
                    try {
                        const fileRes = await fetch(data.attachment.url);
                        if (fileRes.ok) {
                            return await fileRes.json();
                        }
                    } catch(e) {
                        console.warn("Erro ao baixar anexo da nuvem:", e);
                    }
                }
                // Se veio inline no corpo da mensagem
                if (data.message) {
                    try {
                        return JSON.parse(data.message);
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
                return null;
            }

            async fetchFullCloudState(isFirstLoad = false) {
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(this.getPollUrl());
                    if (!res.ok) return;
                    const text = await res.text();
                    const lines = text.trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);

                    let hasNew = false;
                    for (const line of lines) {
                        try {
                            const data = JSON.parse(line);
                            if (data.event === 'message' && data.id) {
                                if (!this.processedMessageIds.has(data.id)) {
                                    this.saveProcessedId(data.id);
                                    const payload = await this.extractPayload(data);
                                    if (payload) {
                                        // Apenas notifica se não for carga inicial/retorno, for recente (< 45s) e pós-startup
                                        const isRecent = payload.timestamp ? (Date.now() - payload.timestamp < 45000) : false;
                                        const isAfterStartup = (Date.now() - this.appStartTime > 3500);
                                        const shouldNotify = !isFirstLoad && isRecent && isAfterStartup;
                                        this.handleIncomingAction(payload, shouldNotify);
                                        hasNew = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } catch(e) {}
                    }
                    this.updateStatusUI(true);
                    if (hasNew && window.app) app.render();
                } catch(err) {
                    this.updateStatusUI(false);
                }
            }

            async forceSyncNow() {
                const icon = document.getElementById('btn-sync-icon');
                if (icon) icon.classList.add('fa-spin');
                this.showToast("Sincronizando com a nuvem...");
                await this.fetchFullCloudState(false);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (icon) icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
                    this.showToast("✓ Sincronizado com a equipe!");
                }, 800);
            }

            async publish(actionData) {
                actionData.sessionId = this.sessionId;
                actionData.timestamp = Date.now();

                // Garante que se tiver foto na tarefa, ela esteja comprimida e otimizada
                if (actionData.task && actionData.task.image && actionData.task.image.length > 50000 && window.app && window.app.compressImage) {
                    try {
                        actionData.task.image = await window.app.compressImage(actionData.task.image, 640, 0.65);
                    } catch(e) {}
                }

                try {
                    this.showToast("Enviando para a equipe...");
                    const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(actionData);
                    const headers = {};
                    if (payloadStr.length > 3500) {
                        headers['Filename'] = 'payload.json';
                    }
                    await fetch(this.getPublishUrl(), {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: headers,
                        body: payloadStr
                    });
                    this.showToast("✓ Atualizado na nuvem!");
                } catch(err) {
                    this.showToast("Salvo localmente (offline)");
                }
            }

            handleIncomingAction(payload, notify = true) {
                if (!payload || !payload.type) return;

                // Se o usuário estiver deslogado, NUNCA dispara som, notificação ou toast de tarefas
                if (!window.auth || !auth.currentUser) {
                    notify = false;
                }

                // Ignora ação se veio da mesma aba/sessão que acabou de enviar
                if (payload.sessionId && payload.sessionId === this.sessionId) return;

                // Se a mensagem for anterior ao início da sessão ou tiver mais de 45 segundos, NUNCA dispara som/notificação
                if (payload.timestamp && (Date.now() - payload.timestamp > 45000)) {
                    notify = false;
                }
                if (Date.now() - this.appStartTime < 3500) {
                    notify = false;
                }

                if (payload.type === 'TASK_UPSERT' && payload.task) {
                    if (window.app) {
                        app.applyRemoteTask(payload.task);
                        if (notify) {
                            app.playNotificationSound();
                            const actionLabel = payload.task.completed ? "concluiu a tarefa" : "adicionou a tarefa";
                            const notifTitle = `TaskFlow - ${payload.task.authorName || 'Equipe'}`;
                            const notifBody = `${payload.task.authorName || 'Colaborador'} ${actionLabel}: "${payload.task.title}"`;
                            app.dispatchNotification(notifTitle, notifBody);
                            this.showToast(`🔔 ${payload.task.authorName || 'Equipe'}: "${payload.task.title}"`);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'TASK_DELETE') {
                    if (window.app) {
                        app.applyRemoteDelete(payload.taskId);
                        if (notify) {
                            app.dispatchNotification("TaskFlow - Equipe", "Uma tarefa foi excluída na nuvem");
                            this.showToast("🗑️ Tarefa removida na nuvem");
                        }
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'ACCOUNT_REGISTER') {
                    if (window.auth) {
                        auth.applyRemoteAccount(payload.account);
                        if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.isAdmin) {
                            if (notify) {
                                app.playNotificationSound();
                                app.dispatchNotification("TaskFlow - Nova Solicitação", `Novo colaborador aguardando aprovação: ${payload.account.displayName}`);
                                this.showToast(`🛡️ Novo cadastro pendente: ${payload.account.displayName}`);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_UPDATE') {
                    if (window.auth) {
                        auth.applyRemoteAccount(payload.account);
                        // Se for a conta do próprio usuário logado:
                        if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email.toLowerCase() === payload.email.toLowerCase()) {
                            const previousStatus = auth.currentUser.status;
                            auth.currentUser.status = payload.status;
                            if (payload.account && payload.account.canAccessOccurrences !== undefined) {
                                auth.currentUser.canAccessOccurrences = payload.account.canAccessOccurrences;
                                auth.applyPermissionsUI();
                            }
                            localStorage.setItem('taskflow_current_user', JSON.stringify(auth.currentUser));

                            // Só notifica se a conta estava PENDENTE e acabou de ser aprovada nesta sessão
                            if (previousStatus === 'pending' && payload.status === 'approved') {
                                const notifKey = 'taskflow_notified_approval_' + payload.email.toLowerCase();
                                if (!sessionStorage.getItem(notifKey)) {
                                    sessionStorage.setItem(notifKey, 'true');
                                    if (window.app) app.playTaskCompleteSound();
                                    this.showToast("🎉 Sua conta foi APROVADA pelo Administrador!");
                                    const authScreen = document.getElementById('auth-screen');
                                    if (authScreen && !authScreen.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                                        auth.onLoginSuccess();
                                    }
                                }
                            } else if (payload.status === 'blocked' || payload.status === 'rejected') {
                                this.showToast("Sua conta foi suspensa pelo Administrador.");
                                auth.logout();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'ACCOUNT_DELETE') {
                    if (window.auth) {
                        let accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                        accounts = accounts.filter(a => a.email.toLowerCase() !== payload.email.toLowerCase());
                        localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                        auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                        if (window.admin) admin.renderAdminUsers();
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'PENDING_REGISTRATION_CODE' && payload.pending) {
                    const pendingCodes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_pending_codes') || '{}');
                    pendingCodes[payload.pending.email.toLowerCase()] = payload.pending;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_pending_codes', JSON.stringify(pendingCodes));

                    if (window.admin && auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.isAdmin) {
                        admin.updatePendingBadge();
                        admin.renderAdminUsers();
                        if (notify) {
                            app.playNotificationSound();
                            app.dispatchNotification("TaskFlow - Novo Código de E-mail", `Código gerado para ${payload.pending.displayName || payload.pending.name}`);
                            this.showToast(`✉️ Novo código gerado para ${payload.pending.email}`);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'OCCURRENCE_UPSERT' && payload.occurrence) {
                    if (window.occApp) {
                        occApp.applyRemoteOccurrence(payload.occurrence);
                        if (notify) {
                            if (window.app) app.playNotificationSound();
                            const notifTitle = `TaskFlow - Ocorrência / Processo`;
                            const notifBody = `${payload.occurrence.authorName || 'Líder'} relatou: "${payload.occurrence.title}" (${payload.occurrence.department})`;
                            app.dispatchNotification(notifTitle, notifBody);
                            this.showToast(`📋 ${payload.occurrence.title} (${payload.occurrence.department})`);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'OCCURRENCE_REPLY' && payload.occurrence) {
                    if (window.occApp) {
                        occApp.applyRemoteOccurrence(payload.occurrence);
                        if (notify) {
                            if (window.app) app.playAnnouncementAlertSound();
                            const notifTitle = `TaskFlow - Orientação do Administrador`;
                            const notifBody = `O Administrador orientou a ocorrência: "${payload.occurrence.title}"`;
                            app.dispatchNotification(notifTitle, notifBody);
                            this.showToast(`🛡️ Orientação do ADM: "${payload.occurrence.title}"`);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'OCCURRENCE_DELETE') {
                    if (window.occApp) {
                        occApp.applyRemoteDelete(payload.occurrenceId);
                    }
                }

                
                if (payload.type === 'USER_SCHEDULE_PERMISSION_UPDATE' && payload.email) {
                    let accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                    const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === payload.email.toLowerCase());
                    if (acc) {
                        acc.canEditSchedule = payload.canEditSchedule;
                        localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                    }
                    if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email.toLowerCase() === payload.email.toLowerCase()) {
                        auth.currentUser.canEditSchedule = payload.canEditSchedule;
                        localStorage.setItem('taskflow_user', JSON.stringify(auth.currentUser));
                    }
                    if (window.scheduleApp) scheduleApp.render();
                    if (window.admin) admin.renderAdminUsers();
                }

                if (payload.type === 'SCHEDULE_CONFIG_UPDATE' && payload.webAppUrl) {
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_webapp_url', payload.webAppUrl);
                    if (window.scheduleApp) {
                        scheduleApp.webAppUrl = payload.webAppUrl;
                        scheduleApp.updateSyncStatus();
                        scheduleApp.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                    }
                }

                if (payload.type === 'SCHEDULE_SHEET_EDIT') {
                    console.log('[CloudSync] Recebida notificação de edição direta no Google Sheets!');
                    if (window.scheduleApp) {
                        scheduleApp.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                    }
                }

                if (payload.type === 'SCHEDULE_SLOT_UPDATE' && payload.dia && payload.linha) {
                    if (window.scheduleApp && scheduleApp.data && scheduleApp.data.dias && scheduleApp.data.dias[payload.dia]) {
                        const slots = scheduleApp.data.dias[payload.dia].slots || [];
                        const slot = slots.find(s => s.linha === payload.linha);
                        if (slot) {
                            slot.nome = payload.nome;
                            slot.isVago = (!payload.nome || payload.nome.toUpperCase() === 'X');
                            slot.corFundo = slot.isVago ? '#ea4335' : '';
                            localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_data', JSON.stringify(scheduleApp.data));
                            scheduleApp.render();
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (payload.type === 'SCHEDULE_CELL_UPDATE' && payload.dia && payload.linha && window.scheduleApp) {
                    const sApp = window.scheduleApp;
                    const slotC = sApp.findSlot(payload.dia, payload.linha);
                    if (slotC) {
                        if (payload.linhaAtualizada) {
                            sApp.applyLinhaAtualizada(payload.dia, payload.linha, payload.linhaAtualizada, false);
                        } else if (payload.campo) {
                            slotC[payload.campo] = payload.valor;
                            slotC.saida = sApp.computeSaida(slotC, payload.dia);
                            localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_data', JSON.stringify(sApp.data));
                            sApp.refreshRowDom(payload.dia, payload.linha);
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (payload.type === 'INCONSISTENCY_ADD' && payload.inconsistency) {
                    let list = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_inconsistencies') || '[]');
                    list = list.filter(item => item.id !== payload.inconsistency.id);
                    list.unshift(payload.inconsistency);
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_inconsistencies', JSON.stringify(list));
                    if (notify && auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.isAdmin) {
                        this.showToast(`⚠️ Inconsistência registrada: ${payload.inconsistency.reason}`);
                    }
                    if (window.admin && admin.currentTab === 'reports') {
                        admin.generateMonthlyReport();
                    }
                }

                if (payload.type === 'TASK_COMMENT_ADD' && payload.taskId && payload.comment) {
                    if (window.app) {
                        const task = app.tasks.find(t => t.id == payload.taskId);
                        if (task) {
                            if (!task.comments) task.comments = [];
                            const exists = task.comments.some(c => c.id === payload.comment.id);
                            if (!exists) {
                                task.comments.push(payload.comment);
                                if (payload.comment.image) {
                                    if (!task.images) task.images = [];
                                    if (!task.images.includes(payload.comment.image)) {
                                        task.images.push(payload.comment.image);
                                    }
                                }
                                task.updatedAt = Date.now();
                                app.saveLocally();
                                app.render(); // Atualiza contador na lista de tarefas em tempo real
                            }
                        }

                        // Se o modal de chat estiver aberto nesta tarefa, atualiza o feed ao vivo
                        if (app.currentChatTaskId == payload.taskId) {
                            app.renderTaskChat();
                        }

                        // Notifica se o usuário atual foi mencionado, é o criador, é o responsável ou administrador
                        if (notify && auth.currentUser) {
                            const myName = (auth.currentUser.displayName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                            const myEmail = (auth.currentUser.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                            const isMentioned = (payload.comment.mentions || []).some(m => String(m).toLowerCase().trim() === myName);
                            const isCreator = (payload.taskAuthorEmail && payload.taskAuthorEmail.toLowerCase() === myEmail);
                            const isAssignee = (payload.taskAssignee && payload.taskAssignee.toLowerCase().includes(myName));
                            const isAdmin = !!auth.currentUser.isAdmin;

                            if (isMentioned || isCreator || isAssignee || isAdmin) {
                                try { app.playNotificationSound(); } catch(e) {}
                                const notifTitle = isMentioned ? `TaskFlow - @Menção de ${payload.comment.authorName}` : `TaskFlow - Mensagem na Tarefa`;
                                const notifBody = `${payload.comment.authorName}: "${payload.comment.text}" (${payload.taskTitle || 'Tarefa'})`;
                                try { app.dispatchNotification(notifTitle, notifBody); } catch(e) {}
                                this.showToast(`💬 ${payload.comment.authorName}: "${payload.comment.text}"`);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (payload.type === 'FEEDBACK_UPSERT' && payload.feedback) {
                    if (window.feedbackApp) {
                        feedbackApp.handleIncomingFeedback(payload.feedback);
                        if (notify) syncManager.showToast(`💬 Feedback de ${payload.feedback.collaboratorName} atualizado na equipe`);
                    }
                }
                if (payload.type === 'FEEDBACK_DELETE' && payload.feedbackId) {
                    if (window.feedbackApp) {
                        feedbackApp.handleIncomingFeedbackDelete(payload.feedbackId);
                    }
                }
                if (payload.type === 'FEEDBACK_TEMPLATES_UPDATE' && payload.templates) {
                    if (window.feedbackApp) {
                        feedbackApp.handleIncomingTemplates(payload.templates);
                        if (notify) syncManager.showToast('⚙️ Diretrizes de feedback atualizadas pela Administração');
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'PASSWORD_CHANGED') {
                    // Atualiza a conta com a nova senha localmente
                    let accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                    const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === payload.email.toLowerCase());
                    if (acc) {
                        acc.password = payload.newPassword;
                        acc.lastPasswordChangedAt = payload.timestamp || Date.now();
                        if (!acc.passwordHistory) acc.passwordHistory = [];
                        acc.passwordHistory.unshift({
                            password: payload.newPassword,
                            changedAt: payload.timestamp || Date.now(),
                            changedBy: payload.displayName || 'Colaborador'
                        });
                        localStorage.setItem('taskflow_accounts', JSON.stringify(accounts));
                    }

                    // Se for o administrador conectado, toca alerta e notifica com a senha!
                    if (auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.isAdmin) {
                        if (notify) {
                            if (window.app) app.playAnnouncementAlertSound();
                            const notifTitle = "🔐 Senha Alterada por Colaborador";
                            const notifBody = `${payload.displayName} alterou a senha para: "${payload.newPassword}"`;
                            if (window.app) app.dispatchNotification(notifTitle, notifBody);
                            this.showToast(`🔐 ${payload.displayName} alterou a senha para: ${payload.newPassword}`);
                        }
                        if (window.admin) {
                            admin.renderAdminUsers();
                            if (admin.currentTab === 'audit') {
                                admin.renderUserAudit(payload.email);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (payload.type === 'APP_CONFIG_UPDATE') {
                    if (window.admin && payload.config) {
                        admin.config = Object.assign(admin.config, payload.config);
                        if (payload.config.customRoles) {
                            localStorage.setItem('taskflow_custom_roles', JSON.stringify(payload.config.customRoles));
                            admin.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                            if (admin.renderRolesAndDepts) admin.renderRolesAndDepts();
                        }
                        if (payload.config.customDepartments) {
                            localStorage.setItem('taskflow_custom_departments', JSON.stringify(payload.config.customDepartments));
                            admin.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
                            if (admin.renderRolesAndDepts) admin.renderRolesAndDepts();
                        }
                        localStorage.setItem('taskflow_app_config', JSON.stringify(admin.config));
                        admin.applyFeatureConfigUI();
                        if (payload.config.announcement) {
                            if (notify && window.app) {
                                app.playAnnouncementAlertSound();
                                app.dispatchNotification("📢 COMUNICADO OFICIAL DA ADMINISTRAÇÃO", payload.config.announcement);
                            }
                            this.showToast(`📢 COMUNICADO: ${payload.config.announcement}`);
                        }
                    }
                    if (window.emailService && payload.emailConfig) {
                        emailService.config = Object.assign(emailService.config, payload.emailConfig);
                        localStorage.setItem('taskflow_email_config', JSON.stringify(emailService.config));
                        if (window.admin) admin.syncEmailUI();
                    }
                }
            }

            setupVisibilityListeners() {
                document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
                    if (!document.hidden) {
                        // Sincronização silenciosa ao reabrir ou voltar para o app
                        this.fetchFullCloudState(true);
                    }
                });
                window.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                    // Sincronização silenciosa ao focar
                    this.fetchFullCloudState(true);
                });

                window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'taskflow_work_tasks' && window.app) {
                        window.app.tasks = JSON.parse(e.newValue || '[]');
                        window.app.render();
                    }
                    if (e.key === 'taskflow_accounts' && window.auth) {
                        auth.updateCollaboratorsList();
                        if (window.admin) {
                            admin.updatePendingBadge();
                            admin.renderAdminUsers();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            showToast(msg) {
                // Se deslogado, oculta toasts na tela de login exceto conexão inicial
                if ((!window.auth || !auth.currentUser) && !msg.startsWith('✓ Conectado')) return;
                const toast = document.getElementById('sync-toast');
                const text = document.getElementById('sync-toast-text');
                if (toast && text) {
                    text.innerText = msg;
                    toast.classList.remove('-translate-y-12', 'opacity-0');
                    clearTimeout(this.toastTimer);
                    this.toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                        toast.classList.add('-translate-y-12', 'opacity-0');
                    }, 2500);
                }
            }

            updateStatusUI(isOnline) {
                const text = document.getElementById('sync-status-text');
                const dot = document.getElementById('sync-pulse-dot');
                if (text && dot) {
                    if (isOnline) {
                        text.innerText = "Nuvem Sincronizada";
                        dot.className = "w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse";
                    } else {
                        text.innerText = "Reconectando...";
                        dot.className = "w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-ping";
                    }
                }
            }

            updateChannelUI() {
                const label = document.getElementById('sidebar-channel-label');
                if (label) label.innerText = this.channel.replace('taskflow_', '');
            }

            openChannelModal() {
                const m = document.getElementById('channel-modal');
                const inp = document.getElementById('input-channel-code');
                if (inp) inp.value = this.channel;
                if (m) {
                    m.classList.remove('hidden');
                    m.style.display = 'flex';
                }
            }

            closeChannelModal() {
                const m = document.getElementById('channel-modal');
                if (m) {
                    m.classList.add('hidden');
                    m.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            saveCustomChannel() {
                const val = document.getElementById('input-channel-code').value.trim();
                if (val) {
                    this.channel = val;
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_cloud_channel', val);
                    this.updateChannelUI();
                    this.startRealtimeAndPolling();
                    this.showToast(`Conectado ao canal ${val}`);
                }
                this.closeChannelModal();
            }
        }
