        // ==========================================
        window.emailService = new EmailService();
        window.app = new TaskApp();
        window.auth = new AuthManager();
        window.admin = new AdminManager();
        window.syncManager = new CloudSyncManager();

        var emailService = window.emailService;
        var app = window.app;
        var auth = window.auth;
        var admin = window.admin;
        var syncManager = window.syncManager;

        // Inicia componentes
        window.occApp = new OccurrenceApp();
        window.feedbackApp = new FeedbackApp();
        window.app.init();
        window.auth.init();
        window.occApp.init();
        window.feedbackApp.init();
        if (window.admin) window.admin.populateRoleAndDeptSelects();
        window.syncManager.init();

        // ==========================================
        // CONTROLE DO BOTÃO VOLTAR DO ANDROID (HARDWARE / GESTO)
        // ==========================================
        window.handleAndroidBackPressed = function() {

            // Fecha modal de aplicação de feedback
            const fbApplyModal = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-apply');
            if (fbApplyModal && !fbApplyModal.classList.contains('hidden') && fbApplyModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.feedbackApp) feedbackApp.closeNewFeedbackModal();
                return true;
            }

            // Fecha modal de detalhe/impressão de feedback
            const fbDetailModal = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-detail');
            if (fbDetailModal && !fbDetailModal.classList.contains('hidden') && fbDetailModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.feedbackApp) feedbackApp.closeDetailModal();
                return;
            }

            // Fecha modal de editar tópico de feedback
            const fbCatModal = document.getElementById('modal-feedback-edit-category');
            if (fbCatModal && !fbCatModal.classList.contains('hidden') && fbCatModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.feedbackApp) feedbackApp.closeCategoryModal();
                return;
            }

            // 1. Fecha modal unificado de Visualizar Tarefa (fotos + chat)
            const viewTaskModal = document.getElementById('modal-view-task');
            if (viewTaskModal && !viewTaskModal.classList.contains('hidden') && viewTaskModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.app && typeof window.app.closeViewTaskModal === 'function') {
                    window.app.closeViewTaskModal();
                } else {
                    viewTaskModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    viewTaskModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 2. Fecha modal de câmera se estiver aberto
            const cameraModal = document.getElementById('camera-modal');
            if (cameraModal && !cameraModal.classList.contains('hidden') && cameraModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.app && typeof window.app.closeCamera === 'function') {
                    window.app.closeCamera();
                } else {
                    cameraModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    cameraModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 3. Modais de ocorrências
            const occModal = document.getElementById('modal-occurrence');
            if (occModal && !occModal.classList.contains('hidden') && occModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.occApp && typeof window.occApp.closeNewModal === 'function') {
                    window.occApp.closeNewModal();
                } else {
                    occModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    occModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            const replyModal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-reply');
            if (replyModal && !replyModal.classList.contains('hidden') && replyModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.occApp && typeof window.occApp.closeAdminReplyModal === 'function') {
                    window.occApp.closeAdminReplyModal();
                } else {
                    replyModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    replyModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 3.5. Modal de Chat Dedicado da Tarefa
            const chatTaskModal = document.getElementById('task-view-modal');
            if (chatTaskModal && !chatTaskModal.classList.contains('hidden') && chatTaskModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.app && typeof window.app.closeViewTaskModal === 'function') {
                    window.app.closeViewTaskModal();
                } else {
                    chatTaskModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    chatTaskModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 4. Modal de criação/edição de tarefas
            const taskModal = document.getElementById('task-modal');
            if (taskModal && !taskModal.classList.contains('hidden') && taskModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.app && typeof window.app.closeModal === 'function') {
                    window.app.closeModal();
                } else {
                    taskModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    taskModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 5. Modal de canal de sincronização
            const channelModal = document.getElementById('channel-modal');
            if (channelModal && !channelModal.classList.contains('hidden') && channelModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.syncManager && typeof window.syncManager.closeChannelModal === 'function') {
                    window.syncManager.closeChannelModal();
                } else {
                    channelModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    channelModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 6. Modal de configurações / alteração de senha
            const accSettingsModal = document.getElementById('modal-account-settings');
            if (accSettingsModal && !accSettingsModal.classList.contains('hidden') && accSettingsModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.auth && typeof window.auth.closeSettingsModal === 'function') {
                    window.auth.closeSettingsModal();
                } else {
                    accSettingsModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    accSettingsModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 7. Modal de criação de usuário pelo admin
            const adminCreateUserModal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-create-user');
            if (adminCreateUserModal && !adminCreateUserModal.classList.contains('hidden') && adminCreateUserModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.admin && typeof window.admin.closeCreateUserModal === 'function') {
                    window.admin.closeCreateUserModal();
                } else {
                    adminCreateUserModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    adminCreateUserModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // Modal de edição de usuário pelo admin
            const adminEditUserModal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-edit-user');
            if (adminEditUserModal && !adminEditUserModal.classList.contains('hidden') && adminEditUserModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.admin && typeof window.admin.closeEditUserModal === 'function') {
                    window.admin.closeEditUserModal();
                } else {
                    adminEditUserModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    adminEditUserModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // Modal de edição de ocorrência pelo admin
            const adminEditOccModal = document.getElementById('modal-admin-edit-occurrence');
            if (adminEditOccModal && !adminEditOccModal.classList.contains('hidden') && adminEditOccModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.admin && typeof window.admin.closeEditOccurrenceModal === 'function') {
                    window.admin.closeEditOccurrenceModal();
                } else {
                    adminEditOccModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    adminEditOccModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }


            // 8. Modal do painel administrativo
            const adminModal = document.getElementById('admin-modal');
            if (adminModal && !adminModal.classList.contains('hidden') && adminModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.admin && typeof window.admin.closeAdminModal === 'function') {
                    window.admin.closeAdminModal();
                } else {
                    adminModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    adminModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 9. Modal Pomodoro
            const pomoModal = document.getElementById('pomodoro-modal');
            if (pomoModal && !pomoModal.classList.contains('hidden') && pomoModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (window.app && typeof window.app.closePomodoro === 'function') {
                    window.app.closePomodoro();
                } else {
                    pomoModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    pomoModal.style.display = 'none';
                }
                return true;
            }

            // 10. Se estiver na visualização de Ocorrências e não houver modais abertos, volta para Tarefas (tela inicial)
            if (window.currentMainView === 'occurrences') {
                if (typeof window.switchMainView === 'function') {
                    window.switchMainView('tasks');
                    return true;
                }
            }

            // Se estiver na tela inicial padrão de Tarefas e sem nenhum modal, retorna false para permitir o fechamento/minimização normal do aplicativo
            return false;
        };

        window.addEventListener('popstate', function(e) {
            window.handleAndroidBackPressed();
        });

        // ==========================================
        // NAVEGAÇÃO DE FOTOS POR TECLADO E GESTO SWIPE MOBILE
        // ==========================================
        window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            const viewModal = document.getElementById('modal-view-task');
            if (viewModal && !viewModal.classList.contains('hidden') && viewModal.style.display !== 'none') {
                if (e.target && e.target.id === 'task-chat-input') {
                    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                        if (window.app) window.app.closeViewTaskModal();
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
                    if (window.app) window.app.prevGalleryImage();
                } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                    if (window.app) window.app.nextGalleryImage();
                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    if (window.app) window.app.closeViewTaskModal();
                }
            }
        });

        (function setupGalleryTouchSwipe() {
            let touchStartX = 0;
            let touchEndX = 0;
            const container = document.getElementById('view-task-photos-container');
            if (!container) return;

            container.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]) {
                    touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
                }
            }, { passive: true });

            container.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]) {
                    touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
                    const diff = touchEndX - touchStartX;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 40) {
                        if (diff < 0 && window.app) {
                            window.app.nextGalleryImage();
                        } else if (diff > 0 && window.app) {
                            window.app.prevGalleryImage();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        })();
    

// =========================================================================
        // MÓDULO: ESCALA DIÁRIA & TURNOS (SINCRONIZAÇÃO BIDIRECIONAL GOOGLE SHEETS)
        // =========================================================================
        class ScheduleApp {
            toggleFolgasCollapse() {
                this.folgasCollapsed = !this.folgasCollapsed;
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_folgas_collapsed', this.folgasCollapsed ? 'true' : 'false');
                this.applyFolgasCollapseState();
            }

            applyFolgasCollapseState() {
                const body = document.getElementById('schedule-absences-body');
                const icon = document.getElementById('icon-toggle-folgas');
                const text = document.getElementById('text-toggle-folgas');
                const btn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-folgas-collapse');
                const card = document.getElementById('schedule-absences-card');

                if (this.folgasCollapsed) {
                    if (body) body.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (icon) icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-chevron-down text-amber-400 text-xs';
                    if (text) text.innerText = 'Expandir Quadro';
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.classList.add('bg-amber-950/40', 'border-amber-600/60', 'text-amber-200');
                        btn.classList.remove('bg-gray-900', 'border-gray-700/70', 'text-gray-200');
                    }
                    if (card) card.classList.remove('space-y-4');
                } else {
                    if (body) body.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (icon) icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-chevron-up text-amber-400 text-xs';
                    if (text) text.innerText = 'Minimizar';
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.classList.remove('bg-amber-950/40', 'border-amber-600/60', 'text-amber-200');
                        btn.classList.add('bg-gray-900', 'border-gray-700/70', 'text-gray-200');
                    }
                    if (card) card.classList.add('space-y-4');
                }
            }

            canUserEdit() {
                if (!auth.currentUser) return false;
                const email = String(auth.currentUser.email || '').toLowerCase();

                // 1. Administrador sempre pode editar
                if (auth.currentUser.isAdmin || ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(email)) return true;

                // 2. Permissão direta no currentUser
                if (auth.currentUser.canEditSchedule === true) return true;

                // 3. Permissão salva nas contas
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => a.email.toLowerCase() === email);
                if (acc && acc.canEditSchedule === true) return true;

                return false;
            }

            constructor() {
                this.defaultOfficialUrl = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzlmXyjnVs5uH41a_9bddnNfIn-M2KMU4arwHreAlRkB0DFw3ziMLeR5MOVRarQy_4r/exec';
                this.defaultSheetId = '1rGd_XLaMLsI6dwpped3eyB5IGidepyQPWw_kwzpWIzY';
                const savedUrl = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_webapp_url');
                this.webAppUrl = (savedUrl && savedUrl.trim() !== '') ? savedUrl.trim() : this.defaultOfficialUrl;
                this.sheetId = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_sheet_id') || this.defaultSheetId;
                if (!savedUrl || savedUrl.trim() === '') {
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_webapp_url', this.defaultOfficialUrl);
                }
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_sheet_id', this.sheetId);
                this.currentDay = this.getTodayDayName();
                const savedViewMode = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_view_mode');
                this.viewMode = savedViewMode || (window.innerWidth < 768 ? 'cards' : 'table');
                this.currentFilter = 'all';
                this.currentDeptFilter = 'all';
                this.folgasCollapsed = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_folgas_collapsed') === 'true';
                this.searchQuery = '';
                this.isSyncing = false;
                this.showFolgas = (localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_show_folgas') === 'true');
                this.folgasFilterQuery = '';
                this.periodMode = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_period_mode') || 'weekly'; // 'weekly' ou 'monthly'
                this.selectedMonthYear = this.getDefaultMonthYear(); // '10/2026', '11/2026', etc.
                this.monthlyData = null;
                this.currentMonthlyDay = 26;
                this.data = this.loadInitialData();
            }

            getTodayDayName() {
                const dayIndex = new Date().getDay();
                const map = ['Domingo', 'Segunda', 'Terça', 'Quarta', 'Quinta', 'Sexta', 'Sábado'];
                return map[dayIndex] || 'Segunda';
            }

            loadInitialData() {
                const cached = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_schedule_data');
                if (cached) {
                    try {
                        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
                        let hasTimes = false;
                        if (parsed && parsed.dias) {
                            for (let d in parsed.dias) {
                                if (parsed.dias[d].slots && parsed.dias[d].slots.some(s => s.entrada && s.entrada.trim() !== '')) {
                                    hasTimes = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (hasTimes) return parsed;
                    } catch (e) {}
                }

                // Dispara sincronização direta da planilha imediatamente
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (window.scheduleApp) scheduleApp.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                }, 100);

                // Modelo inicial completo baseado na estrutura real da planilha
                const diasNomes = ['Segunda', 'Terça', 'Quarta', 'Quinta', 'Sexta', 'Sábado', 'Domingo'];
                const diasObj = {};

                const turnosPadrao = [
                    '07:00 às 15:20', '08:00 às 16:20', '08:00 às 16:20', '09:00 às 17:20',
                    '10:00 às 18:20', '11:00 às 19:20', '12:00 às 20:20', '13:00 às 21:20',
                    '13:40 às 22:00', '13:40 às 22:00', '14:00 às 22:20', 'Fechamento Geral'
                ];

                const colaboradoresMock = [
                    'CARLOS SILVA', 'MARCOS SOUZA', 'ANA PAULA', 'FERNANDO DIAS',
                    'JULIANA COSTA', 'RODRIGO LIMA', 'BEATRIZ MENDES', 'LUCAS PEREIRA',
                    'GABRIEL ROCHA', 'CAMILA SANTOS', 'FELIPE ALVES', 'PATRICIA RAMOS'
                ];

                diasNomes.forEach((d, idx) => {
                    const slots = [];
                    const isSunday = (d === 'Domingo');
                    const startRow = isSunday ? 19 : 18;
                    const endRow = isSunday ? 32 : 36;

                    for (let r = startRow; r <= endRow; r++) {
                        const slotIdx = r - startRow;
                        const isVacant = (slotIdx === 3 || slotIdx === 7);
                        slots.push({
                            linha: r,
                            colunaLetra: isSunday ? 'BE' : 'C',
                            nome: isVacant ? '' : (colaboradoresMock[slotIdx % colaboradoresMock.length] || 'COLABORADOR ' + r),
                            horario: isSunday ? ('CORREDOR ' + (slotIdx + 1)) : (turnosPadrao[slotIdx % turnosPadrao.length] || '08:00 às 16:20'),
                            isVago: isVacant,
                            corFundo: isVacant ? '#ea4335' : ''
                        });
                    }

                    diasObj[d] = {
                        diaSemana: d,
                        data: getLocalTodayString().split('-').reverse().join('/'),
                        slots: slots,
                        ausencias: (idx % 2 === 0) ? ['MARIA EDUARDA (Folga)', 'ROBERTO COSTA (Atestado)'] : ['JULIO CESAR (Folga)']
                    };
                });

                return {
                    dias: diasObj,
                    colaboradores: colaboradoresMock.map((m, i) => ({
                        nome: m,
                        escala: (i % 2 === 0) ? 'AZUL' : 'VERMELHA',
                        folga: diasNomes[(i + 2) % 7],
                        cracha: '10' + (i + 1),
                        departamento: 'GERAL'
                    })),
                    atualizadoEm: 'Dados Locais'
                };
            }

            init() {
                this.updateSyncStatus();
                this.render();
                if (this.webAppUrl) {
                    this.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                }
                this.startAutoSync();
            }

            startAutoSync() {
                if (this.autoSyncTimer) clearInterval(this.autoSyncTimer);

                // Sincronização contínua inteligente em segundo plano
                // Verifica a planilha a cada 6s na aba da escala e a cada 15s em segundo plano
                this.autoSyncTimer = setInterval(() => {
                    if (document.hidden) return; // Economiza bateria/dados se tela bloqueada
                    const isScheduleActive = (window.currentMainView === 'schedule');
                    const intervalPassed = isScheduleActive ? 6000 : 15000;

                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (!this.lastAutoSyncTime || (now - this.lastAutoSyncTime >= intervalPassed)) {
                        this.lastAutoSyncTime = now;
                        this.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                    }
                }, 3000);

                // DISPARO IMEDIATO AO VOLTAR PARA O APP (troca de aba, volta do Google Drive, desbloqueio)
                document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
                    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                        console.log('[Schedule] App voltou ao foco: sincronizando escala imediatamente...');
                        this.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                    }
                });
                window.addEventListener('focus', () => {
                    this.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                });
            }

            updateSyncStatus() {
                const pill = document.getElementById('schedule-sync-pill');
                const pillText = document.getElementById('schedule-sync-pill-text');
                const unconfigAlert = document.getElementById('schedule-unconfigured-alert');
                const lastSyncText = document.getElementById('schedule-last-sync-text');

                if (!this.webAppUrl) {
                    if (pill) {
                        pill.className = "text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-950 border border-amber-800 text-amber-300 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1";
                        if (pillText) pillText.innerText = "Modo Demonstração (Sem URL)";
                    }
                    if (unconfigAlert) unconfigAlert.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (lastSyncText) lastSyncText.innerText = "Planilha não conectada. Configure a integração em Conectar Planilha.";
                } else {
                    if (pill) {
                        pill.className = "text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-teal-950 border border-teal-800 text-teal-300 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1";
                        if (pillText) pillText.innerText = "Planilha Conectada";
                    }
                    if (unconfigAlert) unconfigAlert.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (lastSyncText && this.data.atualizadoEm) {
                        lastSyncText.innerText = "Sincronizado: " + this.data.atualizadoEm;
                    }
                }
            }

            getDefaultMonthYear() {
                const now = new Date();
                const m = (now.getMonth() + 1 < 10 ? '0' : '') + (now.getMonth() + 1);
                return m + '/' + now.getFullYear();
            }

            setPeriodMode(mode) {
                this.periodMode = mode;
                try { localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_period_mode', mode); } catch (e) {}

                const btnWeekly = document.getElementById('btn-schedule-period-weekly');
                const btnMonthly = document.getElementById('btn-schedule-period-monthly');
                const monthControls = document.getElementById('schedule-month-controls');

                const activeCls = 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer bg-teal-600 text-white shadow';
                const inactiveCls = 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer text-gray-400 hover:text-white';

                if (btnWeekly) btnWeekly.className = (mode === 'weekly' ? activeCls : inactiveCls);
                if (btnMonthly) btnMonthly.className = (mode === 'monthly' ? activeCls : inactiveCls);

                if (monthControls) {
                    if (mode === 'monthly') monthControls.classList.remove('hidden');
                    else monthControls.classList.add('hidden');
                }

                const diasSemanaValidos = ['Segunda', 'Terça', 'Quarta', 'Quinta', 'Sexta', 'Sábado', 'Domingo'];

                if (mode === 'monthly') {
                    this.populateMonthSelect();
                    this.fetchMonthlyHistory();
                } else {
                    if (!diasSemanaValidos.includes(this.currentDay) || !this.data?.dias?.[this.currentDay]) {
                        this.currentDay = this.getTodayDayName();
                    }
                    this.renderDaysSelector();
                    this.renderStatsAndAbsences();
                    this.renderSlots();
                }
            }

            populateMonthSelect() {
                const sel = document.getElementById('select-schedule-month');
                if (!sel) return;

                const mesesNomes = ['Janeiro', 'Fevereiro', 'Março', 'Abril', 'Maio', 'Junho', 'Julho', 'Agosto', 'Setembro', 'Outubro', 'Novembro', 'Dezembro'];
                const now = new Date();
                const curYear = now.getFullYear();
                const curMonth = now.getMonth(); // 0 a 11

                let html = '';
                // Mostra os meses do ano atual e próximo ano (ex: 2026 e 2027)
                for (let y = curYear; y <= curYear + 1; y++) {
                    for (let m = 0; m < 12; m++) {
                        const mStr = (m + 1 < 10 ? '0' : '') + (m + 1);
                        const val = mStr + '/' + y;
                        const label = mesesNomes[m] + ' / ' + y;
                        const isSelected = (val === this.selectedMonthYear);
                        html += '<option value="' + val + '" ' + (isSelected ? 'selected' : '') + ' class="bg-gray-900 text-white">' + label + '</option>';
                    }
                }
                sel.innerHTML = html;
            }

            handleMonthChange(val) {
                this.selectedMonthYear = val;
                this.currentMonthlyDay = 1;
                this.fetchMonthlyHistory();
            }

            async fetchMonthlyHistory() {
                if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Carregando escala de ' + this.selectedMonthYear + '...', 'info');

                try {
                    // 1. Tenta carregar via GViz direto da aba Historico_Escalas (ultra rápido)
                    const gvizUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${this.sheetId || this.defaultSheetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json&sheet=Historico_Escalas&t=${Date.now()}`;
                    const gvizRes = await fetch(gvizUrl);
                    if (gvizRes.ok) {
                        const rawText = await gvizRes.text();
                        const match = rawText.match(/google\.visualization\.Query\.setResponse\((.*)\);?/s);
                        if (match && match[1]) {
                            const parsed = JSON.parse(match[1]);
                            const rows = parsed.table?.rows || [];
                            const diasMap = {};

                            rows.forEach(r => {
                                const c = r.c || [];
                                const id = c[0]?.v ? String(c[0].v).trim() : '';
                                let dataStr = c[1]?.f || (c[1]?.v ? String(c[1].v).trim() : '');
                                const diaSem = c[2]?.v ? String(c[2].v).trim() : '';
                                let mesAno = c[3]?.f || (c[3]?.v ? String(c[3].v).trim() : '');
                                const linha = c[4]?.v ? Number(c[4].v) : 0;
                                const depto = c[5]?.v ? String(c[5].v).trim() : '';
                                const titular = c[6]?.v ? String(c[6].v).trim() : '';
                                const colab = c[7]?.v ? String(c[7].v).trim() : '';

                                // Normaliza Date(ano, mes, dia)
                                if (dataStr.startsWith('Date(')) {
                                    const m = dataStr.match(/Date\((\d+),(\d+),(\d+)\)/);
                                    if (m) {
                                        dataStr = String(m[3]).padStart(2, '0') + '/' + String(Number(m[2]) + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '/' + m[1];
                                    }
                                }
                                if (mesAno.startsWith('Date(')) {
                                    const m = mesAno.match(/Date\((\d+),(\d+)/);
                                    if (m) {
                                        mesAno = String(Number(m[2]) + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '/' + m[1];
                                    }
                                }

                                if (!dataStr) return;

                                // Filtra pelo mês/ano selecionado
                                if (this.selectedMonthYear && mesAno && mesAno !== this.selectedMonthYear) {
                                    return;
                                }

                                if (!diasMap[dataStr]) {
                                    diasMap[dataStr] = {
                                        data: dataStr,
                                        diaSemana: diaSem,
                                        slots: [],
                                        folgas: [],
                                        ausencias: [],
                                        ausenciasCompletas: []
                                    };
                                }

                                // Detecta layout de colunas (Novo de 19 colunas ou clássico de 14 colunas)
                                const hasExtendedCols = (c.length >= 18 && c[17]?.v);
                                let entrada = '', inicioAlm = '', retornoAlm = '', saida = '', banco = '', escala = '', status = '', solucao = '', tipoReg = '', jsonSlot = null;

                                if (hasExtendedCols || c.length >= 17) {
                                    entrada = c[8]?.f || (c[8]?.v ? String(c[8].v).trim() : '');
                                    inicioAlm = c[9]?.f || (c[9]?.v ? String(c[9].v).trim() : '');
                                    retornoAlm = c[10]?.f || (c[10]?.v ? String(c[10].v).trim() : '');
                                    saida = c[11]?.f || (c[11]?.v ? String(c[11].v).trim() : '');
                                    banco = c[12]?.f || (c[12]?.v ? String(c[12].v).trim() : '');
                                    escala = c[13]?.v ? String(c[13].v).trim() : '';
                                    status = c[14]?.v ? String(c[14].v).trim() : '';
                                    solucao = c[15]?.v ? String(c[15].v).trim() : '';
                                    tipoReg = c[16]?.v ? String(c[16].v).trim() : 'ESCALA_POSTO';
                                    if (c[17]?.v) {
                                        try { jsonSlot = JSON.parse(String(c[17].v)); } catch(e) {}
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    entrada = c[8]?.f || (c[8]?.v ? String(c[8].v).trim() : '');
                                    saida = c[9]?.f || (c[9]?.v ? String(c[9].v).trim() : '');
                                    status = c[10]?.v ? String(c[10].v).trim() : '';
                                    solucao = c[11]?.v ? String(c[11].v).trim() : '';
                                    tipoReg = c[12]?.v ? String(c[12].v).trim() : 'ESCALA_POSTO';
                                }

                                const isVago = (!colab || colab === '-' || colab.toUpperCase() === 'VAGO' || colab.toUpperCase() === 'X');

                                if (tipoReg === 'ESCALA_POSTO') {
                                    if (jsonSlot && jsonSlot.linha) {
                                        diasMap[dataStr].slots.push(jsonSlot);
                                    } else {
                                        diasMap[dataStr].slots.push({
                                            linha: linha,
                                            colaborador: colab,
                                            nome: isVago ? '' : colab,
                                            depto: depto,
                                            departamento: depto,
                                            escala: escala,
                                            horario: escala || entrada,
                                            entrada: entrada,
                                            inicioAlmoco: inicioAlm,
                                            retornoAlmoco: retornoAlm,
                                            saida: saida,
                                            banco: banco,
                                            isVago: isVago,
                                            status: status,
                                            grupo: (linha >= 55) ? 'lideranca' : 'reposicao'
                                        });
                                    }
                                } else if (tipoReg === 'FOLGA_SEMANAL') {
                                    diasMap[dataStr].folgas.push({
                                        linha: linha,
                                        nome: colab,
                                        departamento: depto,
                                        solucao: solucao,
                                        tipo: 'folga'
                                    });
                                } else {
                                    diasMap[dataStr].ausenciasCompletas.push({
                                        linha: linha,
                                        nome: colab,
                                        departamento: depto,
                                        situacao: status,
                                        solucao: solucao,
                                        tipo: 'ausencia',
                                        isFeriado: status.toUpperCase().includes('FERIADO')
                                    });
                                    diasMap[dataStr].ausencias.push(colab);
                                }
                            });

                            this.monthlyData = diasMap;
                            if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Escala mensal carregada com sucesso!', 'success');
                            this.renderDaysSelector();
                            this.renderStatsAndAbsences();
                            this.renderSlots();
                            return;
                        }
                    }

                    // 2. Fallback via Web App do Google Apps Script
                    const url = (this.webAppUrl || this.defaultOfficialUrl) + 
                        ((this.webAppUrl || this.defaultOfficialUrl).includes('?') ? '&' : '?') +
                        'action=get_monthly_history&mes_ano=' + encodeURIComponent(this.selectedMonthYear) +
                        '&t=' + Date.now();

                    const res = await fetch(url, { redirect: 'follow' });
                    const json = await res.json();

                    if (json && json.success) {
                        this.monthlyData = json.dias || {};
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Escala mensal carregada com sucesso!', 'success');
                    } else {
                        this.monthlyData = {};
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('Erro ao buscar histórico mensal:', e);
                    this.monthlyData = {};
                }

                this.renderDaysSelector();
                this.renderStatsAndAbsences();
                this.renderSlots();
            }

            async saveCurrentWeekToMonthlyArchive() {
                if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Salvando semana no histórico...', 'info');

                try {
                    const url = (this.webAppUrl || this.defaultOfficialUrl) + 
                        ((this.webAppUrl || this.defaultOfficialUrl).includes('?') ? '&' : '?') +
                        'action=save_daily_to_history&t=' + Date.now();

                    const res = await fetch(url, { redirect: 'follow' });
                    const json = await res.json();

                    if (json && json.success) {
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('✓ ' + (json.totalSalvos || 0) + ' postos arquivados no Histórico Mensal!', 'success');
                        if (this.periodMode === 'monthly') this.fetchMonthlyHistory();
                    } else {
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Aviso: Atualize o script do Google para versão 3.3', 'warning');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Erro ao arquivar: ' + e.message, 'error');
                }
            }

            getSitType(item) {
                if (!item) return "ausencia";
                if (item.tipo === "folga") return "folga";
                const s = String(item.situacao || item.motivo || "").toUpperCase();
                if (s.includes("FERIADO") || item.isFeriado) return "feriado";
                if (s.includes("ATESTADO") || s.includes("MEDICO") || s.includes("MÉDICO")) return "atestado";
                if (s.includes("FÉRIAS") || s.includes("FERIAS")) return "ferias";
                return "ausencia";
            }

            switchDay(dayName) {
                const diasSemanaValidos = ['Segunda', 'Terça', 'Quarta', 'Quinta', 'Sexta', 'Sábado', 'Domingo'];
                if (this.periodMode === 'monthly') {
                    this.currentMonthlyDay = parseInt(dayName, 10) || 1;
                    const curData = this.getCurrentDayData();
                    if (curData && curData.diaSemana && diasSemanaValidos.includes(curData.diaSemana)) {
                        this.currentDay = curData.diaSemana;
                    } else {
                        const parts = (this.selectedMonthYear || this.getDefaultMonthYear()).split('/');
                        const mes = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
                        const ano = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
                        const dateObj = new Date(ano, mes - 1, this.currentMonthlyDay);
                        const mapDias = ['Domingo', 'Segunda', 'Terça', 'Quarta', 'Quinta', 'Sexta', 'Sábado'];
                        this.currentDay = mapDias[dateObj.getDay()] || this.getTodayDayName();
                    }
                } else {
                    if (diasSemanaValidos.includes(dayName)) {
                        this.currentDay = dayName;
                    } else {
                        this.currentDay = this.getTodayDayName();
                    }
                }
                this.render();
            }

            isValidPersonName(n) {
                if (!n || typeof n !== 'string') return false;
                const clean = n.trim().toUpperCase();
                if (clean.length < 2) return false;
                if (clean === '-' || clean === 'X' || clean === 'VAGO' || clean === 'POSTO VAGO') return false;

                const bannedWords = [
                    'DEPARTAMENTO',
                    'NOME DO COLABORADOR',
                    'NOME',
                    'SOLUÇÃO DA FOLGA',
                    'SOLUCAO DA FOLGA',
                    'ESCALA DA REPOSIÇÃO',
                    'ESCALA DA REPOSICAO',
                    'FOLGAS',
                    'FOLGA',
                    'COND',
                    'FAR.',
                    'MAC.',
                    'LIMP.',
                    'BISC/MAT',
                    'ARROZ/OLEO',
                    'BEBIDA',
                    'PERFUMARIA',
                    'LEITE',
                    'CAFÉ',
                    'CAFE'
                ];
                if (bannedWords.includes(clean)) return false;
                if (clean.includes('ESCALA DA REPOSIÇÃO') || clean.includes('ESCALA DA REPOSICAO') || clean.includes('DEPARTAMENTO')) return false;
                return true;
            }

            getCollabDepartment(collabName) {
                if (!collabName) return '';
                const nameUp = String(collabName).trim().toUpperCase();
                if (this.data && this.data.colaboradores) {
                    // 1. Busca exata por nome
                    let found = this.data.colaboradores.find(c => String(c.nome || '').trim().toUpperCase() === nameUp);
                    // 2. Busca por prefixo/variação (ex: EDUARDO -> EDUARDO LUIS)
                    if (!found) {
                        found = this.data.colaboradores.find(c => {
                            const cUp = String(c.nome || '').trim().toUpperCase();
                            return cUp.startsWith(nameUp + ' ') || nameUp.startsWith(cUp + ' ');
                        });
                    }
                    if (found && found.departamento) {
                        let dept = String(found.departamento).trim();
                        if (dept.includes('Liderança')) return 'Liderança';
                        return dept;
                    }
                }
                const accounts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_accounts') || '[]');
                const acc = accounts.find(a => (a.displayName && a.displayName.toUpperCase() === nameUp) || (a.name && a.name.toUpperCase() === nameUp));
                if (acc && acc.department) return acc.department;
                if (acc && acc.dept) return acc.dept;
                return '';
            }

            getSundayPostDepartment(collabName) {
                if (!collabName || !this.data || !this.data.dias || !this.data.dias.Domingo) return '';
                const nameUp = String(collabName).trim().toUpperCase();
                const domSlots = this.data.dias.Domingo.slots || [];
                let found = domSlots.find(s => String(s.nome || '').trim().toUpperCase() === nameUp);
                if (!found) {
                    found = domSlots.find(s => {
                        const cUp = String(s.nome || '').trim().toUpperCase();
                        return cUp.startsWith(nameUp + ' ') || nameUp.startsWith(cUp + ' ');
                    });
                }
                if (found && found.horario && !found.horario.includes('Linha') && found.horario.trim() !== 'X') {
                    return found.horario.trim();
                }
                return '';
            }

            getSlotDepartmentInfo(slot, diaName) {
                const base = this.getSlotDepartmentInfoLegacy(slot, diaName);
                const dep = (slot && slot.departamento) ? String(slot.departamento).trim() : '';
                if (dep && dep.toUpperCase() !== 'DEPARTAMENTO') {
                    return Object.assign({}, base, { sector: dep, hasRealSector: true });
                }
                return base;
            }

            getSlotDepartmentInfoLegacy(slot, diaName) {
                if (!slot) return { sector: '', titular: '', reason: 'Sem dados', hasRealSector: false };

                const isSunday = (diaName === 'Domingo');
                const isVacant = !!slot.isVago;
                const linha = Number(slot.linha);

                // 1. Caso o slot NÃO seja vago (já possui colaborador alocado no dia)
                if (!isVacant && slot.nome) {
                    const depto = isSunday 
                        ? (slot.horario && !slot.horario.includes('Linha') && slot.horario.trim() !== 'X' ? slot.horario.trim() : '') 
                        : (this.getCollabDepartment(slot.nome) || this.getSundayPostDepartment(slot.nome) || '');
                    return { 
                        sector: depto, 
                        titular: slot.nome, 
                        reason: 'Alocado',
                        hasRealSector: !!depto
                    };
                }

                // 2. Se for domingo e o posto tiver especificação no campo horário da planilha
                if (isSunday && slot.horario && !slot.horario.includes('Linha') && slot.horario.trim() !== 'X') {
                    return { 
                        sector: slot.horario.trim(), 
                        titular: '', 
                        reason: 'Posto de Domingo',
                        hasRealSector: true
                    };
                }

                // 3. Caso seja VAGO / DESFALQUE: descobre o titular e o setor habitual desta linha na semana a partir da planilha
                let titularName = '';
                let titularDept = '';
                let reason = 'Vaga Aberta';

                if (this.data && this.data.dias) {
                    const diasSemana = ['Segunda', 'Terça', 'Quarta', 'Quinta', 'Sexta', 'Sábado'];
                    const occupants = [];
                    diasSemana.forEach(d => {
                        if (this.data.dias[d] && this.data.dias[d].slots) {
                            const matchSlot = this.data.dias[d].slots.find(s => Number(s.linha) === linha);
                            if (matchSlot && matchSlot.nome && matchSlot.nome.trim() !== '' && matchSlot.nome.toUpperCase() !== 'NOME' && matchSlot.nome !== 'X') {
                                occupants.push(matchSlot.nome.trim());
                            }
                        }
                    });

                    if (occupants.length > 0) {
                        const freq = {};
                        occupants.forEach(n => freq[n] = (freq[n] || 0) + 1);
                        let topName = occupants[0];
                        let maxF = 0;
                        for (let n in freq) {
                            if (freq[n] > maxF) { maxF = freq[n]; topName = n; }
                        }
                        titularName = topName;
                        titularDept = this.getCollabDepartment(topName) || this.getSundayPostDepartment(topName) || '';
                    }
                }

                // Se o titular habitual tem folga hoje ou está nas ausências
                if (titularName) {
                    const diaInfo = (this.data && this.data.dias && this.data.dias[diaName]) ? this.data.dias[diaName] : null;
                    const ausencias = diaInfo ? (diaInfo.ausencias || []) : [];
                    const isAusente = ausencias.some(a => a.toUpperCase().includes(titularName.toUpperCase()));

                    let isFolgaHoje = false;
                    if (this.data && this.data.colaboradores) {
                        const colabObj = this.data.colaboradores.find(c => {
                            const cName = String(c.nome || '').trim().toUpperCase();
                            const tName = titularName.toUpperCase();
                            return cName === tName || cName.startsWith(tName + ' ') || tName.startsWith(cName + ' ');
                        });
                        if (colabObj && colabObj.folga) {
                            const folgaUpper = colabObj.folga.toUpperCase();
                            const diaUpper = String(diaName).toUpperCase();
                            if (folgaUpper.includes(diaUpper.substring(0, 3))) {
                                isFolgaHoje = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (isAusente) {
                        reason = `Ausência de ${titularName}`;
                    } else if (isFolgaHoje) {
                        reason = `Folga de ${titularName}`;
                    } else {
                        reason = 'Sem Cobertura';
                    }
                }

                // ESTRITAMENTE da planilha: nunca inventar setores fictícios
                const hasRealSector = !!titularDept && titularDept !== 'Geral';

                return {
                    sector: hasRealSector ? titularDept : (titularName ? `Posto de ${titularName}` : `Posto L${linha}`),
                    titular: titularName || '',
                    reason: reason,
                    hasRealSector: hasRealSector
                };
            }

            focusAndEditSlot(dia, linha, colunaLetra, horario) {
                const card = document.getElementById(`schedule-slot-card-${linha}`);
                if (card) {
                    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    card.classList.add('ring-4', 'ring-rose-500', 'animate-pulse');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        card.classList.remove('ring-4', 'ring-rose-500', 'animate-pulse');
                    }, 2800);
                }
                this.openEditSlotModal(dia, linha, colunaLetra, '', horario, true);
            }

            toggleUncoveredFilter() {
                if (this.currentFilter === 'vacant') {
                    this.setFilter('all');
                } else {
                    this.setFilter('vacant');
                }
            }

            toggleAbsencesSection() {
                const card = document.getElementById('schedule-absences-card');
                const arrow = document.getElementById('arrow-toggle-abs');
                const btn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-absences-view');
                if (!card) return;
                const isHidden = card.classList.contains('hidden');
                if (isHidden) {
                    card.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (arrow) arrow.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.classList.add('bg-amber-500', 'text-gray-950', 'shadow-lg');
                        btn.classList.remove('bg-amber-500/20', 'text-amber-300');
                    }
                    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
                } else {
                    card.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (arrow) arrow.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.classList.remove('bg-amber-500', 'text-gray-950', 'shadow-lg');
                        btn.classList.add('bg-amber-500/20', 'text-amber-300');
                    }
                }
            }

            openAndFocusAbsences() {
                const card = document.getElementById('schedule-absences-card');
                const arrow = document.getElementById('arrow-toggle-abs');
                if (card) {
                    card.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (arrow) arrow.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
                    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            toggleDeptDropdown(e) {
                if (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                }
                const menu = document.getElementById('sched-dept-dropdown-menu');
                const arrow = document.getElementById('sched-dept-dropdown-arrow');
                if (!menu) return;
                const isClosed = menu.classList.contains('hidden');
                if (isClosed) {
                    menu.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (arrow) arrow.classList.add('rotate-180');
                } else {
                    menu.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (arrow) arrow.classList.remove('rotate-180');
                }
            }

            closeDeptDropdown() {
                const menu = document.getElementById('sched-dept-dropdown-menu');
                const arrow = document.getElementById('sched-dept-dropdown-arrow');
                if (menu) menu.classList.add('hidden');
                if (arrow) arrow.classList.remove('rotate-180');
            }

            setDeptFilter(val) {
                this.currentDeptFilter = val;
                this.closeDeptDropdown();

                // 1. Atualiza o select oculto (mantém compatibilidade)
                const select = document.getElementById('sched-filter-dept');
                if (select) select.value = val;

                // 2. Atualiza o botão do dropdown
                const labelEl = document.getElementById('sched-dept-dropdown-label');
                if (labelEl) {
                    if (val === 'all') {
                        labelEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-building text-xs text-slate-400 mr-1.5"></i>Todos os Departamentos';
                    } else if (val === 'uncovered') {
                        labelEl.innerHTML = '<span class="text-rose-400 font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-xs text-rose-400"></i> Setores Descobertos</span>';
                    } else {
                        labelEl.innerHTML = `<span class="text-teal-300 font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate"><span>📦</span> <span class="truncate">${val}</span></span>`;
                    }
                }

                // 3. Atualiza os estados visuais dos itens no menu customizado
                const items = document.querySelectorAll('.sched-dept-option-item');
                items.forEach(el => {
                    const itemVal = el.getAttribute('data-value');
                    const check = el.querySelector('.sched-dept-check');
                    if (itemVal === val) {
                        el.classList.add('bg-teal-500/20', 'text-teal-200');
                        el.classList.remove('text-gray-300');
                        if (check) check.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        el.classList.remove('bg-teal-500/20', 'text-teal-200');
                        if (itemVal !== 'uncovered') el.classList.add('text-gray-300');
                        if (check) check.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                });

                this.renderSlots();
            }

            populateDeptFilter() {
                const select = document.getElementById('sched-filter-dept');
                const menu = document.getElementById('sched-dept-dropdown-menu');
                const labelEl = document.getElementById('sched-dept-dropdown-label');

                const currentVal = this.currentDeptFilter || 'all';
                const deptsSet = new Set();

                // 1. Departamentos cadastrados no Banco de Dados da planilha
                if (this.data && this.data.colaboradores) {
                    this.data.colaboradores.forEach(c => {
                        if (c.departamento && c.departamento.trim() !== '') {
                            let d = c.departamento.trim();
                            if (d.includes('Liderança')) d = 'Liderança';
                            if (d !== '' && !d.toLowerCase().includes('em branco')) {
                                deptsSet.add(d);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }

                // 2. Setores do domingo (postos reais da planilha)
                if (this.data && this.data.dias && this.data.dias.Domingo && this.data.dias.Domingo.slots) {
                    this.data.dias.Domingo.slots.forEach(s => {
                        if (s.horario && s.horario.trim() !== '' && !s.horario.includes('Linha') && s.horario.trim() !== 'X') {
                            deptsSet.add(s.horario.trim());
                        }
                    });
                }

                // 3. Departamentos reais das linhas da escala (coluna DEPARTAMENTO da planilha)
                if (this.data && this.data.dias) {
                    Object.keys(this.data.dias).forEach(d => {
                        (this.data.dias[d].slots || []).forEach(s => {
                            const dep = String(s.departamento || '').trim();
                            if (dep && dep.toUpperCase() !== 'DEPARTAMENTO') deptsSet.add(dep);
                        });
                    });
                }

                const sortedDepts = Array.from(deptsSet).sort();

                // Atualiza o select oculto para manter compatibilidade com testes e scripts
                if (select) {
                    let optionsHtml = `
                        <option value="all" ${currentVal === 'all' ? 'selected' : ''}>Todos os Departamentos</option>
                        <option value="uncovered" ${currentVal === 'uncovered' ? 'selected' : ''}>Apenas Setores Descobertos</option>
                    `;
                    sortedDepts.forEach(dept => {
                        optionsHtml += `<option value="${dept}" ${currentVal === dept ? 'selected' : ''}>${dept}</option>`;
                    });
                    select.innerHTML = optionsHtml;
                    select.value = currentVal;
                }

                // Atualiza o texto do botão
                if (labelEl) {
                    if (currentVal === 'all') {
                        labelEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-building text-xs text-slate-400 mr-1.5"></i>Todos os Departamentos';
                    } else if (currentVal === 'uncovered') {
                        labelEl.innerHTML = '<span class="text-rose-400 font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-xs text-rose-400"></i> Setores Descobertos</span>';
                    } else {
                        labelEl.innerHTML = `<span class="text-teal-300 font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate"><span>📦</span> <span class="truncate">${currentVal}</span></span>`;
                    }
                }

                // Constrói o Menu Dropdown 100% Dark
                if (menu) {
                    const daySlots = (this.data && this.data.dias && this.data.dias[this.currentDay]) 
                        ? this.data.dias[this.currentDay].slots || [] 
                        : [];
                    const vacantCount = daySlots.filter(s => s.isVago).length;

                    // Contagem por departamento no dia ativo
                    const deptCounts = {};
                    sortedDepts.forEach(dept => {
                        const targetDept = dept.toUpperCase().trim();
                        deptCounts[dept] = daySlots.filter(s => {
                            const deptInfo = this.getSlotDepartmentInfo(s, this.currentDay);
                            return String(deptInfo.sector || '').toUpperCase().includes(targetDept) ||
                                   String(s.horario || '').toUpperCase().includes(targetDept);
                        }).length;
                    });

                    let menuHtml = `
                        <div class="px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-extrabold text-gray-400">
                            Filtros Gerais
                        </div>
                        <div onclick="scheduleApp.setDeptFilter('all')" data-value="all" 
                             class="sched-dept-option-item flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold transition hover:bg-gray-800 ${currentVal === 'all' ? 'bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-200' : 'text-gray-200'}">
                            <span class="flex items-center gap-2"><i class="fa-solid fa-building text-xs text-slate-400"></i> <span>Todos os Departamentos</span></span>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                                <span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-teal-950 text-teal-300 font-extrabold border border-teal-800">${daySlots.length}</span>
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-check text-teal-400 text-xs sched-dept-check ${currentVal === 'all' ? '' : 'hidden'}"></i>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div onclick="scheduleApp.setDeptFilter('uncovered')" data-value="uncovered" 
                             class="sched-dept-option-item flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold transition hover:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-400 ${currentVal === 'uncovered' ? 'bg-rose-950/50 text-rose-300' : ''}">
                            <span class="flex items-center gap-2"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-xs text-rose-400"></i> <span>Apenas Setores Descobertos</span></span>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                                <span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 font-extrabold border border-rose-800">${vacantCount}</span>
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-check text-rose-400 text-xs sched-dept-check ${currentVal === 'uncovered' ? '' : 'hidden'}"></i>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="px-2.5 py-1 mt-1 border-t border-gray-800 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-extrabold text-gray-400">
                            Departamentos da Planilha (${this.currentDay})
                        </div>
                    `;

                    sortedDepts.forEach(dept => {
                        const isSel = currentVal === dept;
                        const count = deptCounts[dept] || 0;
                        menuHtml += `
                            <div onclick="scheduleApp.setDeptFilter('${dept}')" data-value="${dept}" 
                                 class="sched-dept-option-item flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold transition hover:bg-teal-500/15 hover:text-white ${isSel ? 'bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-200 font-bold' : 'text-gray-300'}">
                                <span class="flex items-center gap-2 truncate"><i class="fa-solid fa-boxes-stacked text-xs text-slate-400"></i> <span class="truncate">${dept}</span></span>
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full ${count > 0 ? 'bg-gray-800 text-teal-300 border border-teal-800/40 font-bold' : 'bg-gray-850 text-gray-500'}">
                                        ${count}
                                    </span>
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-check text-teal-400 text-xs sched-dept-check ${isSel ? '' : 'hidden'}"></i>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    });

                    menu.innerHTML = menuHtml;
                }
            }

            }

            saveInconsistency(inc) {
                let list = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_inconsistencies') || '[]');
                list.unshift(inc);
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_inconsistencies', JSON.stringify(list));
                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({
                        type: 'INCONSISTENCY_ADD',
                        inconsistency: inc
                    });
                }
            }

            setFilter(filter) {
                this.currentFilter = filter;
                const btnAll = document.getElementById('sched-filter-all');
                const btnVacant = document.getElementById('sched-filter-vacant');
                const btnAssigned = document.getElementById('sched-filter-assigned');

                const activeClass = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition bg-teal-600 text-white shadow-sm";
                const inactiveClass = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition bg-gray-900 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 border border-gray-800";

                if (btnAll) btnAll.className = (filter === 'all') ? activeClass : inactiveClass;
                if (btnVacant) btnVacant.className = (filter === 'vacant') ? activeClass : inactiveClass;
                if (btnAssigned) btnAssigned.className = (filter === 'assigned') ? activeClass : inactiveClass;

                this.renderSlots();
            }

            handleSearch(val) {
                this.searchQuery = String(val || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                this.renderSlots();
            }

            async fetchGvizSchedule() {
                const sheetId = this.sheetId || this.defaultSheetId;
                if (!sheetId) throw new Error('ID da planilha não configurado');

                const gvizUrlDiaria = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/' + sheetId + '/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json&sheet=Diaria&t=' + Date.now();
                const gvizUrlBanco = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/' + sheetId + '/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json&sheet=Banco%20de%20Dados&t=' + Date.now();

                const [resDiaria, resBanco] = await Promise.all([
                    fetch(gvizUrlDiaria),
                    fetch(gvizUrlBanco).catch(err => {
                        console.warn('[Schedule] Erro ao carregar aba Banco de Dados:', err);
                        return null;
                    })
                ]);

                if (!resDiaria.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + resDiaria.status + ' ao acessar Google Sheets (Diária)');
                const textDiaria = await resDiaria.text();
                const mDiaria = textDiaria.match(/google\.visualization\.Query\.setResponse\((.*)\);?/s);
                if (!mDiaria) throw new Error('Resposta inválida do Google Sheets (Diária)');
                const jsonDiaria = JSON.parse(mDiaria[1]);
                if (!jsonDiaria || !jsonDiaria.table || !jsonDiaria.table.rows) throw new Error('Dados da planilha incompletos');

                const rows = jsonDiaria.table.rows;

                // Processa colaboradores do Banco de Dados
                const colaboradores = [];
                if (resBanco && resBanco.ok) {
                    try {
                        const textBanco = await resBanco.text();
                        const mBanco = textBanco.match(/google\.visualization\.Query\.setResponse\((.*)\);?/s);
                        if (mBanco) {
                            const jsonBanco = JSON.parse(mBanco[1]);
                            const bRows = jsonBanco?.table?.rows || [];
                            bRows.forEach(r => {
                                const getVal = (idx) => (r.c && r.c[idx]) ? (r.c[idx].f || r.c[idx].v || '') : '';
                                const bNome = String(getVal(0)).trim();
                                if (bNome && bNome.toUpperCase() !== 'NOME') {
                                    colaboradores.push({
                                        nome: bNome,
                                        escala: String(getVal(1)).trim(),
                                        folga: String(getVal(2)).trim(),
                                        cracha: String(getVal(3)).trim(),
                                        departamento: String(getVal(4)).trim()
                                    });
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    } catch (eBanco) {
                        console.warn('[Schedule] Falha no parse do Banco de Dados:', eBanco);
                    }
                }

                const diasConfig = [
                    { nome: 'Segunda', colDept: 1,  colNome: 2,  colEsc: 3,  colEnt: 4,  colIni: 5,  colRet: 6,  colSai: 7,  colBnc: 8,  colData: 3,  colLetra: 'C' },
                    { nome: 'Terça',   colDept: 10, colNome: 11, colEsc: 12, colEnt: 13, colIni: 14, colRet: 15, colSai: 16, colBnc: 17, colData: 12, colLetra: 'L' },
                    { nome: 'Quarta',  colDept: 19, colNome: 20, colEsc: 21, colEnt: 22, colIni: 23, colRet: 24, colSai: 25, colBnc: 26, colData: 21, colLetra: 'U' },
                    { nome: 'Quinta',  colDept: 28, colNome: 29, colEsc: 30, colEnt: 31, colIni: 32, colRet: 33, colSai: 34, colBnc: 35, colData: 30, colLetra: 'AD' },
                    { nome: 'Sexta',   colDept: 37, colNome: 38, colEsc: 39, colEnt: 40, colIni: 41, colRet: 42, colSai: 43, colBnc: 44, colData: 39, colLetra: 'AM' },
                    { nome: 'Sábado',  colDept: 46, colNome: 47, colEsc: 48, colEnt: 49, colIni: 50, colRet: 51, colSai: 52, colBnc: 53, colData: 48, colLetra: 'AV' },
                    { nome: 'Domingo', colDept: 55, colNome: 56, colEsc: 57, colEnt: 58, colIni: 59, colRet: 60, colSai: 61, colBnc: 62, colData: 57, colLetra: 'BE' }
                ];

                const getCell = (rIdx, cIdx) => {
                    if (!rows[rIdx] || !rows[rIdx].c || !rows[rIdx].c[cIdx]) return '';
                    const cell = rows[rIdx].c[cIdx];
                    if (cell.f !== undefined && cell.f !== null) return String(cell.f).trim();
                    if (cell.v !== undefined && cell.v !== null) return String(cell.v).trim();
                    return '';
                };

                const limparHora = (v) => {
                    const s = String(v || '').trim();
                    const mm = s.match(/^([+-])?(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?$/);
                    if (mm) {
                        const h = mm[2].length < 2 ? '0' + mm[2] : mm[2];
                        return (mm[1] === '-' ? '-' : '') + h + ':' + mm[3];
                    }
                    return s;
                };

                const result = { success: true, dias: {}, colaboradores, atualizadoEm: new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR') + ' ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR') };

                diasConfig.forEach(cfg => {
                    const dataStr = getCell(0, cfg.colData);
                    const slots = [];
                    const folgas = [];

                    // Leitura das Folgas da Escala (Linhas 6 a 12 na Planilha / r=3 a 9 no GViz)
                    for (let r = 3; r <= 9; r++) {
                        // Novo layout: colDept é NOME e colNome é DEPARTAMENTO
                        const cell0 = getCell(r, cfg.colDept).trim();
                        const cell1 = getCell(r, cfg.colNome).trim();
                        const fSol = getCell(r, cfg.colEsc).trim();
                        const fNome = cell0;
                        const fDept = cell1;
                        if (this.isValidPersonName(fNome)) {
                            folgas.push({
                                linha: r + 3,
                                nome: fNome,
                                departamento: fDept || 'Geral',
                                solucao: fSol,
                                tipo: 'folga',
                                motivo: 'Folga da Escala Diária'
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    // Leitura das Ausências / Atestados / Férias (Linhas 6 a 12 / Colunas E:I)
                    const ausenciasCompletas = [];
                    for (let r = 3; r <= 9; r++) {
                        const aNome = getCell(r, cfg.colDept + 3).trim();
                        const aDept = getCell(r, cfg.colDept + 4).trim();
                        const aSit = getCell(r, cfg.colDept + 5).trim();
                        const aSol = (getCell(r, cfg.colDept + 6) || getCell(r, cfg.colDept + 7) || '').trim();
                        if (this.isValidPersonName(aNome)) {
                            const isFer = (aSit + ' ' + aDept).toUpperCase().includes('FERIADO');
                            ausenciasCompletas.push({
                                linha: r + 3,
                                nome: aNome,
                                departamento: aDept || 'Geral',
                                situacao: aSit,
                                solucao: aSol,
                                tipo: 'ausencia',
                                isFeriado: isFer,
                                motivo: aSit || 'Ausência / Atestado / Férias'
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    if (cfg.nome === 'Domingo') {
                        // Domingo: Reposição linhas 19 a 33 na planilha (gviz rows 12 a 26)
                        for (let r = 12; r <= 26; r++) {
                            const linha = 19 + (r - 12);
                            const dept = getCell(r, cfg.colDept);
                            const nome = getCell(r, cfg.colNome);
                            if (!dept && !nome) continue;
                            const esc  = getCell(r, cfg.colEsc);
                            const isVago = !nome || nome === '-' || nome.toUpperCase() === 'VAGO' || nome.toUpperCase() === 'POSTO VAGO';
                            slots.push({
                                linha, grupo: 'reposicao', colunaLetra: cfg.colLetra,
                                departamento: dept, nome: isVago ? 'VAGO' : nome, escala: esc,
                                horario: esc, entrada: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colEnt)),
                                inicioAlmoco: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colIni)),
                                retornoAlmoco: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colRet)),
                                saida: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colSai)),
                                banco: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colBnc)),
                                isVago, corFundo: isVago ? '#ea4335' : ''
                            });
                        }
                        // Domingo: Liderança linha 37 na planilha (gviz row 30)
                        const d30 = getCell(30, cfg.colDept);
                        const n30 = getCell(30, cfg.colNome);
                        if (d30 || n30) {
                            const isVago = !n30 || n30 === '-' || n30.toUpperCase() === 'VAGO';
                            slots.push({
                                linha: 37, grupo: 'lideranca', colunaLetra: cfg.colLetra,
                                departamento: d30, nome: isVago ? 'VAGO' : n30,
                                escala: getCell(30, cfg.colEsc), horario: getCell(30, cfg.colEsc),
                                entrada: limparHora(getCell(30, cfg.colEnt)),
                                inicioAlmoco: limparHora(getCell(30, cfg.colIni)),
                                retornoAlmoco: limparHora(getCell(30, cfg.colRet)),
                                saida: limparHora(getCell(30, cfg.colSai)),
                                banco: limparHora(getCell(30, cfg.colBnc)),
                                isVago, corFundo: isVago ? '#ea4335' : ''
                            });
                        }
                        // Domingo: Extras PF linhas 41 e 42 na planilha (gviz rows 34 e 35)
                        [ { r: 34, linha: 41 }, { r: 35, linha: 42 } ].forEach(item => {
                            const dept = getCell(item.r, cfg.colDept);
                            const nome = getCell(item.r, cfg.colNome);
                            if (!dept && !nome) return;
                            const esc  = getCell(item.r, cfg.colEsc);
                            const isVago = !nome || nome === '-' || nome.toUpperCase() === 'VAGO';
                            slots.push({
                                linha: item.linha, grupo: 'reposicao', colunaLetra: cfg.colLetra,
                                departamento: dept, nome: isVago ? 'VAGO' : nome, escala: esc,
                                horario: esc, entrada: limparHora(getCell(item.r, cfg.colEnt)),
                                inicioAlmoco: limparHora(getCell(item.r, cfg.colIni)),
                                retornoAlmoco: limparHora(getCell(item.r, cfg.colRet)),
                                saida: limparHora(getCell(item.r, cfg.colSai)),
                                banco: limparHora(getCell(item.r, cfg.colBnc)),
                                isVago, corFundo: isVago ? '#ea4335' : ''
                            });
                        });
                    } else {
                        // Segunda a Sábado: Reposição linhas 19 a 50 na planilha (gviz rows 12 a 43, 32 postos completos)
                        for (let r = 12; r <= 43; r++) {
                            const linha = 19 + (r - 12);
                            const dept = getCell(r, cfg.colDept);
                            const nome = getCell(r, cfg.colNome);
                            if (dept.toUpperCase().includes('LIDERANÇA') || dept.toUpperCase().includes('MONITORIA')) continue;
                            const esc  = getCell(r, cfg.colEsc);
                            const isVago = !nome || nome === '-' || nome.toUpperCase() === 'VAGO' || nome.toUpperCase() === 'POSTO VAGO';
                            slots.push({
                                linha, grupo: 'reposicao', colunaLetra: cfg.colLetra,
                                departamento: dept, nome: isVago ? 'VAGO' : nome, escala: esc,
                                horario: esc, entrada: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colEnt)),
                                inicioAlmoco: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colIni)),
                                retornoAlmoco: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colRet)),
                                saida: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colSai)),
                                banco: limparHora(getCell(r, cfg.colBnc)),
                                isVago, corFundo: isVago ? '#ea4335' : ''
