                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                ` : ''}
                            </div>
                        ` : ''}
                    `;
                } else {
                    // Modo 'all': Mostra as duas colunas lado a lado
                    contentHtml = `
                        <div class="col-span-full grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                            <!-- COLUNA 1: FOLGAS DA ESCALA -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-teal-900/60 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3.5 shadow-lg flex flex-col justify-between">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-teal-900/40">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                        <span class="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-400 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold border border-teal-500/30">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-umbrella-beach"></i>
                                        </span>
                                        <div>
                                            <h5 class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                                                <span>Folgas da Escala</span>
                                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold bg-teal-950 text-teal-300 border border-teal-800">${folgas.length}</span>
                                            </h5>
                                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">Linhas 6 a 12 • Folgas semanais</span>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.openNewAbsenceModal('folga')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-teal-950 hover:bg-teal-900 text-teal-300 border border-teal-700/60 text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-[10px]"></i>
                                        <span>+ Folga</span>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div class="space-y-2.5 flex-1">
                                    ${colFolgasHtml}
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- COLUNA 2: AUSÊNCIAS, ATESTADOS & FÉRIAS -->
                            <div class="bg-gray-900/90 border border-indigo-900/60 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3.5 shadow-lg flex flex-col justify-between">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-indigo-900/40">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                        <span class="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold border border-indigo-500/30">
                                            <i class="fa-solid fa-notes-medical"></i>
                                        </span>
                                        <div>
                                            <h5 class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                                                <span>Ausências, Atestados & Férias</span>
                                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-800">${effectiveAus.length}</span>
                                            </h5>
                                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">Linhas 6 a 12 • Atestados, Férias e Feriados</span>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.openNewAbsenceModal('ausencia')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-950 hover:bg-indigo-900 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-700/60 text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-[10px]"></i>
                                        <span>+ Ausência</span>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div class="space-y-2.5 flex-1">
                                    ${colAusenciasHtml}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                absencesList.innerHTML = contentHtml;
                this.applyFolgasCollapseState();
            }

            getDayColConfig(dia) {
                const map = {
                    'Segunda': { colDepto: 2 },
                    'Terça':   { colDepto: 11 },
                    'Quarta':  { colDepto: 20 },
                    'Quinta':  { colDepto: 29 },
                    'Sexta':   { colDepto: 38 },
                    'Sábado':  { colDepto: 47 },
                    'Domingo': { colDepto: 56 }
                };
                return map[dia] || { colDepto: 2 };
            }

            openEditAbsenceModal(tipo, linha, nome, depto, solucao, situacao = '') {
                this.editingAbsence = { tipo, linha, nome, depto, solucao, situacao };

                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-schedule-absence-edit');
                const colabNameEl = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-colab-name');
                const subtitleEl = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-subtitle');
                const tipoBadgeEl = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-tipo-badge');
                const deptoEl = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-depto');
                const linhaEl = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-linha');
                const inputSolucao = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-solucao-input');
                const selectSubstitute = document.getElementById('modal-abs-substitute-select');

                if (colabNameEl) colabNameEl.innerText = nome;
                if (subtitleEl) subtitleEl.innerText = tipo === 'folga' ? 'Definir Substituto para Folga' : 'Definir Substituto para Ausência/Atestado';
                if (tipoBadgeEl) {
                    tipoBadgeEl.innerText = tipo === 'folga' ? 'Folga da Escala' : 'Ausência / Afastamento';
                    tipoBadgeEl.className = tipo === 'folga' 
                        ? 'font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-teal-950 text-teal-300 border border-teal-800' 
                        : 'font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-800';
                }
                if (deptoEl) deptoEl.innerText = depto || 'Geral';
                if (linhaEl) linhaEl.innerText = `Linha ${linha} da Planilha Google`;
                if (inputSolucao) inputSolucao.value = solucao || '';
                
                // Configura Motivo da Ausência / Situação
                const motivoBox = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-motivo-box');
                const inputSit = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-situacao-input');
                if (motivoBox) {
                    if (tipo === 'folga') {
                        motivoBox.classList.add('hidden');
                    } else {
                        motivoBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                        const sitVal = situacao || 'ATESTADO';
                        if (inputSit) inputSit.value = sitVal;
                        this.updateEditMotivoButtons(sitVal);
                    }
                }
                const toggleFer = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-feriado-toggle');
                if (toggleFer) {
                    const isFer = (depto + ' ' + nome + ' ' + (solucao || '')).toUpperCase().includes('FERIADO');
                    toggleFer.checked = isFer;
                }

                // Preenche dropdown de colaboradores escalados hoje
                if (selectSubstitute) {
                    const diaInfo = this.getCurrentDayData();
                    const ausentesSet = new Set((diaInfo?.ausencias || []).map(n => String(n).toUpperCase().trim()));
                    const slots = this.getCleanSlots(this.currentDay);

                    // Colaboradores que estão trabalhando hoje e não estão ausentes/folga
                    const disponiveisHoje = slots
                        .filter(s => !s.isVago && s.nome && s.nome !== '-' && s.nome.toUpperCase() !== 'VAGO' && !ausentesSet.has(s.nome.toUpperCase().trim()) && s.nome.toUpperCase().trim() !== nome.toUpperCase().trim())
                        .map(s => ({ nome: s.nome, departamento: s.departamento, horario: s.horario }))
                        .sort((a, b) => a.nome.localeCompare(b.nome));

                    const optionsHtml = ['<option value="">-- Escolha um colaborador escalado hoje --</option>']
                        .concat(disponiveisHoje.map(c => `<option value="${c.nome}">${c.nome} (${c.departamento} • ${c.horario})</option>`))
                        .join('');

                    selectSubstitute.innerHTML = optionsHtml;
                    selectSubstitute.value = '';
                }

                if (modal) {
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            }

            closeEditAbsenceModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-schedule-absence-edit');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                }
                this.editingAbsence = null;
            }

            handleSubstituteSelectChange(val) {
                const input = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-solucao-input');
                if (input && val) input.value = val;
            }

            setSubstituteFastAction(val) {
                const input = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-solucao-input');
                const sel = document.getElementById('modal-abs-substitute-select');
                if (input) input.value = val;
                if (sel && !val) sel.value = '';
            }

            setEditMotivo(motivo) {
                const input = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-situacao-input');
                if (input) input.value = motivo;
                this.updateEditMotivoButtons(motivo);
            }

            updateEditMotivoButtons(activeMotivo) {
                const mNorm = String(activeMotivo || '').toUpperCase().trim();
                const btnAtestado = document.getElementById('btn-edit-motivo-atestado');
                const btnFerias = document.getElementById('btn-edit-motivo-ferias');
                const btnFeriado = document.getElementById('btn-edit-motivo-feriado');

                const activeCls = 'py-2 px-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-md text-white';
                const inactiveCls = 'py-2 px-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer bg-gray-950 hover:bg-gray-800';

                if (btnAtestado) {
                    btnAtestado.className = (mNorm.includes('ATESTADO') || mNorm.includes('MEDIC'))
                        ? activeCls + ' bg-rose-600 border-rose-500'
                        : inactiveCls + ' text-rose-300 border-rose-900/60';
                }
                if (btnFerias) {
                    btnFerias.className = mNorm.includes('FERIA')
                        ? activeCls + ' bg-cyan-600 border-cyan-500'
                        : inactiveCls + ' text-cyan-300 border-cyan-900/60';
                }
                if (btnFeriado) {
                    btnFeriado.className = mNorm.includes('FERIADO')
                        ? activeCls + ' bg-amber-600 border-amber-500'
                        : inactiveCls + ' text-amber-300 border-amber-900/60';
                }
            }

            setNewMotivo(motivo) {
                const input = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-situacao-input');
                if (input) input.value = motivo;
                this.updateNewMotivoButtons(motivo);
            }

            updateNewMotivoButtons(activeMotivo) {
                const mNorm = String(activeMotivo || '').toUpperCase().trim();
                const btnAtestado = document.getElementById('btn-new-motivo-atestado');
                const btnFerias = document.getElementById('btn-new-motivo-ferias');
                const btnFeriado = document.getElementById('btn-new-motivo-feriado');

                const activeCls = 'py-2 px-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-md text-white';
                const inactiveCls = 'py-2 px-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer bg-gray-950 hover:bg-gray-800';

                if (btnAtestado) {
                    btnAtestado.className = (mNorm.includes('ATESTADO') || mNorm.includes('MEDIC'))
                        ? activeCls + ' bg-rose-600 border-rose-500'
                        : inactiveCls + ' text-rose-300 border-rose-900/60';
                }
                if (btnFerias) {
                    btnFerias.className = mNorm.includes('FERIA')
                        ? activeCls + ' bg-cyan-600 border-cyan-500'
                        : inactiveCls + ' text-cyan-300 border-cyan-900/60';
                }
                if (btnFeriado) {
                    btnFeriado.className = mNorm.includes('FERIADO')
                        ? activeCls + ' bg-amber-600 border-amber-500'
                        : inactiveCls + ' text-amber-300 border-amber-900/60';
                }
            }

            async saveAbsenceModalSubmit() {
                if (!this.editingAbsence) return;
                const input = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-solucao-input');
                const solucao = input ? input.value.trim() : '';

                let { tipo, linha, nome, depto } = this.editingAbsence;
                const inputSit = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-situacao-input');
                let situacao = inputSit ? inputSit.value.trim().toUpperCase() : '';

                const toggleFer = document.getElementById('modal-abs-edit-feriado-toggle');
                const isFerChecked = toggleFer ? toggleFer.checked : false;

                if (isFerChecked) {
                    situacao = 'FERIADO';
                }

                if (tipo === 'ausencia' && !situacao) {
                    situacao = 'ATESTADO';
                }

                this.closeEditAbsenceModal();
                await this.saveAbsenceCoverage(tipo, linha, nome, depto, solucao, situacao);
            }

            async confirmRemoveAbsence() {
                if (!this.editingAbsence) return;
                const { tipo, linha, nome } = this.editingAbsence;

                if (!confirm(`Deseja realmente remover o registro de ${nome} (Linha ${linha}) e limpar esta linha na planilha?`)) {
                    return;
                }

                this.closeEditAbsenceModal();
                await this.removeAbsenceEntry(tipo, linha);
            }

            async saveAbsenceCoverage(tipo, linha, nome, depto, solucao, situacao = '') {
                const diaInfo = this.getCurrentDayData();
                if (!diaInfo) return;

                // 1. Atualização Otimista Instantânea (0ms de espera)
                if (tipo === 'folga') {
                    if (!diaInfo.folgas) diaInfo.folgas = [];
                    const item = diaInfo.folgas.find(f => f.linha === linha);
                    if (item) {
                        item.solucao = solucao;
                        item.departamento = depto;
                    } else {
                        diaInfo.folgas.push({ linha, nome, departamento: depto, solucao, tipo: 'folga' });
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas) diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas = [];
                    const item = diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas.find(a => a.linha === linha);
                    if (item) {
                        item.solucao = solucao;
                        item.departamento = depto;
                        item.situacao = situacao;
                        item.isFeriado = situacao.toUpperCase().includes('FERIADO');
                    } else {
                        diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas.push({
                            linha, nome, departamento: depto, solucao,
                            situacao: situacao || 'ATESTADO',
                            tipo: 'ausencia',
                            isFeriado: (situacao || '').toUpperCase().includes('FERIADO')
                        });
                    }
                }

                // Salva no localStorage e re-renderiza o card imediatamente
                try { localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_data', JSON.stringify(this.data)); } catch(e) {}
                this.renderStatsAndAbsences();

                if (window.notifications) {
                    notifications.showToast(`✓ Cobertura de ${nome} salva com sucesso!`, 'success');
                }

                // 2. Sincroniza em segundo plano com a Planilha Google (gravando a coluna SITUAÇÃO!)
                await this.syncAbsenceToGoogleSheets(tipo, linha, nome, depto, solucao, situacao);
            }

            async removeAbsenceEntry(tipo, linha) {
                const diaInfo = this.getCurrentDayData();
                if (!diaInfo) return;

                // 1. Otimista
                if (tipo === 'folga' && diaInfo.folgas) {
                    diaInfo.folgas = diaInfo.folgas.filter(f => f.linha !== linha);
                } else if (diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas) {
                    diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas = diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas.filter(a => a.linha !== linha);
                }

                // Atualiza lista unificada de ausencias
                const folgaNames = (diaInfo.folgas || []).map(f => f.nome);
                const ausNames = (diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas || []).map(a => a.nome);
                diaInfo.ausencias = Array.from(new Set([...folgaNames, ...ausNames]));

                try { localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_data', JSON.stringify(this.data)); } catch(e) {}
                this.renderStatsAndAbsences();
                this.renderColabSelect();

                if (window.notifications) {
                    notifications.showToast('✓ Registro removido da planilha Google!', 'info');
                }

                // 2. Limpa as células na Planilha Google
                await this.syncAbsenceToGoogleSheets(tipo, linha, '', '', '');
            }

            openNewAbsenceModal(defaultTipo = 'folga') {
                this.newAbsenceType = defaultTipo;

                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-schedule-absence-new');
                const titleEl = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-title');
                const dayEl = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-day-label');
                const selColab = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-colab-select');
                const inputDepto = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-depto-input');
                const selSub = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-substitute-select');
                const inputSol = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-solucao-input');

                if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = defaultTipo === 'folga' ? 'Registrar Nova Folga' : 'Registrar Atestado / Ausência';
                if (dayEl) dayEl.innerText = `Dia selecionado: ${this.currentDay} (${this.data?.dias?.[this.currentDay]?.data || ''})`;

                this.setNewAbsenceType(defaultTipo);

                // Preenche colaboradores do Banco de Dados
                if (selColab) {
                    const todosColabs = (this.data?.colaboradores || []).slice().sort((a, b) => a.nome.localeCompare(b.nome));
                    selColab.innerHTML = ['<option value="">-- Selecione o colaborador --</option>']
                        .concat(todosColabs.map(c => `<option value="${c.nome}">${c.nome} (${c.departamento || 'Geral'})</option>`))
                        .join('');
                    selColab.value = '';
                }

                if (inputDepto) inputDepto.value = '';
                if (inputSol) inputSol.value = '';
                const toggleNewFer = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-feriado-toggle');
                if (toggleNewFer) toggleNewFer.checked = false;

                // Preenche substitutos escalados hoje
                if (selSub) {
                    const diaInfo = this.getCurrentDayData();
                    const ausentesSet = new Set((diaInfo?.ausencias || []).map(n => String(n).toUpperCase().trim()));
                    const slots = this.getCleanSlots(this.currentDay);

                    const disponiveisHoje = slots
                        .filter(s => !s.isVago && s.nome && s.nome !== '-' && s.nome.toUpperCase() !== 'VAGO' && !ausentesSet.has(s.nome.toUpperCase().trim()))
                        .map(s => ({ nome: s.nome, departamento: s.departamento, horario: s.horario }))
                        .sort((a, b) => a.nome.localeCompare(b.nome));

                    selSub.innerHTML = ['<option value="">-- Selecionar substituto escalado hoje --</option>']
                        .concat(disponiveisHoje.map(c => `<option value="${c.nome}">${c.nome} (${c.departamento} • ${c.horario})</option>`))
                        .join('');
                    selSub.value = '';
                }

                if (modal) {
                    modal.style.display = 'flex';
                    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            }

            closeNewAbsenceModal() {
                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-schedule-absence-new');
                if (modal) {
                    modal.style.display = 'none';
                    modal.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

            setNewAbsenceType(tipo) {
                this.newAbsenceType = tipo;
                const btnFolga = document.getElementById('btn-new-type-folga');
                const btnAus = document.getElementById('btn-new-type-ausencia');
                const motivoBox = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-motivo-box');

                if (motivoBox) {
                    if (tipo === 'ausencia') {
                        motivoBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                        const curSit = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-situacao-input')?.value || 'ATESTADO';
                        this.setNewMotivo(curSit);
                    } else {
                        motivoBox.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }

                if (tipo === 'folga') {
                    if (btnFolga) btnFolga.className = 'p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer bg-teal-600 text-white border-teal-500 shadow-md';
                    if (btnAus) btnAus.className = 'p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer bg-gray-800 text-gray-300 border-gray-700 hover:text-white';
                } else {
                    if (btnFolga) btnFolga.className = 'p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer bg-gray-800 text-gray-300 border-gray-700 hover:text-white';
                    if (btnAus) btnAus.className = 'p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-500 shadow-md';
                }
            }

            handleNewAbsenceColabChange(nome) {
                const colab = (this.data?.colaboradores || []).find(c => c.nome === nome);
                const inputDepto = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-depto-input');
                if (colab && inputDepto) {
                    inputDepto.value = colab.departamento || '';
                }
            }

            async saveNewAbsenceModalSubmit() {
                const selColab = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-colab-select');
                const inputDepto = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-depto-input');
                const inputSol = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-solucao-input');
                const toggleFer = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-feriado-toggle');
                const inputSit = document.getElementById('modal-abs-new-situacao-input');

                const nome = selColab ? selColab.value.trim() : '';
                let depto = inputDepto ? inputDepto.value.trim().toUpperCase() : 'GERAL';
                const isFerChecked = toggleFer ? toggleFer.checked : false;
                const solucao = inputSol ? inputSol.value.trim() : '';
                let situacao = inputSit ? inputSit.value.trim().toUpperCase() : '';

                if (isFerChecked) {
                    situacao = 'FERIADO';
                }

                const tipo = this.newAbsenceType || 'folga';
                if (tipo === 'ausencia' && !situacao) {
                    situacao = 'ATESTADO';
                }

                if (!nome) {
                    alert('Por favor, selecione um colaborador.');
                    return;
                }

                const diaInfo = this.getCurrentDayData();
                if (!diaInfo) return;

                // Encontra a primeira linha vaga entre as linhas 6 e 12
                const itemsExistentes = tipo === 'folga' ? (diaInfo.folgas || []) : (diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas || []);
                const linhasOcupadas = new Set(itemsExistentes.map(i => i.linha));

                let targetLinha = null;
                for (let l = 6; l <= 12; l++) {
                    if (!linhasOcupadas.has(l)) {
                        targetLinha = l;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!targetLinha) {
                    alert('Aviso: Todas as 7 linhas (6 a 12) para este dia já estão preenchidas. Edite uma linha existente ou libere um posto.');
                    return;
                }

                this.closeNewAbsenceModal();

                // 1. Otimista
                if (tipo === 'folga') {
                    if (!diaInfo.folgas) diaInfo.folgas = [];
                    diaInfo.folgas.push({ linha: targetLinha, nome, departamento: depto, solucao, tipo: 'folga' });
                } else {
                    if (!diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas) diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas = [];
                    diaInfo.ausenciasCompletas.push({
                        linha: targetLinha, nome, departamento: depto, solucao,
                        situacao: situacao,
                        tipo: 'ausencia',
                        isFeriado: situacao.toUpperCase().includes('FERIADO')
                    });
                }

                if (!diaInfo.ausencias) diaInfo.ausencias = [];
                if (!diaInfo.ausencias.includes(nome)) diaInfo.ausencias.push(nome);

                try { localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_data', JSON.stringify(this.data)); } catch(e) {}
                this.renderStatsAndAbsences();
                this.renderColabSelect();

                if (window.notifications) {
                    notifications.showToast(`✓ ${tipo === 'folga' ? 'Folga' : situacao} de ${nome} registrada com sucesso!`, 'success');
                }

                // 2. Sincroniza em segundo plano
                await this.syncAbsenceToGoogleSheets(tipo, targetLinha, nome, depto, solucao, situacao);
            }

            async syncAbsenceToGoogleSheets(tipo, linha, nome, depto, solucao, situacao = '') {
                if (!this.webAppUrl) return;

                const cfgCol = this.getDayColConfig(this.currentDay);
                const safeDepto = (depto || '').replace(/"/g, '\"');
                const safeNome = (nome || '').replace(/"/g, '\"');
                const safeSol = (solucao || '').replace(/"/g, '\"');
                const safeSit = (situacao || '').replace(/"/g, '\"');

                let code = '';
                if (tipo === 'folga') {
                    // Colunas B, C, D (Folgas: Nome, Depto, Solução)
                    code = `var s = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName("Diaria"); s.getRange(${linha}, ${cfgCol.colDepto}).setValue("${safeNome}"); s.getRange(${linha}, ${cfgCol.colDepto + 1}).setValue("${safeDepto}"); s.getRange(${linha}, ${cfgCol.colDepto + 2}).setValue("${safeSol}");`;
                } else {
                    // Colunas E, F, G, H (Ausências: Nome, Depto, SITUAÇÃO, Solução)
                    code = `var s = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName("Diaria"); s.getRange(${linha}, ${cfgCol.colDepto + 3}).setValue("${safeNome}"); s.getRange(${linha}, ${cfgCol.colDepto + 4}).setValue("${safeDepto}"); s.getRange(${linha}, ${cfgCol.colDepto + 5}).setValue("${safeSit}"); s.getRange(${linha}, ${cfgCol.colDepto + 6}).setValue("${safeSol}");`;
                }

                try {
                    // Gravação direta ao vivo via POST no Google Apps Script
                    await fetch(this.webAppUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'execute_command', code: code })
                    });
                } catch (err) {
                    try {
                        const url = this.webAppUrl + (this.webAppUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'action=execute_command&code=' + encodeURIComponent(code) + '&t=' + Date.now();
                        await fetch(url, { redirect: 'follow' });
                    } catch(err2) {
                        console.warn('[Schedule] Erro ao sincronizar ausência com Google Sheets:', err2);
                    }
                }
            }

            setViewMode(mode) {
                this.viewMode = mode;
                try { localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_view_mode', mode); } catch(e) {}
                this.updateViewModeButtons();
                this.renderSlots();
            }

            updateViewModeButtons() {
                const btnCards = document.getElementById('sched-view-cards');
                const btnTable = document.getElementById('sched-view-table');
                const activeCls = 'px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer bg-teal-600 text-white shadow';
                const inactiveCls = 'px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer text-gray-400 hover:text-white';
                if (btnCards) btnCards.className = (this.viewMode === 'cards' ? activeCls : inactiveCls);
                if (btnTable) btnTable.className = (this.viewMode === 'table' ? activeCls : inactiveCls);
            }

            // ===============================================================
            // PAINEL LATERAL INTERATIVO: PESSOAS DE FOLGA NO DIA (REQUISITO 3)
            // ===============================================================
            toggleShowFolgas(forceState) {
                this.showFolgas = (forceState !== undefined) ? !!forceState : !this.showFolgas;
                try { localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_show_folgas', this.showFolgas); } catch (e) {}
                this.updateFolgasButtonState();
                this.renderSlots();

            filterFolgasSidePanel(q) {
                this.folgasFilterQuery = String(q || '').trim();
                const container = document.getElementById('sched-side-folgas-content');
                if (container) {
                    container.innerHTML = this.buildInteractiveFolgasList();
                }
            }

            updateFolgasButtonState() {
                const btn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-folgas');
                const badge = document.getElementById('badge-folgas-count');
                const folgas = this.getFolgasForDay(this.currentDay);
                if (badge) badge.innerText = folgas.length;

                if (btn) {
                    if (this.showFolgas) {
                        btn.className = "px-3 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white border border-indigo-400 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition shadow-lg shadow-indigo-950/60 cursor-pointer";
                    } else {
                        btn.className = "px-3 py-2 bg-indigo-950/70 hover:bg-indigo-900 active:scale-95 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition shadow cursor-pointer";
                    }
                }
            }

            getFolgasForDay(dia) {
                dia = dia || this.currentDay;
                const norm = s => String(s || '').toUpperCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").trim();
                const diaNorm = norm(dia);

                const diaMap = {
                    'SEGUNDA': ['2A', '2', 'SEGUNDA', 'SEG'],
                    'TERCA': ['3A', '3', 'TERCA', 'TER'],
                    'QUARTA': ['4A', '4', 'QUARTA', 'QUA'],
                    'QUINTA': ['5A', '5', 'QUINTA', 'QUI'],
                    'SEXTA': ['6A', '6', 'SEXTA', 'SEX'],
                    'SABADO': ['SABADO', 'SAB'],
                    'DOMINGO': ['DOMINGO', 'DOM']
                };
                const targetKeys = diaMap[diaNorm] || [diaNorm];

                const folgasMap = new Map();

                // 1. Folgas explícitas da Diária (linhas 5 a 12 da planilha)
                const diaInfo = (this.data && this.data.dias) ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                if (diaInfo && diaInfo.folgas) {
                    diaInfo.folgas.forEach(f => {
                        const n = String(f.nome || '').trim();
                        if (this.isValidPersonName(n)) {
                            const cNorm = norm(n);
                            folgasMap.set(cNorm, {
                                nome: n,
                                departamento: this.getCollabDepartment(n) || f.departamento || 'Geral',
                                motivo: f.motivo || 'Folga da Escala Diária'
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }

                // 2. Colaboradores do Banco de Dados
                const colabs = (this.data && this.data.colaboradores) ? this.data.colaboradores : [];
                colabs.forEach(c => {
                    const cNome = String(c.nome || '').trim();
                    if (!this.isValidPersonName(cNome)) return;
                    const cNorm = norm(cNome);

                    const f1 = norm(c.folga || '');
                    const f2 = norm(c.folga2 || '');
                    const isMatch = targetKeys.some(k => f1.includes(k) || f2.includes(k));

                    if (isMatch) {
                        if (!folgasMap.has(cNorm)) {
                            folgasMap.set(cNorm, {
                                nome: cNome,
                                cracha: c.cracha || '',
                                escala: c.escala || '',
                                departamento: c.departamento || this.getCollabDepartment(cNome) || 'Geral',
                                motivo: 'Folga (' + (c.folga || dia) + ')'
                            });
                        }
                    }
                });

                return Array.from(folgasMap.values());
            }

            buildInteractiveFolgasList() {
                const dia = this.currentDay;
                const folgas = this.getFolgasForDay(dia);
                const q = String(this.folgasFilterQuery || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                const filtered = q 
                    ? folgas.filter(f => f.nome.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (f.departamento && f.departamento.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
                    : folgas;

                if (filtered.length === 0) {
                    return '<div class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-gray-400 bg-gray-900/40 rounded-xl border border-gray-800/60">' +
                        (q ? 'Nenhum colaborador encontrado para "' + this.escHtml(q) + '"' : 'Nenhuma folga registrada para ' + dia) +
                    '</div>';
                }

                let html = '<div class="space-y-2">';
                filtered.forEach(f => {
                    html += '<div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gray-900/80 border border-indigo-950/80 hover:border-indigo-800/60 transition flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shadow-sm">' +
                        '<div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">' +
                            '<div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-indigo-950 border border-indigo-800/60 text-indigo-300 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shrink-0">' +
                                f.nome.charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
                            '</div>' +
                            '<div class="min-w-0">' +
                                '<div class="font-bold text-xs text-gray-200 truncate">' + this.escHtml(f.nome) + '</div>' +
                                '<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-gray-400 truncate">' +
                                    '<span class="text-teal-400 font-semibold truncate">' + this.escHtml(f.departamento || 'Geral') + '</span>' +
                                    (f.escala ? '<span class="text-gray-600">•</span><span class="text-indigo-400">' + this.escHtml(f.escala) + '</span>' : '') +
                                '</div>' +
                            '</div>' +
                        '</div>' +
                        '<div class="shrink-0 text-right">' +
                            '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-rose-950/70 border border-rose-800/60 text-rose-300 text-[10px] font-black tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1">' +
                                '<i class="fa-solid fa-umbrella-beach text-[9px]"></i> FOLGA' +
                            '</span>' +
                        '</div>' +
                    '</div>';
                });
                html += '</div>';
                return html;
            }
