            renderSlots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('schedule-slots-grid');
                if (!container) return;

                this.updateFolgasButtonState();

                const diaInfo = this.getCurrentDayData();
                if (!diaInfo || !diaInfo.slots || diaInfo.slots.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = '<div class="col-span-full p-8 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">Nenhum posto cadastrado para este dia na planilha.</div>';
                    return;
                }

                let slots = this.getCleanSlots(this.currentDay);

                // Filtros de Status (Todos / Vagas Abertas / Alocados)
                if (this.currentFilter === 'vacant') {
                    slots = slots.filter(s => s.isVago);
                } else if (this.currentFilter === 'assigned') {
                    slots = slots.filter(s => !s.isVago);
                }

                // Filtro de Departamento
                if (this.currentDeptFilter === 'uncovered') {
                    slots = slots.filter(s => s.isVago);
                } else if (this.currentDeptFilter && this.currentDeptFilter !== 'all') {
                    const targetDept = this.currentDeptFilter.toUpperCase().trim();
                    slots = slots.filter(s => {
                        const deptInfo = this.getSlotDepartmentInfo(s, this.currentDay);
                        return String(deptInfo.sector || '').toUpperCase().includes(targetDept);
                    });
                }

                // Busca por texto
                if (this.searchQuery) {
                    const q = this.searchQuery;
                    slots = slots.filter(s => {
                        const deptInfo = this.getSlotDepartmentInfo(s, this.currentDay);
                        return String(s.nome || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                            String(s.horario || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                            String(deptInfo.sector || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                            String(deptInfo.titular || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                            String(s.linha || '').includes(q);
                    });
                }

                if (slots.length === 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="col-span-full p-8 text-center bg-gray-900/60 rounded-xl border border-gray-800 space-y-3">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-users-slash text-3xl text-gray-500 block"></i>
                            <p class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-200">Nenhum posto encontrado para este filtro</p>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Não há colaboradores escalados neste departamento para ${this.currentDay}.</p>
                            <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.setDeptFilter('all')" class="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 text-white text-xs font-bold transition shadow-lg shadow-teal-900/40 cursor-pointer">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-left"></i>
                                <span>Ver Todos os Departamentos</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>`;
                    return;
                }

                const mainViewHtml = (this.viewMode === 'cards') ? this.buildCardsView(slots) : this.buildSheetTable(slots);
                this.updateViewModeButtons();

                // Requisito 3: Painel Lateral Interativo de Folgas exibido ao lado da planilha/cards
                if (this.showFolgas) {
                    container.innerHTML = 
                        '<div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-4 items-start w-full">' +
                            '<div class="flex-1 w-full min-w-0">' + mainViewHtml + '</div>' +
                            '<div class="w-full lg:w-80 xl:w-96 shrink-0 bg-gray-950/95 border border-indigo-900/60 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-2xl sticky top-4 select-none">' +
                                this.buildInteractiveFolgasPanel() +
                            '</div>' +
                        '</div>';
                } else {
                    container.innerHTML = mainViewHtml;
                }
            }

            // ================= VISUALIZAÇÃO ESTILO PLANILHA =================
            escHtml(v) {
                return String(v === undefined || v === null ? '' : v)
                    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
            }

            horaToMin(v) {
                const s = String(v || '').trim();
                const m = s.match(/^([+-])?(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?$/);
                if (!m) return null;
                const t = parseInt(m[2], 10) * 60 + parseInt(m[3], 10);
                return m[1] === '-' ? -t : t;
            }

            minToHora(min, allowSign) {
                if (min === null || min === undefined || isNaN(min)) return '';
                let neg = min < 0;
                let t = Math.abs(Math.round(min));
                if (!allowSign) { t = ((Math.round(min) % 1440) + 1440) % 1440; neg = false; }
                const h = Math.floor(t / 60), m = t % 60;
                return (neg ? '-' : '') + String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0');
            }

            // Aceita "7", "730", "07:30", "7:30", "2:00", "-2:00", "+1:30", "1h30"
            normalizeHora(raw, allowSign) {
                let s = String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(',', ':').replace('.', ':').replace('h', ':');
                if (s.endsWith(':')) s = s.slice(0, -1);
                let sign = '';
                if (s.startsWith('-') || s.startsWith('+')) { sign = s[0]; s = s.slice(1).trim(); }
                if (sign && !allowSign) return null;
                let h, m;
                if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(s)) { h = parseInt(s, 10); m = 0; }
                else if (/^\d{3,4}$/.test(s)) { h = parseInt(s.slice(0, s.length - 2), 10); m = parseInt(s.slice(-2), 10); }
                else {
                    const mm = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
                    if (!mm) return null;
                    h = parseInt(mm[1], 10); m = parseInt(mm[2], 10);
                }
                if (m > 59 || (!allowSign && h > 23)) return null;
                if (h === 0 && m === 0 && allowSign) return '00:00';
                return (sign === '-' ? '-' : '') + String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0');
            }

            // Mesma regra da fórmula da coluna SAÍDA da planilha
            computeSaida(slot, dia) {
                const e = this.horaToMin(slot.entrada);
                if (e === null) return '';
                const ini = this.horaToMin(slot.inicioAlmoco) || 0;
                const ret = this.horaToMin(slot.retornoAlmoco) || 0;
                const banco = this.horaToMin(slot.banco) || 0;
                const esc = String(slot.escala || '').trim().toUpperCase();
                let jornada;
                if (dia === 'Domingo') {
                    jornada = 360;
                } else if (esc === 'SEM ESCALA') {
                    jornada = 440;
                } else {
                    const diaInfo = this.data && this.data.dias ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                    let weekEven = false;
                    const p = diaInfo && diaInfo.data ? String(diaInfo.data).split('/') : null;
                    if (p && p.length === 3) {
                        const dt = new Date(parseInt(p[2], 10), parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(p[0], 10));
                        const jan1 = new Date(dt.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
                        const doy = Math.round((dt - jan1) / 86400000);
                        const wk = Math.floor((doy + jan1.getDay()) / 7) + 1; // WEEKNUM (tipo 1) do Sheets
                        weekEven = (wk % 2 === 0);
                    }
                    const azul = esc === 'AZUL';
                    jornada = weekEven ? (azul ? 480 : 456) : (azul ? 456 : 480);
                }
                return this.minToHora(e + (ret - ini) + jornada + banco, false);
            }

            bancoClass(v) {
                const m = this.horaToMin(v);
                if (m === null || m === 0) return 'text-gray-300';
                return m > 0 ? 'text-emerald-300' : 'text-rose-300';
            }

            escalaChip(esc) {
                const e = String(esc || '').trim().toUpperCase();
                if (!e || e === 'X') return '<span class="text-gray-600">—</span>';
                let cls = 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-300 border-gray-700';
                if (e === 'AZUL') cls = 'bg-sky-950 text-sky-300 border-sky-800';
                else if (e.startsWith('VERMELH')) cls = 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-800';
                return '<span class="inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md border text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wide ' + cls + '">' + this.escHtml(e) + '</span>';
            }

            buildCardsView(slots) {
                const dia = this.currentDay;
                const diaInfo = (this.data && this.data.dias) ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                const dataStr = diaInfo && diaInfo.data ? diaInfo.data : '';
                const canEdit = this.canUserEdit();
                const editTimes = canEdit;

                const grupos = [
                    { key: 'reposicao', titulo: 'Escala da Reposição' },
                    { key: 'lideranca', titulo: 'Liderança Operacional e Monitoria' }
                ];

                let html = '<div class="space-y-4">';

                grupos.forEach(g => {
                    const rows = slots.filter(s => (s.grupo || 'reposicao') === g.key);
                    if (rows.length === 0) return;

                    html += '<div class="space-y-2.5">' +
                        '<div class="flex items-center justify-between px-1.5 py-1">' +
                            '<h4 class="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">' +
                                '<i class="fa-solid fa-users text-teal-400"></i>' +
                                '<span>' + g.titulo + '</span>' +
                                (dataStr ? '<span class="text-gray-400 font-semibold">— ' + this.escHtml(dataStr) + '</span>' : '') +
                            '</h4>' +
                            '<span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">' + rows.length + ' postos</span>' +
                        '</div>' +
                        '<div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">';

                    rows.forEach((s) => {
                        const isVacant = !!s.isVago;
                        const depto = s.departamento !== undefined ? s.departamento : (this.getSlotDepartmentInfo(s, dia).sector || '');
                        const nomeSafe = (s.nome || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
                        const horSafe = (s.horario || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
                        const openModal = 'scheduleApp.openEditSlotModal(\'' + dia + '\', ' + s.linha + ', \'' + s.colunaLetra + '\', \'' + this.escHtml(nomeSafe) + '\', \'' + this.escHtml(horSafe) + '\', ' + isVacant + ')';

                        const cardBorder = isVacant 
                            ? 'border-rose-900/60 bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-950/25 to-gray-900/90' 
                            : 'border-gray-800/80 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-900/95 to-gray-950/95';
                        const saida = s.saida || this.computeSaida(s, dia);

                        html += '<div id="schedule-slot-card-' + s.linha + '" class="rounded-xl p-3 border ' + cardBorder + ' shadow-lg flex flex-col justify-between gap-2.5 transition hover:border-gray-700 relative">' +
                            // Cabeçalho da Ficha: Departamento, Escala Chip e Linha Real
                            '<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">' +
                                '<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 flex-wrap">' +
                                    '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-teal-950/70 border border-teal-800/50 text-teal-300 font-extrabold text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider truncate max-w-[140px]">' + this.escHtml(depto || 'GERAL') + '</span>' +
                                    this.escalaChip(s.escala) +
                                '</div>' +
                                '<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 text-[10px] font-mono text-gray-400 font-bold shrink-0" title="Linha ' + s.linha + ' na planilha do Google">L' + s.linha + '</span>' +
                            '</div>' +

                            // Nome do Colaborador (botão para editar)
                            '<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">' +
                                (isVacant 
                                    ? '<button type="button" onclick="' + openModal + '" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-black text-xs tracking-wide shadow cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-[10px]"></i> VAGA ABERTA <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-[9px]"></i></button>'
                                    : '<button type="button" onclick="' + openModal + '" class="group flex items-center gap-1.5 text-left cursor-pointer hover:underline decoration-teal-400 truncate" title="Substituir colaborador">' +
                                        '<span class="font-bold text-sm text-white group-hover:text-teal-200 truncate">' + this.escHtml(s.nome) + '</span>' +
                                        '<i class="fa-solid fa-pen text-gray-500 group-hover:text-teal-300 text-[10px]"></i>' +
                                      '</button>') +
                            '</div>' +

                            // Grade dos 4 campos de horários (Entrada, Início Alm, Retorno Alm, Banco)
                            (isVacant 
                                ? '<div class="bg-rose-950/20 border border-rose-900/40 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-center text-xs text-rose-300 font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2">' +
                                    '<i class="fa-solid fa-clock-slash text-rose-400"></i>' +
                                    '<span>Sem horário definido (Vaga Aberta)</span>' +
                                  '</div>'
                                : '<div class="bg-gray-950/70 rounded-xl p-2 border border-gray-800/60 grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 text-center">' +
                                // Entrada
                                '<div>' +
                                    '<label class="block text-[9px] font-extrabold uppercase text-gray-400 mb-0.5">Entrada</label>' +
                                    (editTimes 
                                        ? '<input type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" maxlength="5" value="' + this.escHtml(s.entrada || '') + '" placeholder="--:--" ' +
                                          'data-dia="' + this.escHtml(dia) + '" data-linha="' + s.linha + '" data-campo="entrada" data-old="' + this.escHtml(s.entrada || '') + '" ' +
                                          'onfocus="this.select()" oninput="scheduleApp.previewSaidaInline(this)" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){this.blur();}" onchange="scheduleApp.saveCellInline(this)" ' +
                                          'class="sched-cell-input w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 hover:border-gray-500 focus:border-teal-400 rounded-lg py-1 px-0.5 text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white placeholder-gray-600 focus:outline-none transition">'
                                        : '<span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-gray-200">' + (s.entrada || '—') + '</span>') +
                                '</div>' +
                                // Início Almoço
                                '<div>' +
                                    '<label class="block text-[9px] font-extrabold uppercase text-gray-400 mb-0.5">Início Alm.</label>' +
                                    (editTimes 
                                        ? '<input type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" maxlength="5" value="' + this.escHtml(s.inicioAlmoco || '') + '" placeholder="--:--" ' +
                                          'data-dia="' + this.escHtml(dia) + '" data-linha="' + s.linha + '" data-campo="inicioAlmoco" data-old="' + this.escHtml(s.inicioAlmoco || '') + '" ' +
                                          'onfocus="this.select()" oninput="scheduleApp.previewSaidaInline(this)" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){this.blur();}" onchange="scheduleApp.saveCellInline(this)" ' +
                                          'class="sched-cell-input w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 hover:border-gray-500 focus:border-teal-400 rounded-lg py-1 px-0.5 text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white placeholder-gray-600 focus:outline-none transition">'
                                        : '<span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-gray-200">' + (s.inicioAlmoco || '—') + '</span>') +
                                '</div>' +
                                // Retorno Almoço
                                '<div>' +
                                    '<label class="block text-[9px] font-extrabold uppercase text-gray-400 mb-0.5">Retorno</label>' +
                                    (editTimes 
                                        ? '<input type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" maxlength="5" value="' + this.escHtml(s.retornoAlmoco || '') + '" placeholder="--:--" ' +
                                          'data-dia="' + this.escHtml(dia) + '" data-linha="' + s.linha + '" data-campo="retornoAlmoco" data-old="' + this.escHtml(s.retornoAlmoco || '') + '" ' +
                                          'onfocus="this.select()" oninput="scheduleApp.previewSaidaInline(this)" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){this.blur();}" onchange="scheduleApp.saveCellInline(this)" ' +
                                          'class="sched-cell-input w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 hover:border-gray-500 focus:border-teal-400 rounded-lg py-1 px-0.5 text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white placeholder-gray-600 focus:outline-none transition">'
                                        : '<span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-gray-200">' + (s.retornoAlmoco || '—') + '</span>') +
                                '</div>' +
                                // Banco de Horas
                                '<div>' +
                                    '<label class="block text-[9px] font-extrabold uppercase text-gray-400 mb-0.5">Banco</label>' +
                                    (editTimes 
                                        ? '<input type="text" autocomplete="off" maxlength="6" value="' + this.escHtml(s.banco || '') + '" placeholder="±0:00" ' +
                                          'data-dia="' + this.escHtml(dia) + '" data-linha="' + s.linha + '" data-campo="banco" data-old="' + this.escHtml(s.banco || '') + '" ' +
                                          'onfocus="this.select()" oninput="scheduleApp.previewSaidaInline(this)" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){this.blur();}" onchange="scheduleApp.saveCellInline(this)" ' +
                                          'class="sched-cell-input w-full bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 hover:border-gray-500 focus:border-teal-400 rounded-lg py-1 px-0.5 text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold ' + this.bancoClass(s.banco) + ' placeholder-gray-600 focus:outline-none transition">'
                                        : '<span class="text-xs font-mono font-bold ' + this.bancoClass(s.banco) + '">' + (s.banco || '±0:00') + '</span>') +
                                '</div>' +
                            '</div>') +

                            // Rodapé da Ficha: Saída Calculada
                            '<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1 border-t border-gray-800/40">' +
                                '<span class="text-gray-400 text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">' +
                                    '<i class="fa-solid fa-lock text-[9px] text-gray-500"></i>' +
                                    '<span>Saída Calculada:</span>' +
                                '</span>' +
                                '<span id="sched-saida-' + s.linha + '" class="font-mono font-extrabold text-sm text-teal-300 bg-teal-950/60 border border-teal-800/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg">' + (saida ? this.escHtml(saida) : '—') + '</span>' +
                            '</div>' +
                        '</div>';
                    });

                    html += '</div></div>';
                });

                html += '</div>';
                return html;
            }

            buildSheetTable(slots) {
                const dia = this.currentDay;
                const diaInfo = (this.data && this.data.dias) ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                const dataStr = diaInfo && diaInfo.data ? diaInfo.data : '';
                const canEdit = this.canUserEdit();
                const editTimes = canEdit;
                const temHorarios = slots.some(s => s.entrada !== undefined && s.entrada !== '');

                const grupos = [
                    { key: 'reposicao', titulo: 'Escala da Reposição' },
                    { key: 'lideranca', titulo: 'Liderança Operacional e Monitoria' }
                ];

                let html = '';
                if (!temHorarios) {
                    html += '<div class="p-3 rounded-xl border border-teal-800/60 bg-teal-950/40 text-teal-200 text-xs flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-sm">' +
                        '<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><i class="fa-solid fa-clock text-teal-400"></i><span>Edição direta de Entrada, Almoço e Banco de Horas ativa nas células abaixo. (Saída é calculada e travada)</span></div>' +
                        '<button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.copyAppsScriptCode()" class="shrink-0 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 text-white font-bold text-[11px] transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow"><i class="fa-solid fa-copy"></i> Copiar Script v2 da Planilha</button>' +
                        '</div>';
                }

                const timeCell = (s, campo) => {
                    const v = (s.isVago ? '' : (s[campo] || ''));
                    if (s.isVago) {
                        return '<td class="px-1.5 py-1.5 text-center font-mono text-gray-600 text-xs">—</td>';
                    }
                    if (!editTimes) return '<td class="px-1.5 py-1.5 text-center font-mono text-gray-200">' + (v ? this.escHtml(v) : '<span class="text-gray-600">—</span>') + '</td>';
                    return '<td class="px-1 py-1 text-center"><input type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" maxlength="5" value="' + this.escHtml(v) + '" placeholder="--:--" ' +
                        'data-dia="' + this.escHtml(dia) + '" data-linha="' + s.linha + '" data-campo="' + campo + '" data-old="' + this.escHtml(v) + '" ' +
                        'onfocus="this.select()" oninput="scheduleApp.previewSaidaInline(this)" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){this.blur();}" onchange="scheduleApp.saveCellInline(this)" ' +
                        'class="sched-cell-input w-[58px] bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 hover:border-gray-600 focus:border-teal-400 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-center font-mono text-xs text-gray-100 placeholder-gray-700 focus:outline-none transition"></td>';
                };

                grupos.forEach(g => {
                    const rows = slots.filter(s => (s.grupo || 'reposicao') === g.key);
                    if (rows.length === 0) return;

                    html += '<div class="rounded-xl border border-gray-800 bg-gray-900/60 overflow-hidden">' +
                        '<div class="px-3 py-2 border-b border-gray-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-gray-900">' +
                        '<h4 class="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-300">' + g.titulo + (dataStr ? ' <span class="text-gray-400 font-semibold">— ' + this.escHtml(dataStr) + '</span>' : '') + '</h4>' +
                        '<span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500">' + rows.length + ' linha(s)</span></div>' +
                        '<div class="md:hidden px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-950 border-b border-gray-800 text-[11px] text-gray-400 flex items-center justify-between"><span>↔️ Arraste p/ ver horários</span><button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.setViewMode(\'cards\')" class="text-teal-400 font-bold hover:underline">Ver em Cards 📱</button></div>' +
                        '<div class="overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar"><table class="w-full min-w-[760px] text-xs border-collapse">' +
                        '<thead><tr class="bg-gray-950 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400">' +
                        '<th class="px-2 py-2 text-left font-bold">Departamento</th>' +
                        '<th class="px-2 py-2 text-left font-bold sticky left-0 bg-gray-950 z-10 max-w-[125px] sm:max-w-none truncate">Nome</th>' +
                        '<th class="px-1.5 py-2 text-center font-bold">Escala</th>' +
                        '<th class="px-1.5 py-2 text-center font-bold">Entrada</th>' +
                        '<th class="px-1.5 py-2 text-center font-bold">Início Alm.</th>' +
                        '<th class="px-1.5 py-2 text-center font-bold">Retorno Alm.</th>' +
                        '<th class="px-1.5 py-2 text-center font-bold" title="Calculada automaticamente pela planilha"><i class="fa-solid fa-lock text-[9px] mr-1 text-gray-500"></i>Saída</th>' +
                        '<th class="px-1.5 py-2 text-center font-bold" title="Positivo faz banco, negativo reduz banco (ex: 2:00 ou -2:00)">Banco</th>' +
                        '<th class="px-1.5 py-2 text-center font-bold">L</th>' +
                        '</tr></thead><tbody>';

                    rows.forEach((s, idx) => {
                        const isVacant = !!s.isVago;
                        const depto = s.departamento !== undefined ? s.departamento : (this.getSlotDepartmentInfo(s, dia).sector || '');
                        const rowBg = isVacant ? 'bg-rose-950/30' : (idx % 2 ? 'bg-gray-900/40' : 'bg-gray-950/40');
                        const stickyBg = isVacant ? 'bg-[#3a1418]' : (idx % 2 ? 'bg-[#111522]' : 'bg-[#0b0e17]');
                        const nomeSafe = (s.nome || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
                        const horSafe = (s.horario || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
                        const openModal = 'scheduleApp.openEditSlotModal(\'' + dia + '\', ' + s.linha + ', \'' + s.colunaLetra + '\', \'' + this.escHtml(nomeSafe) + '\', \'' + this.escHtml(horSafe) + '\', ' + isVacant + ')';

                        let nomeHtml;
                        if (isVacant) {
                            nomeHtml = '<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#ea4335] text-white font-black text-[10px] tracking-wide"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-[9px]"></i> VAGO</span>';
                        } else {
                            nomeHtml = '<span class="font-bold text-white">' + this.escHtml(s.nome) + '</span>';
                        }
                        if (canEdit) {
                            nomeHtml = '<button type="button" onclick="' + openModal + '" class="group inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-left cursor-pointer hover:underline decoration-teal-500/60" title="' + (isVacant ? 'Alocar colaborador' : 'Substituir colaborador') + '">' + nomeHtml +
                                '<i class="fa-solid ' + (isVacant ? 'fa-plus text-rose-300' : 'fa-pen text-gray-600 group-hover:text-teal-300') + ' text-[9px]"></i></button>';
                        }

                        const saida = s.saida || this.computeSaida(s, dia);
                        let bancoCell;
                        if (editTimes) {
                            bancoCell = '<td class="px-1 py-1 text-center"><input type="text" autocomplete="off" maxlength="6" value="' + this.escHtml(s.banco || '') + '" placeholder="±0:00" ' +
                                'data-dia="' + this.escHtml(dia) + '" data-linha="' + s.linha + '" data-campo="banco" data-old="' + this.escHtml(s.banco || '') + '" ' +
                                'onfocus="this.select()" oninput="scheduleApp.previewSaidaInline(this)" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){this.blur();}" onchange="scheduleApp.saveCellInline(this)" ' +
                                'class="sched-cell-input w-[62px] bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 hover:border-gray-600 focus:border-teal-400 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold ' + this.bancoClass(s.banco) + ' placeholder-gray-700 focus:outline-none transition"></td>';
                        } else {
                            bancoCell = '<td class="px-1.5 py-1.5 text-center font-mono font-bold ' + this.bancoClass(s.banco) + '">' + (s.banco ? this.escHtml(s.banco) : '<span class="text-gray-600">—</span>') + '</td>';
                        }

                        html += '<tr id="schedule-slot-card-' + s.linha + '" class="' + rowBg + ' border-t border-gray-800/70 hover:bg-gray-800/40 transition">' +
                            '<td class="px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase text-gray-400 whitespace-nowrap">' + this.escHtml(depto) + '</td>' +
                            '<td class="px-2 py-1.5 whitespace-nowrap sticky left-0 z-10 ' + stickyBg + '">' + nomeHtml + '</td>' +
                            '<td class="px-1.5 py-1.5 text-center" id="sched-escala-' + s.linha + '">' + this.escalaChip(s.escala !== undefined ? s.escala : (dia === 'Domingo' ? '' : s.horario)) + '</td>' +
                            timeCell(s, 'entrada') + timeCell(s, 'inicioAlmoco') + timeCell(s, 'retornoAlmoco') +
                            '<td class="px-1.5 py-1.5 text-center"><span id="sched-saida-' + s.linha + '" class="inline-block min-w-[52px] px-1.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-gray-800/70 border border-gray-700/60 font-mono font-bold text-teal-200 cursor-not-allowed" title="Calculada pela planilha (não editável)">' + (saida ? this.escHtml(saida) : '—') + '</span></td>' +
                            bancoCell +
                            '<td class="px-1.5 py-1.5 text-center font-mono text-[10px] text-gray-500">' + s.linha + '</td>' +
                            '</tr>';
                    });

                    html += '</tbody></table></div></div>';
                });

                if (editTimes) {
                    html += '<p class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-1.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i> Clique em um horário para editar e pressione Enter. A <strong>Saída</strong> é calculada pela planilha. No <strong>Banco</strong> use valores como <code>2:00</code> (faz banco) ou <code>-2:00</code> (reduz banco).</p>';
                }
                return html;
            }

            findSlot(dia, linha) {
                if (!this.data || !this.data.dias || !this.data.dias[dia]) return null;
                return (this.data.dias[dia].slots || []).find(s => Number(s.linha) === Number(linha)) || null;
            }

            previewSaidaInline(input) {
                const dia = input.dataset.dia;
                const linha = parseInt(input.dataset.linha, 10);
                const campo = input.dataset.campo;
                const slot = this.findSlot(dia, linha);
                if (!slot) return;
                const raw = input.value.trim();
                const isBanco = campo === 'banco';
                const norm = this.normalizeHora(raw, isBanco);
                const temp = Object.assign({}, slot, { [campo]: norm || raw });
                const saida = this.computeSaida(temp, dia);
                const saidaEl = document.getElementById('sched-saida-' + linha);
                if (saidaEl && saida) saidaEl.textContent = saida;
            }

            refreshRowDom(dia, linha) {
                if (dia !== this.currentDay) return;
                const slot = this.findSlot(dia, linha);
                if (!slot) return;
                const saidaEl = document.getElementById('sched-saida-' + linha);
                if (saidaEl) saidaEl.textContent = slot.saida || this.computeSaida(slot, dia) || '—';
                const escEl = document.getElementById('sched-escala-' + linha);
                if (escEl && slot.escala !== undefined) escEl.innerHTML = this.escalaChip(slot.escala);
                ['entrada', 'inicioAlmoco', 'retornoAlmoco', 'banco'].forEach(campo => {
                    const inp = document.querySelector('#schedule-slot-card-' + linha + ' input[data-campo="' + campo + '"]');
                    if (inp && document.activeElement !== inp) {
                        inp.value = slot[campo] || '';
                        inp.dataset.old = slot[campo] || '';
                        if (campo === 'banco') {
                            inp.classList.remove('text-emerald-300', 'text-rose-300', 'text-gray-300');
                            inp.classList.add(this.bancoClass(slot.banco));
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            applyLinhaAtualizada(dia, linha, la, rerender) {
                const slot = this.findSlot(dia, linha);
                if (!slot || !la) return;
                ['departamento', 'escala', 'entrada', 'inicioAlmoco', 'retornoAlmoco', 'saida', 'banco'].forEach(k => {
                    if (la[k] !== undefined) slot[k] = la[k];
                });
                if (dia !== 'Domingo' && la.escala !== undefined) slot.horario = la.escala;
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_data', JSON.stringify(this.data));
                if (rerender) this.render(); else this.refreshRowDom(dia, linha);
            }

            flashInput(input, status) {
                if (!input) return;
                let cls;
                if (status === true || status === 'success') {
                    cls = ['border-emerald-500', 'ring-1', 'ring-emerald-500/50'];
                } else if (status === 'warning') {
                    cls = ['border-amber-500', 'ring-1', 'ring-amber-500/50'];
                } else {
                    cls = ['border-rose-500', 'ring-1', 'ring-rose-500/50'];
                }
                input.classList.add(...cls);
                setTimeout(() => input.classList.remove(...cls), 2000);
            }

            async saveCellInline(input) {
                if (!this.canUserEdit()) return;
                const dia = input.dataset.dia;
                const linha = parseInt(input.dataset.linha, 10);
                const campo = input.dataset.campo;
                const old = input.dataset.old || '';
                const raw = input.value.trim();
                const isBanco = campo === 'banco';

                let valor = '';
                if (raw !== '') {
                    valor = this.normalizeHora(raw, isBanco);
                    if (valor === null) {
                        input.value = old;
                        this.flashInput(input, false);
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(isBanco ? 'Banco inválido. Use ex: 2:00 ou -2:00' : 'Horário inválido. Use o formato HH:MM (ex: 07:30)', 'error');
                        return;
                    }
                }
                input.value = valor;
                if (valor === old) return;
                await this.updateCell(dia, linha, campo, valor, input);
            }

            async updateCell(dia, linha, campo, valor, input) {
                const slot = this.findSlot(dia, linha);
                if (!slot) return;

                const colunasPorDia = {
                    'Segunda': { nome: 'C', entrada: 'E', inicioAlmoco: 'F', retornoAlmoco: 'G', banco: 'I' },
                    'Terça':   { nome: 'L', entrada: 'N', inicioAlmoco: 'O', retornoAlmoco: 'P', banco: 'R' },
                    'Quarta':  { nome: 'U', entrada: 'W', inicioAlmoco: 'X', retornoAlmoco: 'Y', banco: 'AA' },
                    'Quinta':  { nome: 'AD', entrada: 'AF', inicioAlmoco: 'AG', retornoAlmoco: 'AH', banco: 'AJ' },
                    'Sexta':   { nome: 'AM', entrada: 'AO', inicioAlmoco: 'AP', retornoAlmoco: 'AQ', banco: 'AS' },
                    'Sábado':  { nome: 'AV', entrada: 'AX', inicioAlmoco: 'AY', retornoAlmoco: 'AZ', banco: 'BB' },
                    'Domingo': { nome: 'BE', entrada: 'BG', inicioAlmoco: 'BH', retornoAlmoco: 'BI', banco: 'BK' }
                };
                const colLetra = colunasPorDia[dia] ? colunasPorDia[dia][campo] : null;

                // Atualização otimista + cálculo local da saída (igual à fórmula da planilha)
                slot[campo] = valor;
                slot.saida = this.computeSaida(slot, dia);
                if (input) input.dataset.old = valor;
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_schedule_data', JSON.stringify(this.data));
                this.refreshRowDom(dia, linha);

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    window.syncManager.publish({ type: 'SCHEDULE_CELL_UPDATE', dia, linha, campo, valor, timestamp: Date.now() });
                }

                if (!this.webAppUrl) { this.flashInput(input, true); return; }

                const urlV2 = this.webAppUrl + (this.webAppUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') +
                    'action=update_cell&dia=' + encodeURIComponent(dia) +
                    '&linha=' + linha +
                    '&campo=' + encodeURIComponent(campo) +
                    '&valor=' + encodeURIComponent(valor) +
                    '&colunaLetra=' + encodeURIComponent(colLetra || '') +
                    '&t=' + Date.now();

                try {
                    let res = await fetch(urlV2, { redirect: 'follow' });
                    let json = await res.json();

                    if (json && json.success && json.linhaAtualizada) {
                        this.applyLinhaAtualizada(dia, linha, json.linhaAtualizada, false);
                        this.flashInput(input, true);
                        if (window.syncManager) {
                            window.syncManager.publish({ type: 'SCHEDULE_CELL_UPDATE', dia, linha, linhaAtualizada: json.linhaAtualizada, timestamp: Date.now() });
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    // Se for alteração de NOME e o script na planilha ainda for v1, o update_slot funciona
                    if (campo === 'nome' && colLetra && json && json.dias) {
                        const urlV1 = this.webAppUrl + (this.webAppUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') +
                            'action=update_slot&dia=' + encodeURIComponent(dia) +
                            '&linha=' + linha +
                            '&colunaLetra=' + encodeURIComponent(colLetra) +
                            '&nome=' + encodeURIComponent(valor === '' ? ' ' : valor) +
                            '&t=' + Date.now();
                        res = await fetch(urlV1, { redirect: 'follow' });
                        json = await res.json();
                        if (json && json.success) {
                            this.flashInput(input, true);
                            return;
                        }
                    }

                    // Se for BANCO DE HORAS ou HORÁRIOS e o script na planilha ainda não tem a v2:
                    if (campo !== 'nome' && json && json.dias) {
                        this.flashInput(input, 'warning');
                        if (window.notifications) {
                            notifications.showToast('Salvo no TaskFlow! Para gravar na planilha Google, atualize o script api_taskflow no Google Sheets para v2.', 'warning');
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    if (json && json.success) {
                        this.flashInput(input, true);
                    } else {
                        this.flashInput(input, false);
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Erro ao salvar na planilha: ' + ((json && json.error) || 'desconhecido'), 'error');
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    console.warn('[Schedule] Erro de rede ao sincronizar célula:', err);
                    this.flashInput(input, false);
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Sem conexão com a planilha. Salvo localmente.', 'warning');
                }
            }

            copyAppsScriptCode() {
                const code = decodeURIComponent(escape(atob("")));
                if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Código do Apps Script (v3 Master) copiado!', 'success');
                        else alert('Código do Apps Script copiado!');
                    }).catch(() => { this.fallbackCopy(code); });
                } else {
                    this.fallbackCopy(code);
                }
            }

            fallbackCopy(code) {
                const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
                ta.value = code;
                document.body.appendChild(ta);
                ta.select();
                document.execCommand('copy');
                document.body.removeChild(ta);
                if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Código do Apps Script copiado!', 'success');
                else alert('Código do Apps Script copiado!');
            }

            // ==============================================================
            // ASSISTENTE OPERACIONAL IA (Vagas, Redução de BH e Auditoria)
            // ==============================================================
            toggleAiDrawer(forceState) {
                const drawer = document.getElementById('drawer-schedule-ai');
                const backdrop = document.getElementById('drawer-schedule-ai-backdrop');
                if (!drawer) return;

                const isOpen = !drawer.classList.contains('translate-x-full');
                const newState = (forceState !== undefined) ? forceState : !isOpen;

                if (newState) {
                    drawer.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
                    drawer.classList.add('translate-x-0');
                    if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.remove('hidden');
                    this.renderAiDrawer();
                } else {
                    drawer.classList.add('translate-x-full');
                    drawer.classList.remove('translate-x-0');
                    if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

            switchAiTab(tabKey) {
                this.currentAiTab = tabKey;
                const tabs = ['vacancies', 'bh', 'senior', 'audit'];
                tabs.forEach(t => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById('ai-tab-btn-' + t);
                    if (btn) {
                        if (t === tabKey) {
                            btn.className = "py-2 rounded-xl transition flex flex-col items-center gap-1 bg-purple-950/60 border border-purple-500/40 text-purple-200";
                        } else {
                            btn.className = "py-2 rounded-xl transition flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-900 hover:text-gray-200";
                        }
                    }
                });
                this.renderAiDrawer();
            }

            updateAiBadgeCount() {
                const diaInfo = this.data && this.data.dias ? this.data.dias[this.currentDay] : null;
                const vagas = (diaInfo && diaInfo.slots) ? diaInfo.slots.filter(s => s.isVago).length : 0;
                
                const badgeHeader = document.getElementById('badge-ai-vacancies');
                const badgeFab = document.getElementById('fab-ai-badge');
                
                if (badgeHeader) {
                    if (vagas > 0) {
                        badgeHeader.innerText = vagas;
                        badgeHeader.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        badgeHeader.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }
                if (badgeFab) {
                    if (vagas > 0) {
                        badgeFab.innerText = vagas;
                        badgeFab.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        badgeFab.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                }
            }

            renderAiDrawer() {
                const body = document.getElementById('ai-drawer-body');
                const footerDay = document.getElementById('ai-drawer-footer-day');
                if (footerDay) footerDay.innerText = `Dia ativo: ${this.currentDay}`;
                if (!body) return;

                const tab = this.currentAiTab || 'vacancies';
                if (tab === 'vacancies') this.renderAiVacancies(body);
                else if (tab === 'bh') this.renderAiBhReducer(body);
                else if (tab === 'senior') this.renderAiSeniorImport(body);
                else if (tab === 'audit') this.renderAiAudit(body);
            }

            getAvailableCollaboratorsForDay(dia) {
                dia = dia || this.currentDay;
                const norm = s => String(s || '').toUpperCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").trim();
                const diaTarget = norm(dia);
                const diaInfo = this.data && this.data.dias ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                const folgasDoDia = (diaInfo && diaInfo.folgas) ? diaInfo.folgas.map(f => norm(f.nome)) : [];
                const alocadosHoje = new Set((diaInfo && diaInfo.slots) ? diaInfo.slots.filter(s => !s.isVago && s.nome).map(s => norm(s.nome)) : []);

                const colabs = (this.data && this.data.colaboradores) ? this.data.colaboradores : [];
                return colabs.filter(c => {
                    const cNorm = norm(c.nome);
                    if (norm(c.folga) === diaTarget) return false;
                    if (folgasDoDia.some(f => f.includes(cNorm) || cNorm.includes(f))) return false;
                    if (alocadosHoje.has(cNorm)) return false;
                    return true;
                });
            }

            renderAiVacancies(container) {
                const dia = this.currentDay;
                const diaInfo = this.data && this.data.dias ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                const slots = (diaInfo && diaInfo.slots) ? diaInfo.slots : [];
                const vagas = slots.filter(s => s.isVago);
                const disponiveis = this.getAvailableCollaboratorsForDay(dia);

                let html = `
                    <div class="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-950/40 via-indigo-950/30 to-gray-900 border border-purple-500/30 space-y-2">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-purple-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved text-purple-400"></i>
                                <span>Diagnóstico de Vagas (${dia})</span>
                            </span>
                            <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black ${vagas.length > 0 ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40' : 'bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border border-teal-500/40'}">
                                ${vagas.length} ${vagas.length === 1 ? 'POSTO PARA ALOCAR' : 'POSTOS PARA ALOCAR'}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-300 leading-relaxed">
                            O assistente cruza as vagas do dia com os <strong>${disponiveis.length} colaboradores disponíveis</strong> (excluindo folguistas da ${dia}) para cobertura imediata.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                `;

                if (vagas.length === 0) {
                    html += `
                        <div class="p-6 rounded-xl bg-teal-950/30 border border-teal-800/40 text-center space-y-3">
                            <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-xl">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i>
                            </div>
                            <h4 class="font-bold text-sm text-teal-200">Escala 100% Preenchida!</h4>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Nenhum posto está vago na ${dia}. Todos os setores estão cobertos.</p>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    container.innerHTML = html;
                    return;
                }

                // Botão de preenchimento automático em lote
                html += `
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1">
                        <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.autoFillAllVacancies()" id="btn-ai-autofill-all" class="w-full py-2.5 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-600 to-emerald-600 hover:from-teal-500 hover:to-emerald-500 active:scale-95 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs transition shadow-lg shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles text-amber-300"></i>
                            <span>Preencher Todas as Vagas (${Math.min(vagas.length, disponiveis.length)}) em 1 Clique</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="space-y-3 pt-2">
                `;

                vagas.forEach((v, idx) => {
                    const deptInfo = this.getSlotDepartmentInfo(v, dia);
                    const setorNome = deptInfo.hasRealSector ? deptInfo.sector : (deptInfo.titular ? `Posto de ${deptInfo.titular}` : 'Posto Vago');
                    const sugestao = disponiveis[idx % disponiveis.length];

                    html += `
                        <div class="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 hover:border-gray-700 transition space-y-2.5">
                            <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                                <div>
                                    <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30 font-black text-[10px]">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> VAGO • LINHA ${v.linha}
                                    </span>
                                    <h5 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-100 mt-1">${this.escHtml(setorNome)}</h5>
                                    <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-mono mt-0.5"><i class="fa-regular fa-clock text-teal-400"></i> ${v.horario || '08:00 às 16:20'}</p>
                                </div>
                                <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.openEditSlotModal('${dia}', ${v.linha}, '${v.colunaLetra}', '', '${this.escHtml(v.horario)}', true)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-teal-300 text-[11px] font-bold transition">
                                    Abrir Modal
                                </button>
                            </div>

                            ${sugestao ? `
                            <div class="pt-2 border-t border-gray-800/80 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <div class="min-w-0">
                                    <p class="text-[10px] text-purple-300 font-bold uppercase">Sugestão da IA:</p>
                                    <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-white truncate">${this.escHtml(sugestao.nome)} <span class="text-gray-400 font-normal">• ${sugestao.escala}</span></p>
                                </div>
                                <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.autoFillSingleVacancy('${dia}', ${v.linha}, '${v.colunaLetra}', '${this.escHtml(sugestao.nome)}')" class="shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 active:scale-95 text-white font-bold text-xs transition shadow flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Alocar
                                </button>
                            </div>
                            ` : '<p class="text-[11px] text-amber-400">Sem mais colaboradores disponíveis sem folga hoje.</p>'}
                        </div>

                html += `</div>`;
                container.innerHTML = html;

            async autoFillSingleVacancy(dia, linha, colunaLetra, nome) {
                if (!this.canUserEdit()) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Sem permissão de edição.', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                const oldText = 'Alocando...';
                if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`Alocando ${nome} no posto da linha ${linha}...`, 'info');

                try {
                    const url = this.webAppUrl;
                    const res = await fetch(url, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'update_slot', dia, linha, colunaLetra, nome })
                    });
                    const json = await res.json();
                    if (json && json.success) {
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`✓ ${nome} alocado com sucesso!`, 'success');
                        await this.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                        this.renderAiDrawer();
                    } else {
                        throw new Error(json.error || 'Falha ao alocar');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`Erro: ${e.message}`, 'error');
                }
            }

            async autoFillAllVacancies() {
                const dia = this.currentDay;
                const diaInfo = this.data && this.data.dias ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                const slots = (diaInfo && diaInfo.slots) ? diaInfo.slots : [];
                const vagas = slots.filter(s => s.isVago);
                const disponiveis = this.getAvailableCollaboratorsForDay(dia);

                if (vagas.length === 0 || disponiveis.length === 0) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Não há vagas ou colaboradores disponíveis.', 'warning');
                    return;
                }

                const updates = [];
                const limit = Math.min(vagas.length, disponiveis.length);
                for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
                    updates.push({
                        dia,
                        linha: vagas[i].linha,
                        colunaLetra: vagas[i].colunaLetra,
                        nome: disponiveis[i].nome
                    });
                }

                const btn = document.getElementById('btn-ai-autofill-all');
                if (btn) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Gravando na Planilha...';
                }

                try {
                    const res = await fetch(this.webAppUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'batch_update', updates })
                    });
                    const json = await res.json();
                    if (json && json.success) {
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`✓ ${limit} vagas preenchidas e salvas na planilha!`, 'success');
                        await this.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                        this.renderAiDrawer();
                    } else {
                        throw new Error(json.error || 'Falha na gravação em lote');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`Erro: ${e.message}`, 'error');
                } finally {
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles text-amber-300"></i> Preencher Todas as Vagas';
                    }
                }
            }

            renderAiBhReducer(container) {
                const dia = this.currentDay;
                const diaInfo = this.data && this.data.dias ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                const slots = (diaInfo && diaInfo.slots) ? diaInfo.slots.filter(s => !s.isVago && s.nome) : [];
                
                const seniorMap = {};
                try {
                    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_senior_bh') || '[]');
                    saved.forEach(s => {
                        const n = String(s.nome || '').toUpperCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").trim();
                        seniorMap[n] = s.saldo;
                        if (s.cracha) seniorMap[String(s.cracha).trim()] = s.saldo;
                    });
                } catch (eS) {}

                let html = `
                    <div class="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-950/40 via-indigo-950/30 to-gray-900 border border-purple-500/30 space-y-2">

                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-purple-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-clock text-purple-400"></i>
                                <span>Otimizador de Banco de Horas</span>
                            </span>
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400">${slots.length} alocados hoje</span>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-300 leading-relaxed">
                            Simule e aplique saídas antecipadas programadas (ex: <code>-1:00</code>, <code>-2:00</code>) individualmente ou para toda a equipe.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <!-- SEÇÃO 1: REDUÇÃO INDIVIDUAL -->

                        <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-user-clock text-teal-400"></i>
                            <span>Redução Individual de Colaborador</span>

                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-semibold mb-1">Escolha o colaborador alocado na ${dia}:</label>

                });

                html += `
                            </select>
                        </div>

                        <div id="ai-bh-preview-box" class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800/80 space-y-2 text-xs">
                            <p class="text-gray-400 text-[11px]">Selecione um colaborador acima para simular a saída antecipada.</p>
                        </div>

                        <div class="space-y-1.5">
                            <label class="block text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-semibold">Quanto abater do banco hoje?</label>
                            <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
                                <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.setAiBhValue('-0:30')" class="py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-teal-300 border border-gray-700">-0:30</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.setAiBhValue('-1:00')" class="py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-teal-300 border border-gray-700">-1:00</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.setAiBhValue('-1:30')" class="py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-teal-300 border border-gray-700">-1:30</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.setAiBhValue('-2:00')" class="py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-teal-300 border border-gray-700">-2:00</button>
                            </div>
                            <input type="text" id="ai-bh-custom-val" placeholder="Ou digite (ex: -1:15)" class="w-full bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-100 font-mono text-center focus:border-teal-500 transition mt-1.5">
                        </div>

                        <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.applyAiBhIndividual()" id="btn-ai-apply-bh-ind" class="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 active:scale-95 text-white font-bold text-xs transition shadow-lg shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>
                            <span>Gravar Redução na Planilha</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <!-- SEÇÃO 2: REDUÇÃO DA EQUIPE -->
                    <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 space-y-3">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">

                                <span>Redução em Lote da Equipe</span>
                            </h4>
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-300 bg-purple-950/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-purple-800/40">Meta %</span>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                            Aplica saídas antecipadas de 1h ou 30m nos colaboradores de maior banco, distribuindo os turnos para não desfalcar nenhum setor.
                        </p>

                            <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.applyAiBhTeam(10)" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-800 hover:bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 font-bold text-xs transition">
                                Reduzir 10%
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.applyAiBhTeam(25)" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-800 hover:bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 font-bold text-xs transition">
                                Reduzir 25%
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="scheduleApp.applyAiBhTeam(50)" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-800 hover:bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 font-bold text-xs transition">
                                Reduzir 50%
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;

                container.innerHTML = html;
            }

            onAiBhCollabChange(linha) {
                const box = document.getElementById('ai-bh-preview-box');
                if (!box || !linha) return;
                const dia = this.currentDay;
                const diaInfo = this.data && this.data.dias ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                const slot = (diaInfo && diaInfo.slots) ? diaInfo.slots.find(s => s.linha == linha) : null;
                if (!slot) return;

                box.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span class="text-gray-400">Colaborador:</span>
                        <span class="font-bold text-white">${this.escHtml(slot.nome)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span class="text-gray-400">Horário Normal:</span>
                        <span class="font-mono text-gray-200">${slot.entrada || '--:--'} às ${slot.saida || '--:--'}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span class="text-gray-400">Banco Atual da Célula:</span>
                        <span class="font-mono font-bold ${this.bancoClass(slot.banco)}">${slot.banco || '00:00'}</span>
                    </div>
                `;
            }

            setAiBhValue(val) {
                const input = document.getElementById('ai-bh-custom-val');
                if (input) input.value = val;
            }

            async applyAiBhIndividual() {
                const select = document.getElementById('ai-bh-collab-select');
                const valInput = document.getElementById('ai-bh-custom-val');
                if (!select || !select.value) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Selecione um colaborador primeiro.', 'warning');
                    return;
                }
                const linha = select.value;
                const valor = (valInput ? valInput.value : '').trim();
                if (!valor) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Informe o valor de banco (ex: -1:00).', 'warning');
                    return;
                }

                const btn = document.getElementById('btn-ai-apply-bh-ind');
                if (btn) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Gravando...';
                }

                try {
                    const dia = this.currentDay;
                    const res = await fetch(this.webAppUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'update_cell', dia, linha, campo: 'banco', valor })
                    });
                    const json = await res.json();
                    if (json && json.success) {
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`✓ Banco atualizado para ${valor}!`, 'success');
                        await this.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                        this.renderAiDrawer();
                    } else {
                        throw new Error(json.error || 'Erro ao atualizar');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`Erro: ${e.message}`, 'error');
                } finally {
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Gravar Redução na Planilha';
                    }
                }
            }

            async applyAiBhTeam(percent) {
                const dia = this.currentDay;
                const diaInfo = this.data && this.data.dias ? this.data.dias[dia] : null;
                const slots = (diaInfo && diaInfo.slots) ? diaInfo.slots.filter(s => !s.isVago && s.nome) : [];
                if (slots.length === 0) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Sem colaboradores alocados para reduzir.', 'warning');
                    return;
                }

                const qtdTarget = Math.max(1, Math.round((slots.length * percent) / 100));
                const confirmMsg = `Deseja programar saída antecipada (-1:00) para ${qtdTarget} colaborador(es) na ${dia} (${percent}% da equipe)?`;
                if (!confirm(confirmMsg)) return;

                const updates = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < qtdTarget; i++) {
                    updates.push({
                        dia,
                        linha: slots[i].linha,
                        banco: '-1:00'
                    });
                }

                if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`Aplicando redução na equipe...`, 'info');
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(this.webAppUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'batch_update', updates })
                    });
                    const json = await res.json();
                    if (json && json.success) {
                        if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`✓ ${qtdTarget} colaboradores tiveram -1:00 de BH programado!`, 'success');
                        await this.syncWithGoogleSheets(true);
                        this.renderAiDrawer();
                    } else {
                        throw new Error(json.error || 'Falha ao aplicar');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`Erro: ${e.message}`, 'error');
                }
            }

            async parseAndSaveSeniorBh() {
                const ta = document.getElementById('ai-senior-paste-input');
                const raw = ta ? ta.value : '';
                if (!raw || !raw.trim()) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Cole o conteúdo da tela do Senior na caixa.', 'warning');
                    return;
                }

                const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taskflow_senior_bh') || '[]');
                const map = {};
                existing.forEach(e => { if (e.cracha) map[e.cracha] = e; else if (e.nome) map[e.nome] = e; });

                const lines = raw.split(/[\r\n]+/);
                let added = 0;

                lines.forEach(line => {
                    const l = line.trim();
                    if (!l || l.toUpperCase().includes('COLABORADOR') || l.toUpperCase().includes('BANCO DE HORAS')) return;
                    
                    // Procura padrão de saldo no formato 00:00 ou similar
                    const parts = l.split(/[\t;]+/);
                    if (parts.length >= 2) {
                        const nome = parts[0].trim();
                        const cracha = (parts[1] && /^\d+$/.test(parts[1].trim())) ? parts[1].trim() : '';
                        // Procura coluna com horas (ex: 63:06)
                        const saldoMatch = l.match(/(\d{1,3}:\d{2})/g);
                        const saldo = saldoMatch ? saldoMatch[saldoMatch.length - 1] : '00:00';
                        if (nome && nome.length > 3) {
                            const key = cracha || nome;
                            map[key] = { cracha, nome, saldo };
                            added++;
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Linha única separada por espaços ou colada direto
                        const crachaM = l.match(/\b(\d{3,6})\b/);
                        const saldoM = l.match(/(\d{1,3}:\d{2})/g);
                        if (crachaM && saldoM) {
                            const cracha = crachaM[1];
                            const saldo = saldoM[saldoM.length - 1];
                            const nome = l.replace(cracha, '').replace(saldo, '').replace(/Detalhes/i, '').trim();
                            if (nome.length > 3) {
                                map[cracha] = { cracha, nome, saldo };
                                added++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });

                const finalList = Object.values(map);
                localStorage.setItem('taskflow_senior_bh', JSON.stringify(finalList));
                if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`✓ ${finalList.length} saldos do Senior salvos localmente!`, 'success');

                // Envia para o Google Sheets para atualizar a aba Senior_BH
                try {
                    await fetch(this.webAppUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'sync_senior_bh', saldos: finalList })
                    });
                } catch (eG) {
                    console.warn('Erro ao atualizar aba Senior_BH na planilha:', eG);
                }

                if (ta) ta.value = '';
                this.renderAiDrawer();
            }

            clearSeniorBh() {
                if (confirm('Deseja limpar todos os saldos do Senior salvos neste aparelho?')) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('taskflow_senior_bh');
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast('Saldos do Senior limpos.', 'info');
                    this.renderAiDrawer();
                }
            }

            async executeRemoteAudit() {
                const resBox = document.getElementById('ai-audit-results');
                const btn = document.getElementById('btn-ai-run-audit');
                if (btn) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Auditando planilha...';
                }

                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`${this.webAppUrl}?action=audit_sheet&t=${Date.now()}`);
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data && data.success) {
                        if (!resBox) return;
                        if (data.totalAlertas === 0) {
                            resBox.innerHTML = `
                                <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-teal-950/40 border border-teal-800 text-center text-teal-300 text-xs font-bold">
                                    ✓ Nenhum erro ou duplicidade encontrado na planilha!
                                </div>
                            `;
                        } else {
                            let listHtml = `
                                <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 text-xs space-y-2">
                                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-gray-200">
                                        <span>Alertas Encontrados (${data.totalAlertas}):</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="space-y-1.5 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                            `;
                            data.alertas.forEach(a => {
                                const isDupl = a.tipo === 'duplicidade';
                                listHtml += `
                                    <div class="p-2 rounded-lg ${isDupl ? 'bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-800/40 text-amber-200' : 'bg-rose-950/20 border border-rose-900/30 text-rose-300'} text-[11px] flex items-start gap-2">
                                        <i class="fa-solid ${isDupl ? 'fa-user-group text-amber-400' : 'fa-triangle-exclamation text-rose-400'} mt-0.5"></i>
                                        <div>
                                            <span class="font-bold uppercase">[${a.dia}]</span> ${this.escHtml(a.mensagem)}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                `;
                            });
                            listHtml += `</div></div>`;
                            resBox.innerHTML = listHtml;
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.notifications) notifications.showToast(`Erro: ${e.message}`, 'error');
                } finally {
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-shield-virus"></i> Disparar Auditoria na Planilha';
                    }
                }
            }
