        class PosterApp {
            constructor() {
                this.posters = [];
                this.currentTab = 'creator';
                this.currentType = 'oferta';
                this.currentSize = 'a4';
                this.editingId = null;
                this.isSyncing = false;
                this.baseCanvaImg = null;
            }

            init() {
                this.loadFromStorage();
                this.preloadBaseImage();
                this.updateLivePreview();
                this.renderQueue();
                this.renderHistory();
                this.updateBadges();
                this.syncWithCloud(false);
            }

            preloadBaseImage() {
                if (!this.baseCanvaImg) {
                    this.baseCanvaImg = new Image();
                    this.baseCanvaImg.onload = () => {
                        this.updateLivePreview();
                    };
                    this.baseCanvaImg.src = window.CANVA_BASE_IMG_DATA;
                }
            }

            loadFromStorage() {
                try {
                    const raw = localStorage.getItem('taskflow_posters_db');
                    if (raw) {
                        this.posters = JSON.parse(raw);
                    } else {
                        this.posters = [
                            {
                                id: 'post_1',
                                type: 'oferta',
                                title: 'CEBOLA ROXA COMUM KG',
                                dept: 'Hortifruti',
                                unit: 'KG',
                                priceFrom: '',
                                priceTo: '19,90',
                                expiry: '',
                                atacadoCond: '',
                                footer: 'Oferta válida enquanto durar o estoque • Supermercados Rondon',
                                size: 'a4',
                                status: 'pending',
                                author: 'Hortifruti',
                                createdAt: Date.now() - 3600000
                            }
                        ];
                        this.saveToStorage();
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    console.error('[PosterApp] Erro ao carregar do storage:', e);
                    this.posters = [];
                }
            }

            saveToStorage() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('taskflow_posters_db', JSON.stringify(this.posters));
                    this.updateBadges();
                } catch(e) {
                    console.error('[PosterApp] Erro ao salvar local:', e);
                }
            }

            getDefaultExpiry(daysAhead = 7) {
                const d = new Date();
                d.setDate(d.getDate() + daysAhead);
                const ano = d.getFullYear();
                const mes = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
                const dia = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
                return `${ano}-${mes}-${dia}`;
            }

            formatDateBR(dateStr) {
                if (!dateStr) return '';
                const parts = dateStr.split('-');
                if (parts.length === 3) return `${parts[2]}/${parts[1]}/${parts[0]}`;
                return dateStr;
            }

            parseMoney(str) {
                if (!str) return 0;
                const clean = String(str).replace(/[^0-9,.]/g, '').replace(',', '.');
                const val = parseFloat(clean);
                return isNaN(val) ? 0 : val;
            }

            switchTab(tab) {
                this.currentTab = tab;
                const tabCreator = document.getElementById('poster-tab-creator');
                const tabQueue = document.getElementById('poster-tab-queue');
                const tabHistory = document.getElementById('poster-tab-history');

                const btnCreator = document.getElementById('btn-tab-poster-creator');
                const btnQueue = document.getElementById('btn-tab-poster-queue');
                const btnHistory = document.getElementById('btn-tab-poster-history');

                if (tabCreator) tabCreator.classList.toggle('hidden', tab !== 'creator');
                if (tabQueue) tabQueue.classList.toggle('hidden', tab !== 'queue');
                if (tabHistory) tabHistory.classList.toggle('hidden', tab !== 'history');

                [btnCreator, btnQueue, btnHistory].forEach(b => {
                    if (b) {
                        b.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer";
                    }
                });

                if (tab === 'creator' && btnCreator) {
                    btnCreator.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500 text-black transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm";
                    this.updateLivePreview();
                } else if (tab === 'queue' && btnQueue) {
                    btnQueue.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500 text-black transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm";
                    this.renderQueue();
                } else if (tab === 'history' && btnHistory) {
                    btnHistory.className = "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500 text-black transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm";
                    this.renderHistory();
                }
            }

            setType(type) {
                this.currentType = type;
                ['vencimento', 'oferta', 'normal', 'atacado'].forEach(t => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById(`btn-type-${t}`);

            resetForm() {
                const titleInput = document.getElementById('poster-input-title');
                const priceFromInput = document.getElementById('poster-input-price-from');
                const priceToInput = document.getElementById('poster-input-price-to');
                const expiryInput = document.getElementById('poster-input-expiry');

                if (titleInput) titleInput.value = 'CEBOLA ROXA COMUM KG';
                if (priceFromInput) priceFromInput.value = '';
                if (priceToInput) priceToInput.value = '19,90';
                if (expiryInput) expiryInput.value = '';

                this.setType('oferta');
                this.updateLivePreview();
            }

            renderToCanvas(canvas, item) {
                if (!canvas) return;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                if (!ctx) return;

                const title = item.title || 'CEBOLA ROXA COMUM KG';
                const dept = item.dept || 'Hortifruti';
                const priceFromStr = item.priceFrom || '';
                const priceToStr = item.priceTo || '19,90';
                const expiry = item.expiry || '';

                const parts = priceToStr.split(',');
                const reais = parts[0] || '0';
                const centavos = parts[1] || '00';

                const pFrom = this.parseMoney(priceFromStr);
                const pTo = this.parseMoney(priceToStr);

                const executeDraw = () => {
                    // 1. Desenhar a arte oficial original do Canva em 1131x1600
                    ctx.drawImage(this.baseCanvaImg, 0, 0, 1131, 1600);

                    // 2. Limpar a área inferior (produto e preço) a partir de Y = 770 até 1600
                    // Usando o gradiente vertical linear idêntico ao original do Canva (#fef155 -> #ffe32a)
                    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 770, 0, 1600);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, '#fef155');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.3, '#feee51');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#fee73c');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, '#ffe32a');

                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 768, 1131, 832);

                    // 3. Categoria no topo:
                    // Se o setor for DIFERENTE de Hortifruti ou se for Vencimento:
                    if (dept !== 'Hortifruti' || item.type === 'vencimento') {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                        ctx.fillRect(160, 315, 811, 115);

                        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
                        ctx.font = '900 50px "Montserrat", "Arial Black", sans-serif';
                        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                        const catCall = item.type === 'vencimento' ? 'PRODUTO PRÓXIMO AO' : (dept.toUpperCase() + ' EM');
                        ctx.fillText(catCall, 565, 375);
                    }

                    // Se for vencimento, desenhar a pílula de vencimento com espaçamento perfeito
                    let prodCenterY = 910;
                    if (item.type === 'vencimento') {
                        const expBr = this.formatDateBR(expiry) || 'DATA NA EMBALAGEM';
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.roundRect(165, 785, 801, 74, 37);
                        ctx.fill();

                        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFE500';
                        ctx.font = '900 34px "Montserrat", sans-serif';
                        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                        ctx.fillText('⚠️ CONSUMIR ATÉ: ' + expBr, 565, 822);
                        ctx.restore();

                        prodCenterY = 965;
                    }

                    // Preço DE / Desconto: SÓ EXIBE SE O PREÇO DE FOR REALMENTE MAIOR QUE O PREÇO POR!
                    if (pFrom > pTo && pTo > 0) {
                        const diff = pFrom - pTo;
                        const pct = Math.round((diff / pFrom) * 100);
                        if (pct > 0) {
                            ctx.save();
                            ctx.font = '900 38px "Montserrat", sans-serif';
                            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                            ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
                            ctx.fillText('DE: R$ ' + priceFromStr + '   (' + pct + '% OFF)', 565, 1055);
                            ctx.restore();
                        }
                    }

                    // 4. Desenhar o Nome do Produto (em 1 ou 2 linhas bem distribuído no centro)
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
                    ctx.font = '900 64px "Montserrat", "Arial Black", sans-serif';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

                    let line1 = title;
                    let line2 = '';
                    if (title.length > 13) {
                        const words = title.split(' ');
                        if (words.length >= 2) {
                            const mid = Math.ceil(words.length / 2);
                            line1 = words.slice(0, mid).join(' ');
                            line2 = words.slice(mid).join(' ');
                        }
                    }

                    if (line2) {
                        ctx.fillText(line1, 565, prodCenterY - 40);
                        ctx.fillText(line2, 565, prodCenterY + 42);
                    } else {
                        ctx.fillText(line1, 565, prodCenterY);
                    }
                    ctx.restore();

                    // 5. Desenhar o Bloco de Preço Idêntico ao da Foto
                    // Ajuste de tamanho dinâmico para caber perfeitamente se for 100 ou mais
                    const isThreeDigits = reais.length >= 3;
                    const reaisFontSize = isThreeDigits ? 280 : 330;
                    const centavosFontSize = isThreeDigits ? 130 : 150;
                    const circleDiam = isThreeDigits ? 130 : 150;
                    const priceBaselineY = 1390;

                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.font = '900 ' + reaisFontSize + 'px "Impact", "Arial Black", sans-serif';
                    const reaisWidth = ctx.measureText(reais).width;

                    ctx.font = '900 ' + centavosFontSize + 'px "Impact", "Arial Black", sans-serif';
                    const centavosWidth = ctx.measureText(',' + centavos).width;

                    const totalBlockWidth = circleDiam + 25 + reaisWidth + 10 + centavosWidth;
                    const startX = Math.max(40, (1131 - totalBlockWidth) / 2);

                    // A) Círculo Vermelho com R$ Amarelo
                    const circleCenterX = startX + (circleDiam / 2);
                    const circleCenterY = priceBaselineY - (isThreeDigits ? 115 : 135);

                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(circleCenterX, circleCenterY, circleDiam / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#E51920';
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
                    ctx.stroke();

                    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFE500';
                    ctx.font = '900 ' + (isThreeDigits ? 50 : 58) + 'px "Impact", sans-serif';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    ctx.fillText('R$', circleCenterX, circleCenterY + 3);

                    // B) Número Reais (ex: "100" ou "19") em Vermelho com Sombra Dura Preta
                    const reaisX = startX + circleDiam + 25;

                    ctx.font = '900 ' + reaisFontSize + 'px "Impact", "Arial Black", sans-serif';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';

                    // Sombra dura preta (offset)
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
                    ctx.fillText(reais, reaisX + 16, priceBaselineY + 16);

                    // Número Vermelho
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#E51920';
                    ctx.fillText(reais, reaisX, priceBaselineY);

                    // C) Centavos (ex: ",00" ou ",90") com Sombra Dura Preta
                    const centavosX = reaisX + reaisWidth + 10;
                    const centavosBaselineY = priceBaselineY - (isThreeDigits ? 120 : 140);

                    ctx.font = '900 ' + centavosFontSize + 'px "Impact", "Arial Black", sans-serif';
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
                    ctx.fillText(',' + centavos, centavosX + 8, centavosBaselineY + 8);

                    ctx.fillStyle = '#E51920';
                    ctx.fillText(',' + centavos, centavosX, centavosBaselineY);

                    ctx.restore();
                };

                if (this.baseCanvaImg && this.baseCanvaImg.complete) {
                    executeDraw();
                } else {
                    this.baseCanvaImg = new Image();
                    this.baseCanvaImg.onload = executeDraw;
                    this.baseCanvaImg.src = window.CANVA_BASE_IMG_DATA;
                }
            }

            updateLivePreview() {
                const liveCanvas = document.getElementById('poster-live-canvas');
                if (!liveCanvas) return;

                const item = {
                    title: (document.getElementById('poster-input-title')?.value || '').trim() || 'CEBOLA ROXA COMUM KG',
                    dept: document.getElementById('poster-input-dept')?.value || 'Hortifruti',
                    unit: document.getElementById('poster-input-unit')?.value || 'KG',
                    priceFrom: (document.getElementById('poster-input-price-from')?.value || '').trim(),
                    priceTo: (document.getElementById('poster-input-price-to')?.value || '').trim() || '19,90',
                    expiry: document.getElementById('poster-input-expiry')?.value || '',
                    type: this.currentType
                };

                this.renderToCanvas(liveCanvas, item);
            }

            buildPrintableHtml(item, isSingle = true) {
                // Criar um canvas temporário em memória para renderizar a imagem em alta resolução 1131x1600
                const offscreenCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                offscreenCanvas.width = 1131;
                offscreenCanvas.height = 1600;
                this.renderToCanvas(offscreenCanvas, item);

                const dataUrl = offscreenCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                const pageBreakClass = isSingle ? '' : 'poster-page-break';

                return `
                    <div class="${pageBreakClass}" style="width: 100%; min-height: 100vh; background-color: #ffffff; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; page-break-inside: avoid; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; box-sizing: border-box;">
                        <img src="${dataUrl}" style="width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 100vh; object-fit: contain; margin: 0 auto; display: block;" />
                    </div>
                `;
            }

            printCurrent() {
                const title = (document.getElementById('poster-input-title')?.value || '').trim();
                const priceTo = (document.getElementById('poster-input-price-to')?.value || '').trim();
                if (!title || !priceTo) {
                    alert('Por favor, informe ao menos o Nome do Produto e o Preço POR.');
                    return;
                }

                const liveCanvas = document.getElementById('poster-live-canvas');
                if (!liveCanvas) return;

                const printArea = document.getElementById('poster-printable-area');
                if (!printArea) return;

                const imgUrl = liveCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
                printArea.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="width: 100%; min-height: 100vh; background: #ffffff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;">
                        <img src="${imgUrl}" style="width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 100vh; object-fit: contain; display: block; margin: 0 auto;" />
                    </div>
                `;
                printArea.style.display = 'block';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.print();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        printArea.style.display = 'none';
                        printArea.innerHTML = '';
                    }, 1000);
                }, 300);
            }

            printPosterById(id) {
                const item = this.posters.find(p => p.id === id);
                if (!item) return;

                const printArea = document.getElementById('poster-printable-area');
                if (!printArea) return;

                printArea.innerHTML = this.buildPrintableHtml(item, true);
                printArea.style.display = 'block';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.print();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        printArea.style.display = 'none';
                        printArea.innerHTML = '';
                    }, 1000);
                }, 400);
            }

            printAllPending() {
                const pending = this.posters.filter(p => p.status === 'pending');
                if (pending.length === 0) {
                    alert('Não há cartazes pendentes na fila de impressão.');
                    return;
                }

                const printArea = document.getElementById('poster-printable-area');
                if (!printArea) return;

                let html = '';
                pending.forEach((item, idx) => {
                    html += this.buildPrintableHtml(item, false);
                });

                printArea.innerHTML = html;
                printArea.style.display = 'block';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.print();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        printArea.style.display = 'none';
                        printArea.innerHTML = '';
                        pending.forEach(p => p.status = 'printed');
                        this.saveToStorage();
                        this.renderQueue();
                        this.renderHistory();
                    }, 1000);
                }, 500);
            }

            saveToQueue() {
                const title = (document.getElementById('poster-input-title')?.value || '').trim();
                const priceTo = (document.getElementById('poster-input-price-to')?.value || '').trim();

                if (!title || !priceTo) {
                    alert('Informe ao menos o Nome do Produto e o Preço POR para salvar na fila.');
                    return;
                }

                const authorName = (window.auth && auth.currentUser) ? auth.currentUser.name : 'Equipe Loja';

                const newPoster = {
                    id: 'post_' + Date.now(),
                    type: this.currentType,
                    title: title.toUpperCase(),
                    dept: document.getElementById('poster-input-dept')?.value || 'Hortifruti',
                    unit: document.getElementById('poster-input-unit')?.value || 'KG',
                    priceFrom: document.getElementById('poster-input-price-from')?.value || '',
                    priceTo: priceTo,
                    expiry: document.getElementById('poster-input-expiry')?.value || '',
                    atacadoCond: document.getElementById('poster-input-atacado-cond')?.value || '',
                    footer: document.getElementById('poster-input-footer')?.value || 'Oferta válida enquanto durar o estoque • Supermercados Rondon',
                    size: this.currentSize,
                    status: 'pending',
                    author: authorName,
                    createdAt: Date.now()
                };

                this.posters.unshift(newPoster);
                this.saveToStorage();

                if (window.syncManager) {
                    syncManager.showToast('✓ Cartaz salvo na fila! Abrindo no PC da impressora...');
                }

                this.syncWithCloud(true);
                this.switchTab('queue');
            }

            deletePoster(id) {
                if (!confirm('Deseja realmente excluir esta solicitação de cartaz?')) return;
                this.posters = this.posters.filter(p => p.id !== id);
                this.saveToStorage();
                this.renderQueue();
                this.renderHistory();
                this.syncWithCloud(true);
            }

            markAsPrinted(id) {
                const item = this.posters.find(p => p.id === id);
                if (item) {
                    item.status = 'printed';
                    this.saveToStorage();
                    this.renderQueue();
                    this.renderHistory();
                    this.syncWithCloud(true);
                }
            }

            reprintPoster(id) {
                const item = this.posters.find(p => p.id === id);
                if (item) {
                    item.status = 'pending';
                    this.saveToStorage();
                    this.renderQueue();
                    this.renderHistory();
                    this.switchTab('queue');
                }
            }

            renderQueue() {
                const list = document.getElementById('poster-queue-list');
                const empty = document.getElementById('poster-queue-empty');
                const badge = document.getElementById('poster-queue-count');

                const pending = this.posters.filter(p => p.status === 'pending');
                if (badge) badge.innerText = pending.length;

                if (!list) return;

                if (pending.length === 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = '';
                    if (empty) empty.classList.remove('hidden');
                    return;
                }

                if (empty) empty.classList.add('hidden');

                list.innerHTML = pending.map(item => `
                    <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 hover:border-amber-500/40 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 transition">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/40 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-sm shrink-0">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-tags"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="min-w-0">
                                <h4 class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-white truncate">${item.title}</h4>
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
                                    <span class="text-amber-400 font-extrabold text-xs">R$ ${item.priceTo}</span>
                                    <span>• ${item.unit}</span>
                                    <span>• ${item.dept}</span>
                                    <span class="text-gray-500">• Por: ${item.author}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end shrink-0">
                            <button type="button" onclick="posterApp.printPosterById('${item.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-black font-extrabold rounded-lg text-xs transition flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-print"></i>
                                <span>Imprimir</span>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="posterApp.markAsPrinted('${item.id}')" title="Marcar como impresso" class="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-emerald-400 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="posterApp.deletePoster('${item.id}')" title="Excluir" class="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-rose-400 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }

            renderHistory() {
                const list = document.getElementById('poster-history-list');
                const empty = document.getElementById('poster-history-empty');

                const history = this.posters.filter(p => p.status === 'printed');
                if (!list) return;

                if (history.length === 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = '';
                    if (empty) empty.classList.remove('hidden');
                    return;
                }

                if (empty) empty.classList.add('hidden');

                list.innerHTML = history.map(item => `
                    <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                            <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shrink-0">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-check-double text-emerald-400"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="min-w-0">
                                <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-300 truncate">${item.title}</h4>
                                <div class="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                                    <span>R$ ${item.priceTo}</span> • <span>${item.dept}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
                            <button type="button" onclick="posterApp.reprintPoster('${item.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition flex items-center gap-1">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-left"></i>
                                <span>Reimprimir</span>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="posterApp.deletePoster('${item.id}')" class="p-1 text-gray-500 hover:text-rose-400 rounded">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-trash text-xs"></i>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }

            updateBadges() {
                const pending = this.posters.filter(p => p.status === 'pending').length;
                const badgeQueue = document.getElementById('poster-queue-count');
                const badgeSidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar-tools-badge');
                const badgeTopbar = document.getElementById('topbar-tools-badge');
                const badgeMob = document.getElementById('mob-tools-badge');

                if (badgeQueue) badgeQueue.innerText = pending;
                [badgeSidebar, badgeTopbar, badgeMob].forEach(b => {
                    if (b) {
                        b.innerText = pending;
                        b.classList.toggle('hidden', pending === 0);
                    }
                });
            }

            syncWithCloud(interactive = false) {
                if (this.isSyncing) return;
                this.isSyncing = true;
                try {
                    // Sincronização via script / nuvem
                } catch(e) {
                    console.warn('[PosterApp] Erro sync nuvem:', e);
                } finally {
                    this.isSyncing = false;
                }
            }
        }window.posterApp = new PosterApp();
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            if (window.posterApp) window.posterApp.init();
        });


    </script>
